sourceRange.text: 壬寅，征西大將軍、高涼王那等討吐谷渾慕利延。軍到蔓頭城，慕利延驅其部落西度流沙，那急追，故西秦王莫璝世子被囊逆軍拒戰，那擊破之。中山公杜豐追度三危，至雪山，禽被囊及慕利延兄子什歸、熾盤子成龍，送於京師。慕利延遂西入于闐國。九月，盧水胡蓋吳聚眾反於杏城。冬十一月，高涼王那振旅還京師。庚申，遼東王竇漏頭薨。河東蜀薛永宗聚黨入汾曲。西通蓋吳，受其位號。蓋吳自號天臺王，署百官。辛未，車駕還宮。選六州兵勇猛者，使永昌王仁、高涼王那分領為二道，南略淮、泗以北。徙青、徐之人以實河北。癸未，西巡。

context.beforeSource: 令人北徙畜牧至廣漠，以餌蠕蠕。
context.afterSource: 七年春正月戊辰，車駕次東雍，禽薛永宗，斬之。

manualTranslations.zh: 壬寅，征西大將軍、高涼王那等討吐谷渾慕利延。
manualTranslations.literal: On the renyin day, Na, General-in-Chief Who Conquers the West and Prince of Gaoliang, and others campaigned against Muli Yan of the Tuyuhun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Na, General-in-Chief Who Conquers the West and Prince of Gaoliang, and others campaigned against Muli Yan of the Tuyuhun.

manualTranslations.zh: 軍到蔓頭城，慕利延驅其部落西度流沙，那急追，故西秦王莫璝世子被囊逆軍拒戰，那擊破之。
manualTranslations.literal: When the army reached Mantou City, Muli Yan drove his tribes west across the flowing sands. Na pursued hard; Beinan, heir of Mogui, the former King of Western Qin, met the army and resisted in battle, and Na defeated him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the army reached Mantou City, Muli Yan drove his tribes west across the flowing sands. Na pursued hard; Beinan, heir of Mogui, the former King of Western Qin, met the army and resisted in battle, and Na defeated him.

manualTranslations.zh: 中山公杜豐追度三危，至雪山，禽被囊及慕利延兄子什歸、熾盤子成龍，送於京師。
manualTranslations.literal: Du Feng, Duke of Zhongshan, pursued them across Sanwei to Snow Mountain, captured Beinan, Shigui, son of Muli Yan's elder brother, and Chenglong, son of Chipan, and sent them to the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Du Feng, Duke of Zhongshan, pursued them across Sanwei to Snow Mountain, captured Beinan, Shigui, son of Muli Yan's elder brother, and Chenglong, son of Chipan, and sent them to the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 慕利延遂西入于闐國。
manualTranslations.literal: Muli Yan then went west into Khotan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Muli Yan then went west into Khotan.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月，盧水胡蓋吳聚眾反於杏城。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, Gai Wu of the Lushui Hu gathered a following and rebelled at Xingcheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Gai Wu of the Lushui Hu gathered a following and rebelled at Xingcheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十一月，高涼王那振旅還京師。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the eleventh month, Na, Prince of Gaoliang, returned the army to the capital in triumph.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the eleventh month, Na, Prince of Gaoliang, returned the army to the capital in triumph.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚申，遼東王竇漏頭薨。
manualTranslations.literal: On the gengshen day, Dou Loutou, Prince of Liaodong, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Dou Loutou, Prince of Liaodong, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 河東蜀薛永宗聚黨入汾曲。
manualTranslations.literal: Xue Yongzong of Hedong Shu gathered followers and entered the bend of the Fen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xue Yongzong of Hedong Shu gathered followers and entered the bend of the Fen.

manualTranslations.zh: 西通蓋吳，受其位號。
manualTranslations.literal: To the west he communicated with Gai Wu and accepted his titles and ranks.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: To the west he communicated with Gai Wu and accepted his titles and ranks.

manualTranslations.zh: 蓋吳自號天臺王，署百官。
manualTranslations.literal: Gai Wu styled himself King of Tiantai and appointed the hundred officials.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gai Wu styled himself King of Tiantai and appointed the hundred officials.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛未，車駕還宮。
manualTranslations.literal: On the xinwei day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 選六州兵勇猛者，使永昌王仁、高涼王那分領為二道，南略淮、泗以北。
manualTranslations.literal: The bravest soldiers from six prefectures were selected, and Ren, Prince of Yongchang, and Na, Prince of Gaoliang, were made to lead them separately in two columns to raid southward north of the Huai and Si rivers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The bravest soldiers from six prefectures were selected, and Ren, Prince of Yongchang, and Na, Prince of Gaoliang, were made to lead them separately in two columns to raid southward north of the Huai and Si rivers.

manualTranslations.zh: 徙青、徐之人以實河北。
manualTranslations.literal: People from Qingzhou and Xuzhou were moved to fill Hebei.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: People from Qingzhou and Xuzhou were moved to fill Hebei.

manualTranslations.zh: 癸未，西巡。
manualTranslations.literal: On the guiwei day, the emperor made a western tour.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, the emperor made a western tour.

sourceRange.text: 皇興元年春正月癸巳，鎮南大將軍尉元大破宋將張永、沈攸之於呂梁東。宋人來聘。庚子，東平王道符謀反於長安，其司馬段太陽斬之，傳首京師。道符兄弟皆伏誅。閏月，以頓丘王李峻為太宰。二月，濟陰王小新成薨。宋東平太守申纂戍無鹽，遏絕王使，詔征南大將軍慕容白曜督諸軍往討。三月甲寅，克之。秋八月丁酉，幸武州山石窟寺。戊申，皇子宏生。大赦，改元。九月己巳，進馮翊公李白為梁郡王。冬十月己亥朔，日有蝕之。癸卯，田於那男池。濮陽王孔雀坐怠慢降為公。

context.beforeSource: 是歲，州鎮十一旱，人饑，開倉振恤。
context.afterSource: 二年春二月癸未，田於西山，親射武豹。

manualTranslations.literal: Envoys from Song came on a friendly mission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Envoys from Song came on a friendly mission.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚子，東平王道符謀反於長安，其司馬段太陽斬之，傳首京師。
manualTranslations.literal: On the gengzi day, Daofu, Prince of Dongping, plotted rebellion at Chang'an; his Marshal Duan Taiyang beheaded him and sent his head to the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Daofu, Prince of Dongping, plotted rebellion at Chang'an; his Marshal Duan Taiyang beheaded him and sent his head to the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 道符兄弟皆伏誅。
manualTranslations.literal: Daofu's brothers were all executed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Daofu's brothers were all executed.

manualTranslations.zh: 閏月，以頓丘王李峻為太宰。
manualTranslations.literal: In the intercalary month, Li Jun, Prince of Dunqiu, was made Grand Preceptor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, Li Jun, Prince of Dunqiu, was made Grand Preceptor.

manualTranslations.zh: 二月，濟陰王小新成薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month, Xiaoxincheng, Prince of Jiyin, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month, Xiaoxincheng, Prince of Jiyin, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 宋東平太守申纂戍無鹽，遏絕王使，詔征南大將軍慕容白曜督諸軍往討。
manualTranslations.literal: Shen Zuan, Song Administrator of Dongping, was garrisoning Wuyan and cut off the royal envoys; an edict ordered Murong Baiyao, General-in-Chief Who Conquers the South, to command the armies in campaigning against him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shen Zuan, Song Administrator of Dongping, was garrisoning Wuyan and cut off the royal envoys; an edict ordered Murong Baiyao, General-in-Chief Who Conquers the South, to command the armies in campaigning against him.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月甲寅，克之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, on the jiayin day, it was taken.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jiayin day, it was taken.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋八月丁酉，幸武州山石窟寺。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the eighth month, on the dingyou day, the emperor visited the grotto monastery at Mount Wuzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the eighth month, on the dingyou day, the emperor visited the grotto monastery at Mount Wuzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊申，皇子宏生。
manualTranslations.literal: On the wushen day, the imperial son Hong was born.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, the imperial son Hong was born.

manualTranslations.zh: 大赦，改元。
manualTranslations.literal: A great amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A great amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月己巳，進馮翊公李白為梁郡王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, on the jisi day, Li Bai, Duke of Fengyi, was promoted to Prince of Liang Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jisi day, Li Bai, Duke of Fengyi, was promoted to Prince of Liang Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十月己亥朔，日有蝕之。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the tenth month, on the jihai day, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on the jihai day, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

manualTranslations.zh: 癸卯，田於那男池。
manualTranslations.literal: On the guimao day, the emperor hunted at Nanan Pond.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, the emperor hunted at Nanan Pond.

manualTranslations.zh: 濮陽王孔雀坐怠慢降為公。
manualTranslations.literal: Kongque, Prince of Puyang, was demoted to duke for negligence.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Kongque, Prince of Puyang, was demoted to duke for negligence.

sourceRange.text: 五年春正月丁亥，封皇弟雲為任城王。二月，詔以州鎮十四去歲蟲水，開倉振恤。夏四月癸卯，進封頓丘公李峻為王。閏月戊子，帝以旱故，減膳責身。是夜，澍雨大降。五月，宋孝武帝殂。六月丁亥，行幸陰山。秋七月壬寅，行幸河西。九月辛丑，車駕還宮。冬十月，瑯邪侯司馬楚之薨。十二月，南秦王楊難當薨。吐呼羅國遣使朝貢。

context.beforeSource: 今制皇族師傅王公侯伯及士庶之家，不得與百工伎巧卑姓為婚，犯者加罪。
context.afterSource: 六年春正月丙申，大赦。

manualTranslations.zh: 閏月戊子，帝以旱故，減膳責身。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the wuzi day, because of drought, the emperor reduced his meals and blamed himself.

manualTranslations.zh: 是夜，澍雨大降。

manualTranslations.zh: 六月丁亥，行幸陰山。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, on the dinghai day, the emperor went to Yinshan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the dinghai day, the emperor went to Yinshan.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月壬寅，行幸河西。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the renyin day, the emperor went to Hexi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the renyin day, the emperor went to Hexi.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月辛丑，車駕還宮。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, on the xinchou day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the xinchou day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十月，瑯邪侯司馬楚之薨。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, Sima Chuzhi, Marquis of Langye, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月，南秦王楊難當薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, Yang Nandang, Prince of Southern Qin, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Yang Nandang, Prince of Southern Qin, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 吐呼羅國遣使朝貢。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: The state of Tuhuluo sent envoys to court with tribute.

sourceRange.text: 始光元年春正月丙寅，安定王彌薨。夏四月甲辰，東巡，幸大寧。六月，宋徐羨之弒其主義符。秋七月，車駕還宮。八月，蠕蠕六萬騎入雲中，殺略人吏，攻陷盛樂。帝帥輕騎討之，虜乃退走。九月，大簡輿徒於東郊，將北討。冬十二月，遣平陽王長孫翰等討蠕蠕，車騎次祚山，蠕蠕北遁，諸軍追之，大獲而還。

context.beforeSource: 河南流人相率內屬者甚眾。
context.afterSource: 二年春正月己卯，車駕至自北伐。

manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Shiguang, in spring, in the first month, on the bingyin day, Prince Mi of Anding died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shiguang, in spring, in the first month, on the bingyin day, Prince Mi of Anding died.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月甲辰，東巡，幸大寧。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, on the jiachen day, the emperor toured east and visited Daning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on the jiachen day, the emperor toured east and visited Daning.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月，宋徐羨之弒其主義符。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, Xu Xianzhi of Song assassinated his ruler Yifu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Xu Xianzhi of Song assassinated his ruler Yifu.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月，車駕還宮。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the seventh month, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 八月，蠕蠕六萬騎入雲中，殺略人吏，攻陷盛樂。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month, sixty thousand Rouran cavalry entered Yunzhong, killed and plundered the people and officials, and captured Shengle.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, sixty thousand Rouran cavalry entered Yunzhong, killed and plundered the people and officials, and captured Shengle.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝帥輕騎討之，虜乃退走。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor led light cavalry to campaign against them, and the enemy then retreated.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor led light cavalry to campaign against them, and the enemy then retreated.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月，大簡輿徒於東郊，將北討。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, there was a great review of troops and transport in the eastern suburbs, in preparation for a northern campaign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, there was a great review of troops and transport in the eastern suburbs, in preparation for a northern campaign.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十二月，遣平陽王長孫翰等討蠕蠕，車騎次祚山，蠕蠕北遁，諸軍追之，大獲而還。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the twelfth month, Changsun Han, Prince of Pingyang, and others were sent against the Rouran. The chariots and cavalry halted at Zuoshan; the Rouran fled north, and the armies pursued them and returned with great spoils.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the twelfth month, Changsun Han, Prince of Pingyang, and others were sent against the Rouran. The chariots and cavalry halted at Zuoshan; the Rouran fled north, and the armies pursued them and returned with great spoils.

sourceRange.text: 三年春正月乙丑，東陽潰，虜沈文秀。戊辰，司空、平昌公和其奴薨。二月己卯，進上黨公慕容白曜爵為濟南王。夏四月壬辰，宋人來聘。丙申，名皇子宏，大赦。丁酉，田於崞山。五月，徙青、齊人於京師。六月辛未，立皇子宏為皇太子。

manualTranslations.zh: 二月己卯，進上黨公慕容白曜爵為濟南王。

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月壬辰，宋人來聘。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, on the renchen day, envoys from Song came on a friendly mission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on the renchen day, envoys from Song came on a friendly mission.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙申，名皇子宏，大赦。
manualTranslations.literal: On the bingshen day, the imperial son was named Hong, and a great amnesty was proclaimed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, the imperial son was named Hong, and a great amnesty was proclaimed.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁酉，田於崞山。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, the emperor hunted at Mount Guo.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月，徙青、齊人於京師。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month, people from Qing and Qi were moved to the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, people from Qing and Qi were moved to the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月辛未，立皇子宏為皇太子。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, on the xinwei day, the imperial son Hong was installed as crown prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the xinwei day, the imperial son Hong was installed as crown prince.

sourceRange.text: 和平元年春正月甲子朔，大赦改元。庚午，詔散騎侍郎馮闡使於宋。夏四月戊戌，皇太后常氏崩於壽安宮。五月癸酉，葬昭太后於廣寧鳴雞山。六月甲午，詔征西大將軍、陽平王新成等討吐谷渾什寅。崔浩之誅也，史官遂廢，至是復置。秋七月，西征諸軍至西平，什寅走保南山。九月庚申朔，日有蝕之。是月，諸軍濟河，追什寅。遇瘴氣，多病疫，乃引還。庚午，車駕還宮。冬十月，居常王獻馴象三。

manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Heping, in spring, in the first month, on the jiazi day, the first day of the month, a great amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Heping, in spring, in the first month, on the jiazi day, the first day of the month, a great amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, an edict sent Feng Chan, Mounted Attendant Gentleman, as envoy to Song.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月戊戌，皇太后常氏崩於壽安宮。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, on the wuxu day, Empress Dowager Chang died at Shouan Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on the wuxu day, Empress Dowager Chang died at Shouan Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月癸酉，葬昭太后於廣寧鳴雞山。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month, on the guiyou day, Empress Dowager Zhao was buried at Mingji Mountain in Guangning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the guiyou day, Empress Dowager Zhao was buried at Mingji Mountain in Guangning.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月甲午，詔征西大將軍、陽平王新成等討吐谷渾什寅。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, on the jiawu day, an edict ordered Xincheng, General-in-Chief Who Conquers the West and Prince of Yangping, and others to campaign against Shiyin of the Tuyuhun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiawu day, an edict ordered Xincheng, General-in-Chief Who Conquers the West and Prince of Yangping, and others to campaign against Shiyin of the Tuyuhun.

manualTranslations.zh: 崔浩之誅也，史官遂廢，至是復置。
manualTranslations.literal: When Cui Hao was executed, the historiographical office was abolished; at this time it was restored.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Cui Hao was executed, the historiographical office was abolished; at this time it was restored.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月，西征諸軍至西平，什寅走保南山。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the seventh month, the western campaign armies reached Xiping, and Shiyin fled to defend himself in the southern mountains.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, the western campaign armies reached Xiping, and Shiyin fled to defend himself in the southern mountains.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月庚申朔，日有蝕之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, on the gengshen day, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the gengshen day, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

manualTranslations.zh: 是月，諸軍濟河，追什寅。
manualTranslations.literal: That month, the armies crossed the river and pursued Shiyin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That month, the armies crossed the river and pursued Shiyin.

manualTranslations.zh: 遇瘴氣，多病疫，乃引還。
manualTranslations.literal: They encountered miasma and many fell ill, so the forces withdrew and returned.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They encountered miasma and many fell ill, so the forces withdrew and returned.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚午，車駕還宮。
manualTranslations.literal: On the gengwu day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十月，居常王獻馴象三。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the tenth month, the king of Juchang presented three trained elephants.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, the king of Juchang presented three trained elephants.

sourceRange.text: 延和元年春正月丙午，尊保太后為皇太后，立皇后赫連氏，以皇子晃為皇太子，謁於太廟，大赦改元。三月丁未，追贈夫人賀氏為皇后。壬申，西秦王吐谷渾慕璝送赫連定於京師。夏五月，宋人來聘。六月庚寅，車駕伐和龍。詔尚書左僕射安原等屯於漠南，以備蠕蠕。辛卯，詔兼散騎常侍鄧穎使於宋。秋七月己巳，車駕至和龍，穿塹以守之。是月，築東宮。九月乙卯，車駕西還。徙營丘、成周、遼東、樂浪、帶方、玄菟六郡人三萬家於幽州，開倉以振之。冬十月，吐谷渾慕璝遣使朝貢。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, Mugui of the Tuyuhun sent envoys to court with tribute.

sourceRange.text: 四年春正月，州鎮大饑，詔開倉振恤。二月，以東郡王陸定國為司空公。詔征西大將軍、上黨王長孫觀討吐谷渾什寅。廣陽王石侯薨。三月丙戌，詔天下人病者，所在官司遣醫就家診視，所須藥任醫所量給之。夏四月辛丑，大赦。戊申，長孫觀軍至曼頭山，大破什寅。五月，封皇弟長樂為建昌王。六月，宋人來聘。秋八月，蠕蠕犯塞。九月丙寅，車駕北伐，諸將俱會於女水，大破虜軍。司徒、東安公劉尼坐事免。壬申，車駕至自北伐，飲至策勛，告於宗廟。冬十月，誅濟南王慕容白曜、高平公李敷。十一月，詔弛山澤禁。十二月甲辰，幸鹿野苑、石窟寺。陽平王新成薨。五年春二月乙亥，詔假員外散騎常侍邢佑使於宋。夏四月，北平王長孫敦薨。

context.beforeSource: 十一月，進襄城公韓頹爵為王。
context.afterSource: 六月丁未，行幸河西。
context.beforeLocal: 十一月，進襄城公韓頹爵為王。
context.afterLocal: 六月丁未，行幸河西。

manualTranslations.zh: 四年春正月，州鎮大饑，詔開倉振恤。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, in spring, in the first month, the prefectures and garrisons suffered a great famine, and an edict ordered the granaries opened for relief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, in spring, in the first month, the prefectures and garrisons suffered a great famine, and an edict ordered the granaries opened for relief.

manualTranslations.zh: 二月，以東郡王陸定國為司空公。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month, Lu Dingguo, Prince of Dongjun, was made Duke Minister of Works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month, Lu Dingguo, Prince of Dongjun, was made Duke Minister of Works.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔征西大將軍、上黨王長孫觀討吐谷渾什寅。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict ordered Changsun Guan, General-in-Chief Who Conquers the West and Prince of Shangdang, to campaign against Shiyin of the Tuyuhun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Changsun Guan, General-in-Chief Who Conquers the West and Prince of Shangdang, to campaign against Shiyin of the Tuyuhun.

manualTranslations.zh: 廣陽王石侯薨。
manualTranslations.literal: Shihou, Prince of Guangyang, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shihou, Prince of Guangyang, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月丙戌，詔天下人病者，所在官司遣醫就家診視，所須藥任醫所量給之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, on the bingxu day, an edict ordered that for sick people throughout the realm, the local offices should send physicians to their homes to examine them and provide whatever medicines the physicians deemed necessary.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the bingxu day, an edict ordered that for sick people throughout the realm, the local offices should send physicians to their homes to examine them and provide whatever medicines the physicians deemed necessary.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月辛丑，大赦。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, on the xinchou day, a great amnesty was proclaimed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on the xinchou day, a great amnesty was proclaimed.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊申，長孫觀軍至曼頭山，大破什寅。
manualTranslations.literal: On the wushen day, Changsun Guan's army reached Mantou Mountain and greatly defeated Shiyin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Changsun Guan's army reached Mantou Mountain and greatly defeated Shiyin.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月，封皇弟長樂為建昌王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month, the imperial younger brother Changle was enfeoffed as Prince of Jianchang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the imperial younger brother Changle was enfeoffed as Prince of Jianchang.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月，宋人來聘。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, envoys from Song came on a friendly mission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, envoys from Song came on a friendly mission.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋八月，蠕蠕犯塞。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the eighth month, the Rouran raided the frontier.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the eighth month, the Rouran raided the frontier.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月丙寅，車駕北伐，諸將俱會於女水，大破虜軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, on the bingyin day, the imperial carriage went north on campaign; the generals all assembled at Nüshui and greatly defeated the enemy army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the bingyin day, the imperial carriage went north on campaign; the generals all assembled at Nüshui and greatly defeated the enemy army.

manualTranslations.zh: 司徒、東安公劉尼坐事免。
manualTranslations.literal: Liu Ni, Minister over the Masses and Duke of Dongan, was dismissed because of an offense.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liu Ni, Minister over the Masses and Duke of Dongan, was dismissed because of an offense.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬申，車駕至自北伐，飲至策勛，告於宗廟。
manualTranslations.literal: On the renshen day, the imperial carriage arrived back from the northern campaign; the arrival feast was held, merit was recorded, and the achievement was announced in the ancestral temple.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, the imperial carriage arrived back from the northern campaign; the arrival feast was held, merit was recorded, and the achievement was announced in the ancestral temple.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十月，誅濟南王慕容白曜、高平公李敷。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the tenth month, Murong Baiyao, Prince of Jinan, and Li Fu, Duke of Gaoping, were executed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, Murong Baiyao, Prince of Jinan, and Li Fu, Duke of Gaoping, were executed.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月，詔弛山澤禁。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month, an edict relaxed the prohibitions on mountains and marshes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, an edict relaxed the prohibitions on mountains and marshes.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月甲辰，幸鹿野苑、石窟寺。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the jiachen day, the emperor visited Luyeyuan and the Grotto Monastery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jiachen day, the emperor visited Luyeyuan and the Grotto Monastery.

manualTranslations.zh: 陽平王新成薨。
manualTranslations.literal: Xincheng, Prince of Yangping, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xincheng, Prince of Yangping, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年春二月乙亥，詔假員外散騎常侍邢佑使於宋。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year, in spring, in the second month, on the yihai day, an edict appointed Xing You as Acting Supernumerary Regular Mounted Attendant and sent him as envoy to Song.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, in spring, in the second month, on the yihai day, an edict appointed Xing You as Acting Supernumerary Regular Mounted Attendant and sent him as envoy to Song.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月，北平王長孫敦薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, Changsun Dun, Prince of Beiping, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, Changsun Dun, Prince of Beiping, died.

sourceRange.text: 八月，波斯國遣使朝貢。冬十月，詔假員外散騎常侍遊明根使於宋。廣平王洛侯薨。三年春正月壬午，以東郡公乙渾為太原王。癸未，樂良王萬壽薨。二月壬子朔，日有蝕之。癸酉，田於崞山，遂觀漁於旋鴻池。三月甲申，宋人來聘。高麗、蓰王、契嚙、思厭、於師、疏勒、石那、悉居半、渴盤陀等國並遣使朝貢。夏六月庚申，行幸陰山。秋七月壬寅，幸河西。九月壬辰，常山王素薨。冬十月，詔員外散騎常侍遊明根使於宋。十一月壬寅，車駕還宮。十二月乙卯，制戰陣之法十有餘條，因大儺曜兵，有飛龍騰蛇魚麗之變，以示威武。戊午，零陵王閭拔薨。

context.afterSource: 四年春三月乙未，賜京師人年七十以上太官廚食，以終其年。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, an edict appointed You Minggen as Acting Supernumerary Regular Mounted Attendant and sent him as envoy to Song.

manualTranslations.zh: 廣平王洛侯薨。

manualTranslations.literal: In the second month, on the renzi day, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

manualTranslations.zh: 癸酉，田於崞山，遂觀漁於旋鴻池。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jiashen day, envoys from Song came on a friendly mission.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Goguryeo, Xiwang, Qinie, Siyan, Yushi, Kashgar, Shina, Xijuban, Khotan, and other states all sent envoys to court with tribute.

manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the sixth month, on the gengshen day, the emperor went to Yinshan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the sixth month, on the gengshen day, the emperor went to Yinshan.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月壬寅，幸河西。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the renyin day, he went to Hexi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the renyin day, he went to Hexi.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月壬辰，常山王素薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, on the renchen day, Su, Prince of Changshan, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the renchen day, Su, Prince of Changshan, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十月，詔員外散騎常侍遊明根使於宋。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the tenth month, an edict sent You Minggen, Supernumerary Regular Mounted Attendant, as envoy to Song.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, an edict sent You Minggen, Supernumerary Regular Mounted Attendant, as envoy to Song.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月壬寅，車駕還宮。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the renyin day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the renyin day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the yimao day, more than ten articles on battle formations were established. During the great exorcism the troops were displayed, with changes such as Flying Dragon, Soaring Serpent, and Fish-Scale, to show martial power.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊午，零陵王閭拔薨。
manualTranslations.literal: On the wuwu day, Lü Ba, Prince of Lingling, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Lü Ba, Prince of Lingling, died.

sourceRange.text: 以驃騎大將軍元壽樂為太宰、都督中外諸軍、錄尚書事。以尚書長孫渴侯為尚書令、儀同三司。十一月丙子，二人爭權，並賜死。癸未，廣陽王建、臨淮王譚薨。甲申，皇妣閭氏薨。進平南將軍、宋子侯周忸爵為樂陵王，南部尚書、常安子陸麗為平原王，文武各加位一等。壬寅，追尊皇考景穆太子為景穆皇帝，妣閭氏為恭皇后，尊保母常氏為保太后。十二月戊申，祔葬恭皇后於金陵。乙卯，初復佛法。丁巳，以樂陵王周忸為太尉，平原王陸麗為司徒，鎮西將軍杜元寶為司空。保達、沙獵等國各遣使朝貢。戊寅，進建業公陸俟爵為東平王，進廣平公杜遣爵為王。癸亥，詔以營州蝗，開倉振恤。甲子，太尉、樂陵王周忸有罪賜死。進濮陽公閭若文爵為王。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuan Shoule, General-in-Chief of Agile Cavalry, was made Grand Preceptor, Commander-in-Chief of all armies within and without, and Manager of the Affairs of the Masters of Writing.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Changsun Kehou, Master of Writing, was made Director of the Masters of Writing and Equal to the Three Excellencies.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月丙子，二人爭權，並賜死。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the bingzi day, the two men contended for power and were both granted death.

manualTranslations.zh: 癸未，廣陽王建、臨淮王譚薨。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Jian, Prince of Guangyang, and Tan, Prince of Linhuai, died.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the imperial mother, Lady Lü, died.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the wushen day, Empress Gong was interred in accompanying burial at Jinling.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙卯，初復佛法。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, the Buddhist teaching was restored for the first time.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Zhou Niu, Prince of Leling, was made Grand Commandant, Lu Li, Prince of Pingyuan, Minister over the Masses, and Du Yuanbao, General Who Guards the West, Minister of Works.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: The states of Baoda, Shalie, and others each sent envoys to court with tribute.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Lu Si, Duke of Jianye, was promoted in title to Prince of Dongping, and Du Qian, Duke of Guangping, was promoted in title to prince.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, because of locusts in Yingzhou, an edict ordered the granaries opened for relief.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲子，太尉、樂陵王周忸有罪賜死。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jiazi day, Zhou Niu, Grand Commandant and Prince of Leling, was found guilty and granted death.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Zhou Niu, Grand Commandant and Prince of Leling, was found guilty and granted death.

manualTranslations.zh: 進濮陽公閭若文爵為王。
manualTranslations.literal: Lü Ruowen, Duke of Puyang, was promoted in title to prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lü Ruowen, Duke of Puyang, was promoted in title to prince.

sourceRange.text: 夏四月甲寅，皇子小兒、苗兒並薨。五月乙卯，馮弘奔高麗。戊午，詔散騎常侍封撥使高麗，征送馮弘。丁卯，行幸河西。赫連定之西也，楊難當竊據上邽，秋七月庚戌，命樂平王丕等討之。詔散騎常侍遊雅使於宋。八月丁亥，遣使六輩使西域。

context.beforeSource: 弘求救於高麗，高麗遣其大將葛蔓盧迎之。
context.afterSource: 帝校獵於河西，詔廣平公張黎發定州七郡一萬二千人通莎泉道。

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月甲寅，皇子小兒、苗兒並薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, on the jiayin day, the imperial sons Xiaoer and Miaoer both died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on the jiayin day, the imperial sons Xiaoer and Miaoer both died.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月乙卯，馮弘奔高麗。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month, on the yimao day, Feng Hong fled to Goguryeo.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the yimao day, Feng Hong fled to Goguryeo.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊午，詔散騎常侍封撥使高麗，征送馮弘。
manualTranslations.literal: On the wuwu day, an edict sent Feng Bo, Regular Mounted Attendant, as envoy to Goguryeo to demand that Feng Hong be delivered.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, an edict sent Feng Bo, Regular Mounted Attendant, as envoy to Goguryeo to demand that Feng Hong be delivered.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁卯，行幸河西。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingmao day, the emperor went to Hexi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, the emperor went to Hexi.

manualTranslations.zh: 赫連定之西也，楊難當竊據上邽，秋七月庚戌，命樂平王丕等討之。
manualTranslations.literal: When Helian Ding went west, Yang Nandang seized Shanggui. In autumn, in the seventh month, on the gengxu day, Pi, Prince of Leping, and others were ordered to campaign against him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Helian Ding went west, Yang Nandang seized Shanggui. In autumn, in the seventh month, on the gengxu day, Pi, Prince of Leping, and others were ordered to campaign against him.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔散騎常侍遊雅使於宋。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict sent You Ya, Regular Mounted Attendant, as envoy to Song.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict sent You Ya, Regular Mounted Attendant, as envoy to Song.

manualTranslations.zh: 八月丁亥，遣使六輩使西域。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month, on the dinghai day, six groups of envoys were sent to the Western Regions.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the dinghai day, six groups of envoys were sent to the Western Regions.

sourceRange.text: 太平真君元年春正月己酉，沮渠無諱圍酒泉。辛亥，分遣侍臣巡行州郡，觀察風俗，問人疾苦。二月己巳，詔假通直常侍邢穎使於宋。發長安人五千浚昆明池。

context.beforeSource: 是歲，鄯善、龜茲、疏勒、焉耆、高麗、粟特、渴盤陀、破洛那、悉居半等國並遣使朝貢。
context.afterSource: 三月，酒泉陷。

manualTranslations.zh: 太平真君元年春正月己酉，沮渠無諱圍酒泉。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Taiping Zhenjun, in spring, in the first month, on the jiyou day, Juqu Wuhui besieged Jiuquan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taiping Zhenjun, in spring, in the first month, on the jiyou day, Juqu Wuhui besieged Jiuquan.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛亥，分遣侍臣巡行州郡，觀察風俗，問人疾苦。
manualTranslations.literal: On the xinhai day, attendant officials were sent separately to inspect the prefectures and commanderies, observe local customs, and inquire into the people's sufferings.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, attendant officials were sent separately to inspect the prefectures and commanderies, observe local customs, and inquire into the people's sufferings.

manualTranslations.zh: 二月己巳，詔假通直常侍邢穎使於宋。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month, on the jisi day, an edict appointed Xing Ying as Acting Palace Attendant of Unbroken Communication and sent him as envoy to Song.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jisi day, an edict appointed Xing Ying as Acting Palace Attendant of Unbroken Communication and sent him as envoy to Song.

manualTranslations.zh: 發長安人五千浚昆明池。
manualTranslations.literal: Five thousand men from Chang'an were conscripted to dredge Kunming Pond.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Five thousand men from Chang'an were conscripted to dredge Kunming Pond.

sourceRange.text: 五年春二月己酉，司空、河南公伊珝薨。三月庚寅，曲赦京師死罪已下。夏四月己巳，封皇弟子推為京兆王。五月，居常國遣使朝貢。六月戊申，行幸陰山。秋八月庚戌，遂幸雲中。壬戌，還宮。九月戊辰，儀同三司、敦煌公李寶薨。冬十二月戊申，詔以六鎮、雲中、高平、二雍、秦州遍遇災旱，年谷不收，開倉廩振乏。

context.beforeSource: 十二月，中山王托真薨。
context.afterSource: 有徙流者，喻還桑梓。

context.afterLocal: 有徙流者，喻還桑梓。

manualTranslations.zh: 五年春二月己酉，司空、河南公伊珝薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year, in spring, in the second month, on the jiyou day, Yi Xu, Minister of Works and Duke of Henan, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, in spring, in the second month, on the jiyou day, Yi Xu, Minister of Works and Duke of Henan, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月庚寅，曲赦京師死罪已下。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, on the gengyin day, there was a partial amnesty in the capital for those sentenced to death and below.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengyin day, there was a partial amnesty in the capital for those sentenced to death and below.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月己巳，封皇弟子推為京兆王。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, on the jisi day, the imperial younger brother Zitui was enfeoffed as Prince of Jingzhao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on the jisi day, the imperial younger brother Zitui was enfeoffed as Prince of Jingzhao.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月，居常國遣使朝貢。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month, the state of Juchang sent envoys to court with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the state of Juchang sent envoys to court with tribute.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月戊申，行幸陰山。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, on the wushen day, the emperor went to Yinshan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the wushen day, the emperor went to Yinshan.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋八月庚戌，遂幸雲中。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the eighth month, on the gengxu day, he then went to Yunzhong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the eighth month, on the gengxu day, he then went to Yunzhong.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬戌，還宮。
manualTranslations.literal: On the renxu day, he returned to the palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, he returned to the palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月戊辰，儀同三司、敦煌公李寶薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, on the wuchen day, Li Bao, Equal to the Three Excellencies and Duke of Dunhuang, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the wuchen day, Li Bao, Equal to the Three Excellencies and Duke of Dunhuang, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十二月戊申，詔以六鎮、雲中、高平、二雍、秦州遍遇災旱，年谷不收，開倉廩振乏。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the twelfth month, on the wushen day, an edict said that the Six Garrisons, Yunzhong, Gaoping, the two Yong prefectures, and Qinzhou had all suffered disaster and drought so that the year's grain had not been harvested, and ordered granaries and storehouses opened to relieve the needy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the twelfth month, on the wushen day, an edict said that the Six Garrisons, Yunzhong, Gaoping, the two Yong prefectures, and Qinzhou had all suffered disaster and drought so that the year's grain had not been harvested, and ordered granaries and storehouses opened to relieve the needy.

sourceRange.text: 三年春正月癸未，中山王纂薨。戊子，太尉、北平王長孫嵩薨。乙巳，丹楊王叔孫建薨。二月乙卯，行幸幽州，存恤孤老，問人疾苦。還幸上谷，遂至代，所過復田租之半。三月己卯，車駕還宮。丁酉，宋人來聘。夏五月己丑，詔天下吏人得舉告守令不如法者。丙申，行幸雲中。秋七月戊子，使永昌王健、上黨王長孫道生討山胡白龍余黨於西河，滅之。八月甲辰，行幸河西。九月甲申，車駕還宮。丁酉，遣使者拜西秦王慕璝弟慕利延為鎮西大將軍、儀同三司，改封西平王。冬十月癸卯，行幸雲中。十一月壬申，車駕還宮。是歲，河西王沮渠牧犍世子封壇來朝，高麗、契丹、龜茲、悅般、焉耆、車師、粟特、疏勒、烏孫、渴盤陁、鄯善、破洛那、者舌等國各遣使朝貢。四年春三月庚辰，鄯善王弟素延耆來朝。癸未，罷沙門年五十以下。江陽王根薨。是月，高麗殺馮弘。夏五月戊寅，赦。秋七月壬申，車駕北伐。冬十一月丁卯朔，日有蝕之。十二月，車駕至自北伐。上洛巴、泉蕇等相帥內附。詔兼散騎常侍高雅使於宋。

context.beforeSource: 是歲，吐谷渾慕璝死。
context.afterSource: 五年春正月庚寅，行幸定州。

manualTranslations.zh: 三年春正月癸未，中山王纂薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, in spring, in the first month, on the guiwei day, Zuan, Prince of Zhongshan, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year, in spring, in the first month, on the guiwei day, Zuan, Prince of Zhongshan, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊子，太尉、北平王長孫嵩薨。
manualTranslations.literal: On the wuzi day, Changsun Song, Grand Commandant and Prince of Beiping, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Changsun Song, Grand Commandant and Prince of Beiping, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙巳，丹楊王叔孫建薨。
manualTranslations.literal: On the yisi day, Shusun Jian, Prince of Danyang, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Shusun Jian, Prince of Danyang, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 二月乙卯，行幸幽州，存恤孤老，問人疾苦。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month, on the yimao day, the emperor went to Youzhou, comforted the orphaned and aged, and inquired into the people's hardships.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the yimao day, the emperor went to Youzhou, comforted the orphaned and aged, and inquired into the people's hardships.

manualTranslations.zh: 還幸上谷，遂至代，所過復田租之半。
manualTranslations.literal: On the return he visited Shanggu and then reached Dai, remitting half the field tax wherever he passed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the return he visited Shanggu and then reached Dai, remitting half the field tax wherever he passed.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月己卯，車駕還宮。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, on the jimao day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jimao day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁酉，宋人來聘。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingyou day, envoys from Song came on a friendly mission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, envoys from Song came on a friendly mission.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏五月己丑，詔天下吏人得舉告守令不如法者。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fifth month, on the jichou day, an edict allowed officials and people throughout the realm to denounce commandery and county officials who acted unlawfully.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fifth month, on the jichou day, an edict allowed officials and people throughout the realm to denounce commandery and county officials who acted unlawfully.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙申，行幸雲中。
manualTranslations.literal: On the bingshen day, the emperor went to Yunzhong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, the emperor went to Yunzhong.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月戊子，使永昌王健、上黨王長孫道生討山胡白龍余黨於西河，滅之。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the wuzi day, Jian, Prince of Yongchang, and Changsun Daosheng, Prince of Shangdang, were sent to campaign against the remaining followers of the Mountain Hu Bai Long in Xihe and destroyed them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the wuzi day, Jian, Prince of Yongchang, and Changsun Daosheng, Prince of Shangdang, were sent to campaign against the remaining followers of the Mountain Hu Bai Long in Xihe and destroyed them.

manualTranslations.zh: 八月甲辰，行幸河西。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month, on the jiachen day, the emperor went to Hexi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiachen day, the emperor went to Hexi.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月甲申，車駕還宮。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, on the jiashen day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jiashen day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁酉，遣使者拜西秦王慕璝弟慕利延為鎮西大將軍、儀同三司，改封西平王。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingyou day, an envoy was sent to appoint Muli Yan, younger brother of Mugui, King of Western Qin, as General Who Guards the West and Equal to the Three Excellencies, and to change his title to Prince of Xiping.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, an envoy was sent to appoint Muli Yan, younger brother of Mugui, King of Western Qin, as General Who Guards the West and Equal to the Three Excellencies, and to change his title to Prince of Xiping.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十月癸卯，行幸雲中。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the tenth month, on the guimao day, the emperor went to Yunzhong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on the guimao day, the emperor went to Yunzhong.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月壬申，車駕還宮。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the renshen day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the renshen day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲，河西王沮渠牧犍世子封壇來朝，高麗、契丹、龜茲、悅般、焉耆、車師、粟特、疏勒、烏孫、渴盤陁、鄯善、破洛那、者舌等國各遣使朝貢。
manualTranslations.literal: That year Fengtan, heir of Juqu Mujian, Prince of Hexi, came to court, and Goguryeo, the Khitan, Kucha, Yueban, Yanqi, Cheshi, Sogdiana, Kashgar, Wusun, Khotan, Shanshan, Bactria, Zheshe, and other states each sent envoys to court with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year Fengtan, heir of Juqu Mujian, Prince of Hexi, came to court, and Goguryeo, the Khitan, Kucha, Yueban, Yanqi, Cheshi, Sogdiana, Kashgar, Wusun, Khotan, Shanshan, Bactria, Zheshe, and other states each sent envoys to court with tribute.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年春三月庚辰，鄯善王弟素延耆來朝。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, in spring, in the third month, on the gengchen day, Su Yanqi, younger brother of the king of Shanshan, came to court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, in spring, in the third month, on the gengchen day, Su Yanqi, younger brother of the king of Shanshan, came to court.

manualTranslations.zh: 癸未，罷沙門年五十以下。
manualTranslations.literal: On the guiwei day, Buddhist monks under the age of fifty were dismissed from the clergy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Buddhist monks under the age of fifty were dismissed from the clergy.

manualTranslations.zh: 江陽王根薨。
manualTranslations.literal: Gen, Prince of Jiangyang, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gen, Prince of Jiangyang, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 是月，高麗殺馮弘。
manualTranslations.literal: That month, Goguryeo killed Feng Hong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That month, Goguryeo killed Feng Hong.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏五月戊寅，赦。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fifth month, on the wuyin day, there was an amnesty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fifth month, on the wuyin day, there was an amnesty.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月壬申，車駕北伐。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the renshen day, the imperial carriage went north on campaign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the renshen day, the imperial carriage went north on campaign.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十一月丁卯朔，日有蝕之。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the eleventh month, on the dingmao day, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the eleventh month, on the dingmao day, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月，車駕至自北伐。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, the imperial carriage arrived back from the northern campaign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the imperial carriage arrived back from the northern campaign.

manualTranslations.zh: 上洛巴、泉蕇等相帥內附。
manualTranslations.literal: The Ba and Quanchan of Shangluo and others led one another in submitting.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Ba and Quanchan of Shangluo and others led one another in submitting.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔兼散騎常侍高雅使於宋。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict sent Gao Ya, Concurrent Regular Mounted Attendant, as envoy to Song.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict sent Gao Ya, Concurrent Regular Mounted Attendant, as envoy to Song.

sourceRange.text: 八年春正月癸未，行幸中山。三月，河西王沮渠牧犍謀反，伏誅。夏五月，車駕還宮。六月，西征諸將扶風公處真等八將坐盜沒軍資，所在虜掠，贓各千萬計，並斬之。秋八月，樂安王範薨。冬十一月，侍中、中書監、宜都王穆壽薨。十二月，晉王伏羅薨。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, Juqu Mujian, Prince of Hexi, plotted rebellion and was executed.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏五月，車駕還宮。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fifth month, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fifth month, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月，西征諸將扶風公處真等八將坐盜沒軍資，所在虜掠，贓各千萬計，並斬之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, the western campaign generals, including Chuzhen, Duke of Fufeng, eight generals in all, were implicated in stealing confiscated military supplies and plundering wherever they were; their stolen goods each numbered in the tens of millions, and all were beheaded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the western campaign generals, including Chuzhen, Duke of Fufeng, eight generals in all, were implicated in stealing confiscated military supplies and plundering wherever they were; their stolen goods each numbered in the tens of millions, and all were beheaded.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋八月，樂安王範薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the eighth month, Fan, Prince of Lean, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the eighth month, Fan, Prince of Lean, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十一月，侍中、中書監、宜都王穆壽薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the eleventh month, Mu Shou, Palace Attendant, Director of the Secretariat, and Prince of Yidu, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the eleventh month, Mu Shou, Palace Attendant, Director of the Secretariat, and Prince of Yidu, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月，晉王伏羅薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, Fuluo, Prince of Jin, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Fuluo, Prince of Jin, died.

sourceRange.text: 二年春正月癸卯，拜沮渠無諱為征西大將軍、涼州牧、酒泉王。三月辛卯，葬惠太后於崞山。庚戌，新興王俊、略陽王羯兒有罪，黜為公。辛亥，封蠕蠕郁久閭乞歸為朔方王，沮渠萬年為張掖王。夏四月丁巳，宋人來聘。秋八月辛亥，詔散騎侍郎張偉使於宋。九月戊戌，永昌王健薨。冬十一月庚子，鎮南大將軍奚眷平酒泉。

context.beforeSource: 以河南主曜子羯兒為河間王，後改封略陽王。
context.afterSource: 十二月丙子，宋人來聘。
context.beforeLocal: 以河南主曜子羯兒為河間王，後改封略陽王。
context.afterLocal: 十二月丙子，宋人來聘。

manualTranslations.zh: 二年春正月癸卯，拜沮渠無諱為征西大將軍、涼州牧、酒泉王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year, in spring, in the first month, on the guimao day, Juqu Wuhui was appointed General Who Conquers the West, Governor of Liangzhou, and Prince of Jiuquan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year, in spring, in the first month, on the guimao day, Juqu Wuhui was appointed General Who Conquers the West, Governor of Liangzhou, and Prince of Jiuquan.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月辛卯，葬惠太后於崞山。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, on the xinmao day, Empress Dowager Hui was buried at Mount Guo.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinmao day, Empress Dowager Hui was buried at Mount Guo.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚戌，新興王俊、略陽王羯兒有罪，黜為公。
manualTranslations.literal: On the gengxu day, Jun, Prince of Xinxing, and Jieer, Prince of Lueyang, were found guilty and demoted to dukes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Jun, Prince of Xinxing, and Jieer, Prince of Lueyang, were found guilty and demoted to dukes.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛亥，封蠕蠕郁久閭乞歸為朔方王，沮渠萬年為張掖王。
manualTranslations.literal: On the xinhai day, Yujiulü Qigui of the Rouran was enfeoffed as Prince of Shuofang and Juqu Wannian as Prince of Zhangye.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, Yujiulü Qigui of the Rouran was enfeoffed as Prince of Shuofang and Juqu Wannian as Prince of Zhangye.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月丁巳，宋人來聘。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, on the dingsi day, envoys from Song came on a friendly mission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on the dingsi day, envoys from Song came on a friendly mission.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋八月辛亥，詔散騎侍郎張偉使於宋。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the eighth month, on the xinhai day, an edict sent Zhang Wei, Mounted Attendant Gentleman, as envoy to Song.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the eighth month, on the xinhai day, an edict sent Zhang Wei, Mounted Attendant Gentleman, as envoy to Song.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月戊戌，永昌王健薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, on the wuxu day, Jian, Prince of Yongchang, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the wuxu day, Jian, Prince of Yongchang, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十一月庚子，鎮南大將軍奚眷平酒泉。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the eleventh month, on the gengzi day, Xi Juan, General-in-Chief Who Guards the South, pacified Jiuquan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the eleventh month, on the gengzi day, Xi Juan, General-in-Chief Who Guards the South, pacified Jiuquan.

sourceRange.text: 三年春正月甲申，帝至道壇，親受符箓，備法駕，旗幟盡青。三月壬寅，北平王長孫頹有罪，削爵為侯。夏四月，酒泉王沮渠無諱走渡流沙，據鄯善。涼武昭王孫李寶據敦煌，遣使內附。五月，行幸陰山北。六月丙戌，楊難當朝於行宮。先是，起殿於陰山北，殿成而難當至，因曰廣德焉。秋八月甲戌晦，日有蝕之。冬十月己卯，封皇子伏羅為晉王，翰為秦王，譚為燕王，建為楚王，余為吳王。十二月辛巳，太保、襄城公盧魯元薨。丁酉，車駕還宮，李寶遣使朝貢，以寶為鎮西大將軍、開府儀同三司、沙州牧、敦煌公。

context.beforeSource: 十二月丙子，宋人來聘。
context.afterSource: 四年春正月庚午，行幸中山。
context.beforeLocal: 十二月丙子，宋人來聘。
context.afterLocal: 四年春正月庚午，行幸中山。

manualTranslations.zh: 三年春正月甲申，帝至道壇，親受符箓，備法駕，旗幟盡青。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, in spring, in the first month, on the jiashen day, the emperor went to the Daoist altar and personally received the talismans and registers, with the full ceremonial carriage arrayed and all banners blue-green.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year, in spring, in the first month, on the jiashen day, the emperor went to the Daoist altar and personally received the talismans and registers, with the full ceremonial carriage arrayed and all banners blue-green.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月壬寅，北平王長孫頹有罪，削爵為侯。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, on the renyin day, Changsun Tui, Prince of Beiping, was found guilty and his rank was reduced to marquis.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the renyin day, Changsun Tui, Prince of Beiping, was found guilty and his rank was reduced to marquis.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月，酒泉王沮渠無諱走渡流沙，據鄯善。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, Juqu Wuhui, Prince of Jiuquan, fled across the flowing sands and occupied Shanshan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, Juqu Wuhui, Prince of Jiuquan, fled across the flowing sands and occupied Shanshan.

manualTranslations.zh: 涼武昭王孫李寶據敦煌，遣使內附。
manualTranslations.literal: Li Bao, grandson of King Wuzhao of Liang, occupied Dunhuang and sent envoys to submit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Li Bao, grandson of King Wuzhao of Liang, occupied Dunhuang and sent envoys to submit.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月，行幸陰山北。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month, the emperor went north of Yinshan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the emperor went north of Yinshan.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月丙戌，楊難當朝於行宮。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, on the bingxu day, Yang Nandang attended court at the traveling palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the bingxu day, Yang Nandang attended court at the traveling palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 先是，起殿於陰山北，殿成而難當至，因曰廣德焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Earlier, a hall had been built north of Yinshan; when the hall was completed and Nandang arrived, it was therefore named Guangde.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier, a hall had been built north of Yinshan; when the hall was completed and Nandang arrived, it was therefore named Guangde.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋八月甲戌晦，日有蝕之。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the eighth month, on the jiaxu day, the last day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the eighth month, on the jiaxu day, the last day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十月己卯，封皇子伏羅為晉王，翰為秦王，譚為燕王，建為楚王，余為吳王。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the tenth month, on the jimao day, the imperial sons Fuluo, Han, Tan, Jian, and Yu were enfeoffed respectively as Princes of Jin, Qin, Yan, Chu, and Wu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on the jimao day, the imperial sons Fuluo, Han, Tan, Jian, and Yu were enfeoffed respectively as Princes of Jin, Qin, Yan, Chu, and Wu.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月辛巳，太保、襄城公盧魯元薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the xinsi day, Lu Luyuan, Grand Protector and Duke of Xiangcheng, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the xinsi day, Lu Luyuan, Grand Protector and Duke of Xiangcheng, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁酉，車駕還宮，李寶遣使朝貢，以寶為鎮西大將軍、開府儀同三司、沙州牧、敦煌公。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingyou day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace. Li Bao sent envoys to court with tribute, and he was made General-in-Chief Who Guards the West, Kaifu Yitong Sansi, Governor of Shazhou, and Duke of Dunhuang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace. Li Bao sent envoys to court with tribute, and he was made General-in-Chief Who Guards the West, Kaifu Yitong Sansi, Governor of Shazhou, and Duke of Dunhuang.

sourceRange.text: 高祖孝文皇帝諱宏，獻文皇帝之太子也。母曰李夫人。皇興元年八月戊申，生於平城紫宮，神光照室，天地氛氳，和氣充塞。帝潔白有異姿，繈褓岐嶷，長而弘裕仁孝，綽然有人君之表。獻文尤愛異之。三年六月辛未，立為皇太子。五年，受禪。延興元年秋八月丙午，皇帝即位於太華前殿，改皇興五年為延興。丁未，宋人來聘。九月壬戌，詔在位及人庶進直言。壬午，青州高陽人封辨聚黨自號齊王，州軍討平之。冬十月丁亥，沃野、統萬二鎮敕勒叛，詔太尉、隴西王源賀追擊至枹罕，滅之。徙其遺迸於冀、定、相三州為戶。十二月乙酉，封駙馬都尉穆亮為趙郡王。

localRange.text: 高祖孝文帝

context.afterSource: 壬辰，詔求舜後，獲東萊人媯茍之。
context.afterLocal: 壬辰，詔求舜後，獲東萊人媯茍之。

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖孝文皇帝諱宏，獻文皇帝之太子也。
manualTranslations.literal: Gaozu, Emperor Xiaowen, bore the taboo name Hong. He was the crown prince of Emperor Xianwen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gaozu, Emperor Xiaowen, bore the taboo name Hong. He was the crown prince of Emperor Xianwen.

manualTranslations.zh: 母曰李夫人。
manualTranslations.literal: His mother was Lady Li.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His mother was Lady Li.

manualTranslations.zh: 皇興元年八月戊申，生於平城紫宮，神光照室，天地氛氳，和氣充塞。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Huangxing, in the eighth month, on the wushen day, he was born in the Purple Palace at Pingcheng. Divine light shone into the room; heaven and earth were suffused, and harmonious qi filled the space.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Huangxing, in the eighth month, on the wushen day, he was born in the Purple Palace at Pingcheng. Divine light shone into the room; heaven and earth were suffused, and harmonious qi filled the space.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝潔白有異姿，繈褓岐嶷，長而弘裕仁孝，綽然有人君之表。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor was fair and had an extraordinary bearing. Even in swaddling clothes he was remarkable; when he grew up, he was broad-minded, generous, humane, and filial, with the clear appearance of a ruler of men.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor was fair and had an extraordinary bearing. Even in swaddling clothes he was remarkable; when he grew up, he was broad-minded, generous, humane, and filial, with the clear appearance of a ruler of men.

manualTranslations.zh: 獻文尤愛異之。
manualTranslations.literal: Xianwen especially loved and esteemed him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xianwen especially loved and esteemed him.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年六月辛未，立為皇太子。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, in the sixth month, on the xinwei day, he was installed as crown prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the sixth month, on the xinwei day, he was installed as crown prince.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年，受禪。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year, he received the abdication.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, he received the abdication.

manualTranslations.zh: 延興元年秋八月丙午，皇帝即位於太華前殿，改皇興五年為延興。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Yanxing, in autumn, in the eighth month, on the bingwu day, the emperor ascended the throne in the front hall of Taihua and changed the fifth year of Huangxing to Yanxing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yanxing, in autumn, in the eighth month, on the bingwu day, the emperor ascended the throne in the front hall of Taihua and changed the fifth year of Huangxing to Yanxing.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁未，宋人來聘。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingwei day, envoys from Song came on a friendly mission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, envoys from Song came on a friendly mission.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月壬戌，詔在位及人庶進直言。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, on the renxu day, an edict ordered officials in office and commoners to submit frank remonstrances.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the renxu day, an edict ordered officials in office and commoners to submit frank remonstrances.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬午，青州高陽人封辨聚黨自號齊王，州軍討平之。
manualTranslations.literal: On the renwu day, Feng Bian of Gaoyang in Qingzhou gathered followers and styled himself Prince of Qi; the provincial army attacked and pacified him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, Feng Bian of Gaoyang in Qingzhou gathered followers and styled himself Prince of Qi; the provincial army attacked and pacified him.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十月丁亥，沃野、統萬二鎮敕勒叛，詔太尉、隴西王源賀追擊至枹罕，滅之。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the tenth month, on the dinghai day, the Chile of the two garrisons of Woye and Tongwan rebelled. An edict ordered Yuan He, Grand Commandant and Prince of Longxi, to pursue and attack them as far as Fuhan, where he destroyed them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on the dinghai day, the Chile of the two garrisons of Woye and Tongwan rebelled. An edict ordered Yuan He, Grand Commandant and Prince of Longxi, to pursue and attack them as far as Fuhan, where he destroyed them.

manualTranslations.zh: 徙其遺迸於冀、定、相三州為戶。
manualTranslations.literal: Their remaining fugitives were moved to Ji, Ding, and Xiang prefectures and registered as households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Their remaining fugitives were moved to Ji, Ding, and Xiang prefectures and registered as households.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月乙酉，封駙馬都尉穆亮為趙郡王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the yiyou day, Mu Liang, Commandant of the Imperial Son-in-Law, was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the yiyou day, Mu Liang, Commandant of the Imperial Son-in-Law, was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao Commandery.

sourceRange.text: 癸丑，詔介山之邑，聽為寒食，自餘禁斷。三月丙寅，宴群臣及國老、庶老於華林園。詔國老黃耇以上，假中散大夫、郡守。耋年以上，假給事中、縣令。庶老直假郡縣。各賜鳩杖衣裳。丁丑，詔諸州中正各舉其鄉人望，年五十已上，守素衡門者，授以令長。夏五月丙子，詔敦勸農功，令畿內嚴加課督。墮業者申以楚撻，力田者具以名聞。丙戌，初營方澤於河陰。遣使以太牢祭漢光武及明、章三帝陵。又詔漢、魏、晉諸帝陵各禁方百步不得樵蘇踐藉。丁亥，祀方澤。秋七月，廢皇后馮氏。戊寅，帝以久旱，咸秩群神。自癸未不食至於乙酉。是夜，澍雨大洽。八月壬辰朔，幸華林園，親錄囚徒，咸降本罪二等決遣之。丁巳，南安王楨薨。幸華林園聽訟。

context.beforeSource: 庚戌，幸華林，聽訟於都亭。
context.afterSource: 九月戊辰，車駕閱武於小平津。
context.beforeLocal: 庚戌，幸華林，聽訟於都亭。
context.afterLocal: 九月戊辰，車駕閱武於小平津。

manualTranslations.zh: 癸丑，詔介山之邑，聽為寒食，自餘禁斷。
manualTranslations.literal: On the guichou day, an edict allowed the settlements of Mount Jie to observe Cold Food, while all the rest were prohibited.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, an edict allowed the settlements around Mount Jie to observe the Cold Food festival, while all other places were prohibited.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月丙寅，宴群臣及國老、庶老於華林園。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, on the bingyin day, the assembled ministers, state elders, and common elders were feasted in Hualin Garden.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the bingyin day, the emperor feasted the assembled ministers, state elders, and common elders in Hualin Garden.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔國老黃耇以上，假中散大夫、郡守。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict provisionally appointed state elders of yellow-haired old age and above as Palace Gentlemen for Miscellaneous Service or commandery governors.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict provisionally appointed the most aged state elders as Palace Gentlemen for Miscellaneous Service or commandery governors.

manualTranslations.zh: 耋年以上，假給事中、縣令。
manualTranslations.literal: Those of advanced age and above were provisionally appointed as Palace Attendants or county magistrates.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those of advanced age and above were provisionally appointed as Palace Attendants or county magistrates.

manualTranslations.zh: 庶老直假郡縣。
manualTranslations.literal: Common elders were simply provisionally appointed to commandery and county posts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Common elders were simply given provisional commandery and county posts.

manualTranslations.zh: 各賜鳩杖衣裳。
manualTranslations.literal: Each was given a dove-headed staff and clothing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Each was given a dove-headed staff and clothing.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁丑，詔諸州中正各舉其鄉人望，年五十已上，守素衡門者，授以令長。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingchou day, an edict ordered the Correctors of the several provinces each to recommend men of local reputation in their districts, aged fifty and above, who preserved simplicity at humble gates, to be appointed as magistrates and chiefs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, an edict ordered the Correctors of the several provinces to recommend locally respected men aged fifty or above who lived plainly in retirement, so they could be appointed as magistrates and chiefs.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏五月丙子，詔敦勸農功，令畿內嚴加課督。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fifth month, on the bingzi day, an edict urged and encouraged agricultural work and ordered strict supervision within the capital region.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fifth month, on the bingzi day, an edict encouraged agricultural work and ordered strict supervision within the capital region.

manualTranslations.zh: 墮業者申以楚撻，力田者具以名聞。
manualTranslations.literal: Those who neglected their occupations were to be dealt with by rod and lash, while those who worked the fields diligently were to be fully reported by name.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those who neglected their work were to be punished with rod and lash, while diligent farmers were to be fully reported by name.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙戌，初營方澤於河陰。
manualTranslations.literal: On the bingxu day, construction of the Fangze altar first began at Heyin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, construction of the Fangze altar first began at Heyin.

manualTranslations.zh: 遣使以太牢祭漢光武及明、章三帝陵。
manualTranslations.literal: Envoys were sent to sacrifice with the grand victim at the tombs of Emperor Guangwu of Han and the three emperors Ming and Zhang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to sacrifice with the grand victim at the tombs of Emperor Guangwu of Han and the emperors Ming and Zhang.

manualTranslations.zh: 又詔漢、魏、晉諸帝陵各禁方百步不得樵蘇踐藉。
manualTranslations.literal: Another edict established prohibited zones of one hundred paces around the imperial tombs of Han, Wei, and Jin, where gathering firewood and trampling were not permitted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Another edict established prohibited zones of one hundred paces around the imperial tombs of Han, Wei, and Jin, where gathering firewood and trampling were forbidden.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁亥，祀方澤。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dinghai day, sacrifice was offered at Fangze.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, sacrifice was offered at Fangze.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月，廢皇后馮氏。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the seventh month, Empress Feng was deposed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, Empress Feng was deposed.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊寅，帝以久旱，咸秩群神。
manualTranslations.literal: On the wuyin day, because of the prolonged drought, the emperor made ordered sacrifices to all the spirits.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, because of the prolonged drought, the emperor made ordered sacrifices to all the spirits.

manualTranslations.zh: 自癸未不食至於乙酉。
manualTranslations.literal: From the guiwei day he did not eat until the yiyou day.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From the guiwei day until the yiyou day, he abstained from food.

manualTranslations.zh: 是夜，澍雨大洽。
manualTranslations.literal: That night, soaking rain fell in great abundance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That night, soaking rain fell in great abundance.

manualTranslations.zh: 八月壬辰朔，幸華林園，親錄囚徒，咸降本罪二等決遣之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month, on the renchen day, the first day of the month, he visited Hualin Garden and personally reviewed the prisoners, reducing all their original offenses by two degrees and disposing of them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the renchen day, the first day of the month, he visited Hualin Garden and personally reviewed the prisoners, reducing all their original offenses by two degrees and disposing of their cases.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁巳，南安王楨薨。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingsi day, Zhen, Prince of Nan'an, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Zhen, Prince of Nan'an, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 幸華林園聽訟。
manualTranslations.literal: He visited Hualin Garden to hear lawsuits.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He visited Hualin Garden to hear lawsuits.

sourceRange.text: <!--暫時校修至此-->十七年春正月壬子朔，饗百寮於太極殿。

localRange.text: 十七年春正月壬子朔，饗百寮於太極殿。

sourceRange.text: 司徒馮誕薨。壬戌，詔班師。丁卯，遣使臨江，數齊主罪惡。三月戊子，太師馮熙薨。夏四月丁未，曲赦徐、豫二州，其運轉之士，復租三年。辛亥，詔賜高年爵，恤孤寡老疾各有差。德著丘園者，具以名聞。齊人降者，給復十五年。癸丑，幸小沛。使以太牢祭漢高祖廟。己未，幸瑕丘。使以太牢祠岱嶽。詔宿衛武官增位一級。

context.beforeSource: 辛酉，發鐘離，將臨江水。
context.afterSource: 庚申，幸魯城。
context.beforeLocal: 辛酉，發鐘離，將臨江水。
context.afterLocal: 庚申，幸魯城。

manualTranslations.zh: 司徒馮誕薨。
manualTranslations.literal: Feng Dan, Minister over the Masses, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Feng Dan, Minister over the Masses, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬戌，詔班師。
manualTranslations.literal: On the renxu day, an edict ordered the army to return.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, an edict ordered the army to return.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁卯，遣使臨江，數齊主罪惡。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingmao day, envoys were sent to the river to enumerate the crimes and evils of the Qi ruler.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, envoys were sent to the river to enumerate the crimes of the Qi ruler.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月戊子，太師馮熙薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, on the wuzi day, Feng Xi, Grand Preceptor, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the wuzi day, Feng Xi, Grand Preceptor, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月丁未，曲赦徐、豫二州，其運轉之士，復租三年。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, on the dingwei day, a partial amnesty was granted to Xu and Yu provinces; the men who had served in transport were exempted from rent for three years.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on the dingwei day, a partial amnesty was granted to Xu and Yu provinces, and the men who had served in transport were exempted from rent for three years.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛亥，詔賜高年爵，恤孤寡老疾各有差。
manualTranslations.literal: On the xinhai day, an edict bestowed noble ranks on the aged and provided relief for orphans, widows, the old, and the ill, each by grade.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, an edict bestowed noble ranks on the aged and provided graded relief for orphans, widows, the old, and the ill.

manualTranslations.zh: 德著丘園者，具以名聞。
manualTranslations.literal: Those whose virtue was known in the hills and gardens were to be fully reported by name.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those whose virtue was known in private retirement were to be fully reported by name.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊人降者，給復十五年。
manualTranslations.literal: Those people of Qi who surrendered were granted exemption from service for fifteen years.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those from Qi who surrendered were granted exemption from service for fifteen years.

manualTranslations.zh: 癸丑，幸小沛。
manualTranslations.literal: On the guichou day, the emperor visited Xiaopei.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, the emperor visited Xiaopei.

manualTranslations.zh: 使以太牢祭漢高祖廟。
manualTranslations.literal: He sent an envoy to sacrifice with the grand victim at the temple of Gaozu of Han.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He sent an envoy to sacrifice with the grand victim at the temple of Gaozu of Han.

manualTranslations.zh: 己未，幸瑕丘。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jiwei day, he visited Xiaqiu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, he visited Xiaqiu.

manualTranslations.zh: 使以太牢祠岱嶽。
manualTranslations.literal: He sent an envoy to offer sacrifice with the grand victim at Daiyue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He sent an envoy to offer sacrifice with the grand victim at Mount Tai.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔宿衛武官增位一級。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict increased the ranks of the military officers of the palace guard by one grade.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict increased the ranks of the military officers of the palace guard by one grade.

sourceRange.text: 五年春二月癸丑，詔定考課，明黜陟。夏四月，詔禁畜鷹鷂，開相告之制。五月丙午，詔員外散騎常侍許赤武使於宋。丁未，幸武州山。辛酉，幸車輪山。六月庚午，禁殺牛馬。壬申，曲赦京師死罪，遣備蠕蠕。秋九月癸卯，洛州人賈伯奴稱恒農王，豫州人田智度稱上洛王，郡討平之。冬十月，太上皇帝大閱於北郊。十二月丙寅，改封建昌王長樂為安樂王。己丑，城陽王長壽薨。庚寅，宋人來聘。是歲，高麗、吐谷渾、龜茲、契丹、庫莫奚、地豆于、蠕蠕等國並遣使朝貢。承明元年春二月，司空、東郡王陸定國坐事免官爵為兵。夏五月，冀州人宋伏龍聚眾自稱南平王。郡縣捕斬之。六月甲子，詔中外戒嚴。分京師見兵為三等，第一軍出，遣第一兵，二等亦如之。辛未，太上皇帝崩。壬申，大赦，改元。大司馬、大將軍、安城王萬安國坐法賜死。戊寅，以征西大將軍、安樂王長樂為太尉；尚書左僕射、南平公目辰為司徒，進封宜都王；以南部尚書李訢為司空。尊皇太后為太皇太后，臨朝稱制。秋七月甲辰，追尊皇妣李貴人為思皇后。濮陽王孔雀有罪賜死。

context.beforeSource: 州鎮十三大饑，丐人田租，開倉振之。
context.afterSource: 八月甲子，詔群公卿士，有便人益國者，具狀以聞。
context.beforeLocal: 州鎮十三大饑，丐人田租，開倉振之。
context.afterLocal: 八月甲子，詔群公卿士，有便人益國者，具狀以聞。
