manualTranslations.zh: 五年春二月癸丑，詔定考課，明黜陟。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year, in spring, in the second month, on the guichou day, an edict fixed performance evaluations and clarified demotion and promotion.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, in spring, in the second month, on the guichou day, an edict fixed performance evaluations and clarified demotion and promotion.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月，詔禁畜鷹鷂，開相告之制。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, an edict forbade keeping hawks and sparrowhawks and opened a system for mutual reporting.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, an edict forbade keeping hawks and sparrowhawks and opened a system for mutual reporting.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月丙午，詔員外散騎常侍許赤武使於宋。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month, on the bingwu day, an edict sent Xu Chiwu, Supernumerary Regular Mounted Attendant, as envoy to Song.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the bingwu day, an edict sent Xu Chiwu, Supernumerary Regular Mounted Attendant, as envoy to Song.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁未，幸武州山。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingwei day, the emperor visited Mount Wuzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, the emperor visited Mount Wuzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛酉，幸車輪山。
manualTranslations.literal: On the xinyou day, he visited Mount Chelun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, he visited Mount Chelun.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月庚午，禁殺牛馬。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, on the gengwu day, killing cattle and horses was forbidden.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the gengwu day, killing cattle and horses was forbidden.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬申，曲赦京師死罪，遣備蠕蠕。
manualTranslations.literal: On the renshen day, capital crimes in the capital were partially pardoned, and those pardoned were sent to defend against the Rouran.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, capital crimes in the capital were partially pardoned, and those pardoned were sent to defend against the Rouran.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋九月癸卯，洛州人賈伯奴稱恒農王，豫州人田智度稱上洛王，郡討平之。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the ninth month, on the guimao day, Jia Bonu of Luozhou styled himself Prince of Hengnong, and Tian Zhidu of Yuzhou styled himself Prince of Shangluo; the commanderies attacked and pacified them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the ninth month, on the guimao day, Jia Bonu of Luozhou styled himself Prince of Hengnong, and Tian Zhidu of Yuzhou styled himself Prince of Shangluo; the commanderies attacked and pacified them.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十月，太上皇帝大閱於北郊。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the tenth month, the Retired Emperor held a great review in the northern suburbs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, the Retired Emperor held a great review in the northern suburbs.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月丙寅，改封建昌王長樂為安樂王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the bingyin day, Changle, Prince of Jianchang, was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Anle.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the bingyin day, Changle, Prince of Jianchang, was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Anle.

manualTranslations.zh: 己丑，城陽王長壽薨。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jichou day, Changshou, Prince of Chengyang, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Changshou, Prince of Chengyang, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚寅，宋人來聘。
manualTranslations.literal: On the gengyin day, envoys from Song came on a friendly mission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, envoys from Song came on a friendly mission.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲，高麗、吐谷渾、龜茲、契丹、庫莫奚、地豆于、蠕蠕等國並遣使朝貢。
manualTranslations.literal: That year Goguryeo, Tuyuhun, Kucha, the Khitan, the Kumoxi, Didouyu, the Rouran, and other states all sent envoys to court with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year Goguryeo, Tuyuhun, Kucha, the Khitan, the Kumoxi, Didouyu, the Rouran, and other states all sent envoys to court with tribute.

manualTranslations.zh: 承明元年春二月，司空、東郡王陸定國坐事免官爵為兵。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Chengming, in spring, in the second month, Lu Dingguo, Minister of Works and Prince of Dongjun, was implicated in an offense, stripped of office and noble rank, and made a soldier.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chengming, in spring, in the second month, Lu Dingguo, Minister of Works and Prince of Dongjun, was implicated in an offense, stripped of office and noble rank, and made a soldier.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏五月，冀州人宋伏龍聚眾自稱南平王。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fifth month, Song Fulong of Jizhou gathered followers and styled himself Prince of Nanping.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fifth month, Song Fulong of Jizhou gathered followers and styled himself Prince of Nanping.

manualTranslations.zh: 郡縣捕斬之。
manualTranslations.literal: The commandery and county authorities captured and beheaded him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The commandery and county authorities captured and beheaded him.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月甲子，詔中外戒嚴。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, on the jiazi day, an edict ordered those within and without to be on alert.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiazi day, an edict ordered those within and without to be on alert.

manualTranslations.zh: 分京師見兵為三等，第一軍出，遣第一兵，二等亦如之。
manualTranslations.literal: The troops currently in the capital were divided into three grades: when the first army went out, first-grade troops were sent, and the second grade was handled in the same way.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The troops currently in the capital were divided into three grades: when the first army went out, first-grade troops were sent, and the second grade was handled in the same way.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛未，太上皇帝崩。
manualTranslations.literal: On the xinwei day, the Retired Emperor died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, the Retired Emperor died.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬申，大赦，改元。
manualTranslations.literal: On the renshen day, a great amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, a great amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

manualTranslations.zh: 大司馬、大將軍、安城王萬安國坐法賜死。
manualTranslations.literal: Wan Anguo, Grand Marshal, General-in-Chief, and Prince of Ancheng, was granted death for violating the law.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wan Anguo, Grand Marshal, General-in-Chief, and Prince of Ancheng, was granted death for violating the law.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊寅，以征西大將軍、安樂王長樂為太尉；
manualTranslations.literal: On the wuyin day, Changle, General-in-Chief Who Conquers the West and Prince of Anle, was made Grand Commandant;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Changle, General-in-Chief Who Conquers the West and Prince of Anle, was made Grand Commandant;

manualTranslations.zh: 尚書左僕射、南平公目辰為司徒，進封宜都王；
manualTranslations.literal: Muchen, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Duke of Nanping, was made Minister over the Masses and promoted in enfeoffment to Prince of Yidu;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Muchen, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Duke of Nanping, was made Minister over the Masses and promoted in enfeoffment to Prince of Yidu;

manualTranslations.zh: 以南部尚書李訢為司空。
manualTranslations.literal: and Li Xin, Southern Department Master of Writing, was made Minister of Works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: and Li Xin, Southern Department Master of Writing, was made Minister of Works.

manualTranslations.zh: 尊皇太后為太皇太后，臨朝稱制。
manualTranslations.literal: The Empress Dowager was honored as Grand Empress Dowager and presided over court, issuing commands in imperial style.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager was honored as Grand Empress Dowager and presided over court, issuing commands in imperial style.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月甲辰，追尊皇妣李貴人為思皇后。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the jiachen day, the imperial mother, Honored Lady Li, was posthumously honored as Empress Si.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the jiachen day, the imperial mother, Honored Lady Li, was posthumously honored as Empress Si.

manualTranslations.zh: 濮陽王孔雀有罪賜死。
manualTranslations.literal: Kongque, Prince of Puyang, was found guilty and granted death.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Kongque, Prince of Puyang, was found guilty and granted death.

sourceRange.text: 五月庚申，以農時要月，詔天下勿使有留獄。六月甲辰，中山王睿薨。戊午，封皇叔簡為齊郡王，猛為安豐王。秋七月庚申朔，日有蝕之。甲子，齊人來聘。九月庚午，閱武於南郊，大饗群臣。齊使車僧朗以班在宋使殷靈誕後，辭不就席。宋降人解奉君刃僧朗於會中。詔誅奉君等。乙亥，封昌黎王馮熙世子誕為南平王。冬十二月癸巳，州鎮十二饑，詔開倉振恤。是歲，鄧至、蠕蠕等國並使朝貢。

context.beforeSource: 任城王雲薨。
context.afterSource: 六年春正月甲戌，大赦。
context.beforeLocal: 任城王雲薨。
context.afterLocal: 六年春正月甲戌，大赦。

manualTranslations.zh: 五月庚申，以農時要月，詔天下勿使有留獄。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month, on the gengshen day, because it was an important month for farming, an edict ordered that there be no lingering prison cases anywhere under Heaven.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the gengshen day, because it was an important month for farming, an edict ordered that no unresolved prison cases be left anywhere in the realm.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月甲辰，中山王睿薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, on the jiachen day, Rui, Prince of Zhongshan, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiachen day, Rui, Prince of Zhongshan, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊午，封皇叔簡為齊郡王，猛為安豐王。
manualTranslations.literal: On the wuwu day, the emperor’s uncles Jian and Meng were enfeoffed as Prince of Qi Commandery and Prince of Anfeng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, the emperor’s uncles Jian and Meng were enfeoffed as Prince of Qi Commandery and Prince of Anfeng.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月庚申朔，日有蝕之。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the gengshen day, the first day of the month, the sun was eclipsed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the gengshen day, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲子，齊人來聘。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jiazi day, people of Qi came to make a friendly mission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, envoys from Qi came on a friendly mission.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月庚午，閱武於南郊，大饗群臣。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, on the gengwu day, the emperor reviewed the troops in the southern suburbs and greatly feasted the assembled ministers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the gengwu day, the emperor reviewed the troops in the southern suburbs and held a great feast for the assembled ministers.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊使車僧朗以班在宋使殷靈誕後，辭不就席。
manualTranslations.literal: The Qi envoy Che Senglang, because his place in the order was after the Song envoy Yin Lingdan, declined and did not take his seat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Qi envoy Che Senglang, because his place in the seating order came after the Song envoy Yin Lingdan, declined and would not take his seat.

manualTranslations.zh: 宋降人解奉君刃僧朗於會中。
manualTranslations.literal: Xie Fengjun, a surrendered man from Song, stabbed Senglang in the midst of the assembly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xie Fengjun, a man surrendered from Song, stabbed Senglang amid the assembly.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔誅奉君等。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict ordered Fengjun and the others executed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Fengjun and the others executed.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙亥，封昌黎王馮熙世子誕為南平王。
manualTranslations.literal: On the yihai day, Dan, heir of Feng Xi, Prince of Changli, was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanping.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Dan, heir of Feng Xi, Prince of Changli, was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanping.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十二月癸巳，州鎮十二饑，詔開倉振恤。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the twelfth month, on the guisi day, twelve prefectures and garrisons suffered famine, and an edict ordered the granaries opened to relieve them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the twelfth month, on the guisi day, twelve prefectures and garrisons suffered famine, and an edict ordered the granaries opened for relief.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲，鄧至、蠕蠕等國並使朝貢。
manualTranslations.literal: That year Dengzhi, Rouran, and other states all sent envoys to court with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year Dengzhi, the Rouran, and other states all sent envoys to court with tribute.

sourceRange.text: 十二年春正月辛巳朔，初建五牛旌旗。乙未，詔鎮戍流徙之人，年滿七十，孤單窮獨，無成人子孫，旁無期親者，具狀以聞。二月辛亥朔，日有蝕之。三月丁亥，中散梁眾保等謀反，伏誅。夏四月甲子，大赦。己巳，齊將陳顯達攻陷醴陽，長樂王穆亮率騎討之。五月丁酉，詔六鎮、雲中、河西及關內郡，各修水田，通渠溉灌。壬寅，增置彝器於太廟。秋九月甲午，詔曰：「日蝕修德，月蝕修刑。乃者癸巳夜，月蝕盡，公卿已下，宜慎刑罰，以答天意。」丁酉，起宣文堂、經武殿。癸卯，淮南王他薨。冬閏十月甲子，帝觀築圓丘於南郊。十一月，雍、豫二州人饑，詔開倉振恤。梁州刺史、臨淮王提坐貪縱，配北鎮。是歲，高麗、宕昌、吐谷渾、勿吉、武興等國並遣使朝貢。

context.beforeSource: 吐谷渾、高麗、悉萬斤等國並遣使朝貢。
context.afterSource: 十三年春正月辛亥，祀圓丘，初備大駕。
context.beforeLocal: 吐谷渾、高麗、悉萬斤等國並遣使朝貢。
context.afterLocal: 十三年春正月辛亥，祀圓丘，初備大駕。

manualTranslations.zh: 十二年春正月辛巳朔，初建五牛旌旗。
manualTranslations.literal: In spring, in the first month of the twelfth year, on the xinsi day, the first day of the month, the five-ox banners and flags were first established.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month of the twelfth year, on the xinsi day, the first day of the month, the five-ox banners and flags were first established.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙未，詔鎮戍流徙之人，年滿七十，孤單窮獨，無成人子孫，旁無期親者，具狀以聞。
manualTranslations.literal: On the yiwei day, an edict ordered that people relocated to garrisons who were fully seventy years old, solitary, poor, and alone, with no adult sons or grandsons and no collateral kin within the one-year mourning degree, have their circumstances reported in full.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, an edict ordered that people relocated to garrisons who were at least seventy, solitary and destitute, with no adult sons or grandsons and no collateral relatives within the one-year mourning degree, have their circumstances reported in full.

manualTranslations.zh: 二月辛亥朔，日有蝕之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month, on the xinhai day, the first day of the month, the sun was eclipsed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the xinhai day, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月丁亥，中散梁眾保等謀反，伏誅。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, on the dinghai day, Liang Zhongbao, a central regular attendant, and others plotted rebellion and submitted to execution.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the dinghai day, Liang Zhongbao, a central regular attendant, and others plotted rebellion and were executed.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月甲子，大赦。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, on the jiazi day, there was a great amnesty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on the jiazi day, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

manualTranslations.zh: 己巳，齊將陳顯達攻陷醴陽，長樂王穆亮率騎討之。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jisi day, the Qi general Chen Xianda attacked and captured Liyang, and Mu Liang, Prince of Changle, led cavalry to campaign against him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, the Qi general Chen Xianda attacked and captured Liyang, and Mu Liang, Prince of Changle, led cavalry to campaign against him.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月丁酉，詔六鎮、雲中、河西及關內郡，各修水田，通渠溉灌。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month, on the dingyou day, an edict ordered the Six Garrisons, Yunzhong, Hexi, and the commanderies within the passes each to repair paddy fields and open channels for irrigation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the dingyou day, an edict ordered the Six Garrisons, Yunzhong, Hexi, and the commanderies within the passes each to repair paddy fields and open channels for irrigation.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬寅，增置彝器於太廟。
manualTranslations.literal: On the renyin day, ritual vessels were added in the Grand Temple.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, ritual vessels were added in the Grand Temple.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋九月甲午，詔曰：「日蝕修德，月蝕修刑。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the ninth month, on the jiawu day, an edict said, "At a solar eclipse cultivate virtue; at a lunar eclipse cultivate punishments.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the ninth month, on the jiawu day, an edict said, "At a solar eclipse cultivate virtue; at a lunar eclipse cultivate punishments.

manualTranslations.zh: 乃者癸巳夜，月蝕盡，公卿已下，宜慎刑罰，以答天意。」
manualTranslations.literal: Recently, on the guisi night, the moon was completely eclipsed; from the dukes and ministers on down, all should be careful with penal punishments in order to answer Heaven's intent."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Recently, on the guisi night, the moon was completely eclipsed. From the dukes and ministers on down, all should be careful with punishments in order to answer Heaven's intent."

manualTranslations.zh: 丁酉，起宣文堂、經武殿。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingyou day, construction began on Xuanwen Hall and Jingwu Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, construction began on Xuanwen Hall and Jingwu Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 癸卯，淮南王他薨。
manualTranslations.literal: On the guimao day, Ta, Prince of Huainan, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Ta, Prince of Huainan, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬閏十月甲子，帝觀築圓丘於南郊。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the intercalary tenth month, on the jiazi day, the emperor watched the construction of the round mound at the southern suburb.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the intercalary tenth month, on the jiazi day, the emperor watched the construction of the round mound at the southern suburb.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月，雍、豫二州人饑，詔開倉振恤。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month, the people of Yong and Yu provinces suffered famine, and an edict ordered granaries opened to relieve them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, the people of Yong and Yu provinces suffered famine, and an edict ordered granaries opened for relief.

manualTranslations.zh: 梁州刺史、臨淮王提坐貪縱，配北鎮。
manualTranslations.literal: Ti, Prince of Linhuai and inspector of Liangzhou, was punished for greed and license and assigned to the northern garrisons.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ti, Prince of Linhuai and inspector of Liangzhou, was punished for greed and license and assigned to the northern garrisons.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲，高麗、宕昌、吐谷渾、勿吉、武興等國並遣使朝貢。
manualTranslations.literal: That year, Goryeo, Dangchang, Tuyuhun, Wuji, Wuxing, and other states all sent envoys to court with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year, Goryeo, Dangchang, Tuyuhun, Wuji, Wuxing, and other states all sent envoys to court with tribute.

sourceRange.text: 三月丙子，以河南公梁彌機為宕昌王。夏四月己丑，宋人來聘。京師旱。甲辰，祈天災於北苑，親自禮焉，減膳避正殿。丙午，澍雨大洽，曲赦京師。五月，詔曰：「乃者人漸奢尚，婚葬越軌。又皇族貴戚及士庶之家，不惟氏族高下，與非類婚偶。先帝親發明詔，為之科禁。而百姓習常，仍不肅改。朕念憲章舊典，永為定準，犯者以違制論。」六月庚子，皇叔若薨。秋八月，分遣使者，考察守宰，問人疾苦。丙戌，詔罷諸州禽獸之貢。九月己巳朔，日有蝕之。丙辰，曲赦京師。冬十月壬辰，詔員外散騎常侍鄭發使於宋。十二月癸巳，誅南郡王李惠。是歲，龜茲國獻名駝龍馬珍寶甚眾。吐谷渾、蠕蠕、勿吉等國並遣使朝貢。州鎮二十餘水旱，人饑，詔開倉振恤。

context.beforeSource: 乙酉晦，日有蝕之。
context.afterSource: 三年春正月癸丑，坤德六合殿成。
context.beforeLocal: 乙酉晦，日有蝕之。
context.afterLocal: 三年春正月癸丑，坤德六合殿成。

manualTranslations.zh: 三月丙子，以河南公梁彌機為宕昌王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, on the bingzi day, Liang Miji, Duke of Henan, was made Prince of Dangchang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the bingzi day, Liang Miji, Duke of Henan, was made Prince of Dangchang.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月己丑，宋人來聘。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, on the jichou day, envoys from Song came on a friendly mission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on the jichou day, envoys from Song came on a friendly mission.

manualTranslations.zh: 京師旱。
manualTranslations.literal: There was drought in the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: There was drought in the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲辰，祈天災於北苑，親自禮焉，減膳避正殿。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jiachen day, the emperor prayed over the disaster from Heaven in the northern park, personally performed the rite there, reduced his meals, and avoided the main hall.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, the emperor prayed over the disaster from Heaven in the northern park, personally performed the rite there, reduced his meals, and avoided the main hall.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙午，澍雨大洽，曲赦京師。
manualTranslations.literal: On the bingwu day, timely rain fell abundantly, and a partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, timely rain fell abundantly, and a partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月，詔曰：「乃者人漸奢尚，婚葬越軌。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month, an edict said: "Recently the people have gradually come to value extravagance, and marriages and burials exceed the regulations.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, an edict said: "Recently the people have gradually come to value extravagance, and marriages and burials exceed the regulations.

manualTranslations.zh: 又皇族貴戚及士庶之家，不惟氏族高下，與非類婚偶。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, the imperial clan, noble relatives, and households of officials and commoners do not consider the standing of clans and lineages, but marry with those not of their kind.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Moreover, the imperial clan, noble relatives, and households of officials and commoners do not consider the standing of clans and lineages, but marry with those not of their kind.

manualTranslations.zh: 先帝親發明詔，為之科禁。
manualTranslations.literal: The former emperor personally issued a clear edict and established prohibitions for this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The former emperor personally issued a clear edict and established prohibitions for this.

manualTranslations.zh: 而百姓習常，仍不肅改。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet the people have followed habit and still have not reverently reformed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet the people have followed habit and still have not reverently reformed.

manualTranslations.zh: 朕念憲章舊典，永為定準，犯者以違制論。」
manualTranslations.literal: We reflect on the old models and statutes and establish them forever as the fixed standard; violators shall be judged as having violated the regulations."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We reflect on the old models and statutes and establish them forever as the fixed standard; violators shall be judged as having violated the regulations."

manualTranslations.zh: 六月庚子，皇叔若薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, on the gengzi day, the emperor's uncle Ruo died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the gengzi day, the emperor's uncle Ruo died.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋八月，分遣使者，考察守宰，問人疾苦。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the eighth month, envoys were sent out separately to examine governors and magistrates and inquire into the people's hardships.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the eighth month, envoys were sent out separately to examine governors and magistrates and inquire into the people's hardships.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙戌，詔罷諸州禽獸之貢。
manualTranslations.literal: On the bingxu day, an edict abolished the tribute of birds and beasts from the various prefectures.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, an edict abolished the tribute of birds and beasts from the various prefectures.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月己巳朔，日有蝕之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, on the jisi day, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jisi day, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙辰，曲赦京師。
manualTranslations.literal: On the bingchen day, a partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, a partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十月壬辰，詔員外散騎常侍鄭發使於宋。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the tenth month, on the renchen day, an edict sent Zheng Fa, Supernumerary Regular Mounted Attendant, as envoy to Song.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on the renchen day, an edict sent Zheng Fa, Supernumerary Regular Mounted Attendant, as envoy to Song.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月癸巳，誅南郡王李惠。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the guisi day, Li Hui, Prince of Nan Commandery, was executed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the guisi day, Li Hui, Prince of Nan Commandery, was executed.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲，龜茲國獻名駝龍馬珍寶甚眾。
manualTranslations.literal: That year the state of Kucha presented famous camels, dragon horses, and many precious goods.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year the state of Kucha presented famous camels, dragon horses, and many precious goods.

manualTranslations.zh: 吐谷渾、蠕蠕、勿吉等國並遣使朝貢。
manualTranslations.literal: Tuyuhun, the Rouran, Wuji, and other states all sent envoys to court with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tuyuhun, the Rouran, Wuji, and other states all sent envoys to court with tribute.

manualTranslations.zh: 州鎮二十餘水旱，人饑，詔開倉振恤。
manualTranslations.literal: More than twenty prefectures and garrisons suffered floods or droughts, and the people were hungry; an edict ordered the granaries opened for relief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: More than twenty prefectures and garrisons suffered floods or droughts, and the people were hungry; an edict ordered the granaries opened for relief.

sourceRange.text: 太和元年春正月乙酉，改元。辛亥，起太和、安昌二殿。己酉，秦州略陽人王元壽聚眾，自號沖天王。雲中饑，開倉振恤。二月辛未，秦益二州刺史、武都公尉洛侯討破王元壽。三月庚子，以雍州刺史、東陽王歪為司徒。丙午，詔曰：「去年牛疫，死傷大半。今東作既興，人須肄業，其敕在所督課田農，有牛者加勤於常歲，無牛者倍庸於余年。一夫制田四十畝，中男二十畝，無令人有餘力，地有遺利。

context.beforeSource: 是歲，蠕蠕、高麗、庫莫奚、波斯、契丹、宕昌、悉萬斤等國並遣使朝貢。
context.afterSource: 」夏四月，樂安王良薨。

manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Taihe, in spring, in the first month, on the yiyou day, the era name was changed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taihe, in spring, in the first month, on the yiyou day, the era name was changed.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, the two halls Taihe and Anchang were built.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yunzhong suffered famine, and the granaries were opened for relief.

manualTranslations.zh: 二月辛未，秦益二州刺史、武都公尉洛侯討破王元壽。

manualTranslations.zh: 三月庚子，以雍州刺史、東陽王歪為司徒。

manualTranslations.zh: 丙午，詔曰：「去年牛疫，死傷大半。
manualTranslations.literal: On the bingwu day, an edict said: "Last year a cattle epidemic killed and injured more than half of the herds.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, an edict said: "Last year a cattle epidemic killed and injured more than half of the herds.

manualTranslations.zh: 今東作既興，人須肄業，其敕在所督課田農，有牛者加勤於常歲，無牛者倍庸於余年。
manualTranslations.literal: Now that eastern fieldwork has begun and the people must practice their occupations, the local authorities are ordered to supervise and assess farming: those with oxen shall work harder than in ordinary years, and those without oxen shall double their labor compared with other years.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now that eastern fieldwork has begun and the people must practice their occupations, the local authorities are ordered to supervise and assess farming: those with oxen shall work harder than in ordinary years, and those without oxen shall double their labor compared with other years.

manualTranslations.zh: 一夫制田四十畝，中男二十畝，無令人有餘力，地有遺利。
manualTranslations.literal: Each adult man shall be assigned forty mu of fields, and each adolescent male twenty mu, so that no person has surplus strength and no land leaves benefit unused.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Each adult man shall be assigned forty mu of fields, and each adolescent male twenty mu, so that no person has surplus strength and no land leaves benefit unused.

sourceRange.text: 癸卯，行飲至策勛之禮。甲辰，大赦。太保、齊郡王簡薨。二月辛亥，以長兼太尉、咸陽王禧為太尉。癸亥，以中軍大將軍、彭城王勰為司徒。復樂陵王思譽本封。癸酉，齊將陳顯達攻陷馬圈戍。三月庚辰，車駕南伐。癸未，次梁城。丙戌，帝不豫。

manualTranslations.literal: Jian, Grand Protector and Prince of Qi Commandery, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jian, Grand Protector and Prince of Qi Commandery, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 二月辛亥，以長兼太尉、咸陽王禧為太尉。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month, on the xinhai day, Xi, Prince of Xianyang, who had been Senior Concurrent Grand Commandant, was made Grand Commandant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the xinhai day, Xi, Prince of Xianyang, who had been Senior Concurrent Grand Commandant, was made Grand Commandant.

manualTranslations.zh: 癸亥，以中軍大將軍、彭城王勰為司徒。
manualTranslations.literal: On the guihai day, Xie, Central Army General-in-Chief and Prince of Pengcheng, was made Minister over the Masses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Xie, Central Army General-in-Chief and Prince of Pengcheng, was made Minister over the Masses.

manualTranslations.zh: 復樂陵王思譽本封。
manualTranslations.literal: Siyu, Prince of Leling, was restored to his original fief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Siyu, Prince of Leling, was restored to his original fief.

manualTranslations.zh: 癸酉，齊將陳顯達攻陷馬圈戍。
manualTranslations.literal: On the guiyou day, the Qi general Chen Xianda attacked and captured the Maquan garrison.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, the Qi general Chen Xianda attacked and captured the Maquan garrison.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月庚辰，車駕南伐。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, on the gengchen day, the imperial carriage campaigned south.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengchen day, the emperor set out on a southern campaign.

manualTranslations.zh: 癸未，次梁城。
manualTranslations.literal: On the guiwei day, he halted at Liangcheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, he halted at Liangcheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙戌，帝不豫。
manualTranslations.literal: On the bingxu day, the emperor was unwell.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, the emperor fell ill.

sourceRange.text: 庚寅，行幸樊城，觀兵襄沔，耀武而還。曲赦二荊、魯陽。辛亥，行幸懸瓠。夏四月，趙郡王幹薨。秋七月壬午，詔後之私府損半。六宮嬪御、五服男女恒恤恒供，亦令減半。在戎之親，三分省一：以供賞。是月，齊明帝殂。八月辛亥，皇太子自京師來朝。壬戌，高麗國遣使朝貢。九月己亥，帝以禮不伐喪，詔反旆。丙午，車駕發懸瓠。冬十月乙酉朔，曲赦二豫州殊死已下，復人田租一歲。十一月辛巳，幸鄴。

context.beforeSource: 三月壬午朔，大破齊將崔慧景、蕭衍軍於鄧城。
context.afterSource: 二十三年春正月戊寅朔，朝饗群臣於鄴。
context.beforeLocal: 三月壬午朔，大破齊將崔慧景、蕭衍軍於鄧城。
context.afterLocal: 二十三年春正月戊寅朔，朝饗群臣於鄴。

manualTranslations.zh: 庚寅，行幸樊城，觀兵襄沔，耀武而還。
manualTranslations.literal: On the gengyin day, the emperor traveled to Fancheng, reviewed troops along the Xiang and Mian, displayed military power, and returned.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, the emperor traveled to Fancheng, reviewed troops along the Xiang and Mian, displayed military power, and returned.

manualTranslations.zh: 曲赦二荊、魯陽。
manualTranslations.literal: A partial amnesty was granted to the two Jing provinces and Luyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A partial amnesty was granted to the two Jing provinces and Luyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛亥，行幸懸瓠。
manualTranslations.literal: On the xinhai day, the emperor traveled to Xuanhu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, the emperor traveled to Xuanhu.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月，趙郡王幹薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, Gan, Prince of Zhao Commandery, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, Gan, Prince of Zhao Commandery, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月壬午，詔後之私府損半。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the renwu day, an edict reduced the empress's private treasury by half.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the renwu day, an edict reduced the empress's private treasury by half.

manualTranslations.zh: 六宮嬪御、五服男女恒恤恒供，亦令減半。
manualTranslations.literal: The regular relief and provisions for the consorts and attendants of the six palaces and for male and female kin within the five mourning grades were likewise ordered reduced by half.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The regular relief and provisions for the consorts and attendants of the six palaces and for male and female kin within the five mourning grades were likewise reduced by half.

manualTranslations.zh: 在戎之親，三分省一：以供賞。
manualTranslations.literal: For relatives serving in the army, one part in three was to be reduced in order to supply rewards.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For relatives serving in the army, one-third was to be cut in order to fund rewards.

manualTranslations.zh: 是月，齊明帝殂。
manualTranslations.literal: That month, Emperor Ming of Qi died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That month, Emperor Ming of Qi died.

manualTranslations.zh: 八月辛亥，皇太子自京師來朝。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month, on the xinhai day, the crown prince came from the capital to attend court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the xinhai day, the crown prince came from the capital to attend court.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬戌，高麗國遣使朝貢。
manualTranslations.literal: On the renxu day, the state of Goryeo sent envoys to court with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, the state of Goryeo sent envoys to court with tribute.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月己亥，帝以禮不伐喪，詔反旆。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, on the jihai day, because ritual did not permit attacking one in mourning, the emperor issued an edict to turn back the banners.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jihai day, because ritual did not permit attacking a ruler in mourning, the emperor issued an edict to turn back the banners.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙午，車駕發懸瓠。
manualTranslations.literal: On the bingwu day, the imperial carriage set out from Xuanhu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, the imperial carriage set out from Xuanhu.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十月乙酉朔，曲赦二豫州殊死已下，復人田租一歲。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the tenth month, on the yiyou day, the first day of the month, a partial amnesty was granted in the two Yu provinces for capital crimes and below, and the people were exempted from field rent for one year.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on the yiyou day, the first day of the month, a partial amnesty was granted in the two Yu provinces for capital crimes and below, and the people were exempted from field rent for one year.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月辛巳，幸鄴。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the xinsi day, the emperor visited Ye.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the xinsi day, the emperor visited Ye.

sourceRange.text: 辛未，幸長安。壬申，武興王楊集始來朝。乙亥，親見高年，問所疾苦。丙子，遣侍臣分省縣邑，賑賜穀帛。戊寅，幸未央殿、阿房宮，遂幸昆明池。癸未，宋王劉昶薨。丙戌，使以太牢祀漢帝諸陵。五月丁亥朔，衛大國遣使朝貢。己丑，車駕東旋，泛渭入河。庚寅，詔雍州士人百年以上，假華郡太守。九十以上，假荒郡。八十以上，假華縣。七十以上，假荒縣。庶老以年各減一等，七十已上，賜爵三級。

context.beforeSource: 修堯、舜、夏禹廟。
context.afterSource: 其營船夫，賜爵一級。
context.beforeLocal: 修堯、舜、夏禹廟。
context.afterLocal: 其營船夫，賜爵一級。

manualTranslations.zh: 辛未，幸長安。
manualTranslations.literal: On the xinwei day, the emperor visited Chang'an.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, the emperor visited Chang'an.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬申，武興王楊集始來朝。
manualTranslations.literal: On the renshen day, Yang Jishi, King of Wuxing, came to court for the first time.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Yang Jishi, King of Wuxing, came to court for the first time.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙亥，親見高年，問所疾苦。
manualTranslations.literal: On the yihai day, the emperor personally received the elderly and asked about their sufferings and hardships.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, the emperor personally received the elderly and asked about their hardships.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙子，遣侍臣分省縣邑，賑賜穀帛。
manualTranslations.literal: On the bingzi day, attendants were sent separately to inspect the counties and settlements and distribute grain and silk for relief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, attendants were sent separately to inspect the counties and settlements and distribute relief grain and silk.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊寅，幸未央殿、阿房宮，遂幸昆明池。
manualTranslations.literal: On the wuyin day, he visited Weiyang Hall and Afang Palace, then proceeded to visit Kunming Pool.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, he visited Weiyang Hall and Afang Palace, then proceeded to Kunming Pool.

manualTranslations.zh: 癸未，宋王劉昶薨。
manualTranslations.literal: On the guiwei day, Liu Chang, Prince of Song, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Liu Chang, Prince of Song, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙戌，使以太牢祀漢帝諸陵。
manualTranslations.literal: On the bingxu day, an envoy was sent to sacrifice with the grand victim at the tombs of the Han emperors.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, an envoy was sent to sacrifice with the grand victim at the tombs of the Han emperors.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月丁亥朔，衛大國遣使朝貢。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month, on the dinghai day, the first day of the month, the state of Weida sent envoys to court with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the dinghai day, the first day of the month, the state of Weida sent envoys to court with tribute.

manualTranslations.zh: 己丑，車駕東旋，泛渭入河。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jichou day, the imperial carriage turned east, floated along the Wei, and entered the Yellow River.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, the imperial carriage turned east, floated along the Wei, and entered the Yellow River.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚寅，詔雍州士人百年以上，假華郡太守。
manualTranslations.literal: On the gengyin day, an edict provisionally appointed Yong Province men of the scholar class aged one hundred or above as governors of flourishing commanderies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, an edict provisionally appointed Yong Province men of the scholar class aged one hundred or above as governors of flourishing commanderies.

manualTranslations.zh: 九十以上，假荒郡。
manualTranslations.literal: Those aged ninety or above were provisionally appointed to remote commanderies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those aged ninety or above were provisionally appointed to remote commanderies.

manualTranslations.zh: 八十以上，假華縣。
manualTranslations.literal: Those aged eighty or above were provisionally appointed to flourishing counties.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those aged eighty or above were provisionally appointed to flourishing counties.

manualTranslations.zh: 七十以上，假荒縣。
manualTranslations.literal: Those aged seventy or above were provisionally appointed to remote counties.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those aged seventy or above were provisionally appointed to remote counties.

manualTranslations.zh: 庶老以年各減一等，七十已上，賜爵三級。
manualTranslations.literal: For common elders, each rank was reduced by one grade according to age; those seventy and above were granted three grades of noble rank.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For common elders, each age category was lowered by one grade; those seventy or above were granted three grades of noble rank.

sourceRange.text: 景明元年春正月辛丑朔，日有蝕之。壬寅，謁長陵。乙巳，大赦，改元。丁未，齊豫州刺史裴叔業以壽春內屬。二月戊戌，復以彭城王勰為司徒。齊將胡松、李居士軍屯宛，陳伯之水軍逼壽春。夏四月丙申，司徒彭城王勰、車騎將軍王肅大破之。己亥，皇弟恌薨。五月甲寅，北鎮饑，遣兼侍中楊播巡撫振恤。六月丙子，以司徒、彭城王勰為大司馬。秋七月己亥朔，日有蝕之。齊將陳伯之寇淮南。八月乙酉，彭城王勰破伯之於肥口。九月，齊州人柳世明聚眾反。冬十月丁卯朔，謁長陵。庚寅，齊、兗二州討世明平之。丁亥，改授彭城王勰司徒、錄尚書事。十一月丁巳，陽平王頤薨。是歲，州鎮十七大饑，分遣使者，開倉振恤。高麗、吐谷渾等國並遣使朝貢。

context.beforeSource: 是歲，州鎮十八水饑，分遣使者，開倉振恤。
context.afterSource: 二年春正月丙申朔，謁長陵。

manualTranslations.zh: 景明元年春正月辛丑朔，日有蝕之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Jingming, in spring, in the first month, on the xinchou day, the first day of the month, the sun was eclipsed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jingming, in spring, in the first month, on the xinchou day, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬寅，謁長陵。
manualTranslations.literal: On the renyin day, the emperor paid respects at Changling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, the emperor paid respects at Changling.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙巳，大赦，改元。
manualTranslations.literal: On the yisi day, there was a great amnesty and the era name was changed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁未，齊豫州刺史裴叔業以壽春內屬。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingwei day, Pei Shuye, Qi inspector of Yuzhou, submitted inward with Shouchun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, Pei Shuye, Qi inspector of Yuzhou, submitted to Wei with Shouchun.

manualTranslations.zh: 二月戊戌，復以彭城王勰為司徒。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month, on the wuxu day, Xie, Prince of Pengcheng, was again made Minister over the Masses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the wuxu day, Xie, Prince of Pengcheng, was again made Minister over the Masses.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊將胡松、李居士軍屯宛，陳伯之水軍逼壽春。
manualTranslations.literal: The Qi generals Hu Song and Li Jushi stationed troops at Wan, while Chen Bozhi’s naval forces pressed toward Shouchun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Qi generals Hu Song and Li Jushi stationed troops at Wan, while Chen Bozhi’s naval forces threatened Shouchun.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月丙申，司徒彭城王勰、車騎將軍王肅大破之。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, on the bingshen day, Xie, Minister over the Masses and Prince of Pengcheng, and Wang Su, General of Chariots and Cavalry, greatly defeated them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on the bingshen day, Xie, Minister over the Masses and Prince of Pengcheng, and Wang Su, General of Chariots and Cavalry, greatly defeated them.

manualTranslations.zh: 己亥，皇弟恌薨。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jihai day, the emperor’s younger brother Tiao died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, the emperor’s younger brother Tiao died.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月甲寅，北鎮饑，遣兼侍中楊播巡撫振恤。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month, on the jiayin day, the northern garrisons suffered famine, and Yang Bo, acting Palace Attendant, was sent to tour, comfort, and relieve them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jiayin day, the northern garrisons suffered famine, and Yang Bo, acting Palace Attendant, was sent to tour, comfort, and provide relief.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月丙子，以司徒、彭城王勰為大司馬。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, on the bingzi day, Xie, Minister over the Masses and Prince of Pengcheng, was made Grand Marshal.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the bingzi day, Xie, Minister over the Masses and Prince of Pengcheng, was made Grand Marshal.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月己亥朔，日有蝕之。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the jihai day, the first day of the month, the sun was eclipsed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the jihai day, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊將陳伯之寇淮南。
manualTranslations.literal: The Qi general Chen Bozhi raided Huainan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Qi general Chen Bozhi raided Huainan.

manualTranslations.zh: 八月乙酉，彭城王勰破伯之於肥口。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month, on the yiyou day, Xie, Prince of Pengcheng, defeated Bozhi at Feikou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the yiyou day, Xie, Prince of Pengcheng, defeated Bozhi at Feikou.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月，齊州人柳世明聚眾反。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, Liu Shiming of Qi Province gathered a crowd and rebelled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Liu Shiming of Qi Province gathered a crowd and rebelled.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十月丁卯朔，謁長陵。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the tenth month, on the dingmao day, the first day of the month, the emperor paid respects at Changling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on the dingmao day, the first day of the month, the emperor paid respects at Changling.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚寅，齊、兗二州討世明平之。
manualTranslations.literal: On the gengyin day, Qi and Yan provinces attacked Shiming and pacified him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Qi and Yan provinces attacked Shiming and pacified him.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁亥，改授彭城王勰司徒、錄尚書事。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dinghai day, Xie, Prince of Pengcheng, was reassigned as Minister over the Masses and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Xie, Prince of Pengcheng, was reassigned as Minister over the Masses and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月丁巳，陽平王頤薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the dingsi day, Yi, Prince of Yangping, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the dingsi day, Yi, Prince of Yangping, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲，州鎮十七大饑，分遣使者，開倉振恤。
manualTranslations.literal: That year, seventeen provinces and garrisons suffered great famine; envoys were dispatched separately to open granaries and relieve them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year, seventeen provinces and garrisons suffered great famine; envoys were dispatched separately to open granaries for relief.

manualTranslations.zh: 高麗、吐谷渾等國並遣使朝貢。
manualTranslations.literal: Goryeo, Tuyuhun, and other states all sent envoys to court with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Goryeo, Tuyuhun, and other states all sent envoys to court with tribute.

sourceRange.text: 三年春二月壬子，秦州沙門劉光秀謀反，州郡捕斬之。癸亥，秦州隴西羌殺鎮將趙俊反，州軍討平之。三月丙戌，皇子詡生，大赦。夏四月，平陽郡之禽昌、襄陵二縣大疫，自正月至此月，死者二千七百三十人。五月丁亥，冀、定二州旱儉，詔開倉振恤。六月甲寅，詔重求遺書於天下。冬十月辛卯，中山王英薨。丙申，詔太常立館，使京畿內外疾病之徒，咸令居處。嚴敕醫署分師救療，考其能否而行賞罰。又令有司集諸醫工，惟簡精要，取三十卷以班九服。十二月辛巳，江陽王繼坐事除名。甲申，詔於青州立孝文皇帝廟。殿中侍御史王敞謀反，伏誅。是歲，西域、東夷、北狄十六國並遣使朝貢。四年春正月丁巳，汾州劉龍駒聚眾反，詔諫議大夫薛和討之。二月壬午，青、齊、徐、兗四州人饑甚，遣使振恤。三月壬戌，司徒、廣陽王嘉薨。夏四月，梁遣其鎮北將軍張稷及馬仙琕寇朐山，詔徐州刺史盧昶率眾赴之。五月己亥，遷代京銅龍置天泉池西。丙辰，詔禁天文學。冬十一月，朐山城陷，盧昶大敗而還。十二月壬戌朔，日有蝕之。是歲，西域、東夷、北狄二十九國並遣使朝貢。

context.beforeSource: 是歲，西域、東夷二十四國並遣使朝貢。

context.afterLocal: 延昌元年春正月乙巳，以頻年水旱，百姓饑弊，分遣使者，開倉振恤。

manualTranslations.zh: 三年春二月壬子，秦州沙門劉光秀謀反，州郡捕斬之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, in spring, in the second month, on the renzi day, Liu Guangxiu, a monk of Qin Province, plotted rebellion, and the province and commandery authorities captured and beheaded him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year, in spring, in the second month, on the renzi day, Liu Guangxiu, a monk of Qin Province, plotted rebellion; provincial and commandery authorities captured and beheaded him.

manualTranslations.zh: 癸亥，秦州隴西羌殺鎮將趙俊反，州軍討平之。
manualTranslations.literal: On the guihai day, Qiang of Longxi in Qin Province killed the garrison commander Zhao Jun and rebelled; provincial troops attacked and pacified them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Qiang of Longxi in Qin Province killed the garrison commander Zhao Jun and rebelled; provincial troops attacked and pacified them.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月丙戌，皇子詡生，大赦。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, on the bingxu day, the imperial son Xu was born, and there was a great amnesty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the bingxu day, the imperial son Xu was born, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月，平陽郡之禽昌、襄陵二縣大疫，自正月至此月，死者二千七百三十人。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, the two counties of Qinchang and Xiangling in Pingyang Commandery suffered a great epidemic; from the first month to this month, 2,730 people died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, the two counties of Qinchang and Xiangling in Pingyang Commandery suffered a great epidemic; from the first month to this month, 2,730 people died.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月丁亥，冀、定二州旱儉，詔開倉振恤。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month, on the dinghai day, Ji and Ding provinces suffered drought and shortage, and an edict ordered granaries opened to relieve them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the dinghai day, Ji and Ding provinces suffered drought and shortage, and an edict ordered granaries opened for relief.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月甲寅，詔重求遺書於天下。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, on the jiayin day, an edict again sought lost books throughout the realm.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiayin day, an edict again sought lost books throughout the realm.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十月辛卯，中山王英薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the tenth month, on the xinmao day, Ying, Prince of Zhongshan, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on the xinmao day, Ying, Prince of Zhongshan, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙申，詔太常立館，使京畿內外疾病之徒，咸令居處。
manualTranslations.literal: On the bingshen day, an edict ordered the Chamberlain for Ceremonials to establish a hospice and have all the sick inside and outside the capital region reside there.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, an edict ordered the Chamberlain for Ceremonials to establish a hospice where the sick from inside and outside the capital region could all be housed.

manualTranslations.zh: 嚴敕醫署分師救療，考其能否而行賞罰。
manualTranslations.literal: The Medical Office was strictly ordered to assign physicians to treat and rescue them, and their ability or inability was to be examined so rewards and punishments could be carried out.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Medical Office was strictly ordered to assign physicians for treatment, with rewards and punishments based on assessments of their effectiveness.

manualTranslations.zh: 又令有司集諸醫工，惟簡精要，取三十卷以班九服。
manualTranslations.literal: It was also ordered that the responsible officials gather the medical practitioners, select only the essential material, and take thirty juan to distribute through the nine regions.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: It was also ordered that the responsible officials gather the medical practitioners, select the essential material, and compile thirty juan for distribution throughout the realm.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月辛巳，江陽王繼坐事除名。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the xinsi day, Ji, Prince of Jiangyang, was stripped of his name for an offense.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the xinsi day, Ji, Prince of Jiangyang, was stripped of office and title for an offense.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲申，詔於青州立孝文皇帝廟。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jiashen day, an edict ordered a temple for Emperor Xiaowen established in Qing Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, an edict ordered a temple for Emperor Xiaowen established in Qing Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 殿中侍御史王敞謀反，伏誅。
manualTranslations.literal: Wang Chang, Palace Attendant Censor, plotted rebellion and submitted to execution.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang Chang, Palace Attendant Censor, plotted rebellion and was executed.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲，西域、東夷、北狄十六國並遣使朝貢。
manualTranslations.literal: That year, sixteen states of the Western Regions, Eastern Yi, and Northern Di all sent envoys to court with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year, sixteen states of the Western Regions, Eastern Yi, and Northern Di all sent envoys to court with tribute.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年春正月丁巳，汾州劉龍駒聚眾反，詔諫議大夫薛和討之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, in spring, in the first month, on the dingsi day, Liu Longju of Fen Province gathered a crowd and rebelled; an edict ordered Remonstrance Grandee Xue He to attack him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, in spring, in the first month, on the dingsi day, Liu Longju of Fen Province gathered a crowd and rebelled; an edict ordered Remonstrance Grandee Xue He to attack him.

manualTranslations.zh: 二月壬午，青、齊、徐、兗四州人饑甚，遣使振恤。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month, on the renwu day, the people of Qing, Qi, Xu, and Yan provinces suffered severe famine, and envoys were sent to relieve them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the renwu day, the people of Qing, Qi, Xu, and Yan provinces suffered severe famine, and envoys were sent to provide relief.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月壬戌，司徒、廣陽王嘉薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, on the renxu day, Jia, Minister over the Masses and Prince of Guangyang, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the renxu day, Jia, Minister over the Masses and Prince of Guangyang, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月，梁遣其鎮北將軍張稷及馬仙琕寇朐山，詔徐州刺史盧昶率眾赴之。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, Liang sent its General Who Guards the North Zhang Ji and Ma Xianbei to raid Qushan; an edict ordered Lu Chang, inspector of Xu Province, to lead troops to go there.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, Liang sent its General Who Guards the North Zhang Ji and Ma Xianbei to raid Qushan; an edict ordered Lu Chang, inspector of Xu Province, to lead troops there.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月己亥，遷代京銅龍置天泉池西。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month, on the jihai day, the bronze dragon from the old capital at Dai was moved and placed west of Tianquan Pool.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jihai day, the bronze dragon from the old capital at Dai was moved and placed west of Tianquan Pool.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙辰，詔禁天文學。
manualTranslations.literal: On the bingchen day, an edict prohibited the study of astronomy and astrology.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, an edict prohibited the study of astronomy and astrology.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十一月，朐山城陷，盧昶大敗而還。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the eleventh month, Qushan city fell, and Lu Chang returned after a great defeat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the eleventh month, Qushan city fell, and Lu Chang returned after a crushing defeat.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月壬戌朔，日有蝕之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the renxu day, the first day of the month, the sun was eclipsed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the renxu day, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲，西域、東夷、北狄二十九國並遣使朝貢。
manualTranslations.literal: That year, twenty-nine states of the Western Regions, Eastern Yi, and Northern Di all sent envoys to court with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year, twenty-nine states of the Western Regions, Eastern Yi, and Northern Di all sent envoys to court with tribute.

sourceRange.text: 孝昌元年春正月庚申，徐州刺史元法僧據城反，自稱宋王，年號天啟。遣其子景仲歸梁。梁遣其將豫章王綜入守彭城。法僧擁其僚屬南入。詔臨淮王彧、尚書李憲為都督，安豐王延明為東道行臺，俱討徐州。癸亥，蕭寶夤及征西將軍崔延伯大破賊於黑水。天生退走入隴，涇、岐及隴悉平。以太師、大將軍、京兆王繼為太尉。

context.beforeSource: 是歲，嚈噠、契丹、地豆幹、庫莫奚等國並遣使朝貢。
context.afterSource: 二月，詔追復故樂良王長命爵，以其子忠紹之。
context.beforeLocal: 是歲，嚈噠、契丹、地豆幹、庫莫奚等國並遣使朝貢。
context.afterLocal: 二月，詔追復故樂良王長命爵，以其子忠紹之。

manualTranslations.zh: 孝昌元年春正月庚申，徐州刺史元法僧據城反，自稱宋王，年號天啟。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Xiaochang, in spring, in the first month, on the gengshen day, Yuan Faseng, inspector of Xu Province, occupied the city and rebelled, calling himself King of Song and giving his reign the era name Tianqi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xiaochang, in spring, in the first month, on the gengshen day, Yuan Faseng, inspector of Xu Province, occupied the city and rebelled, calling himself King of Song and taking Tianqi as his era name.

manualTranslations.zh: 遣其子景仲歸梁。
manualTranslations.literal: He sent his son Jingzhong to submit to Liang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He sent his son Jingzhong to submit to Liang.

manualTranslations.zh: 梁遣其將豫章王綜入守彭城。
manualTranslations.literal: Liang sent its general Zong, Prince of Yuzhang, to enter and defend Pengcheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liang sent its general Zong, Prince of Yuzhang, to enter and defend Pengcheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 法僧擁其僚屬南入。
manualTranslations.literal: Faseng took his staff and subordinates and entered the south.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Faseng took his staff and subordinates and withdrew south.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔臨淮王彧、尚書李憲為都督，安豐王延明為東道行臺，俱討徐州。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict made Yu, Prince of Linhuai, and Li Xian, Minister of the Masters of Writing, commanders-in-chief, and Yanming, Prince of Anfeng, acting imperial commissioner of the eastern route; together they were to attack Xu Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict made Yu, Prince of Linhuai, and Li Xian, Minister of the Masters of Writing, commanders-in-chief, and Yanming, Prince of Anfeng, acting imperial commissioner of the eastern route; together they were to campaign against Xu Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 癸亥，蕭寶夤及征西將軍崔延伯大破賊於黑水。
manualTranslations.literal: On the guihai day, Xiao Baoyin and Cui Yanbo, General Who Conquers the West, greatly defeated the rebels at Black Water.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Xiao Baoyin and Cui Yanbo, General Who Conquers the West, crushed the rebels at Black Water.

manualTranslations.zh: 天生退走入隴，涇、岐及隴悉平。
manualTranslations.literal: Tiansheng retreated and fled into Long, and Jing, Qi, and Long were all pacified.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tiansheng retreated into Long, and Jing, Qi, and Long were all pacified.

manualTranslations.zh: 以太師、大將軍、京兆王繼為太尉。
manualTranslations.literal: Ji, Grand Preceptor, General-in-Chief, and Prince of Jingzhao, was made Grand Commandant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ji, Grand Preceptor, General-in-Chief, and Prince of Jingzhao, was made Grand Commandant.

sourceRange.text: 宜遵舊典，稱詔宇內，以副黎蒸元元之望。」是月，改葬文昭皇太后高氏。二月乙丑，齊郡王祐薨。庚午，羽林千餘人焚征西將軍張彝第，毆傷彝，燒殺其子始均。乙亥，大赦。丁丑，詔求直言。壬寅，詔以旱故，命依舊雩祈，察理冤獄，掩胔埋骼，振窮恤寡。三月甲辰，澍雨大洽。夏五月戊戌，以司空、任城王澄為司徒，京兆王繼為司空。秋八月乙未，御史中尉、東平王匡坐事削除官爵。九月庚寅，皇太后幸嵩高山。癸巳，還宮。冬十二月癸丑，司徒、任城王澄薨。庚申，大赦。詔除淫祀，焚諸雜神。是歲，吐谷渾、宕昌、嚈噠等國並遣使朝貢。

manualTranslations.zh: 宜遵舊典，稱詔宇內，以副黎蒸元元之望。」
manualTranslations.literal: It is fitting to follow the old precedents, proclaim the title throughout the realm, and answer the hopes of the black-haired common people."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We should follow precedent, proclaim the title throughout the realm, and answer the hopes of the common people."

manualTranslations.zh: 是月，改葬文昭皇太后高氏。
manualTranslations.literal: That month, Empress Dowager Wenzhao of the Gao clan was reburied.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That month, Empress Dowager Wenzhao of the Gao clan was reburied.

manualTranslations.zh: 二月乙丑，齊郡王祐薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month, on the yichou day, You, Prince of Qi Commandery, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the yichou day, You, Prince of Qi Commandery, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚午，羽林千餘人焚征西將軍張彝第，毆傷彝，燒殺其子始均。
manualTranslations.literal: On the gengwu day, more than a thousand Feathered Forest guards burned the residence of Zhang Yi, General Who Conquers the West, beat and injured Yi, and burned his son Shijun to death.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, more than a thousand Feathered Forest guards burned the residence of Zhang Yi, General Who Conquers the West, beat and injured him, and burned his son Shijun to death.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙亥，大赦。
manualTranslations.literal: On the yihai day, there was a great amnesty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁丑，詔求直言。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingchou day, an edict sought forthright speech.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, an edict called for forthright criticism.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬寅，詔以旱故，命依舊雩祈，察理冤獄，掩胔埋骼，振窮恤寡。
manualTranslations.literal: On the renyin day, because of the drought, an edict ordered rain-prayers according to old practice, the investigation and correction of unjust imprisonments, the covering of exposed corpses and burial of bones, and relief for the poor and aid for widows.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, because of the drought, an edict ordered rain-prayers according to old practice, the review of wrongful imprisonments, the burial of exposed remains, and relief for the poor and widowed.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月甲辰，澍雨大洽。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, on the jiachen day, soaking rain fell in great abundance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jiachen day, soaking rain fell in great abundance.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏五月戊戌，以司空、任城王澄為司徒，京兆王繼為司空。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fifth month, on the wuxu day, Cheng, Minister of Works and Prince of Rencheng, was made Minister over the Masses, and Ji, Prince of Jingzhao, was made Minister of Works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fifth month, on the wuxu day, Cheng, Minister of Works and Prince of Rencheng, was made Minister over the Masses, and Ji, Prince of Jingzhao, was made Minister of Works.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋八月乙未，御史中尉、東平王匡坐事削除官爵。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the eighth month, on the yiwei day, Kuang, Censor-in-Chief and Prince of Dongping, was implicated in an affair and stripped of office and noble rank.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the eighth month, on the yiwei day, Kuang, Censor-in-Chief and Prince of Dongping, was stripped of office and noble rank for an offense.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月庚寅，皇太后幸嵩高山。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, on the gengyin day, the Empress Dowager visited Mount Songgao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the gengyin day, the Empress Dowager visited Mount Songgao.

manualTranslations.zh: 癸巳，還宮。
manualTranslations.literal: On the guisi day, she returned to the palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, she returned to the palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十二月癸丑，司徒、任城王澄薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the twelfth month, on the guichou day, Cheng, Minister over the Masses and Prince of Rencheng, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the twelfth month, on the guichou day, Cheng, Minister over the Masses and Prince of Rencheng, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚申，大赦。
manualTranslations.literal: On the gengshen day, there was a great amnesty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔除淫祀，焚諸雜神。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict abolished improper sacrifices and burned the various miscellaneous gods.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict abolished improper cults and burned assorted cult images.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲，吐谷渾、宕昌、嚈噠等國並遣使朝貢。
manualTranslations.literal: That year, Tuyuhun, Dangchang, Hephthalites, and other states all sent envoys to court with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year, Tuyuhun, Dangchang, the Hephthalites, and other states all sent envoys to court with tribute.

sourceRange.text: 夏五月壬子，廣陵王羽薨。壬戌，太保、咸陽王禧謀反，賜死。六月丁亥，考諸州刺史，加以黜陟。秋七月癸巳朔，日有蝕之。乙巳，蠕蠕犯塞。辛酉，大赦。九月丁酉，發畿內夫五萬五千人築京師三百二十坊，四旬罷。己亥，立皇后於氏。乙卯，免壽春營戶，並隸揚州。冬十一月丙申，以驃騎大將軍穆亮為司空。丁酉，以大將軍、北海王詳為太傅，領司徒。壬寅，改築圓丘於伊水之陽。乙卯，仍有事焉。十二月，齊直後張齊殺其主蕭寶卷以降蕭衍。是歲，高麗、吐谷渾等國並遣使朝貢。三年春二月戊寅，以旱故，詔州郡掩骸骨。三月，齊建安王寶夤來奔。夏四月，詔撫軍將軍李崇討魯陽反蠻。齊主蕭寶融遜位於梁。閏四月丁巳，司空穆亮薨。秋七月丁巳朔，日有蝕之。八月丁卯，以前太傅、平陽公元丕為三老。九月丁巳，行幸鄴。丁卯，詔使者吊比幹墓。戊寅，閱武於鄴南。冬十月庚子，帝躬禦弧矢射，遠及一里五十步，群臣勒銘於射所。甲辰，車駕還宮。十二月壬寅，以太極前殿初成，饗群臣，賜布帛有差。是歲，河州大饑，死者二千餘口。西域二十七國並遣使朝貢。四年春正月乙亥，親耕籍田。三月己巳，皇后先蠶於北郊。四月癸未朔，以蕭寶夤為東揚州刺史，封丹楊郡公、齊王。庚寅，南天竺國獻辟支佛牙。戊戌，為旱故，命鞫冤獄。己亥，減膳徹懸。辛丑，澍雨大洽。五月甲戌，行梁州事楊椿大破反氐。六月壬午朔，封皇弟悅為汝南王。秋七月乙卯，三老平陽公元丕薨。庚午，詔復收鹽池利。辛未，以彭城王勰為太師。八月，勿吉國貢楛矢。冬十一月己未，封武興國世子楊紹先為武興王。正始元年春正月丙寅，大赦，改元。夏五月丁未朔，太傅、北海王詳以罪廢為庶人。六月，以旱故，徹樂減膳。癸巳，詔有司修案舊典，祗行六事。甲午，帝以旱故，親薦享於太廟。戊戌，詔立周旦、夷、齊廟於首陽山。庚子，以旱故，公卿以下，引咎責躬。又錄京師見囚，殊死以下皆減一等；鞭杖之坐，悉原之。秋七月丙子，假鎮南將軍李崇大破諸蠻。八月丙子，假鎮南將軍元英破梁將馬仙琕於義陽。

context.beforeSource: 是月，齊雍州刺史蕭衍奉其南康王寶融為主，東赴建鄴。
context.afterSource: 詔洛陽令有大事，聽面敷奏。
context.beforeLocal: 是月，齊雍州刺史蕭衍奉其南康王寶融為主，東赴建鄴。
context.afterLocal: 詔洛陽令有大事，聽面敷奏。
