manualTranslations.zh: 夏五月壬子，廣陵王羽薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fifth month, on the renzi day, Yu, Prince of Guangling, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fifth month, on the renzi day, Yu, Prince of Guangling, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬戌，太保、咸陽王禧謀反，賜死。
manualTranslations.literal: On the renxu day, Xi, Grand Protector and Prince of Xianyang, plotted rebellion and was granted death.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Xi, Grand Protector and Prince of Xianyang, plotted rebellion and was ordered to die.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月丁亥，考諸州刺史，加以黜陟。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, on the dinghai day, the inspectors of the several provinces were evaluated, and demotions and promotions were added accordingly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the dinghai day, the inspectors of the several provinces were evaluated and promoted or demoted accordingly.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月癸巳朔，日有蝕之。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the guisi day, the first day of the month, the sun was eclipsed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the guisi day, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙巳，蠕蠕犯塞。
manualTranslations.literal: On the yisi day, the Rouran violated the frontier passes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, the Rouran raided the frontier passes.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛酉，大赦。
manualTranslations.literal: On the xinyou day, there was a great amnesty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月丁酉，發畿內夫五萬五千人築京師三百二十坊，四旬罷。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, on the dingyou day, fifty-five thousand laborers from within the capital region were levied to build 320 wards in the capital; after forty days the work stopped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the dingyou day, fifty-five thousand laborers from the capital region were levied to build 320 wards in the capital; the work stopped after forty days.

manualTranslations.zh: 己亥，立皇后於氏。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jihai day, the empress of the Yu clan was installed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Empress Yu was installed.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙卯，免壽春營戶，並隸揚州。
manualTranslations.literal: On the yimao day, the garrison households of Shouchun were released and all placed under Yang Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Shouchun's garrison households were released and placed under Yang Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十一月丙申，以驃騎大將軍穆亮為司空。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the eleventh month, on the bingshen day, Mu Liang, Grand General of Agile Cavalry, was made Minister of Works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the eleventh month, on the bingshen day, Mu Liang, Grand General of Agile Cavalry, was made Minister of Works.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁酉，以大將軍、北海王詳為太傅，領司徒。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingyou day, Xiang, General-in-Chief and Prince of Beihai, was made Grand Tutor and concurrently held the post of Minister over the Masses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Xiang, General-in-Chief and Prince of Beihai, was made Grand Tutor and concurrently held the post of Minister over the Masses.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬寅，改築圓丘於伊水之陽。
manualTranslations.literal: On the renyin day, the Circular Mound Altar was rebuilt on the north bank of the Yi River.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, the Circular Mound Altar was rebuilt on the north bank of the Yi River.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙卯，仍有事焉。
manualTranslations.literal: On the yimao day, sacrifice was again performed there.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, sacrifice was again performed there.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月，齊直後張齊殺其主蕭寶卷以降蕭衍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, Zhang Qi, personal attendant of Qi, killed his ruler Xiao Baojuan and surrendered to Xiao Yan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Zhang Qi, a Qi personal attendant, killed his ruler Xiao Baojuan and surrendered to Xiao Yan.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲，高麗、吐谷渾等國並遣使朝貢。
manualTranslations.literal: That year, Goryeo, Tuyuhun, and other states all sent envoys to court with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year, Goryeo, Tuyuhun, and other states all sent envoys to court with tribute.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年春二月戊寅，以旱故，詔州郡掩骸骨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, in spring, in the second month, on the wuyin day, because of drought, an edict ordered the provinces and commanderies to cover and bury bones.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year, in spring, in the second month, on the wuyin day, because of drought, an edict ordered the provinces and commanderies to bury exposed remains.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月，齊建安王寶夤來奔。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, Baoyin, Prince of Jian'an of Qi, came in flight.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, Baoyin, Prince of Jian'an of Qi, came over as a defector.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月，詔撫軍將軍李崇討魯陽反蠻。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, an edict ordered Li Chong, General Who Pacifies the Army, to attack the rebel Man of Luyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, an edict ordered Li Chong, General Who Pacifies the Army, to attack the rebel Man of Luyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊主蕭寶融遜位於梁。
manualTranslations.literal: The Qi ruler Xiao Baorong yielded the throne to Liang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Qi ruler Xiao Baorong yielded the throne to Liang.

manualTranslations.zh: 閏四月丁巳，司空穆亮薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the intercalary fourth month, on the dingsi day, Mu Liang, Minister of Works, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month, on the dingsi day, Mu Liang, Minister of Works, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月丁巳朔，日有蝕之。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the dingsi day, the first day of the month, the sun was eclipsed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the dingsi day, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

manualTranslations.zh: 八月丁卯，以前太傅、平陽公元丕為三老。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month, on the dingmao day, Yuan Pi, former Grand Tutor and Duke of Pingyang, was made one of the Three Elders.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the dingmao day, Yuan Pi, former Grand Tutor and Duke of Pingyang, was made one of the Three Elders.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月丁巳，行幸鄴。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, on the dingsi day, the emperor traveled to Ye.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the dingsi day, the emperor traveled to Ye.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁卯，詔使者吊比幹墓。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingmao day, an edict ordered envoys to offer condolences at Bi Gan's tomb.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, an edict ordered envoys to offer condolences at Bi Gan's tomb.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊寅，閱武於鄴南。
manualTranslations.literal: On the wuyin day, troops were reviewed south of Ye.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, a military review was held south of Ye.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十月庚子，帝躬禦弧矢射，遠及一里五十步，群臣勒銘於射所。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the tenth month, on the gengzi day, the emperor personally wielded bow and arrows to shoot, the distance reaching one li and fifty paces; the assembled ministers engraved an inscription at the shooting place.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on the gengzi day, the emperor personally shot a bow, reaching a distance of one li and fifty paces; the assembled ministers engraved an inscription at the archery ground.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲辰，車駕還宮。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jiachen day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月壬寅，以太極前殿初成，饗群臣，賜布帛有差。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the renyin day, because the front hall of Taiji had just been completed, the assembled ministers were feasted and cloth and silk were bestowed by grade.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the renyin day, because the front hall of Taiji had just been completed, the assembled ministers were feasted and cloth and silk were bestowed by grade.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲，河州大饑，死者二千餘口。
manualTranslations.literal: That year, He Province suffered a great famine, and more than two thousand people died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year, He Province suffered a great famine, and more than two thousand people died.

manualTranslations.zh: 西域二十七國並遣使朝貢。
manualTranslations.literal: Twenty-seven states of the Western Regions all sent envoys to court with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Twenty-seven states of the Western Regions all sent envoys to court with tribute.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年春正月乙亥，親耕籍田。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, in spring, in the first month, on the yihai day, the emperor personally plowed the imperial field.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, in spring, in the first month, on the yihai day, the emperor personally plowed the imperial field.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月己巳，皇后先蠶於北郊。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, on the jisi day, the empress performed the first silkworm rite at the northern suburb.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jisi day, the empress performed the first silkworm rite at the northern suburb.

manualTranslations.zh: 四月癸未朔，以蕭寶夤為東揚州刺史，封丹楊郡公、齊王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth month, on the guiwei day, the first day of the month, Xiao Baoyin was made inspector of Eastern Yang Province and enfeoffed as Duke of Danyang Commandery and Prince of Qi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the guiwei day, the first day of the month, Xiao Baoyin was made inspector of Eastern Yang Province and enfeoffed as Duke of Danyang Commandery and Prince of Qi.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚寅，南天竺國獻辟支佛牙。
manualTranslations.literal: On the gengyin day, the state of Southern Tianzhu presented a pratyeka-buddha tooth.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, the state of Southern Tianzhu presented a pratyeka-buddha tooth.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊戌，為旱故，命鞫冤獄。
manualTranslations.literal: On the wuxu day, because of drought, he ordered wrongful imprisonments to be examined.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, because of drought, he ordered wrongful imprisonments to be examined.

manualTranslations.zh: 己亥，減膳徹懸。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jihai day, he reduced his meals and removed the suspended music racks.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, he reduced his meals and suspended the court music.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛丑，澍雨大洽。
manualTranslations.literal: On the xinchou day, soaking rain fell in great abundance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, soaking rain fell in great abundance.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月甲戌，行梁州事楊椿大破反氐。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month, on the jiaxu day, Yang Chun, acting in charge of Liang Province affairs, greatly defeated the rebel Di.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jiaxu day, Yang Chun, acting in charge of Liang Province affairs, greatly defeated the rebel Di.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月壬午朔，封皇弟悅為汝南王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, on the renwu day, the first day of the month, the emperor's younger brother Yue was enfeoffed as Prince of Runan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the renwu day, the first day of the month, the emperor's younger brother Yue was enfeoffed as Prince of Runan.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月乙卯，三老平陽公元丕薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the yimao day, Yuan Pi, one of the Three Elders and Duke of Pingyang, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the yimao day, Yuan Pi, one of the Three Elders and Duke of Pingyang, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚午，詔復收鹽池利。
manualTranslations.literal: On the gengwu day, an edict again collected the profits of the salt ponds.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, an edict restored collection of the salt-pond profits.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛未，以彭城王勰為太師。
manualTranslations.literal: On the xinwei day, Xie, Prince of Pengcheng, was made Grand Preceptor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Xie, Prince of Pengcheng, was made Grand Preceptor.

manualTranslations.zh: 八月，勿吉國貢楛矢。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month, the state of Wuji presented hardwood arrows as tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, the state of Wuji presented hardwood arrows as tribute.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十一月己未，封武興國世子楊紹先為武興王。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the eleventh month, on the jiwei day, Yang Shaoxian, heir of the state of Wuxing, was enfeoffed as King of Wuxing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the eleventh month, on the jiwei day, Yang Shaoxian, heir of Wuxing, was enfeoffed as King of Wuxing.

manualTranslations.zh: 正始元年春正月丙寅，大赦，改元。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Zhengshi, in spring, in the first month, on the bingyin day, there was a great amnesty and the era name was changed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhengshi, in spring, in the first month, on the bingyin day, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏五月丁未朔，太傅、北海王詳以罪廢為庶人。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fifth month, on the dingwei day, the first day of the month, Xiang, Grand Tutor and Prince of Beihai, was deposed for an offense and made a commoner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fifth month, on the dingwei day, the first day of the month, Xiang, Grand Tutor and Prince of Beihai, was deposed for an offense and made a commoner.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月，以旱故，徹樂減膳。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, because of drought, music was withdrawn and meals were reduced.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, because of drought, music was withdrawn and meals were reduced.

manualTranslations.zh: 癸巳，詔有司修案舊典，祗行六事。
manualTranslations.literal: On the guisi day, an edict ordered the responsible officials to examine the old precedents and respectfully carry out six measures.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, an edict ordered the responsible officials to examine the old precedents and respectfully carry out six measures.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲午，帝以旱故，親薦享於太廟。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jiawu day, because of drought, the emperor personally presented offerings in the Grand Temple.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, because of drought, the emperor personally presented offerings in the Grand Temple.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊戌，詔立周旦、夷、齊廟於首陽山。
manualTranslations.literal: On the wuxu day, an edict established temples to Zhou Dan, Yi, and Qi on Mount Shouyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, an edict established temples to the Duke of Zhou, Boyi, and Shuqi on Mount Shouyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚子，以旱故，公卿以下，引咎責躬。
manualTranslations.literal: On the gengzi day, because of drought, the dukes and ministers and those below them took blame and reproached themselves.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, because of drought, the dukes and ministers and those below them took the blame and reproached themselves.

manualTranslations.zh: 又錄京師見囚，殊死以下皆減一等；
manualTranslations.literal: He also reviewed the current prisoners in the capital, and all sentences from death downward were reduced by one grade;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also reviewed the current prisoners in the capital, and all sentences from death downward were reduced by one grade;

manualTranslations.zh: 鞭杖之坐，悉原之。
manualTranslations.literal: those liable to flogging or caning were all pardoned.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: those liable to flogging or caning were all pardoned.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月丙子，假鎮南將軍李崇大破諸蠻。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the bingzi day, Li Chong, acting General Who Guards the South, greatly defeated the various Man groups.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the bingzi day, Li Chong, acting General Who Guards the South, badly defeated the various Man groups.

manualTranslations.zh: 八月丙子，假鎮南將軍元英破梁將馬仙琕於義陽。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month, on the bingzi day, Yuan Ying, acting General Who Guards the South, defeated the Liang general Ma Xianbi at Yiyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the bingzi day, Yuan Ying, acting General Who Guards the South, defeated the Liang general Ma Xianbi at Yiyang.

sourceRange.text: 春正月辛酉，以尚書令孫騰為司徒。三月甲寅朔，封常山郡王第二子曜為陳郡王。五月甲戌，立皇后高氏。乙亥，大赦。是月，高麗遣使朝貢。六月乙酉，以尚書左僕射司馬子如為山東黜陟大使，尋為東北道行臺，差選勇士。庚寅，前潁州刺史奚思業為河南大使，簡發勇士。丁酉，梁人來聘。戊申，開府儀同三司、汝陽王暹薨。秋八月壬辰，遣兼散騎常侍王元景聘於梁。九月甲子，發畿內十萬人城鄴，四十日罷。辛未，曲赦畿內死罪已下，各有差。冬十一月癸亥，以新宮成，大赦，改元。八十已上賜綾帽及杖。七十旁無期親及有疾廢者，各賜粟帛。築城之夫，給復一年。

context.beforeSource: 十二月庚寅，遣陸操聘於梁。
context.afterSource: 二年春正月壬申，以太保尉景為太傅，以驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司厙狄幹為太保。

manualTranslations.zh: 春正月辛酉，以尚書令孫騰為司徒。
manualTranslations.literal: In spring, in the first month, on the xinyou day, Sun Teng, Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Minister over the Masses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month, on the xinyou day, Sun Teng, Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Minister over the Masses.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月甲寅朔，封常山郡王第二子曜為陳郡王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, on the jiayin day, the first day of the month, Yao, the second son of the Prince of Changshan Commandery, was enfeoffed as Prince of Chen Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jiayin day, the first day of the month, Yao, the second son of the Prince of Changshan Commandery, was enfeoffed as Prince of Chen Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月甲戌，立皇后高氏。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month, on the jiaxu day, Empress Gao was installed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jiaxu day, Empress Gao was installed.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙亥，大赦。
manualTranslations.literal: On the yihai day, there was a great amnesty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

manualTranslations.zh: 是月，高麗遣使朝貢。
manualTranslations.literal: That month, Goryeo sent envoys to court with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That month, Goryeo sent envoys to court with tribute.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月乙酉，以尚書左僕射司馬子如為山東黜陟大使，尋為東北道行臺，差選勇士。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, on the yiyou day, Sima Ziru, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Grand Commissioner for demotions and promotions in Shandong; shortly afterward he became Mobile Office of the Northeastern Circuit and selected brave men.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the yiyou day, Sima Ziru, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Grand Commissioner for demotions and promotions in Shandong; soon he became Mobile Office of the Northeastern Circuit and selected brave men.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚寅，前潁州刺史奚思業為河南大使，簡發勇士。
manualTranslations.literal: On the gengyin day, Xi Siye, former inspector of Ying Province, became Grand Commissioner for Henan and screened and mobilized brave men.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Xi Siye, former inspector of Ying Province, became Grand Commissioner for Henan and screened and mobilized brave men.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁酉，梁人來聘。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingyou day, Liang people came on a diplomatic mission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Liang envoys came on a diplomatic mission.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊申，開府儀同三司、汝陽王暹薨。
manualTranslations.literal: On the wushen day, Xian, Prince of Ruyang and holder of Open Office with rank equal to the Three Excellencies, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Xian, Prince of Ruyang and holder of Open Office with rank equal to the Three Excellencies, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋八月壬辰，遣兼散騎常侍王元景聘於梁。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the eighth month, on the renchen day, Wang Yuanjing, acting Scattered Cavalier Attendant, was sent on a diplomatic mission to Liang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the eighth month, on the renchen day, Wang Yuanjing, acting Scattered Cavalier Attendant, was sent on a diplomatic mission to Liang.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月甲子，發畿內十萬人城鄴，四十日罷。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, on the jiazi day, one hundred thousand people from within the capital region were levied to wall Ye; after forty days the work stopped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jiazi day, one hundred thousand people from the capital region were levied to wall Ye; the work stopped after forty days.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛未，曲赦畿內死罪已下，各有差。
manualTranslations.literal: On the xinwei day, a partial amnesty was granted within the capital region for death crimes and below, each by grade.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, the capital region received a graded partial amnesty for crimes from death sentences downward.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十一月癸亥，以新宮成，大赦，改元。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the eleventh month, on the guihai day, because the new palace was completed, there was a great amnesty and the era name was changed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the eleventh month, on the guihai day, because the new palace was completed, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

manualTranslations.zh: 八十已上賜綾帽及杖。
manualTranslations.literal: Those aged eighty and above were given silk gauze caps and staffs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those aged eighty and above were given silk gauze caps and staffs.

manualTranslations.zh: 七十旁無期親及有疾廢者，各賜粟帛。
manualTranslations.literal: Those aged seventy who had no close kin beside them and those ill and disabled were each given grain and silk.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those aged seventy without close kin and those who were ill or disabled were each given grain and silk.

manualTranslations.zh: 築城之夫，給復一年。
manualTranslations.literal: The laborers who built the city wall were granted exemption from service for one year.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The laborers who built the city wall were granted one year of service exemption.

sourceRange.text: ，進封南陽王。

localRange.text: 永安三年，進封南陽王。

sourceRange.text: 四年春正月丙辰，梁人來聘。夏四月丙寅，遣兼散騎常侍李繪聘於梁。乙酉，以侍中、廣陽王湛為太尉，以尚書右僕射高隆之為司徒，以太尉、彭城王韶為錄尚書事。丁亥，太傅尉景坐事，降為驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。辛卯，以太保庫狄幹為太傅，以領軍將軍婁昭為大司馬，封祖裔為尚書右僕射。六月丙申，復前侍中、樂良王忠爵。丁酉，復陳留王景皓、常山王紹宗、高密王永業爵。秋八月庚戌，以開府儀同三司、吏部尚書侯景為兼尚書僕射、河南行臺、隨機討防。冬十月甲寅，梁人來聘。十一月壬午，驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、青州刺史、西河王悽薨。十二月辛亥，使兼散騎常侍陽斐使於梁。是歲，蠕蠕、高麗、吐谷渾並遣使朝貢。春正月壬戌朔，大赦，改元。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, in spring, in the first month, on the bingchen day, Liang envoys came on a diplomatic mission.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月丙寅，遣兼散騎常侍李繪聘於梁。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, on the bingyin day, acting Scattered Cavalier Attendant Li Hui was sent on a diplomatic mission to Liang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on the bingyin day, acting Scattered Cavalier Attendant Li Hui was sent as envoy to Liang.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙酉，以侍中、廣陽王湛為太尉，以尚書右僕射高隆之為司徒，以太尉、彭城王韶為錄尚書事。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Zhan, Palace Attendant and Prince of Guangyang, was made Grand Commandant; Gao Longzhi, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Minister over the Masses; and Shao, Grand Commandant and Prince of Pengcheng, was made Recorder of the Masters of Writing.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁亥，太傅尉景坐事，降為驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dinghai day, Grand Tutor Wei Jing was implicated in an affair and demoted to General of Agile Cavalry with Opening Office Equal in Ceremony to the Three Excellencies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Grand Tutor Wei Jing was implicated in an affair and demoted to General of Agile Cavalry with Opening Office Equal in Ceremony to the Three Excellencies.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛卯，以太保庫狄幹為太傅，以領軍將軍婁昭為大司馬，封祖裔為尚書右僕射。
manualTranslations.literal: On the xinmao day, Kudi Gan, Grand Guardian, was made Grand Tutor; Lou Zhao, General of the Leading Army, was made Grand Marshal; and Zuyi was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Kudi Gan, Grand Guardian, was made Grand Tutor; Lou Zhao, General of the Leading Army, was made Grand Marshal; and Zuyi was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月丙申，復前侍中、樂良王忠爵。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, on the bingshen day, the noble rank of Zhong, former Palace Attendant and Prince of Leliang, was restored.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the bingshen day, Zhong, former Palace Attendant and Prince of Leliang, had his noble rank restored.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁酉，復陳留王景皓、常山王紹宗、高密王永業爵。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingyou day, the noble ranks of Jinghao, Prince of Chenliu, Shaozong, Prince of Changshan, and Yongye, Prince of Gaomi, were restored.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Jinghao, Prince of Chenliu, Shaozong, Prince of Changshan, and Yongye, Prince of Gaomi, had their noble ranks restored.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋八月庚戌，以開府儀同三司、吏部尚書侯景為兼尚書僕射、河南行臺、隨機討防。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the eighth month, on the gengxu day, Hou Jing, with Opening Office Equal in Ceremony to the Three Excellencies and Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was made acting Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Mobile Headquarters of Henan, to campaign and defend as circumstances required.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the eighth month, on the gengxu day, Hou Jing, with Opening Office Equal in Ceremony to the Three Excellencies and Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was made acting Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Mobile Headquarters of Henan, to campaign and defend as circumstances required.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十月甲寅，梁人來聘。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the tenth month, on the jiayin day, Liang people came on a diplomatic mission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on the jiayin day, Liang envoys came on a diplomatic mission.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月壬午，驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、青州刺史、西河王悽薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the renwu day, Qi, General of Agile Cavalry with Opening Office Equal in Ceremony to the Three Excellencies, Regional Inspector of Qing Province, and Prince of Xihe, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the renwu day, Qi, General of Agile Cavalry with Opening Office Equal in Ceremony to the Three Excellencies, Regional Inspector of Qing Province, and Prince of Xihe, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月辛亥，使兼散騎常侍陽斐使於梁。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the xinhai day, acting Scattered Cavalier Attendant Yang Fei was sent as envoy to Liang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the xinhai day, acting Scattered Cavalier Attendant Yang Fei was sent as envoy to Liang.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲，蠕蠕、高麗、吐谷渾並遣使朝貢。
manualTranslations.literal: That year, Rouran, Goryeo, and Tuyuhun all sent envoys to court with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year, Rouran, Goryeo, and Tuyuhun all sent envoys to court with tribute.

sourceRange.text: 七年春正月戊辰，梁北徐州刺史、中山侯蕭正表以鎮內附，封蘭陵郡公、吳郡王。三月丁卯，侯景克建業。夏五月丙辰，侯景殺梁武帝。戊寅，勃海王高澄帥師赴潁川。六月，克之，獲西魏大將軍王思政等。秋八月辛卯，立皇子長仁為太子。盜殺勃海王高澄。癸巳，大赦，內外百官並進二級。甲午，太原公高洋如晉陽。冬十月癸未，以開府儀同三司、咸陽王坦為太傅。甲午，以開府儀同三司潘相樂為司空。十二月甲辰，吳郡王蕭正表薨。己酉，以并州刺史彭樂為司徒。是歲，蠕蠕、地豆幹、室韋、高麗、吐谷渾並遣使朝貢。八年春正月辛酉，帝為勃海王高澄舉哀於東堂。戊辰，詔太原公高洋嗣事，徙封齊郡王。甲戌，地豆幹、契丹並遣使朝貢。二月庚寅，以尚書令高隆之為太保。三月庚申，進齊郡王高洋爵為齊王。夏四月乙巳，蠕蠕遣使朝貢。五月甲寅，詔齊王為相國，總百揆，備九錫之禮。以齊國太妃為王太后，王妃為王后。丙辰，遜帝位於齊。己未，封帝為中山王，邑一萬戶，上書不稱臣，答不稱詔，載天子旌旗，行魏正朔，乘五時副車。封王諸子為縣公，邑各一千戶。奉絹一萬疋，錢一萬貫，粟二萬石，奴婢三百人，水碾一具，田百頃，園一所，於中山國立魏宗廟。

context.afterSource: 二年十二月己酉，中山王殂，時年二十八。

manualTranslations.zh: 三月丁卯，侯景克建業。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, on the dingmao day, Hou Jing took Jianye.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the dingmao day, Hou Jing captured Jianye.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏五月丙辰，侯景殺梁武帝。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fifth month, on the bingchen day, Hou Jing killed Emperor Wu of Liang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fifth month, on the bingchen day, Hou Jing killed Emperor Wu of Liang.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊寅，勃海王高澄帥師赴潁川。
manualTranslations.literal: On the wuyin day, Gao Cheng, Prince of Bohai, led the army to Yingchuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Gao Cheng, Prince of Bohai, led the army to Yingchuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月，克之，獲西魏大將軍王思政等。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, he captured it, taking Wang Sizheng, Grand General of Western Wei, and others prisoner.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋八月辛卯，立皇子長仁為太子。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the eighth month, on the xinmao day, the imperial son Changren was established as crown prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the eighth month, on the xinmao day, the imperial son Changren was established as crown prince.

manualTranslations.zh: 盜殺勃海王高澄。
manualTranslations.literal: An assassin killed Gao Cheng, Prince of Bohai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An assassin killed Gao Cheng, Prince of Bohai.

manualTranslations.zh: 癸巳，大赦，內外百官並進二級。
manualTranslations.literal: On the guisi day, there was a great amnesty, and all officials inside and outside the court were advanced two grades.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, a general amnesty was proclaimed, and all officials inside and outside the court were advanced two grades.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲午，太原公高洋如晉陽。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jiawu day, Gao Yang, Duke of Taiyuan, went to Jinyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, Gao Yang, Duke of Taiyuan, went to Jinyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十月癸未，以開府儀同三司、咸陽王坦為太傅。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the tenth month, on the guiwei day, Tan, Prince of Xianyang and holder of Opening Office Equal in Ceremony to the Three Excellencies, was made Grand Tutor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on the guiwei day, Tan, Prince of Xianyang and holder of Opening Office Equal in Ceremony to the Three Excellencies, was made Grand Tutor.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲午，以開府儀同三司潘相樂為司空。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jiawu day, Pan Xiangle, holder of Opening Office Equal in Ceremony to the Three Excellencies, was made Minister of Works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, Pan Xiangle, holder of Opening Office Equal in Ceremony to the Three Excellencies, was made Minister of Works.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月甲辰，吳郡王蕭正表薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the jiachen day, Xiao Zhengbiao, Prince of Wu Commandery, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jiachen day, Xiao Zhengbiao, Prince of Wu Commandery, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 己酉，以并州刺史彭樂為司徒。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jiyou day, Peng Le, Inspector of Bing Province, was made Minister over the Masses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Peng Le, Inspector of Bing Province, was made Minister over the Masses.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲，蠕蠕、地豆幹、室韋、高麗、吐谷渾並遣使朝貢。
manualTranslations.literal: That year, Rouran, Didougan, Shiwei, Goryeo, and Tuyuhun all sent envoys to court with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year, Rouran, Didougan, Shiwei, Goryeo, and Tuyuhun all sent envoys to court with tribute.

manualTranslations.zh: 八年春正月辛酉，帝為勃海王高澄舉哀於東堂。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth year, in spring, in the first month, on the xinyou day, the Emperor held mourning for Gao Cheng, Prince of Bohai, in the Eastern Hall.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, in spring, in the first month, on the xinyou day, the Emperor held mourning for Gao Cheng, Prince of Bohai, in the Eastern Hall.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊辰，詔太原公高洋嗣事，徙封齊郡王。
manualTranslations.literal: On the wuchen day, an edict ordered Gao Yang, Duke of Taiyuan, to succeed to affairs and transferred his enfeoffment to Prince of Qi Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, an edict ordered Gao Yang, Duke of Taiyuan, to succeed to affairs and transferred his enfeoffment to Prince of Qi Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲戌，地豆幹、契丹並遣使朝貢。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jiaxu day, Didougan and the Khitan both sent envoys to court with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Didougan and the Khitan both sent envoys to court with tribute.

manualTranslations.zh: 二月庚寅，以尚書令高隆之為太保。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month, on the gengyin day, Gao Longzhi, Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Grand Guardian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the gengyin day, Gao Longzhi, Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Grand Guardian.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月庚申，進齊郡王高洋爵為齊王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, on the gengshen day, Gao Yang, Prince of Qi Commandery, was advanced in noble rank to Prince of Qi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengshen day, Gao Yang, Prince of Qi Commandery, was advanced to Prince of Qi.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月乙巳，蠕蠕遣使朝貢。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, on the yisi day, the Rouran sent envoys to court with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on the yisi day, the Rouran sent envoys to court with tribute.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月甲寅，詔齊王為相國，總百揆，備九錫之禮。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month, on the jiayin day, an edict made the Prince of Qi Chancellor, overseeing all offices, with the rites of the Nine Bestowments prepared.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jiayin day, an edict made the Prince of Qi Chancellor, placing all offices under his control and preparing the rites of the Nine Bestowments.

manualTranslations.zh: 以齊國太妃為王太后，王妃為王后。
manualTranslations.literal: The Grand Consort of Qi State was made Queen Dowager, and the prince’s consort was made Queen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Grand Consort of Qi State was made Queen Dowager, and the prince’s consort was made Queen.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙辰，遜帝位於齊。
manualTranslations.literal: On the bingchen day, he yielded the imperial throne to Qi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, he yielded the imperial throne to Qi.

manualTranslations.zh: 己未，封帝為中山王，邑一萬戶，上書不稱臣，答不稱詔，載天子旌旗，行魏正朔，乘五時副車。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jiwei day, the Emperor was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhongshan with a fief of ten thousand households; in memorials he would not call himself subject, in replies they would not be called edicts, he carried the Son of Heaven’s banners and standards, observed the Wei calendar, and rode the secondary carriages of the five seasons.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, the Emperor was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhongshan with a fief of ten thousand households. In memorials he would not call himself a subject, replies to him would not be called edicts, he carried the Son of Heaven’s banners and standards, observed the Wei calendar, and rode the secondary carriages of the five seasons.

manualTranslations.zh: 封王諸子為縣公，邑各一千戶。
manualTranslations.literal: The prince’s sons were enfeoffed as county dukes, each with a fief of one thousand households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prince’s sons were enfeoffed as county dukes, each with a fief of one thousand households.

manualTranslations.zh: 奉絹一萬疋，錢一萬貫，粟二萬石，奴婢三百人，水碾一具，田百頃，園一所，於中山國立魏宗廟。
manualTranslations.literal: He was provided with ten thousand bolts of silk, ten thousand strings of cash, twenty thousand shi of grain, three hundred male and female slaves, one water mill, one hundred qing of fields, and one garden, and the Wei ancestral temple was established in the Zhongshan principality.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was provided with ten thousand bolts of silk, ten thousand strings of cash, twenty thousand shi of grain, three hundred slaves, a water mill, one hundred qing of fields, and a garden; the Wei ancestral temple was established in the Zhongshan principality.

sourceRange.text: 三年春正月丁丑，初行《周禮》，建六官，以安定公宇文泰為太師、冢宰，以柱國李弼為大司徒，趙貴為太保、大宗伯，以尚書令獨孤信為大司馬，以于謹為大司寇，以侯莫陳崇為大司空。冬十月乙亥，安定公宇文泰薨。十二月庚子，帝遜位於周。周閔帝元年正月，封帝為宋公，尋殂。

localRange.text: 孝靜帝

manualTranslations.zh: 三年春正月丁丑，初行《周禮》，建六官，以安定公宇文泰為太師、冢宰，以柱國李弼為大司徒，趙貴為太保、大宗伯，以尚書令獨孤信為大司馬，以于謹為大司寇，以侯莫陳崇為大司空。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, in spring, in the first month, on the dingchou day, the 《Rites of Zhou》 were first put into effect and the Six Offices were established. Yuwen Tai, Duke of Anding, was made Grand Preceptor and Chief Minister; Li Bi, Pillar of State, was made Grand Minister over the Masses; Zhao Gui was made Grand Guardian and Grand Minister of Rites; Dugu Xin, Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Grand Marshal; Yu Jin was made Grand Minister of Justice; and Houmochen Chong was made Grand Minister of Works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year, in spring, in the first month, on the dingchou day, the 《Rites of Zhou》 were first put into effect and the Six Offices were established. Yuwen Tai, Duke of Anding, was made Grand Preceptor and Chief Minister; Li Bi, Pillar of State, was made Grand Minister over the Masses; Zhao Gui was made Grand Guardian and Grand Minister of Rites; Dugu Xin, Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Grand Marshal; Yu Jin was made Grand Minister of Justice; and Houmochen Chong was made Grand Minister of Works.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十月乙亥，安定公宇文泰薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the tenth month, on the yihai day, Yuwen Tai, Duke of Anding, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on the yihai day, Yuwen Tai, Duke of Anding, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月庚子，帝遜位於周。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the gengzi day, the Emperor yielded the throne to Zhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the gengzi day, the Emperor yielded the throne to Zhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 周閔帝元年正月，封帝為宋公，尋殂。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Emperor Min of Zhou, the Emperor was enfeoffed as Duke of Song and soon died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Emperor Min of Zhou, the Emperor was enfeoffed as Duke of Song and soon died.

sourceRange.text: 敬宗孝莊皇帝諱子攸，彭城王勰之第三子也。母曰李妃。明帝初，以勰有魯陽翼衛之勛，封帝武城縣公。幼侍明帝書於禁中。及長，風神秀慧，姿貌甚美，雅為明帝親待。八月，進封長樂王，歷位侍中、中軍將軍。以兄彭城王劭事，轉為衛將軍、左光祿大夫、中書監，實見出也。二月，明帝崩。大都督爾朱榮謀廢立。以帝家有忠勛，且兼人望，陰與帝通，率眾來赴。帝與兄弟夜北度河，會榮於河陽。夏四月戊戌，帝南濟河，即皇帝位。以皇兄彭城王劭為無上王，皇弟霸城公子正為始平王。以爾朱榮為使持節、侍中、都督中外諸軍事、大將軍、尚書令、領軍將軍、領左右，封太原王。己亥，百僚相率，有司奉璽綬，備法駕，奉迎於河梁。西至陶渚，榮以兵權在己，遂有異志。乃害靈太后及幼主，次害無上王劭、始平王子正，又害丞相、高陽王雍已下王公卿士二千人，列騎衛帝，遷於便幕。榮尋悔，稽顙謝罪。

localRange.text: 敬宗孝莊帝

context.afterSource: 辛丑，車駕入宮，御太極殿。
context.afterLocal: 辛丑，車駕入宮，御太極殿。

manualTranslations.zh: 敬宗孝莊皇帝諱子攸，彭城王勰之第三子也。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Jingzong Xiaozhuang bore the taboo name Ziyou and was the third son of Xie, Prince of Pengcheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Jingzong Xiaozhuang, taboo name Ziyou, was the third son of Xie, Prince of Pengcheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 母曰李妃。
manualTranslations.literal: His mother was Consort Li.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His mother was Consort Li.

manualTranslations.zh: 明帝初，以勰有魯陽翼衛之勛，封帝武城縣公。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Ming's reign, because Xie had merit in guarding and supporting at Luyang, the emperor was enfeoffed as Duke of Wucheng County.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in Emperor Ming's reign, because Xie had served with merit in guarding and supporting the throne at Luyang, Ziyou was enfeoffed as Duke of Wucheng County.

manualTranslations.zh: 幼侍明帝書於禁中。
manualTranslations.literal: In youth he attended Emperor Ming in study within the forbidden precincts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As a boy he attended Emperor Ming in study within the palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 及長，風神秀慧，姿貌甚美，雅為明帝親待。
manualTranslations.literal: When he grew up, his bearing was elegant and intelligent and his appearance very handsome; he was greatly treated with closeness by Emperor Ming.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he came of age, his bearing was elegant and keen and his appearance was strikingly fine; Emperor Ming treated him with special intimacy.

manualTranslations.zh: 八月，進封長樂王，歷位侍中、中軍將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month, he was advanced and enfeoffed as Prince of Changle, and he successively held the posts of Palace Attendant and General of the Central Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, he was advanced to Prince of Changle and went on to serve as Palace Attendant and General of the Central Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 以兄彭城王劭事，轉為衛將軍、左光祿大夫、中書監，實見出也。
manualTranslations.literal: Because of the affair of his elder brother Shao, Prince of Pengcheng, he was transferred to General of the Guards, Left Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, and Director of the Secretariat; in fact he was being sent out.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because of the affair involving his elder brother Shao, Prince of Pengcheng, he was transferred to General of the Guards, Left Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, and Director of the Secretariat, which in fact amounted to being sent out of favor.

manualTranslations.zh: 二月，明帝崩。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month, Emperor Ming died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month, Emperor Ming died.

manualTranslations.zh: 大都督爾朱榮謀廢立。
manualTranslations.literal: Grand Commander Erzhu Rong plotted deposition and enthronement.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Grand Commander Erzhu Rong plotted to depose and enthrone rulers.

manualTranslations.zh: 以帝家有忠勛，且兼人望，陰與帝通，率眾來赴。
manualTranslations.literal: Because the emperor's family had loyal merit and also possessed popular expectation, he secretly communicated with the emperor and led his troops to come in response.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because the emperor's house had loyal service to its credit and he also enjoyed popular standing, Rong secretly contacted him and led his troops to answer the call.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝與兄弟夜北度河，會榮於河陽。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor and his brothers crossed the river northward by night and met Rong at Heyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor and his brothers crossed the Yellow River northward by night and met Rong at Heyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月戊戌，帝南濟河，即皇帝位。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, on the wuxu day, the emperor crossed the river southward and took the imperial throne.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on the wuxu day, the emperor crossed south over the Yellow River and ascended the throne.

manualTranslations.zh: 以皇兄彭城王劭為無上王，皇弟霸城公子正為始平王。
manualTranslations.literal: He made the imperial elder brother Shao, Prince of Pengcheng, Prince Without Superior, and the imperial younger brother Zizheng, Duke of Bacheng, Prince of Shiping.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He made his elder brother Shao, Prince of Pengcheng, Prince Without Superior, and his younger brother Zizheng, Duke of Bacheng, Prince of Shiping.

manualTranslations.zh: 以爾朱榮為使持節、侍中、都督中外諸軍事、大將軍、尚書令、領軍將軍、領左右，封太原王。
manualTranslations.literal: He made Erzhu Rong Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Palace Attendant, Commander of All Military Affairs Within and Without, General-in-Chief, Director of the Masters of Writing, General of the Leading Army, and Commander of the Left and Right, and enfeoffed him as Prince of Taiyuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He made Erzhu Rong Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Palace Attendant, Commander of All Military Affairs Within and Without, General-in-Chief, Director of the Masters of Writing, General of the Leading Army, and Commander of the Left and Right, and enfeoffed him as Prince of Taiyuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 己亥，百僚相率，有司奉璽綬，備法駕，奉迎於河梁。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jihai day, the hundred officials followed one another, the responsible offices carried the seal and cord and prepared the full imperial carriage, and they respectfully welcomed him at the river bridge.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, the officials came in procession, the offices brought the imperial seal and cord and prepared the full ceremonial carriage, and they welcomed him at the river bridge.

manualTranslations.zh: 西至陶渚，榮以兵權在己，遂有異志。
manualTranslations.literal: When they reached Taozhu in the west, Rong, because military power was in his own hands, thereupon had different intentions.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When they reached Taozhu to the west, Rong, with military power in his own hands, began to harbor other intentions.

manualTranslations.zh: 乃害靈太后及幼主，次害無上王劭、始平王子正，又害丞相、高陽王雍已下王公卿士二千人，列騎衛帝，遷於便幕。
manualTranslations.literal: He then killed Empress Dowager Ling and the young ruler, next killed Shao, Prince Without Superior, and Zizheng, Prince of Shiping, and also killed the chancellor Yong, Prince of Gaoyang, and two thousand princes, dukes, ministers, and officers below him; he arrayed cavalry to guard the emperor and moved him to a field tent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He then killed Empress Dowager Ling and the young ruler, then Shao, Prince Without Superior, and Zizheng, Prince of Shiping, and also Chancellor Yong, Prince of Gaoyang, together with two thousand princes, dukes, ministers, and officers below him. He arrayed cavalry around the emperor and moved him to a field tent.

manualTranslations.zh: 榮尋悔，稽顙謝罪。
manualTranslations.literal: Rong soon regretted it, knocked his forehead to the ground, and apologized for his crime.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Rong soon regretted it, knocked his forehead to the ground, and confessed his crime.

sourceRange.text: 二年春正月庚寅朔，朝饗群臣於太極前殿。丁酉，勃海王高歡大敗爾朱氏，山東平。罷諸行臺。丁巳，追尊皇考為武穆皇帝，太妃馮氏為武穆皇后，皇妣李氏曰皇太妃。二月，以咸陽王坦為司空。三月甲午，太師、魯郡王肅薨。丁巳，以太保、趙郡王諶為太尉，以太尉、南陽王寶炬為尚書令、太保，開府。是月，阿至羅十萬戶內附。詔復以勃海王高歡為大行臺，隨機裁處。夏四月己未朔，日有蝕之。秋七月壬辰，以太師、廣陵王欣為大司馬，以太尉、趙郡王諶為太師，並開府。庚戌，以前司徒、燕郡王賀拔允為太尉。冬十月癸未，以衛將軍、瓜州刺史、泰臨縣伯、高昌王麹子堅為儀同三司，進爵郡公。十二月丁巳，狩於嵩陽，士卒寒苦。己巳，遂幸溫湯。丁丑，還宮。

context.beforeSource: 是歲，蠕蠕、嚈噠、高麗、契丹、庫莫奚、高昌等國並遣使朝貢。
context.afterSource: 三年春二月壬戌，大赦。
context.beforeLocal: 是歲，蠕蠕、嚈噠、高麗、契丹、庫莫奚、高昌等國並遣使朝貢。
context.afterLocal: 三年春二月壬戌，大赦。

manualTranslations.zh: 二年春正月庚寅朔，朝饗群臣於太極前殿。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year, in spring, in the first month, on the gengyin day, the first day of the month, he held court and feasted the assembled officials in the front hall of Taiji.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year, in spring, in the first month, on gengyin, the first day of the month, he held court and feasted the assembled officials in the front hall of Taiji.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁酉，勃海王高歡大敗爾朱氏，山東平。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingyou day, Prince of Bohai Gao Huan inflicted a great defeat on the Erzhu clan, and Shandong was pacified.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Prince of Bohai Gao Huan routed the Erzhu clan, and Shandong was pacified.

manualTranslations.zh: 罷諸行臺。
manualTranslations.literal: The various mobile administrations were abolished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The various mobile administrations were abolished.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁巳，追尊皇考為武穆皇帝，太妃馮氏為武穆皇后，皇妣李氏曰皇太妃。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingsi day, his late imperial father was posthumously honored as Emperor Wumu, Grand Consort Feng as Empress Wumu, and his late mother Lady Li was called Imperial Grand Consort.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, his late father was posthumously honored as Emperor Wumu, Grand Consort Feng as Empress Wumu, and his late mother Lady Li as Imperial Grand Consort.

manualTranslations.zh: 二月，以咸陽王坦為司空。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month, Tan, Prince of Xianyang, was made Minister of Works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month, Tan, Prince of Xianyang, was made Minister of Works.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月甲午，太師、魯郡王肅薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, on the jiawu day, Su, Grand Preceptor and Prince of Lu Commandery, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jiawu day, Su, Grand Preceptor and Prince of Lu Commandery, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁巳，以太保、趙郡王諶為太尉，以太尉、南陽王寶炬為尚書令、太保，開府。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingsi day, Chen, Grand Guardian and Prince of Zhao Commandery, was made Grand Commandant; Baoju, Grand Commandant and Prince of Nanyang, was made Director of the Masters of Writing and Grand Guardian, with opening office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Chen, Grand Guardian and Prince of Zhao Commandery, was made Grand Commandant; Baoju, Grand Commandant and Prince of Nanyang, was made Director of the Masters of Writing and Grand Guardian, with an open office.

manualTranslations.zh: 是月，阿至羅十萬戶內附。
manualTranslations.literal: That month, one hundred thousand households of the Azhiluo submitted inward.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That month, one hundred thousand households of the Azhiluo submitted.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔復以勃海王高歡為大行臺，隨機裁處。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict again made Prince of Bohai Gao Huan Grand Mobile Secretariat, to decide and handle matters as circumstances required.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict again made Prince of Bohai Gao Huan Grand Mobile Secretariat, with authority to decide matters as circumstances required.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月己未朔，日有蝕之。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, on the jiwei day, the first day of the month, the sun was eclipsed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on jiwei, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月壬辰，以太師、廣陵王欣為大司馬，以太尉、趙郡王諶為太師，並開府。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the renchen day, Xin, Grand Preceptor and Prince of Guangling, was made Grand Marshal, and Chen, Grand Commandant and Prince of Zhao Commandery, was made Grand Preceptor; both opened offices.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the renchen day, Xin, Grand Preceptor and Prince of Guangling, was made Grand Marshal, and Chen, Grand Commandant and Prince of Zhao Commandery, was made Grand Preceptor; both were granted open offices.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚戌，以前司徒、燕郡王賀拔允為太尉。
manualTranslations.literal: On the gengxu day, former Minister over the Masses Heba Yun, Prince of Yan Commandery, was made Grand Commandant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, former Minister over the Masses Heba Yun, Prince of Yan Commandery, was made Grand Commandant.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十月癸未，以衛將軍、瓜州刺史、泰臨縣伯、高昌王麹子堅為儀同三司，進爵郡公。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the tenth month, on the guiwei day, Qu Zijian, General of the Guards, Regional Inspector of Gua Province, Earl of Tailin County, and King of Gaochang, was made Equal in Ceremony to the Three Excellencies and advanced in noble rank to commandery duke.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on the guiwei day, Qu Zijian, General of the Guards, Regional Inspector of Gua Province, Earl of Tailin County, and King of Gaochang, was made Equal in Ceremony to the Three Excellencies and advanced to commandery duke.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月丁巳，狩於嵩陽，士卒寒苦。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the dingsi day, there was a hunt at Songyang; the soldiers suffered from the cold.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dingsi day, he hunted at Songyang; the soldiers suffered bitterly from the cold.

manualTranslations.zh: 己巳，遂幸溫湯。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jisi day, he then visited the hot springs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, he then visited the hot springs.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁丑，還宮。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingchou day, he returned to the palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, he returned to the palace.

sourceRange.text: ，葬於鄴西南野馬崗。

localRange.text: 永熙二年，葬於鄴西南野馬崗。孝武帝

context.beforeSource: 時年二十。
context.afterSource: 孝武皇帝諱修，字孝則，廣平武穆王懷之第三子也。
context.beforeLocal: 時年二十。
context.afterLocal: 孝武皇帝諱修，字孝則，廣平武穆王懷之第三子也。

sourceRange.text: 春二月己巳，皇帝即位於太極前殿，群臣拜賀。禮華，遂登閶闔門大赦。以魏為大魏。改建明二年為普泰元年。罷稅市及稅鹽之官。庚午，詔曰：「自秦之末競為皇帝，忘負乘之深殃，垂貪鄙於萬葉。予今稱帝，已為褒矣！可普告令知。」是月，鎮遠將軍清河崔祖螭聚青州七郡之眾圍東陽。幽州刺史劉靈助起兵於薊。河北大使高幹及其弟昂夜襲冀州，執刺史元嶷，共推前河內太守封隆之行州事。

context.beforeSource: 服袞冕，百官侍衛，入自建春、雲龍門。
context.afterSource: 三月癸酉，封長廣王曄為東海王。
context.beforeLocal: 服袞冕，百官侍衛，入自建春、雲龍門。
context.afterLocal: 三月癸酉，封長廣王曄為東海王。

manualTranslations.zh: 春二月己巳，皇帝即位於太極前殿，群臣拜賀。
manualTranslations.literal: In spring, in the second month, on the jisi day, the Emperor took the throne in the front hall of Taiji, and the assembled officials offered congratulations.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In spring, in the second month, on the jisi day, the Emperor took the throne in the front hall of Taiji, and the assembled officials offered congratulations.

manualTranslations.zh: 禮華，遂登閶闔門大赦。
manualTranslations.literal: The ceremony was resplendent; he then ascended the Changhe Gate and proclaimed a general amnesty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the splendid ceremony, he ascended the Changhe Gate and proclaimed a general amnesty.

manualTranslations.zh: 以魏為大魏。
manualTranslations.literal: He made Wei Great Wei.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He designated Wei as Great Wei.

manualTranslations.zh: 改建明二年為普泰元年。
manualTranslations.literal: The second year of Jianming was changed to the first year of Putai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The second year of Jianming was changed to the first year of Putai.

manualTranslations.zh: 罷稅市及稅鹽之官。
manualTranslations.literal: The offices taxing markets and taxing salt were abolished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The offices for taxing markets and salt were abolished.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚午，詔曰：「自秦之末競為皇帝，忘負乘之深殃，垂貪鄙於萬葉。
manualTranslations.literal: On the gengwu day, an edict said: "Since the end of Qin, men have vied to become huangdi, forgetting the grave calamity of the unworthy riding in the carriage and passing greed and baseness down through ten thousand generations.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, an edict said: "Since the end of Qin, men have competed to become huangdi, forgetting the grave calamity of the unworthy riding in the carriage and passing greed and baseness down through ten thousand generations.

manualTranslations.zh: 予今稱帝，已為褒矣！
manualTranslations.literal: That I now call myself di is already praise enough!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That I now call myself emperor is already honor enough!

manualTranslations.zh: 可普告令知。」
manualTranslations.literal: Let this be proclaimed broadly and made known."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Let this be proclaimed broadly so all may know."

manualTranslations.zh: 是月，鎮遠將軍清河崔祖螭聚青州七郡之眾圍東陽。
manualTranslations.literal: That month, Cui Zuchi of Qinghe, General Who Pacifies the Distant, gathered the people of seven commanderies in Qing Province and besieged Dongyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That month, Cui Zuchi of Qinghe, General Who Pacifies the Distant, gathered forces from seven commanderies in Qing Province and besieged Dongyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 幽州刺史劉靈助起兵於薊。
manualTranslations.literal: Liu Lingzhu, Inspector of You Province, raised troops at Ji.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liu Lingzhu, Inspector of You Province, raised troops at Ji.

manualTranslations.zh: 河北大使高幹及其弟昂夜襲冀州，執刺史元嶷，共推前河內太守封隆之行州事。
manualTranslations.literal: Gao Gan, Grand Commissioner of Hebei, and his younger brother Ang made a night attack on Ji Province, seized Inspector Yuan Yi, and together installed former Administrator of Henei Feng Longzhi to conduct provincial affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gao Gan, Grand Commissioner of Hebei, and his younger brother Ang attacked Ji Province by night, seized Inspector Yuan Yi, and together installed former Henei Administrator Feng Longzhi to manage provincial affairs.

sourceRange.text: 十三年春正月，開白渠以溉田。二月，詔自今應宮刑者，直沒官，勿刑。亡奴婢應黥者，止科亡罪。以開府儀同三司若干惠為司空。東魏勃海王高歡薨。其司徒侯景據潁川率河南六州內附。授景太傅、河南大行臺、上谷郡公。三月，大赦。夏五月，以太傅侯景為大將軍，以開府儀同三司獨孤信為大司馬。晉王謹薨。秋七月，司空若干惠薨。大將軍侯景據豫州叛。封皇子寧為趙王。

context.beforeSource: 冬十二月，歡燒營而退。
context.afterSource: 十四年春正月，赦潁、豫、廣、北、洛、東荊、襄等七州。
context.beforeLocal: 冬十二月，歡燒營而退。
context.afterLocal: 十四年春正月，赦潁、豫、廣、北、洛、東荊、襄等七州。

manualTranslations.zh: 十三年春正月，開白渠以溉田。
manualTranslations.literal: In the thirteenth year, in spring, in the first month, the Bai Canal was opened to irrigate fields.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, in spring, in the first month, the Bai Canal was opened to irrigate fields.

manualTranslations.zh: 二月，詔自今應宮刑者，直沒官，勿刑。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month, an edict ordered that from now on those liable to castration should simply be confiscated to government service and not mutilated.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month, an edict ordered that from then on those liable to castration should instead be confiscated to government service and not mutilated.

manualTranslations.zh: 亡奴婢應黥者，止科亡罪。
manualTranslations.literal: Runaway male and female slaves who would be liable to tattooing were to be punished only for the crime of flight.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Runaway slaves who would have been tattooed were to be punished only for fleeing.

manualTranslations.zh: 以開府儀同三司若干惠為司空。
manualTranslations.literal: Ruogan Hui, with Opening Office Equal in Ceremony to the Three Excellencies, was made Minister of Works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ruogan Hui, with Opening Office Equal in Ceremony to the Three Excellencies, was made Minister of Works.

manualTranslations.zh: 東魏勃海王高歡薨。
manualTranslations.literal: Gao Huan, Prince of Bohai of Eastern Wei, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gao Huan, Prince of Bohai of Eastern Wei, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 其司徒侯景據潁川率河南六州內附。
manualTranslations.literal: His Minister over the Masses Hou Jing occupied Yingchuan and led six provinces of Henan in submission inward.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His Minister over the Masses Hou Jing held Yingchuan and led six Henan provinces in submission.

manualTranslations.zh: 授景太傅、河南大行臺、上谷郡公。
manualTranslations.literal: Jing was granted the posts of Grand Tutor and Grand Mobile Secretariat of Henan, and the title Duke of Shanggu Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hou Jing was appointed Grand Tutor and Grand Mobile Secretariat of Henan and made Duke of Shanggu Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月，大赦。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, there was a great amnesty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏五月，以太傅侯景為大將軍，以開府儀同三司獨孤信為大司馬。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fifth month, Hou Jing, Grand Tutor, was made Grand General, and Dugu Xin, with Opening Office Equal in Ceremony to the Three Excellencies, was made Grand Marshal.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fifth month, Hou Jing, Grand Tutor, was made Grand General, and Dugu Xin, with Opening Office Equal in Ceremony to the Three Excellencies, was made Grand Marshal.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉王謹薨。
manualTranslations.literal: Jin, Prince of Jin, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jin, Prince of Jin, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月，司空若干惠薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the seventh month, Ruogan Hui, Minister of Works, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, Ruogan Hui, Minister of Works, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 大將軍侯景據豫州叛。
manualTranslations.literal: Hou Jing, Grand General, occupied Yu Province and rebelled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hou Jing, Grand General, occupied Yu Province and rebelled.

manualTranslations.zh: 封皇子寧為趙王。
manualTranslations.literal: The imperial son Ning was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The imperial son Ning was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.

sourceRange.text: 二年春正月辛亥，祀南郊，改以神元皇帝配。東魏攻陷夏州。二月，儀同三司段敬討叛羌梁定平之。三月，以涼州刺史李叔仁為司徒，以司徒万俟壽樂幹為太宰。夏五月，司空越勒肱薨。秦州刺史、建忠王万俟普撥及其子太宰壽樂幹率所部奔東魏。秋九月，以扶風王孚為司空，以太保斛斯椿為太傅。冬十一月，追改始祖神元皇帝為太祖，道武皇帝為烈祖。是歲，關中大饑，人相食，死者十七八。

sourceRange.text: 八月壬午，皇帝即位於晉陽宣德殿，大赦，改乾明元年為皇建。詔奉太皇太后還稱皇太后，皇太后稱文宣皇后，宮曰昭信。乙酉，詔自太祖創業已來，諸有佐命功臣，子孫絕滅，國統不傳者，有司搜訪近親，以名聞，當量為立後。諸郡國老人，各授板職，賜黃帽鳩杖。又詔謇正之士，並聽進見陳事。軍人戰亡死王事者，以時申聞，當加榮贈。督將朝士名望素高，位歷通顯，天保以來未蒙追贈者，亦皆錄奏。又以廷尉、中丞，執法所在，繩違案罪，不得舞文弄法。其官奴婢年六十已上，免為庶人。戊子，以太傅、長廣王湛為右丞相，以太尉、平陽王淹為太傅，以尚書令、彭城王浟為大司馬。

context.beforeSource: 太皇太后尋下令廢少主，命帝統大業。
context.afterSource: 壬辰，詔分遣大使，巡省四方，觀察風俗，問人疾苦，考求得失，搜訪賢良。

manualTranslations.zh: 八月壬午，皇帝即位於晉陽宣德殿，大赦，改乾明元年為皇建。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month, on the renwu day, the Emperor took the throne in Xuande Hall at Jinyang; a general amnesty was proclaimed, and the first year of Qianming was changed to Huangjian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the renwu day, the Emperor took the throne in Xuande Hall at Jinyang. A general amnesty was proclaimed, and the first year of Qianming was changed to Huangjian.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔奉太皇太后還稱皇太后，皇太后稱文宣皇后，宮曰昭信。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict ordered that the Grand Empress Dowager be again called Empress Dowager, that the Empress Dowager be called Empress Wenxuan, and that her palace be called Zhaoxin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict restored the Grand Empress Dowager’s title to Empress Dowager, styled the Empress Dowager as Empress Wenxuan, and named her palace Zhaoxin.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙酉，詔自太祖創業已來，諸有佐命功臣，子孫絕滅，國統不傳者，有司搜訪近親，以名聞，當量為立後。
manualTranslations.literal: On the yiyou day, an edict ordered that since the Grand Ancestor founded the enterprise, for all meritorious ministers who had assisted the mandate, whose descendants had died out and whose state lines were not transmitted, the responsible offices should search out close kin and report their names, and suitable persons would be established as heirs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, an edict ordered the offices to search out close kin of meritorious founders whose descendants had died out and whose state lines had not continued, report their names, and establish suitable heirs for them.

manualTranslations.zh: 諸郡國老人，各授板職，賜黃帽鳩杖。
manualTranslations.literal: Elders of the various commanderies and states were each granted honorary board appointments and given yellow caps and dove-headed staffs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Elders in the commanderies and kingdoms were granted honorary appointments and given yellow caps and dove-headed staffs.

manualTranslations.zh: 又詔謇正之士，並聽進見陳事。
manualTranslations.literal: Another edict ordered that men of frank and upright speech all be permitted to come forward for audience and present affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Another edict allowed frank and upright men to come forward for audience and present matters.

manualTranslations.zh: 軍人戰亡死王事者，以時申聞，當加榮贈。
manualTranslations.literal: For soldiers who died in battle or died in royal service, reports were to be submitted in due time, and they would be given honorable posthumous grants.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soldiers who died in battle or in royal service were to be reported promptly and honored with posthumous grants.

manualTranslations.zh: 督將朝士名望素高，位歷通顯，天保以來未蒙追贈者，亦皆錄奏。
manualTranslations.literal: Commanders and court officers whose reputation had long been high and whose offices had been prominent, but who since the Tianbao era had not received posthumous grants, were also all to be recorded and memorialized.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Commanders and court officers of longstanding reputation and prominent office who had not received posthumous honors since the Tianbao era were also to be listed and memorialized.

manualTranslations.zh: 又以廷尉、中丞，執法所在，繩違案罪，不得舞文弄法。
manualTranslations.literal: He further held that the Commandant of Justice and the Censor-in-Chief were where the law was enforced, correcting violations and judging crimes, and must not play with the text and manipulate the law.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He further declared that the Commandant of Justice and Censor-in-Chief, as offices charged with enforcing law, correcting violations, and judging crimes, must not twist texts or manipulate statutes.

manualTranslations.zh: 其官奴婢年六十已上，免為庶人。
manualTranslations.literal: Government male and female slaves aged sixty and above were freed and made commoners.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Government slaves aged sixty and above were freed and made commoners.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊子，以太傅、長廣王湛為右丞相，以太尉、平陽王淹為太傅，以尚書令、彭城王浟為大司馬。
manualTranslations.literal: On the wuzi day, Zhan, Grand Tutor and Prince of Changguang, was made Right Chancellor; Yan, Grand Commandant and Prince of Pingyang, was made Grand Tutor; and You, Director of the Masters of Writing and Prince of Pengcheng, was made Grand Marshal.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Zhan, Grand Tutor and Prince of Changguang, was made Right Chancellor; Yan, Grand Commandant and Prince of Pingyang, was made Grand Tutor; and You, Director of the Masters of Writing and Prince of Pengcheng, was made Grand Marshal.

sourceRange.text: 秋七月戊子，肅慎遣使朝貢。壬辰，降罪人。庚戌，至自北伐。八月庚午，以司州牧、清河王岳為太保，以安德王韓軌為大司馬，以扶風王可朱渾道元為大將軍，以司空尉粲為司徒，以太子少師侯莫陳相為司空，以尚書令、平陽王淹為錄尚書事，以常山王演為尚書令，以上黨王渙為尚書右僕射。丁丑，行幸晉陽。辛巳，錄尚書事、平原王高隆之薨。封冀州刺史段韶為平原王。是月，詔常山王演、上黨王渙、清河王岳、平原王段韶率衆於洛陽西南築伐惡城、新城、嚴城、河南城四鎮。九月，帝親自臨幸，欲以致西師。西師不出，乃如晉陽。

context.beforeSource: 六月，蠕蠕遠遁。
context.afterSource: 冬十月，西魏攻陷江陵，殺梁元帝。

context.afterLocal: 冬十月，西魏攻陷江陵，殺梁元帝。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on wuzu, the Sushen sent envoys with tribute.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬辰，降罪人。
manualTranslations.literal: On the renchen day, punishments for offenders were reduced.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On renchen, punishments for offenders were reduced.

manualTranslations.literal: On the gengxu day, he arrived back from the northern campaign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On gengxu, he returned from the northern campaign.

manualTranslations.zh: 八月庚午，以司州牧、清河王岳為太保，以安德王韓軌為大司馬，以扶風王可朱渾道元為大將軍，以司空尉粲為司徒，以太子少師侯莫陳相為司空，以尚書令、平陽王淹為錄尚書事，以常山王演為尚書令，以上黨王渙為尚書右僕射。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month, on the gengwu day, Yue, Governor of Si Province and Prince of Qinghe, was made Grand Guardian; Han Gui, Prince of Ande, was made Grand Marshal; Kezhuhun Daoyuan, Prince of Fufeng, was made Grand General; Wei Can, Minister of Works, was made Minister over the Masses; Houmochen Xiang, Junior Mentor to the Crown Prince, was made Minister of Works; Yan, Director of the Masters of Writing and Prince of Pingyang, was made Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing; Yan, Prince of Changshan, was made Director of the Masters of Writing; and Huan, Prince of Shangdang, was made Right Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengwu, Yue of Qinghe became Grand Guardian, Han Gui of Ande Grand Marshal, Kezhuhun Daoyuan of Fufeng Grand General, Wei Can Minister over the Masses, Houmochen Xiang Minister of Works, Yan of Pingyang Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, Yan of Changshan Director of the Masters of Writing, and Huan of Shangdang Right Vice Minister.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁丑，行幸晉陽。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingchou day, he went to Jinyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dingchou he went to Jinyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛巳，錄尚書事、平原王高隆之薨。
manualTranslations.literal: On the xinsi day, Gao Longzhi, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing and Prince of Pingyuan, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Gao Longzhi, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing and Prince of Pingyuan, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 封冀州刺史段韶為平原王。
manualTranslations.literal: Duan Shao, Inspector of Ji Province, was enfeoffed as Prince of Pingyuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Duan Shao, Inspector of Ji Province, was enfeoffed as Prince of Pingyuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 是月，詔常山王演、上黨王渙、清河王岳、平原王段韶率衆於洛陽西南築伐惡城、新城、嚴城、河南城四鎮。
manualTranslations.literal: That month, an edict ordered Prince Yan of Changshan, Prince Huan of Shangdang, Prince Yue of Qinghe, and Prince Duan Shao of Pingyuan to lead troops and build the four garrison towns of Fa e, Xincheng, Yancheng, and Henan southwest of Luoyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That month, an edict sent Yan of Changshan, Huan of Shangdang, Yue of Qinghe, and Duan Shao of Pingyuan to lead troops and build four garrison towns southwest of Luoyang: Fae, Xincheng, Yancheng, and Henan.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月，帝親自臨幸，欲以致西師。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, the Emperor personally visited, hoping thereby to draw out the western army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the Emperor went there in person, hoping to draw out the western army.

manualTranslations.zh: 西師不出，乃如晉陽。
manualTranslations.literal: The western army did not come out, and he then went to Jinyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The western army did not come out, so he went on to Jinyang.

sourceRange.text: 乾明元年，從廢帝赴鄴，居于領軍府。時楊愔、燕子獻、可朱渾天和、宋欽道、鄭子默等以帝威望旣重，內懼權逼，請以帝為太師、司州牧、錄尚書事，長廣王湛為大司馬、錄并省尚書事，解京畿大都督。帝旣以尊親而見猜斥，乃與長廣王期獵，謀之於野。

manualTranslations.zh: 乾明元年，從廢帝赴鄴，居于領軍府。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Qianming, he followed the Deposed Emperor to Ye and resided at the Leading Army Office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Qianming year one, he followed the Deposed Emperor to Ye and stayed at the Leading Army Office.

manualTranslations.zh: 時楊愔、燕子獻、可朱渾天和、宋欽道、鄭子默等以帝威望旣重，內懼權逼，請以帝為太師、司州牧、錄尚書事，長廣王湛為大司馬、錄并省尚書事，解京畿大都督。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time Yang Yin, Yan Zixian, Kezhuhun Tianhe, Song Qindao, Zheng Zimo, and others, because the Emperor already held weighty prestige and inwardly feared being pressed by his authority, requested that he be made Grand Preceptor, Governor of Si Province, and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, that Zhan, Prince of Changguang, be made Grand Marshal and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing of Bing Province, and that the Emperor be relieved as Grand Commander of the capital region.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time Yang Yin, Yan Zixian, Kezhuhun Tianhe, Song Qindao, Zheng Zimo, and the others feared his growing prestige and power. They requested that he be made Grand Preceptor, Governor of Si Province, and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, that Prince Zhan of Changguang be made Grand Marshal and Recorder for Bing Province, and that he be relieved of command over the capital region.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝旣以尊親而見猜斥，乃與長廣王期獵，謀之於野。
manualTranslations.literal: Since the Emperor, despite being an honored kinsman, was suspected and pushed aside, he arranged a hunt with the Prince of Changguang and plotted with him in the fields.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Suspected and pushed aside despite his honored kinship, he arranged a hunt with the Prince of Changguang and plotted with him in the fields.

sourceRange.text: 冬十月甲午，帝暴崩於晉陽宮德陽堂，時年三十一。遺詔，凶事一從儉約，喪月之斷，限以三十六日，嗣子百僚，內外遐邇，奉制割情，悉從公除。癸卯，發喪，歛於宣德殿。十一月辛未，梓宮還鄴。十二月乙酉，殯於太極前殿。乾明元年二月丙申，葬於武寧陵，謚曰文宣帝，廟號顯祖。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on jiawu, the Emperor suddenly died in Deyang Hall of Jinyang Palace, aged thirty-one.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yiyou, he lay in state in the front hall of Taiji Palace.

sourceRange.text: 十一月甲辰，詔曰：「朕嬰此暴疾，奄忽無逮。今嗣子沖眇，未閑政術，社稷業重，理歸上德。右丞相、長廣王湛，研機測化，體道居宗，人雄之望，海內瞻仰，同胞共氣，家國所憑。可遣尚書左僕射、趙郡王叡喻旨，徵王統茲大寶。其喪紀之禮，一同漢文，三十六日，悉從公除。山陵施用，務從儉約。」先是，帝不豫而無闕聽覽，是日，崩於晉陽宮，時年二十七。大寧元年閏十二月癸卯，梓宮還鄴，上謚曰孝昭皇帝。庚午，葬於文靜陵。

manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the jiachen day, an edict said, "I have been stricken by this violent illness, and suddenly can no longer go on.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiachen, an edict said, "I have been struck by this sudden illness and can no longer continue.

manualTranslations.zh: 今嗣子沖眇，未閑政術，社稷業重，理歸上德。
manualTranslations.literal: Now the heir is young and small and is not yet practiced in the arts of government; the enterprise of the altars of soil and grain is weighty, and by principle it should return to highest virtue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The heir is young and slight, not yet versed in government; the burden of the state is weighty and should pass to highest virtue.

manualTranslations.zh: 右丞相、長廣王湛，研機測化，體道居宗，人雄之望，海內瞻仰，同胞共氣，家國所憑。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhan, Right Chancellor and Prince of Changguang, studies the subtle and measures transformation, embodies the Way and dwells as kinsman, has the hopes placed in a hero among men, is looked to within the seas, shares my womb and qi, and is what the house and state rely on.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhan, Right Chancellor and Prince of Changguang, grasps subtle change, embodies the Way as a royal kinsman, commands the hopes of the realm, shares my blood, and is the support of house and state.

manualTranslations.zh: 可遣尚書左僕射、趙郡王叡喻旨，徵王統茲大寶。
manualTranslations.literal: Let Rui, Left Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing and Prince of Zhaojun, be sent to explain the intent and summon the Prince to take charge of this great treasure.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Send Rui, Left Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing and Prince of Zhaojun, to convey the decree and summon the Prince to assume the throne.

manualTranslations.zh: 其喪紀之禮，一同漢文，三十六日，悉從公除。
manualTranslations.literal: As for the rites of mourning, make them entirely the same as those of Emperor Wen of Han: thirty-six days, all following public release from mourning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The mourning rites are to follow Emperor Wen of Han: thirty-six days, with public release from mourning for all.

manualTranslations.zh: 山陵施用，務從儉約。」
manualTranslations.literal: For the expenditure on the mountain mausoleum, be sure to follow frugality."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Expenditures for the mausoleum must be frugal."

manualTranslations.zh: 先是，帝不豫而無闕聽覽，是日，崩於晉陽宮，時年二十七。
manualTranslations.literal: Before this, the Emperor was unwell but did not neglect hearings and reviews; that day, he died in Jinyang Palace, at the age of twenty-seven.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before this, though unwell, the Emperor had not neglected audiences and reviews. That day he died in Jinyang Palace, aged twenty-seven.

manualTranslations.zh: 大寧元年閏十二月癸卯，梓宮還鄴，上謚曰孝昭皇帝。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Daning, in the intercalary twelfth month, on the guimao day, the imperial coffin returned to Ye, and the posthumous title Emperor Xiaozhao was presented.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Daning year one, in the intercalary twelfth month, on guimao, the imperial coffin returned to Ye, and the posthumous title Emperor Xiaozhao was presented.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚午，葬於文靜陵。
manualTranslations.literal: On the gengwu day, he was buried in Wenjing Mausoleum.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On gengwu he was buried in Wenjing Mausoleum.

sourceRange.text: 冬十月，梁將陳霸先襲殺王僧辯，廢蕭明，復立蕭方智為主。辛亥，行幸晉陽。十一月，梁秦州刺史徐嗣徽、南豫州刺史任約等襲據石頭城，並以州內附。壬辰，大都督蕭軌帥衆至江，遣都督柳達摩等度江，鎮石頭。己亥，太保、清河王岳薨。柳達摩為霸先攻逼，以石頭降。

sourceRange.text: 帝聦慧夙成，寬厚仁智，天保間，雅有令名。及承大位，楊愔、燕子獻、宋欽道等同輔。以常山王地親望重，內外畏服，加以文宣初崩之日，太后本欲立之，故愔等並懷猜忌。常山王憂悵，乃白太后，誅其黨。時平秦王歸彥亦預謀焉。皇建二年秋，天文告變，歸彥慮有後害，仍白孝昭，以王當咎。乃遣歸彥馳驛至晉陽害之。王薨後，孝昭不豫，見文宣為祟。孝昭深惡之，厭勝術備設而無益也。薨三旬而孝昭崩。大寧二年，葬於武寧之西北，謚閔悼王。

manualTranslations.zh: 帝聦慧夙成，寬厚仁智，天保間，雅有令名。
manualTranslations.literal: The Emperor was intelligent and wise from early on, generous, kind, humane, and discerning; during the Tianbao era, he had an excellent reputation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Emperor was precociously intelligent, generous, humane, and wise; during Tianbao he enjoyed a fine reputation.

manualTranslations.zh: 及承大位，楊愔、燕子獻、宋欽道等同輔。
manualTranslations.literal: When he inherited the great position, Yang Yin, Yan Zixian, Song Qindao, and others assisted him together.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he inherited the throne, Yang Yin, Yan Zixian, Song Qindao, and others served jointly as his assistants.

manualTranslations.zh: 以常山王地親望重，內外畏服，加以文宣初崩之日，太后本欲立之，故愔等並懷猜忌。
manualTranslations.literal: Because the Prince of Changshan was close in kinship and heavy in prestige, and those within and without feared and submitted to him, and because on the day Wenxuan first died the Empress Dowager had originally wished to install him, Yin and the others all harbored suspicion and jealousy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because the Prince of Changshan was a close kinsman of great prestige, feared and respected at court and outside it, and because the Empress Dowager had originally wanted to install him when Wenxuan died, Yang Yin and the others grew suspicious of him.

manualTranslations.zh: 常山王憂悵，乃白太后，誅其黨。
manualTranslations.literal: The Prince of Changshan was worried and resentful, and therefore reported to the Empress Dowager and executed their faction.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Troubled and resentful, the Prince of Changshan reported this to the Empress Dowager and executed their faction.

manualTranslations.zh: 時平秦王歸彥亦預謀焉。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time Guiyan, Prince of Pingqin, also participated in the plot.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guiyan, Prince of Pingqin, also took part in the plot.

manualTranslations.zh: 皇建二年秋，天文告變，歸彥慮有後害，仍白孝昭，以王當咎。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn of the second year of Huangjian, celestial patterns announced an anomaly; Guiyan feared later harm, and again told Xiaozhao that the Prince would bear the blame.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn of Huangjian year two, celestial signs showed a portent. Fearing future harm, Guiyan again told Xiaozhao that the Prince would be blamed.

manualTranslations.zh: 乃遣歸彥馳驛至晉陽害之。
manualTranslations.literal: He then sent Guiyan by relay rider to Jinyang to kill him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He then sent Guiyan by relay to Jinyang to kill him.

manualTranslations.zh: 王薨後，孝昭不豫，見文宣為祟。
manualTranslations.literal: After the Prince died, Xiaozhao became unwell and saw Wenxuan acting as a malign spirit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the Prince died, Xiaozhao fell ill and saw Wenxuan haunting him.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝昭深惡之，厭勝術備設而無益也。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiaozhao deeply hated this, and all exorcistic countermeasures were set out, but they were of no benefit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiaozhao was deeply troubled and set out every exorcistic countermeasure, but none helped.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨三旬而孝昭崩。
manualTranslations.literal: Thirty days after the Prince died, Xiaozhao died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thirty days after the Prince died, Xiaozhao also died.

manualTranslations.zh: 大寧二年，葬於武寧之西北，謚閔悼王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Daning, he was buried northwest of Wuning and given the posthumous title Prince Mindao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Daning year two, he was buried northwest of Wuning and posthumously titled Prince Mindao.

sourceRange.text: 是歲，周武成元年。春正月癸丑朔，改元。己未，詔寬徭賦。癸亥，高陽王湜薨。是月，車駕至自晉陽。二月己亥，以太傅、常山王演為太師、錄尚書事，以太尉、長廣王湛為大司馬、并省錄尚書事，以尚書左僕射、平秦王歸彥為司空，趙郡王叡為尚書左僕射。詔諸元良口配沒宮內及賜人者，並放免。甲辰，帝幸芳林園，親錄囚徒，死罪已下，降免各有差。

sourceRange.text: 大寧元年冬十一月癸丑，皇帝即位於南宮。大赦，改皇建二年為大寧。乙卯，以司徒、平秦王歸彥為太傅，以尚書右僕射、趙郡王睿為尚書令，以太尉尉粲為太保，以尚書令段韶為大司馬，以豐州刺史婁睿為司空，以太傅、平陽王淹為太宰，以太保、彭城王浟為太師、錄尚書事，以冀州刺史、博陵王濟為太尉，以中書監、任城王湝為尚書左僕射，以并州刺史斛律光為右僕射。封孝昭皇帝太子百年為樂陵郡王。庚申，詔大使巡行天下，求政善惡，問人疾苦，擢進賢良。是歲，周武帝保定元年。河清元年春正月乙亥，車駕至自晉陽。辛巳，祀南郊。壬午，享太廟。丙戌，立妃胡氏為皇后，子緯為皇太子。戊子，大赦，內外百官，普加泛級，諸為父後者，賜爵一級。己亥，以前定州刺史、馮翊王潤為尚書左僕射。詔普斷屠殺，以順春令。二月丁未，以太宰、平陽王淹為青州刺史、太傅、領司徒，以領軍大將軍、宗師、平秦王歸彥為太宰、冀州刺史。

localRange.text: 二月丁未，以太宰、平陽王淹為青州刺史、太傅、領司徒；以領軍大將軍、宗師、平秦王歸彥為太宰、冀州刺史。
