manualTranslations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed, and Huangjian year two was changed to Daning.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙卯，以司徒、平秦王歸彥為太傅，以尚書右僕射、趙郡王睿為尚書令，以太尉尉粲為太保，以尚書令段韶為大司馬，以豐州刺史婁睿為司空，以太傅、平陽王淹為太宰，以太保、彭城王浟為太師、錄尚書事，以冀州刺史、博陵王濟為太尉，以中書監、任城王湝為尚書左僕射，以并州刺史斛律光為右僕射。
manualTranslations.literal: On the yimao day, Guiyan, Minister over the Masses and Prince of Pingqin, was made Grand Tutor; Rui, Right Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing and Prince of Zhaojun, was made Director of the Masters of Writing; Grand Commandant Wei Can was made Grand Guardian; Director of the Masters of Writing Duan Shao was made Grand Marshal; Lou Rui, Inspector of Feng Province, was made Minister of Works; Yan, Grand Tutor and Prince of Pingyang, was made Grand Steward; You, Grand Guardian and Prince of Pengcheng, was made Grand Preceptor and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing; Ji, Inspector of Ji Province and Prince of Boling, was made Grand Commandant; Jie, Palace Writer Supervisor and Prince of Rencheng, was made Left Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing; and Bing Province Inspector Hulü Guang was made Right Vice Minister.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On yimao, offices were reassigned: Guiyan of Pingqin became Grand Tutor; Rui of Zhaojun Director of the Masters of Writing; Wei Can Grand Guardian; Duan Shao Grand Marshal; Lou Rui Minister of Works; Yan of Pingyang Grand Steward; You of Pengcheng Grand Preceptor and Recorder; Ji of Boling Grand Commandant; Jie of Rencheng Left Vice Minister; and Hulü Guang Right Vice Minister.

manualTranslations.zh: 封孝昭皇帝太子百年為樂陵郡王。
manualTranslations.literal: Bainian, Crown Prince of Emperor Xiaozhao, was enfeoffed as Prince of Leling Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Bainian, Emperor Xiaozhao’s crown prince, was enfeoffed as Prince of Leling Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚申，詔大使巡行天下，求政善惡，問人疾苦，擢進賢良。
manualTranslations.literal: On the gengshen day, an edict ordered great envoys to tour the realm, seek out the good and bad in governance, ask about the people’s sufferings, and promote the worthy and good.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On gengshen, an edict sent grand envoys through the realm to examine good and bad governance, ask after the people’s hardships, and promote worthy men.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲，周武帝保定元年。
manualTranslations.literal: That year was the first year of Baoding of Emperor Wu of Zhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year was Zhou Emperor Wu’s Baoding year one.

manualTranslations.zh: 河清元年春正月乙亥，車駕至自晉陽。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Heqing, in spring, in the first month, on the yihai day, the imperial carriage arrived back from Jinyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Heqing year one, in spring, in the first month, on yihai, the emperor returned from Jinyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛巳，祀南郊。
manualTranslations.literal: On the xinsi day, he sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On xinsi he sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬午，享太廟。
manualTranslations.literal: On the renwu day, he presented offerings in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On renwu he made offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙戌，立妃胡氏為皇后，子緯為皇太子。
manualTranslations.literal: On the bingxu day, he established Consort Hu as Empress and his son Wei as Crown Prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On bingxu he made Consort Hu Empress and his son Wei Crown Prince.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊子，大赦，內外百官，普加泛級，諸為父後者，賜爵一級。
manualTranslations.literal: On the wuzi day, there was a general amnesty; all officials inside and outside were generally advanced by honorary grades, and all who served as heirs to their fathers were given one noble rank.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On wuzi a general amnesty was proclaimed; officials inside and outside were broadly advanced in grade, and those serving as heirs to their fathers received one noble rank.

manualTranslations.zh: 己亥，以前定州刺史、馮翊王潤為尚書左僕射。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jihai day, Run, former Inspector of Ding Province and Prince of Fengyi, was made Left Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jihai, Run, former Inspector of Ding Province and Prince of Fengyi, became Left Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔普斷屠殺，以順春令。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict universally prohibited slaughter, in order to accord with the ordinances of spring.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict broadly prohibited slaughter to accord with the ordinances of spring.

manualTranslations.zh: 二月丁未，以太宰、平陽王淹為青州刺史、太傅、領司徒，以領軍大將軍、宗師、平秦王歸彥為太宰、冀州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month, on the dingwei day, Yan, Grand Steward and Prince of Pingyang, was made Inspector of Qing Province, Grand Tutor, and Acting Minister over the Masses; Guiyan, General-in-Chief of the Palace Guard, Master of the Imperial Clan, and Prince of Pingqin, was made Grand Steward and Inspector of Ji Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingwei, Yan of Pingyang became Inspector of Qing Province, Grand Tutor, and Acting Minister over the Masses; Guiyan of Pingqin became Grand Steward and Inspector of Ji Province.

sourceRange.text: 己卯，兼右僕射魏收以阿縱除名。丁丑，以武明皇后配祭北郊。辛卯，帝臨都亭錄見囚，降在京罪人各有差。三月己丑，詔司空斛律光督五營軍士築戍於軹關。壬申，室韋國遣使朝貢。丙戌，以兼尚書右僕射趙彥深為左僕射。夏四月，並、汾、晉、東雍、南汾五州蟲旱傷稼，遣使振恤。戊午，陳人來聘。五月壬午，詔以城南雙堂之苑，回造大總持寺。六月乙巳，齊州上言，濟河水口見八龍升天。乙卯，詔兼散騎常侍崔子武使於陳。庚申，司州牧、河南王孝瑜薨。秋八月辛丑，詔以三臺宮為大興聖寺。冬十二月癸巳，陳人來聘。己酉，周將楊忠帥突厥阿史那木可汗等一十餘萬人，自恒州分為三道，殺掠吏人。是時，大雨雪連月，南北千餘里，平地數尺。

context.beforeSource: 以太子少傅魏收為兼尚書右僕射。
context.afterSource: 霜晝下，雨血於太原。
context.beforeLocal: 以太子少傅魏收為兼尚書右僕射。
context.afterLocal: 霜晝下，雨血於太原。

manualTranslations.zh: 己卯，兼右僕射魏收以阿縱除名。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jimao day, Wei Shou, Acting Right Vice Minister, was removed from the rolls for favoritism and indulgence.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jimao, Acting Right Vice Minister Wei Shou was struck from the rolls for favoritism.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁丑，以武明皇后配祭北郊。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingchou day, Empress Wuming was associated in sacrifice at the Northern Suburb.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Empress Wuming was paired in sacrifice at the Northern Suburb.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛卯，帝臨都亭錄見囚，降在京罪人各有差。
manualTranslations.literal: On the xinmao day, the Emperor went to Duting to review prisoners, reducing punishments for offenders in the capital by varying degrees.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the Emperor reviewed prisoners at Duting and reduced sentences for offenders in the capital by varying degrees.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月己丑，詔司空斛律光督五營軍士築戍於軹關。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, on the jichou day, an edict ordered Minister of Works Hulü Guang to supervise soldiers of the five camps in building a garrison at Zhi Pass.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jichou, an edict ordered Minister of Works Hulü Guang to oversee troops from the five camps building a garrison at Zhi Pass.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬申，室韋國遣使朝貢。
manualTranslations.literal: On the renshen day, the Shiwei state sent envoys to court with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On renshen, the Shiwei sent envoys with tribute.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙戌，以兼尚書右僕射趙彥深為左僕射。
manualTranslations.literal: On the bingxu day, Zhao Yanshen, Acting Right Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing, was made Left Vice Minister.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Acting Right Vice Minister Zhao Yanshen became Left Vice Minister.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月，並、汾、晉、東雍、南汾五州蟲旱傷稼，遣使振恤。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, insects and drought damaged the crops in Bing, Fen, Jin, East Yong, and South Fen provinces, and envoys were sent to relieve them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, insects and drought damaged crops in Bing, Fen, Jin, East Yong, and South Fen provinces, so envoys were sent to provide relief.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊午，陳人來聘。
manualTranslations.literal: On the wuwu day, Chen envoys came on a friendly mission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Chen envoys came on a friendly mission.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月壬午，詔以城南雙堂之苑，回造大總持寺。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month, on the renwu day, an edict ordered that the garden of Shuangtang south of the city be converted to build the Great Zongchi Monastery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renwu, an edict converted the Shuangtang garden south of the city into the Great Zongchi Monastery.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月乙巳，齊州上言，濟河水口見八龍升天。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, on the yisi day, Qi Province reported that at the mouth of the Ji River eight dragons were seen ascending to heaven.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yisi, Qi Province reported that eight dragons had been seen ascending to heaven at the mouth of the Ji River.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙卯，詔兼散騎常侍崔子武使於陳。
manualTranslations.literal: On the yimao day, an edict sent Cui Ziwu, Acting Regular Attendant Cavalier, as envoy to Chen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On yimao, Acting Regular Attendant Cavalier Cui Ziwu was sent as envoy to Chen.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚申，司州牧、河南王孝瑜薨。
manualTranslations.literal: On the gengshen day, Xiaoyu, Governor of Si Province and Prince of Henan, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Xiaoyu, Governor of Si Province and Prince of Henan, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋八月辛丑，詔以三臺宮為大興聖寺。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, in the eighth month, on the xinchou day, an edict made the Three Terraces Palace into Daxingsheng Monastery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the eighth month, on xinchou, an edict turned the Three Terraces Palace into Daxingsheng Monastery.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十二月癸巳，陳人來聘。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in the twelfth month, on the guisi day, Chen envoys came on a friendly mission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, in the twelfth month, on guisi, Chen envoys came on a friendly mission.

manualTranslations.zh: 己酉，周將楊忠帥突厥阿史那木可汗等一十餘萬人，自恒州分為三道，殺掠吏人。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jiyou day, the Zhou general Yang Zhong led the Turks under Ashina Mu Qaghan and others, more than one hundred thousand men, divided from Heng Province into three routes and killed and plundered officials and people.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiyou, the Zhou general Yang Zhong led Ashina Mu Qaghan and more than one hundred thousand Turks and others from Heng Province in three columns, killing and plundering officials and commoners.

manualTranslations.zh: 是時，大雨雪連月，南北千餘里，平地數尺。
manualTranslations.literal: At this time, heavy snow fell for successive months; for more than a thousand li north to south, it lay several feet deep on level ground.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time, heavy snow fell for months; across more than a thousand li north to south, it lay several feet deep on level ground.

sourceRange.text: 天統元年夏四月丙子，皇帝即位於晉陽宮。大赦，改河清四年為天統。丁丑，以太保賀拔仁為太師，太尉侯莫陳相為太保，司空、馮翊王潤為司徒，錄尚書事、趙郡王睿為司空，尚書左僕射、河間王孝琬為尚書令。戊寅，以瀛州刺史尉粲為太尉，斛律光為大將軍，東安王婁睿為太尉，尚書右僕射趙彥深為左僕射。六月壬戌，彗星出文昌東北，其大如手，後稍長，乃至丈餘，百日乃滅。己巳，太上皇帝詔兼散騎常侍王季高使於陳。秋七月乙未，太上皇帝詔增置都水使者一人。冬十一月癸未，太上皇帝至自晉陽。己丑，太上皇帝詔改太祖獻武皇帝為神武皇帝，廟號高祖，獻明皇后為武明皇后。其文宣謚號，委有司議定。十二月庚戌，太上皇帝狩於北郊。

context.beforeSource: 河清四年，武成禪位於帝。
context.afterSource: 壬子，狩於南郊。
context.beforeLocal: 河清四年，武成禪位於帝。
context.afterLocal: 壬子，狩於南郊。

manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Tiantong, in summer, in the fourth month, on the bingzi day, the Emperor took the throne in Jinyang Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tiantong year one, in summer, in the fourth month, on bingzi, the Emperor took the throne in Jinyang Palace.

sourceRange.text: 詔曰：及卒哭，孝文服衰，近臣從服。

localRange.text: 詔曰：尊旨從儉，不申罔極之痛；稱情允禮，仰損儉訓之德；進退思惟，倍用崩感。又山陵之節，亦有成命；內則方丈，外裁奄坎。脫於孝子之心有所不盡者，室中可二丈，墳不得過三十步。今以陵萬世所仰，復廣為六十步。孤負遺旨，益以痛絕！其幽房大小，棺槨質約，不設明器。至於素帳縵茵瓷瓦之物，亦皆不置。此則遵先志，從冊令。俱奉遺事，而有從有違，未達者或以致怪。梓宮之裏，玄堂之內，聖靈所憑，已一一奉遵，仰昭儉德。其餘外事，有所不從，以盡痛慕之情。其宣示遠近，著告群司，上明儉誨之美，下彰違命之失。及卒哭，孝文服衰，近臣從服。

sourceRange.text: 孝文文昭皇后高氏，司徒公肇之妹也。父揚，母蓋氏，凡四男三女，皆生於東裔。孝文初，乃舉室西歸。近龍城鎮，鎮表后德色婉豔。及至，文明太后親幸北部曹見后，奇之，入掖庭，時年十三。初，后幼曾夢在堂內立，而日光自窗中照之，灼灼而熱，后東西避之，光猶斜照不已。如是數夕，怪之，以白其父颺。颺以問遼東人閔宗。宗曰：「此奇徵也。昔有夢月入懷，猶生天子，況日照之徵！此女將被帝命，誕育人君之象也。」后生宣武及廣平王懷、長樂公主。馮昭儀寵盛，密有母養帝心。后自代如洛陽，暴薨於汲郡之共縣，或云昭儀所賊也。宣武之為皇太子，二日一朝幽后，后拊念慈愛有加。孝文出征，宣武入朝，必久留后宮，親視櫛沐，母道隆備。

context.beforeSource: 」諡曰幽皇后，葬長陵塋內。
context.afterSource: 其後有司奏請加號，諡曰文昭貴人。

manualTranslations.zh: 孝文文昭皇后高氏，司徒公肇之妹也。
manualTranslations.literal: Empress Gao, Wenzhao of Xiaowen, was the younger sister of Situ Duke Zhao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Empress Gao, Wenzhao of Xiaowen, was the younger sister of Gao Zhao, Duke and Minister over the Masses.

manualTranslations.zh: 父揚，母蓋氏，凡四男三女，皆生於東裔。
manualTranslations.literal: Her father was Yang and her mother was Lady Gai; altogether they had four sons and three daughters, all born in the eastern borderlands.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Her father was Gao Yang and her mother Lady Gai. They had four sons and three daughters in all, all born in the eastern borderlands.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝文初，乃舉室西歸。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Xiaowen, the whole household then returned west.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xiaowen's reign, the whole household returned west.

manualTranslations.zh: 近龍城鎮，鎮表后德色婉豔。
manualTranslations.literal: When they neared Longcheng garrison, the garrison memorialized that the Empress's virtue and beauty were gentle and lovely.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When they neared Longcheng garrison, the garrison reported that she was graceful in virtue and beautiful in appearance.

manualTranslations.zh: 及至，文明太后親幸北部曹見后，奇之，入掖庭，時年十三。
manualTranslations.literal: When she arrived, Empress Dowager Wenming personally went to the Northern Section Office to see her, found her remarkable, and brought her into the rear palace; she was then thirteen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When she arrived, Empress Dowager Wenming personally went to the Northern Section Office to see her, found her extraordinary, and brought her into the inner palace. She was thirteen.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，后幼曾夢在堂內立，而日光自窗中照之，灼灼而熱，后東西避之，光猶斜照不已。
manualTranslations.literal: Earlier, when the Empress was young, she once dreamed that she stood inside the hall and sunlight shone on her from the window, blazing hot; she dodged east and west, but the light still shone slantwise without stopping.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When she was young, the Empress once dreamed she was standing inside a hall while sunlight streamed in through the window, blazing hot. She moved east and west to avoid it, but the light kept slanting toward her.

manualTranslations.zh: 如是數夕，怪之，以白其父颺。
manualTranslations.literal: This happened for several nights, and, finding it strange, she reported it to her father Yang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After this happened for several nights, she found it strange and told her father Gao Yang.

manualTranslations.zh: 颺以問遼東人閔宗。
manualTranslations.literal: Yang asked Min Zong of Liaodong about it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gao Yang asked Min Zong of Liaodong about it.

manualTranslations.zh: 宗曰：「此奇徵也。
manualTranslations.literal: Zong said, "This is an extraordinary omen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zong said, "This is an extraordinary omen.

manualTranslations.zh: 昔有夢月入懷，猶生天子，況日照之徵！
manualTranslations.literal: In the past, someone who dreamed the moon entered her bosom still gave birth to a Son of Heaven; how much more so this sign of the sun shining!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the past, a woman who dreamed the moon entered her breast still gave birth to a Son of Heaven. How much more this omen of sunlight!

manualTranslations.zh: 此女將被帝命，誕育人君之象也。」
manualTranslations.literal: This girl will receive an imperial destiny; it is the sign that she will give birth to a ruler of men."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This girl will receive an imperial destiny; it is a sign that she will bear a ruler."

manualTranslations.zh: 后生宣武及廣平王懷、長樂公主。
manualTranslations.literal: The Empress gave birth to Xuanwu, Prince Huai of Guangping, and Princess Changle.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Empress bore Xuanwu, Prince Huai of Guangping, and Princess Changle.

manualTranslations.zh: 馮昭儀寵盛，密有母養帝心。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhaoyi Feng was highly favored and secretly intended to mother and raise the Emperor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhaoyi Feng was highly favored and secretly hoped to raise the Emperor as his mother.

manualTranslations.zh: 后自代如洛陽，暴薨於汲郡之共縣，或云昭儀所賊也。
manualTranslations.literal: As the Empress was going from Dai to Luoyang, she suddenly died at Gong County in Ji Commandery; some say Zhaoyi had murdered her.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As the Empress traveled from Dai to Luoyang, she suddenly died at Gong County in Ji Commandery; some said Zhaoyi Feng had murdered her.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣武之為皇太子，二日一朝幽后，后拊念慈愛有加。
manualTranslations.literal: When Xuanwu was crown prince, every other day he paid court to Empress You, and she comforted and cared for him with added affection.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Xuanwu was crown prince, he paid court to Empress You every other day, and she cared for him with special tenderness.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝文出征，宣武入朝，必久留后宮，親視櫛沐，母道隆備。
manualTranslations.literal: When Xiaowen went out on campaign and Xuanwu came to court, he was always kept for a long time in the rear palace; she personally saw to his combing and bathing, and the way of a mother was richly complete.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Xiaowen went out on campaign and Xuanwu came to court, he was always kept for a long time in the rear palace; she personally saw to his grooming and bathing, fully performing a mother's role.

sourceRange.text: 後劉顯使人將害帝，帝姑為顯弟亢掞妻，知之，密以告后。梁眷亦來告難。后乃令帝去之。后夜飲顯醉，向晨，故驚廄中群馬，使起視馬，后泣謂曰：「吾諸子始皆在此，今盡亡失，汝等誰殺之？」故顯使不急追。道武得至賀蘭部，群情未甚歸附。后從弟外朝大人悅舉部隨從，供奉盡禮。顯怒，將害后，后奔亢掞家，匿神車中三日。亢掞舉室請救，乃得免。會劉顯部亂，始得亡歸。後后弟染幹忌道武之得人心，舉兵圍逼行宮。后出謂染幹曰：「汝等今安所置我，而欲殺吾子也？」染幹慚而去。後后少子秦王觚使于燕，慕容垂止之。后以觚不反，憂念寢疾。皇始元年，崩，祔葬于盛樂金陵。后追加尊諡，配饗焉。

context.beforeSource: 行百餘里，至七個山南而免難。
context.afterSource: 道武皇后慕容氏，寶之季女也。

manualTranslations.zh: 後劉顯使人將害帝，帝姑為顯弟亢掞妻，知之，密以告后。
manualTranslations.literal: Later, Liu Xian sent men who were about to harm the Emperor; the Emperor's aunt was the wife of Kangyan, Xian's younger brother, and when she learned of it, she secretly informed the Empress.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later, Liu Xian sent men to kill the Emperor. The Emperor's aunt, who was married to Xian's younger brother Kangyan, learned of it and secretly warned the Empress.

manualTranslations.zh: 梁眷亦來告難。
manualTranslations.literal: Liang Juan also came to report the danger.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liang Juan also came to warn them of the danger.

manualTranslations.zh: 后乃令帝去之。
manualTranslations.literal: The Empress then ordered the Emperor to leave.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Empress then had the Emperor leave.

manualTranslations.zh: 后夜飲顯醉，向晨，故驚廄中群馬，使起視馬，后泣謂曰：「吾諸子始皆在此，今盡亡失，汝等誰殺之？」
manualTranslations.literal: At night the Empress plied Xian with drink until he was drunk; toward morning she deliberately startled the horses in the stable and made him rise to look at them. The Empress wept and said, "My sons were all here at first, and now they have all disappeared. Which of you killed them?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That night the Empress got Xian drunk. Toward dawn she deliberately startled the stable horses and made him get up to inspect them. Weeping, she said, "All my sons were here before, and now they have vanished. Which of you killed them?"

manualTranslations.zh: 故顯使不急追。
manualTranslations.literal: Therefore Xian caused the pursuers not to pursue urgently.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because of this, Xian did not press the pursuit.

manualTranslations.zh: 道武得至賀蘭部，群情未甚歸附。
manualTranslations.literal: Daowu was able to reach the Helan tribe, though the feelings of the people had not yet fully turned to him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Daowu reached the Helan tribe, though its people were not yet fully attached to him.

manualTranslations.zh: 后從弟外朝大人悅舉部隨從，供奉盡禮。
manualTranslations.literal: The Empress's younger male cousin Yue, a dignitary of the outer court, brought his whole tribe to follow and served with complete courtesy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Empress's cousin Yue, an outer-court dignitary, brought his whole tribe over to follow him and served him with full ceremony.

manualTranslations.zh: 顯怒，將害后，后奔亢掞家，匿神車中三日。
manualTranslations.literal: Xian was angry and was about to harm the Empress; the Empress fled to Kangyan's house and hid in the spirit cart for three days.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xian was furious and meant to kill the Empress, so she fled to Kangyan's house and hid for three days in a spirit cart.

manualTranslations.zh: 亢掞舉室請救，乃得免。
manualTranslations.literal: Kangyan raised his whole household to plead for rescue, and she was then able to escape.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Only after Kangyan and his entire household pleaded for her was she spared.

manualTranslations.zh: 會劉顯部亂，始得亡歸。
manualTranslations.literal: It happened that Liu Xian's tribe fell into disorder, and only then was she able to escape and return.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Liu Xian's tribe fell into disorder, she was finally able to escape and return.

manualTranslations.zh: 後后弟染幹忌道武之得人心，舉兵圍逼行宮。
manualTranslations.literal: Later, the Empress's younger brother Rangan was jealous that Daowu had won the people's hearts, and he raised troops and pressed in around the temporary palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later, the Empress's younger brother Rangan, jealous that Daowu had won popular support, raised troops and surrounded the temporary palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 后出謂染幹曰：「汝等今安所置我，而欲殺吾子也？」
manualTranslations.literal: The Empress came out and said to Rangan, "Where will you put me now, that you wish to kill my son?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Empress came out and said to Rangan, "Where do you mean to put me, if you intend to kill my son?"

manualTranslations.zh: 染幹慚而去。
manualTranslations.literal: Rangan was ashamed and withdrew.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Rangan was ashamed and withdrew.

manualTranslations.zh: 後后少子秦王觚使于燕，慕容垂止之。
manualTranslations.literal: Later, the Empress's youngest son Gu, Prince of Qin, was sent to Yan, and Murong Chui detained him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later, the Empress's youngest son Gu, Prince of Qin, went as envoy to Yan, and Murong Chui detained him.

manualTranslations.zh: 后以觚不反，憂念寢疾。
manualTranslations.literal: Because Gu did not return, the Empress became worried and brooding and fell ill.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because Gu did not return, the Empress was consumed by worry and fell ill.

manualTranslations.zh: 皇始元年，崩，祔葬于盛樂金陵。
manualTranslations.literal: In Huangshi year one, she died and was buried in attendance at Jinling in Shengle.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Huangshi year one, she died and was buried with the imperial dead at Jinling in Shengle.

manualTranslations.zh: 后追加尊諡，配饗焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Later, an honored posthumous title was added to her, and she was paired in sacrifice there.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later she was given an honored posthumous title and paired in sacrifice there.

sourceRange.text: 昭成皇后慕容氏，慕容晃之女也。初，帝納晃妹為妃，未幾而崩。晃後請繼好。遣大人長孫秩逆后，晃送於境上。后至，有寵，生獻明帝及秦明王。后性聰敏多智，專夕理內，每事多從。初，昭成遣衛辰兄悉勿祈還部落也，后誡之曰：「汝還，必深防衛辰。辰奸猾，終當滅汝。」悉勿祈死，其子果為衛辰所殺，卒如后言。建國二十三年，崩。道武即位，配饗太廟。

manualTranslations.zh: 昭成皇后慕容氏，慕容晃之女也。
manualTranslations.literal: Empress Murong of Zhaocheng was a daughter of Murong Huang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Empress Murong of Zhaocheng was a daughter of Murong Huang.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，帝納晃妹為妃，未幾而崩。
manualTranslations.literal: At first, the Emperor took Huang's younger sister as consort, but before long she died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At first, the Emperor took Huang's younger sister as consort, but she died not long afterward.

manualTranslations.zh: 晃後請繼好。
manualTranslations.literal: Huang afterward requested that the friendly alliance be continued.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Huang later asked to continue the alliance.

manualTranslations.zh: 遣大人長孫秩逆后，晃送於境上。
manualTranslations.literal: He dispatched the dignitary Zhangsun Zhi to meet the Empress, and Huang escorted her to the border.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He sent the dignitary Zhangsun Zhi to receive the Empress, while Huang escorted her to the frontier.

manualTranslations.zh: 后至，有寵，生獻明帝及秦明王。
manualTranslations.literal: After the Empress arrived, she was favored and gave birth to Emperor Xianming and Prince Ming of Qin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After she arrived, she was favored and bore Emperor Xianming and Prince Ming of Qin.

manualTranslations.zh: 后性聰敏多智，專夕理內，每事多從。
manualTranslations.literal: The Empress was intelligent and full of wisdom by nature; she personally managed inner affairs at night, and in most matters he followed her.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Empress was naturally intelligent and resourceful. She personally managed palace affairs, and her advice was usually followed.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，昭成遣衛辰兄悉勿祈還部落也，后誡之曰：「汝還，必深防衛辰。
manualTranslations.literal: Earlier, when Zhaocheng sent Weichen's elder brother Xiwuqei back to his tribe, the Empress warned him, "When you return, you must be deeply on guard against Weichen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Zhaocheng sent Weichen's elder brother Xiwuqei back to his tribe, the Empress warned him, "When you return, be especially wary of Weichen.

manualTranslations.zh: 辰奸猾，終當滅汝。」
manualTranslations.literal: Chen is treacherous and crafty, and in the end he will destroy you."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He is treacherous and cunning, and in the end he will destroy you."

manualTranslations.zh: 悉勿祈死，其子果為衛辰所殺，卒如后言。
manualTranslations.literal: After Xiwuqei died, his son was indeed killed by Weichen, and in the end it was as the Empress had said.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Xiwuqei died, his son was indeed killed by Weichen, just as the Empress had said.

manualTranslations.zh: 建國二十三年，崩。
manualTranslations.literal: In Jianguo year twenty-three, she died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Jianguo year twenty-three, she died.

manualTranslations.zh: 道武即位，配饗太廟。
manualTranslations.literal: When Daowu ascended the throne, she was paired in sacrifice in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Daowu ascended the throne, she was paired in sacrifice in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sourceRange.text: 其詞曰：及帝幸江都，臣下離貳，有宮人白後曰：「外聞人人欲反。

localRange.text: 其詞曰：承積善之余慶，備箕帚於皇庭。恐修名之不立，將負累於先靈。乃夙夜而匪懈，實夤懼于玄冥。雖自強而不息，亮愚蒙之多滯。思竭節於天衢，才追心而弗逮。實庸薄之多幸，荷隆寵之嘉惠。賴天高而地厚，屬王道之升平。均二儀之覆載，與日月而齊明。乃春生而夏長，等品物而同榮。願立志於恭儉，私自兢於誡盈。孰有念于知足，苟無希於濫名。惟至德之弘深，情弗邇於聲色。感懷舊之餘恩，求故劍於宸極。叨不世之殊眄，謬非才而奉職。何寵祿之逾分，撫胸襟而未識。雖沐浴於恩光，內慚惶而累息。顧微躬之寡昧，思令淑之良難。實不遑於啟處，將有情而自安！若臨深而履薄，心戰粟其如寒。夫居高而必危，每處滿而防溢。知恣誇之非道，乃攝生於沖謐。嗟寵辱之易驚，尚無為而抱一。履謙光而守志，且願守乎容膝。珠簾玉箔之奇，金屋瑤台之美；雖時俗之崇麗，蓋哲人之所鄙。愧絺綌之不工，豈絲竹而喧耳。知道德之可尊，明善惡之由己。蕩囂煩之俗慮，乃伏膺于經史。綜箴誡以訓心，觀女圖而作軌。遵古賢之令范，冀福祿之能綏。時循躬而三省，覺今是而昨非。嗤黃、老之損思，信為善之可歸。慕周姒之遺風，美虞妃之聖則。仰先哲之高才，慕至人之休德。質非薄而難蹤，心恬愉而去惑。乃平生之耿介，實禮義之所遵。雖生知之不敏，庶積行以成仁。懼達人之蓋寡，謂何求而自陳。誠素志之難寫，同絕筆於獲麟。及帝幸江都，臣下離貳，有宮人白後曰：「外聞人人欲反。

context.beforeSource: 時後見帝失德，心知不可，不敢措言，因為《述志賦》以自寄焉。
context.afterSource: 」後曰：「任汝奏之。

sourceRange.text: 宣帝后陳氏，名月儀，自雲潁川人，大將軍山提之第八女也。大象元年六月，以選入宮，拜為德妃。月餘日，立為天左皇后。二年二月，改為天左大皇后。三月，又詔以坤儀比德，土數惟五，四大皇后外，增置天中大皇后一人。於是以後為天中大皇后。帝崩，後出俗為尼，改名華光。後永徽初終。父山提，本爾硃兆之隸。仕齊，位特進、開府、東兗州刺史、謝陽王。武帝平齊，拜大將軍，封淅陽公。大象元年，以後父超授上柱國，進鄅國公，除大宗伯。宣帝皇后元氏，名樂尚，河南洛陽人，開府晟之第二女也。年十五，被選入宮，拜貴妃。大象元年七月，立為天右皇后。二年二月，改為天右大皇后。帝崩，後出家為尼，改名華勝。初，後與陳皇后同時被選入宮，俱拜為妃；及升後，又同日受冊。帝寵遇二後，禮數均等，年齒復同，特相親愛。及為尼後，李、硃及尉遲後並相繼殞歿，而二後貞觀中尚存。

context.afterSource: 後父晟，少以元氏宗室，拜開府。

manualTranslations.zh: 宣帝后陳氏，名月儀，自雲潁川人，大將軍山提之第八女也。
manualTranslations.literal: Empress Chen of Emperor Xuan, named Yueyi, said herself that she was from Yingchuan; she was the eighth daughter of Grand General Shanti.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Empress Chen of Emperor Xuan, named Yueyi, said she was from Yingchuan; she was the eighth daughter of Grand General Shanti.

manualTranslations.zh: 大象元年六月，以選入宮，拜為德妃。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month of Daxiang year one, she was selected into the palace and appointed Virtuous Consort.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Daxiang year one, she entered the palace by selection and was appointed Virtuous Consort.

manualTranslations.zh: 月餘日，立為天左皇后。
manualTranslations.literal: A little over a month later, she was established as Heavenly Left Empress.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A little over a month later, she was made Heavenly Left Empress.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年二月，改為天左大皇后。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month of year two, the title was changed to Heavenly Left Grand Empress.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year, her title was changed to Heavenly Left Grand Empress.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月，又詔以坤儀比德，土數惟五，四大皇后外，增置天中大皇后一人。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, an edict again said that the virtue matched the emblem of Earth and that the number of Earth was five, so outside the four grand empresses one Heavenly Central Grand Empress was added.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, another edict said that Earth's virtue corresponded to the number five, and so, in addition to the four grand empresses, one Heavenly Central Grand Empress was added.

manualTranslations.zh: 於是以後為天中大皇后。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon the Empress was made Heavenly Central Grand Empress.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thereupon she was made Heavenly Central Grand Empress.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝崩，後出俗為尼，改名華光。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Emperor died, the Empress left secular life to become a nun and changed her name to Huaguang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the Emperor died, she left lay life to become a nun and changed her name to Huaguang.

manualTranslations.zh: 後永徽初終。
manualTranslations.literal: Later, at the beginning of Yonghui, she died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: She later died at the beginning of the Yonghui era.

manualTranslations.zh: 父山提，本爾硃兆之隸。
manualTranslations.literal: Her father Shanti had originally been a retainer of Erzhu Zhao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Her father Shanti had originally been a retainer of Erzhu Zhao.

manualTranslations.zh: 仕齊，位特進、開府、東兗州刺史、謝陽王。
manualTranslations.literal: Serving Qi, his rank was Specially Advanced, Opening Office, Inspector of East Yanzhou, and Prince of Xieyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Qi service, he held the posts of Specially Advanced, Opening Office, Inspector of East Yanzhou, and Prince of Xieyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 武帝平齊，拜大將軍，封淅陽公。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Wu pacified Qi, he was appointed Grand General and enfeoffed Duke of Xiyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Emperor Wu pacified Qi, Shanti was appointed Grand General and enfeoffed Duke of Xiyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 大象元年，以後父超授上柱國，進鄅國公，除大宗伯。
manualTranslations.literal: In Daxiang year one, because he was the Empress's father, he was specially granted Supreme Pillar of State, advanced to Duke of Yu, and appointed Grand Minister of Rites.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Daxiang year one, as the Empress's father, he was specially granted Supreme Pillar of State, promoted to Duke of Yu, and appointed Grand Minister of Rites.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣帝皇后元氏，名樂尚，河南洛陽人，開府晟之第二女也。
manualTranslations.literal: Empress Yuan of Emperor Xuan, named Leshang, was from Luoyang in Henan and was the second daughter of Opening Office Sheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Empress Yuan of Emperor Xuan, named Leshang, was from Luoyang in Henan and was the second daughter of Sheng, an Opening Office official.

manualTranslations.zh: 年十五，被選入宮，拜貴妃。
manualTranslations.literal: At fifteen she was selected into the palace and appointed Noble Consort.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At fifteen she was selected into the palace and appointed Noble Consort.

manualTranslations.zh: 大象元年七月，立為天右皇后。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh month of Daxiang year one, she was established as Heavenly Right Empress.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Daxiang year one, she was made Heavenly Right Empress.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年二月，改為天右大皇后。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month of year two, the title was changed to Heavenly Right Grand Empress.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year, her title was changed to Heavenly Right Grand Empress.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝崩，後出家為尼，改名華勝。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Emperor died, the Empress left home to become a nun and changed her name to Huasheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the Emperor died, she became a nun and changed her name to Huasheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，後與陳皇后同時被選入宮，俱拜為妃；
manualTranslations.literal: At first, the Empress and Empress Chen were selected into the palace at the same time and were both appointed consorts;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Initially, she and Empress Chen were selected into the palace at the same time and both appointed consorts;

manualTranslations.zh: 及升後，又同日受冊。
manualTranslations.literal: when they were promoted as empresses, they again received their investitures on the same day.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: when they were promoted to empresses, they again received investiture on the same day.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝寵遇二後，禮數均等，年齒復同，特相親愛。
manualTranslations.literal: The Emperor favored and treated the two empresses with equal rites; their ages were also the same, and they were especially affectionate toward each other.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Emperor favored the two empresses equally and gave them the same ceremonial treatment. They were also the same age and were especially close to one another.

manualTranslations.zh: 及為尼後，李、硃及尉遲後並相繼殞歿，而二後貞觀中尚存。
manualTranslations.literal: After they became nuns, Empresses Li, Zhu, and Yuchi all died one after another, but the two empresses were still alive during Zhenguan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After they became nuns, Empresses Li, Zhu, and Yuchi died one after another, but these two empresses were still alive during the Zhenguan era.

sourceRange.text: 武皇后李氏，名娥姿，楚人也。于謹平江陵，後家被籍沒。至長安，周文以後賜武帝。後得親幸，生宣帝。宣政元年七月，尊為帝太后。大象元年二月，改為天元帝太后。七月，又尊為天皇太后。二年二月，尊為天元聖皇太后。宣帝崩，靜帝尊為大帝太后。隋開皇元年三月，出俗為尼，改名常悲。八年，殂，以尼禮葬于京城南。

context.beforeSource: 隋文詔有司備禮，祔葬後於孝陵。
context.afterSource: 宣皇后楊氏名麗華，隋文帝之長女也。
context.beforeLocal: 隋文詔有司備禮，祔葬後於孝陵。
context.afterLocal: 宣皇后楊氏名麗華，隋文帝之長女也。

manualTranslations.zh: 武皇后李氏，名娥姿，楚人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Empress Li of Emperor Wu, named Ezi, was a woman of Chu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Empress Li of Emperor Wu, named Ezi, was from Chu.

manualTranslations.zh: 于謹平江陵，後家被籍沒。
manualTranslations.literal: When Yu Jin pacified Jiangling, the Empress's household was confiscated.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Yu Jin pacified Jiangling, her household was confiscated.

manualTranslations.zh: 至長安，周文以後賜武帝。
manualTranslations.literal: After she reached Chang'an, Emperor Wen of Zhou gave the Empress to Emperor Wu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When she reached Chang'an, Emperor Wen of Zhou gave her to Emperor Wu.

manualTranslations.zh: 後得親幸，生宣帝。
manualTranslations.literal: The Empress received intimate favor and gave birth to Emperor Xuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: She received his favor and bore Emperor Xuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣政元年七月，尊為帝太后。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh month of Xuanzheng year one, she was honored as Emperor's Empress Dowager.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Xuanzheng year one, she was honored as Imperial Empress Dowager.

manualTranslations.zh: 大象元年二月，改為天元帝太后。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month of Daxiang year one, the title was changed to Tianyuan Emperor Empress Dowager.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month of Daxiang year one, her title was changed to Tianyuan Imperial Empress Dowager.

manualTranslations.zh: 七月，又尊為天皇太后。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh month, she was again honored as Heavenly Empress Dowager.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, she was further honored as Heavenly Empress Dowager.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年二月，尊為天元聖皇太后。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month of year two, she was honored as Tianyuan Sage Imperial Empress Dowager.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year, she was honored as Tianyuan Sage Imperial Empress Dowager.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣帝崩，靜帝尊為大帝太后。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xuan died, Emperor Jing honored her as Great Emperor Empress Dowager.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Emperor Xuan died, Emperor Jing honored her as Great Imperial Empress Dowager.

manualTranslations.zh: 隋開皇元年三月，出俗為尼，改名常悲。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month of Sui Kaihuang year one, she left secular life to become a nun and changed her name to Changbei.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month of Sui Kaihuang year one, she left lay life to become a nun and changed her name to Changbei.

manualTranslations.zh: 八年，殂，以尼禮葬于京城南。
manualTranslations.literal: In year eight, she died and was buried south of the capital with the rites of a nun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year eight, she died and was buried south of the capital with a nun's rites.

sourceRange.text: 閏六月，並為皇后。

localRange.text: 宣政元年閏六月，並為皇后。

context.beforeSource: 帝在東宮，武帝為帝納後為皇太子妃。
context.afterSource: 帝后自稱天元皇帝，號後為天元皇后。

sourceRange.text: 孝閔皇后元氏，名胡摩，魏文帝第五女也。初封晉安公主。帝之為略陽公也，尚焉。及踐阼，立為王后；帝被廢，後出俗為尼。建德初，武帝誅晉公護，上帝尊號，以後為孝閔皇后，居崇義宮。隋革命，後出居裏第。大業十二年，殂。

context.beforeSource: 五月，葬永固陵。
context.afterSource: 明敬皇后獨孤氏，太保、衛公信之長女也。
context.beforeLocal: 五月，葬永固陵。
context.afterLocal: 明敬皇后獨孤氏，太保、衛公信之長女也。

manualTranslations.zh: 孝閔皇后元氏，名胡摩，魏文帝第五女也。
manualTranslations.literal: Empress Yuan of Xiaomin, named Humo, was the fifth daughter of Emperor Wen of Wei.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Empress Yuan of Xiaomin, named Humo, was the fifth daughter of Emperor Wen of Wei.

manualTranslations.zh: 初封晉安公主。
manualTranslations.literal: She was first enfeoffed Princess of Jin'an.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: She was first enfeoffed as Princess of Jin'an.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝之為略陽公也，尚焉。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Emperor was Duke of Lüeyang, he married her.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Emperor was Duke of Lüeyang, he married her.

manualTranslations.zh: 及踐阼，立為王后；
manualTranslations.literal: When he ascended the throne, she was established as queen;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he ascended the throne, she was made queen;

manualTranslations.zh: 帝被廢，後出俗為尼。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Emperor was deposed, the Empress left secular life to become a nun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the Emperor was deposed, she left lay life to become a nun.

manualTranslations.zh: 建德初，武帝誅晉公護，上帝尊號，以後為孝閔皇后，居崇義宮。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Jiande, Emperor Wu executed Hu, Duke of Jin, presented the Emperor with an honored title, made the Empress Xiaomin Empress, and had her dwell in Chongyi Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jiande, Emperor Wu executed Hu, Duke of Jin, gave the deposed Emperor an honored title, made her Xiaomin Empress, and had her reside in Chongyi Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 隋革命，後出居裏第。
manualTranslations.literal: When Sui changed the mandate, the Empress left and lived in a private residence.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Sui took the mandate, she left the palace and lived in a private residence.

manualTranslations.zh: 大業十二年，殂。
manualTranslations.literal: In Daye year twelve, she died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: She died in Daye year twelve.

sourceRange.text: 魏，薨。

localRange.text: 魏大統十七年，薨。

context.beforeSource: 生孝閔帝。
context.afterSource: 恭帝三年十二月，合葬成陵。
context.beforeLocal: 生孝閔帝。
context.afterLocal: 恭帝三年十二月，合葬成陵。

sourceRange.text: 孝昭皇后元氏，開府元蠻女也。初為常山王妃，天保末，賜姓步六孤。孝昭即位，立為皇后。帝崩，從梓宮之鄴。始度汾橋，武成聞後有奇藥，追索之不得，使閹人就車頓辱。降居順成宮。武成既殺樂陵王，元被閟隔，不得與家相知。宮闈內忽有飛語，帝令檢推，得後父兄書信，元蠻由是坐免官。後以齊亡，入周氏宮中。隋文帝作相，放還山東。

context.beforeSource: 薛嬪當時有娠，過產亦從戮。
context.afterSource: 武成皇后胡氏，安定胡延之女。
context.beforeLocal: 薛嬪當時有娠，過產亦從戮。
context.afterLocal: 武成皇后胡氏，安定胡延之女。

manualTranslations.zh: 孝昭皇后元氏，開府元蠻女也。
manualTranslations.literal: Empress Yuan of Xiaozhao was the daughter of Yuan Man, Opening Office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Empress Yuan of Xiaozhao was the daughter of Yuan Man, an Opening Office official.

manualTranslations.zh: 初為常山王妃，天保末，賜姓步六孤。
manualTranslations.literal: At first she was Princess Consort of the Prince of Changshan; at the end of Tianbao, she was bestowed the surname Buliugu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: She was first consort to the Prince of Changshan. At the end of Tianbao, she was granted the surname Buliugu.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝昭即位，立為皇后。
manualTranslations.literal: When Xiaozhao ascended the throne, she was established as empress.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Xiaozhao took the throne, she was made empress.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝崩，從梓宮之鄴。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Emperor died, she followed the coffin to Ye.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the Emperor died, she followed his coffin to Ye.

manualTranslations.zh: 始度汾橋，武成聞後有奇藥，追索之不得，使閹人就車頓辱。
manualTranslations.literal: As they first crossed the Fen bridge, Wucheng heard that the Empress had a wondrous medicine; when he pursued and sought it but did not obtain it, he sent eunuchs to the carriage to humiliate her severely.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When they first crossed the Fen bridge, Wucheng heard that she possessed a wondrous medicine. He sent after it, but when it could not be obtained, he had eunuchs go to her carriage and humiliate her.

manualTranslations.zh: 降居順成宮。
manualTranslations.literal: She was demoted to live in Shuncheng Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: She was demoted and made to live in Shuncheng Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 武成既殺樂陵王，元被閟隔，不得與家相知。
manualTranslations.literal: After Wucheng killed the Prince of Leling, Yuan was shut away and separated, unable to communicate with her family.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Wucheng killed the Prince of Leling, Empress Yuan was shut away and cut off from contact with her family.

manualTranslations.zh: 宮闈內忽有飛語，帝令檢推，得後父兄書信，元蠻由是坐免官。
manualTranslations.literal: Suddenly rumors flew within the palace; the Emperor ordered an investigation, and letters from the Empress's father and brothers were found, so Yuan Man was implicated and dismissed from office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Rumors suddenly spread inside the palace. The Emperor ordered an investigation, which uncovered letters from the Empress's father and brothers, and Yuan Man was dismissed from office because of it.

manualTranslations.zh: 後以齊亡，入周氏宮中。
manualTranslations.literal: Later, when Qi fell, she entered the palace of the Zhou house.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later, when Qi fell, she entered the Zhou palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 隋文帝作相，放還山東。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Wen of Sui became chancellor, she was released and returned to Shandong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen of Sui became chancellor, she was released and sent back to Shandong.

sourceRange.text: 隋開皇十五年，殂。靜帝司馬皇后名令姬，柱國、滎陽公消難之女也。大象元年二月，宣帝傳位於帝，七月為帝納後為皇后。二年九月，隋文帝以後父奔陳，廢後為庶人。後嫁為隋司州刺史李丹妻，貞觀初猶存。

localRange.text: 隋開皇十五年，殂。

context.beforeSource: 帝崩，後出俗為尼，改名華道。
context.afterSource: 隋文獻皇后獨孤氏，諱伽羅，河南洛陽人，周大司馬、衛公信之女也。
context.beforeLocal: 帝崩，後出俗為尼，改名華道。
context.afterLocal: 隋文獻皇后獨孤氏，諱伽羅，河南洛陽人，周大司馬、衛公信之女也。

manualTranslations.zh: 隋開皇十五年，殂。
manualTranslations.literal: In Sui Kaihuang year fifteen, she died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: She died in Sui Kaihuang year fifteen.

manualTranslations.zh: 靜帝司馬皇后名令姬，柱國、滎陽公消難之女也。
manualTranslations.literal: Empress Sima of Emperor Jing, named Lingji, was the daughter of Xiaonan, Pillar of State and Duke of Yingyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Empress Sima of Emperor Jing, named Lingji, was the daughter of Sima Xiaonan, Pillar of State and Duke of Yingyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 大象元年二月，宣帝傳位於帝，七月為帝納後為皇后。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month of Daxiang year one, Emperor Xuan transmitted the throne to the Emperor; in the seventh month he took the Empress for the Emperor as empress.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month of Daxiang year one, Emperor Xuan passed the throne to Emperor Jing; in the seventh month he took her as empress for him.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年九月，隋文帝以後父奔陳，廢後為庶人。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month of year two, because the Empress's father had fled to Chen, Emperor Wen of Sui deposed the Empress to commoner status.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the second year, because her father had fled to Chen, Emperor Wen of Sui deposed her to commoner status.

manualTranslations.zh: 後嫁為隋司州刺史李丹妻，貞觀初猶存。
manualTranslations.literal: Later she married Li Dan, Inspector of Sizhou under Sui, as his wife, and she was still alive at the beginning of Zhenguan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later she married Li Dan, Sui Inspector of Sizhou, and she was still alive at the beginning of Zhenguan.

sourceRange.text: 隋，殂，年三十二。

localRange.text: 隋開皇二年，殂，年三十二。

sourceRange.text: 初，後以高熲是父之家客，甚見親禮。至是，聞熲謂己為一婦人，因以銜恨。又以熲夫人死，其妾生男，益不善之，漸加譖毀。帝亦每事唯後言是用。後見諸王及朝士有妾孕者，必勸帝斥之。時皇太子多內寵，妃元氏暴薨，後意太子愛妾雲氏害之。由是諷帝，黜高熲，竟廢太子立晉王廣，皆後之謀也。仁壽二年八月甲子，日暈四重。

localRange.text: 仁壽二年八月甲子，日暈四重。

context.beforeSource: 後自此意頗折。
context.afterSource: 己巳。
context.beforeLocal: 後自此意頗折。
context.afterLocal: 己巳。

manualTranslations.zh: 初，後以高熲是父之家客，甚見親禮。
manualTranslations.literal: At first, because Gao Jiong had been a retainer of her father's household, the Empress treated him with great intimacy and courtesy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At first, because Gao Jiong had been a retainer in her father's household, the Empress treated him with great familiarity and respect.

manualTranslations.zh: 至是，聞熲謂己為一婦人，因以銜恨。
manualTranslations.literal: At this point, when she heard that Jiong had called her a woman, she therefore harbored resentment.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At this point, when she heard that Jiong had called her merely a woman, she bore a grudge.

manualTranslations.zh: 又以熲夫人死，其妾生男，益不善之，漸加譖毀。
manualTranslations.literal: Also, because Jiong's wife had died and his concubine bore a son, she disliked him even more and gradually slandered and ruined him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Moreover, after Jiong's wife died and a concubine bore him a son, she disliked him all the more and gradually slandered him.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝亦每事唯後言是用。
manualTranslations.literal: The Emperor too used only the Empress's words in every matter.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Emperor followed the Empress's words in every matter.

manualTranslations.zh: 後見諸王及朝士有妾孕者，必勸帝斥之。
manualTranslations.literal: Whenever the Empress saw princes or court gentlemen whose concubines were pregnant, she always urged the Emperor to cast them out.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Whenever she saw princes or court officials with pregnant concubines, she urged the Emperor to dismiss them.

manualTranslations.zh: 時皇太子多內寵，妃元氏暴薨，後意太子愛妾雲氏害之。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time the Crown Prince had many inner favorites; when Consort Yuan suddenly died, the Empress thought that the Crown Prince's beloved concubine Lady Yun had harmed her.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time the Crown Prince had many favorites in his inner quarters. When Consort Yuan suddenly died, the Empress believed that his favored concubine Lady Yun had killed her.

manualTranslations.zh: 由是諷帝，黜高熲，竟廢太子立晉王廣，皆後之謀也。
manualTranslations.literal: Because of this she hinted to the Emperor to demote Gao Jiong, and in the end the Crown Prince was deposed and Guang, Prince of Jin, was established; all of this was the Empress's scheme.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because of this she prompted the Emperor to dismiss Gao Jiong, and in the end the Crown Prince was deposed and Guang, Prince of Jin, was installed. All of it was the Empress's scheme.

manualTranslations.zh: 仁壽二年八月甲子，日暈四重。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month of Renshou year two, on jiazi, the sun had four halos.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the eighth month of Renshou year two, the sun had four halos.

sourceRange.text: 大唐，破突厥，皆以禮致之。

localRange.text: 大唐貞觀四年，破突厥，皆以禮致之。

sourceRange.text: 上党太妃韓氏馮翊太妃鄭氏高陽太妃游氏馮娘李娘文襄敬皇后元氏琅邪公主文宣皇后李氏段昭儀王嬪薛嬪孝昭皇后元氏武成皇后胡氏弘德李夫人後主皇后斛律氏後主皇后胡氏後主皇后穆氏馮淑妃周文皇后元氏文宣皇后叱奴氏孝閔皇后元氏明敬皇后獨孤氏武成皇后阿史那氏武皇后李氏宣皇后楊氏宣皇后朱氏宣皇后陳氏宣皇后元氏宣皇后尉遲氏靜皇后司馬氏隋文獻皇后獨孤氏宣華夫人陳氏容華夫人蔡氏湣皇后蕭氏齊武明皇后婁氏，諱昭君，贈司徒內幹之女也。

sourceRange.text: 子毗，字休弼。武帝之在籓邸，少親之，及即位，出必陪乘，入於臥內。及帝與齊神武有隙，時議者各有異同。或勸天子入夷，或言與齊神武決戰，或云奔梁。唯毗數人以關中帝王桑梓，殷勤叩頭請西入。策功論賞，毗與領軍斛斯椿等十三人為首，封魏郡王。時王者邑止一千戶，唯毗邑一千五百。齊神武宣告關東云：「將天子西入，事起元毗，雖百赦不在原限。」薨，諡曰景。子綽。

context.beforeSource: 壽興弟益生，少亡。
context.afterSource: 忠弟德，封河間公，卒于鎮南將軍，贈曹州刺史。

manualTranslations.zh: 子毗，字休弼。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Pi was styled Xiubi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Pi was styled Xiubi.

manualTranslations.zh: 武帝之在籓邸，少親之，及即位，出必陪乘，入於臥內。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Wu was still in his princely residence, he was close to Pi from youth; after he took the throne, Pi always rode with him when he went out and entered his inner chambers when he came in.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu was still in his princely residence, he was close to Pi from youth; after he took the throne, Pi always rode with him when he went out and entered his inner chambers when he came in.

manualTranslations.zh: 及帝與齊神武有隙，時議者各有異同。
manualTranslations.literal: When the emperor became estranged from Shenwu of Qi, the advisers of the time all had different views.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the emperor became estranged from Shenwu of Qi, the advisers of the time all had different views.

manualTranslations.zh: 或勸天子入夷，或言與齊神武決戰，或云奔梁。
manualTranslations.literal: Some urged the Son of Heaven to go among the non-Chinese peoples, some said to fight a decisive battle with Shenwu of Qi, and some said to flee to Liang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Some urged the Son of Heaven to go among the non-Chinese peoples, some said to fight a decisive battle with Shenwu of Qi, and some said to flee to Liang.

manualTranslations.zh: 唯毗數人以關中帝王桑梓，殷勤叩頭請西入。
manualTranslations.literal: Only Pi and a few others argued that Guanzhong was the ancestral home of emperors and kings, and they earnestly bowed to the ground and asked him to enter the west.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Only Pi and a few others argued that Guanzhong was the ancestral home of emperors and kings, and they earnestly bowed to the ground and asked him to enter the west.

manualTranslations.zh: 策功論賞，毗與領軍斛斯椿等十三人為首，封魏郡王。
manualTranslations.literal: When merits were assessed and rewards discussed, Pi and the Commander Husi Chun and thirteen others were ranked first, and Pi was enfeoffed as Prince of Wei Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When merits were assessed and rewards discussed, Pi and the Commander Husi Chun and thirteen others were ranked first, and Pi was enfeoffed as Prince of Wei Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 時王者邑止一千戶，唯毗邑一千五百。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time, princely fiefs were limited to one thousand households, but only Pi's fief had fifteen hundred.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time, princely fiefs were limited to one thousand households, but only Pi's fief had fifteen hundred.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊神武宣告關東云：「將天子西入，事起元毗，雖百赦不在原限。」
manualTranslations.literal: Shenwu of Qi proclaimed throughout Guandong, "The affair of taking the Son of Heaven west began with Yuan Pi; even under a hundred amnesties he will not be within the scope of pardon."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shenwu of Qi proclaimed throughout Guandong, "The affair of taking the Son of Heaven west began with Yuan Pi; even under a hundred amnesties he will not be within the scope of pardon."

manualTranslations.zh: 薨，諡曰景。
manualTranslations.literal: He died and received the posthumous name Jing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died and received the posthumous name Jing.

manualTranslations.zh: 子綽。
manualTranslations.literal: His son was Chuo.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son was Chuo.

sourceRange.text: 良弟幹，善弓馬，以騎從明元于白登之東北，有雙鴟飛鳴於上，帝命左右射之，莫能中。鴟游飛稍高，幹以二箭下雙鴟。帝賜之御馬、弓矢、金帶一，以旌其能。軍中於是號幹為射鴟都將。從太武南巡，進爵新蔡公。文成即位，拜都官尚書。卒，諡曰昭。

context.beforeSource: 明元追錄儀功，封南陽王以紹儀後。
context.afterSource: 子禎，膽氣過人。
context.beforeLocal: 明元追錄儀功，封南陽王以紹儀後。
context.afterLocal: 子禎，膽氣過人。

manualTranslations.zh: 良弟幹，善弓馬，以騎從明元于白登之東北，有雙鴟飛鳴於上，帝命左右射之，莫能中。
manualTranslations.literal: Liang's younger brother Gan was skilled with bow and horse. As a cavalryman he accompanied Mingyuan northeast of Baideng, where two owls flew calling overhead; the emperor ordered his attendants to shoot them, but none could hit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liang's younger brother Gan was skilled with bow and horse. As a cavalryman he accompanied Mingyuan northeast of Baideng, where two owls flew calling overhead; the emperor ordered his attendants to shoot them, but none could hit.

manualTranslations.zh: 鴟游飛稍高，幹以二箭下雙鴟。
manualTranslations.literal: The owls wheeled higher, and Gan brought both owls down with two arrows.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The owls wheeled higher, and Gan brought both owls down with two arrows.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝賜之御馬、弓矢、金帶一，以旌其能。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor gave him an imperial horse, bow and arrows, and one gold belt to honor his skill.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor gave him an imperial horse, bow and arrows, and one gold belt to honor his skill.

manualTranslations.zh: 軍中於是號幹為射鴟都將。
manualTranslations.literal: The army thereafter called Gan the Commander Who Shot the Owls.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The army thereafter called Gan the Commander Who Shot the Owls.

manualTranslations.zh: 從太武南巡，進爵新蔡公。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed Taiwu on the southern tour and was advanced to Duke of Xincai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He followed Taiwu on the southern tour and was advanced to Duke of Xincai.

manualTranslations.zh: 文成即位，拜都官尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: When Wencheng took the throne, Gan was appointed Minister of the Bureau of Justice.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Wencheng took the throne, Gan was appointed Minister of the Bureau of Justice.

manualTranslations.zh: 卒，諡曰昭。
manualTranslations.literal: He died and received the posthumous name Zhao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died and received the posthumous name Zhao.

sourceRange.text: 子玄，字彥道，以節儉知名。孝壯時，為洛陽令。及節閔即位，玄上表乞葬莊帝，時議善之。後除尚書左丞。孝武帝即位，以孫騰為左僕射。騰即齊神武心膂，仗入省，玄依法舉劾，當時咸為玄懼。孝武重其強正，封臨淄縣子。及從入關，封陳郡王，位儀同三司，加開府。薨，諡曰平。

context.beforeSource: 納貨元叉，所以贈禮優越。
context.afterSource: 昭弟紹，字醜倫，少聰慧。
context.beforeLocal: 納貨元叉，所以贈禮優越。
context.afterLocal: 昭弟紹，字醜倫，少聰慧。

manualTranslations.zh: 子玄，字彥道，以節儉知名。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Xuan, styled Yandao, was known for frugality.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Xuan, styled Yandao, was known for frugality.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝壯時，為洛陽令。
manualTranslations.literal: In Xiaozhuang's time, he was magistrate of Luoyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Xiaozhuang's time, he was magistrate of Luoyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 及節閔即位，玄上表乞葬莊帝，時議善之。
manualTranslations.literal: When Jiemin took the throne, Xuan submitted a memorial asking to bury Emperor Zhuang, and opinion at the time approved it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Jiemin took the throne, Xuan submitted a memorial asking to bury Emperor Zhuang, and opinion at the time approved it.

manualTranslations.zh: 後除尚書左丞。
manualTranslations.literal: He was later appointed Left Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was later appointed Left Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝武帝即位，以孫騰為左僕射。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xiaowu took the throne, Sun Teng was made Left Vice Director.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu took the throne, Sun Teng was made Left Vice Director.

manualTranslations.zh: 騰即齊神武心膂，仗入省，玄依法舉劾，當時咸為玄懼。
manualTranslations.literal: Teng was the trusted intimate of Shenwu of Qi and entered the department with armed attendants; Xuan impeached him according to law, and everyone at the time feared for Xuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Teng was the trusted intimate of Shenwu of Qi and entered the department with armed attendants; Xuan impeached him according to law, and everyone at the time feared for Xuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝武重其強正，封臨淄縣子。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiaowu valued his firmness and rectitude and enfeoffed him as Viscount of Linzi County.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiaowu valued his firmness and rectitude and enfeoffed him as Viscount of Linzi County.

manualTranslations.zh: 及從入關，封陳郡王，位儀同三司，加開府。
manualTranslations.literal: When he followed the court into the passes, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Chen Commandery, held rank Equal to the Three Excellencies, and was additionally given an office establishment.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he followed the court into the passes, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Chen Commandery, held rank Equal to the Three Excellencies, and was additionally given an office establishment.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨，諡曰平。
manualTranslations.literal: He died and received the posthumous name Ping.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died and received the posthumous name Ping.

sourceRange.text: 子瑰，位柔玄鎮司馬。瑰子鷙，字孔雀，孝文末，以軍功賜爵晉陽男。武泰元年，爾硃榮至河陰，殺戮朝士，時鷙與榮共登高塚，俯而觀之。自此後，與榮合。永安初，封華山王。莊帝既殺爾硃榮，從子兆為亂。帝欲率諸軍親討，而鷙與兆陰通，乃勸帝曰：「黃河萬仞，寧可卒度？」帝遂自安。及兆入殿，鷙又約止衛兵。帝見逼，京邑破，皆由鷙之謀。孝靜初，入為大司馬，加侍中。鷙容貌魁壯，腰帶十圍，有武藝。木訥少言，性方厚，每息直省闥，雖暑月不解衣冠。曾于侍中高岳之席，咸陽王坦恃力使酒，眾皆下之。坦謂鷙曰：「孔雀老武官，何因得王？」鷙答曰：「斬反人元禧首，是以得之。」眾皆失色，鷙怡然如故。興和三年，薨，贈假黃鉞、尚書令、司徒公。

context.beforeSource: 卒。
context.afterSource: 子大器，襲爵。
context.beforeLocal: 卒。

manualTranslations.zh: 子瑰，位柔玄鎮司馬。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Gui served as marshal of Rouxuan Garrison.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Gui served as marshal of Rouxuan Garrison.

manualTranslations.zh: 瑰子鷙，字孔雀，孝文末，以軍功賜爵晉陽男。
manualTranslations.literal: Gui's son Zhi, styled Kongque, was granted the title Baron of Jinyang for military merit at the end of Xiaowen's reign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gui's son Zhi, styled Kongque, was granted the title Baron of Jinyang for military merit at the end of Xiaowen's reign.

manualTranslations.zh: 武泰元年，爾硃榮至河陰，殺戮朝士，時鷙與榮共登高塚，俯而觀之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Wutai, Erzhu Rong reached Heyin and massacred the court officials; at the time Zhi climbed a high mound with Rong and looked down on it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Wutai, Erzhu Rong reached Heyin and massacred the court officials; at the time Zhi climbed a high mound with Rong and looked down on it.

manualTranslations.zh: 自此後，與榮合。
manualTranslations.literal: After this, he joined with Rong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After this, he joined with Rong.

manualTranslations.zh: 永安初，封華山王。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Yong'an, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Huashan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yong'an, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Huashan.

manualTranslations.zh: 莊帝既殺爾硃榮，從子兆為亂。
manualTranslations.literal: After Emperor Zhuang killed Erzhu Rong, Rong's nephew Zhao rose in rebellion.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Emperor Zhuang killed Erzhu Rong, Rong's nephew Zhao rose in rebellion.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝欲率諸軍親討，而鷙與兆陰通，乃勸帝曰：「黃河萬仞，寧可卒度？」
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor wanted to lead the armies in person to punish him, but Zhi was secretly in contact with Zhao and advised the emperor, "The Yellow River is ten thousand fathoms deep; how could it be crossed all at once?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor wanted to lead the armies in person to punish him, but Zhi was secretly in contact with Zhao and advised the emperor, "The Yellow River is ten thousand fathoms deep; how could it be crossed all at once?"

manualTranslations.zh: 帝遂自安。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor therefore felt secure.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor therefore felt secure.

manualTranslations.zh: 及兆入殿，鷙又約止衛兵。
manualTranslations.literal: When Zhao entered the palace, Zhi again arranged to hold back the guards.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhao entered the palace, Zhi again arranged to hold back the guards.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝見逼，京邑破，皆由鷙之謀。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor was pressed and the capital was broken, all because of Zhi's plotting.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor was pressed and the capital was broken, all because of Zhi's plotting.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝靜初，入為大司馬，加侍中。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Xiaojing's reign, he entered court as Grand Marshal and was additionally made Palace Attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xiaojing's reign, he entered court as Grand Marshal and was additionally made Palace Attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 鷙容貌魁壯，腰帶十圍，有武藝。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhi was imposing in appearance, with a waist ten spans around, and was skilled in martial arts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhi was imposing in appearance, with a waist ten spans around, and was skilled in martial arts.

manualTranslations.zh: 木訥少言，性方厚，每息直省闥，雖暑月不解衣冠。
manualTranslations.literal: He was slow-spoken and said little, upright and generous by nature; whenever he rested while on duty at the palace gates, he did not remove his cap and robe even in the hot months.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was slow-spoken and said little, upright and generous by nature; whenever he rested while on duty at the palace gates, he did not remove his cap and robe even in the hot months.

manualTranslations.zh: 曾于侍中高岳之席，咸陽王坦恃力使酒，眾皆下之。
manualTranslations.literal: Once, at a banquet given by Palace Attendant Gao Yue, Prince Tan of Xianyang relied on his strength and behaved drunkenly, and everyone yielded to him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Once, at a banquet given by Palace Attendant Gao Yue, Prince Tan of Xianyang relied on his strength and behaved drunkenly, and everyone yielded to him.

manualTranslations.zh: 坦謂鷙曰：「孔雀老武官，何因得王？」
manualTranslations.literal: Tan said to Zhi, "Kongque, you are an old military officer. How did you become a prince?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tan said to Zhi, "Kongque, you are an old military officer. How did you become a prince?"

manualTranslations.zh: 鷙答曰：「斬反人元禧首，是以得之。」
manualTranslations.literal: Zhi replied, "I cut off the head of the rebel Yuan Xi; that is how I got it."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhi replied, "I cut off the head of the rebel Yuan Xi; that is how I got it."

manualTranslations.zh: 眾皆失色，鷙怡然如故。
manualTranslations.literal: Everyone turned pale, while Zhi remained perfectly calm.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Everyone turned pale, while Zhi remained perfectly calm.

manualTranslations.zh: 興和三年，薨，贈假黃鉞、尚書令、司徒公。
manualTranslations.literal: In Xinghe year 3, he died; he was posthumously granted the acting yellow axe and the offices of Director of the Masters of Writing and Minister of Works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Xinghe year 3, he died; he was posthumously granted the acting yellow axe and the offices of Director of the Masters of Writing and Minister of Works.

sourceRange.text: 子庫汗，為羽林中郎將。從北巡，有兔起乘輿前，命庫汗射之，應弦而斃。太武悅，賜一金兔，以旌其能。文成起景穆廟，賜爵陽豐侯。獻文即位，復造文成廟，拜殿中給事，進爵為公。庫汗明於斷決，每奉使察行州鎮，折獄以情，所曆皆稱之。秦州父老詣闕乞庫汗為刺史者，前後千餘人。朝廷許之，未及遣，遇病卒。子古辰襲。

context.beforeSource: 及為宰官尚書，頗以驕縱為失，坐事免，徙長社，為人所害。
context.afterSource: 窟咄，昭成崩後，苻洛以其年長，逼徙長安。

manualTranslations.zh: 子庫汗，為羽林中郎將。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Kuhan became General of the Gentlemen of the Feathered Forest.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Kuhan became General of the Gentlemen of the Feathered Forest.

manualTranslations.zh: 從北巡，有兔起乘輿前，命庫汗射之，應弦而斃。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed on a northern tour; when a hare sprang up before the imperial carriage, Kuhan was ordered to shoot it, and it fell dead at the twang of the bowstring.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He followed on a northern tour; when a hare sprang up before the imperial carriage, Kuhan was ordered to shoot it, and it fell dead at the twang of the bowstring.

manualTranslations.zh: 太武悅，賜一金兔，以旌其能。
manualTranslations.literal: Taiwu was pleased and gave him a gold hare to honor his skill.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Taiwu was pleased and gave him a gold hare to honor his skill.

manualTranslations.zh: 文成起景穆廟，賜爵陽豐侯。
manualTranslations.literal: When Wencheng built Jingmu's temple, Kuhan was granted the title Marquis of Yangfeng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Wencheng built Jingmu's temple, Kuhan was granted the title Marquis of Yangfeng.

manualTranslations.zh: 獻文即位，復造文成廟，拜殿中給事，進爵為公。
manualTranslations.literal: When Xianwen took the throne, he again built Wencheng's temple, was appointed Palace Service Gentleman, and was advanced to duke.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Xianwen took the throne, he again built Wencheng's temple, was appointed Palace Service Gentleman, and was advanced to duke.

manualTranslations.zh: 庫汗明於斷決，每奉使察行州鎮，折獄以情，所曆皆稱之。
manualTranslations.literal: Kuhan was clear in judgment; whenever he was sent to inspect provinces and garrisons, he decided cases according to the facts, and every place he passed praised him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Kuhan was clear in judgment; whenever he was sent to inspect provinces and garrisons, he decided cases according to the facts, and every place he passed praised him.

manualTranslations.zh: 秦州父老詣闕乞庫汗為刺史者，前後千餘人。
manualTranslations.literal: The elders of Qinzhou who went to court to request Kuhan as regional inspector numbered more than a thousand in all.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The elders of Qinzhou who went to court to request Kuhan as regional inspector numbered more than a thousand in all.

manualTranslations.zh: 朝廷許之，未及遣，遇病卒。
manualTranslations.literal: The court agreed, but before he could be sent, he fell ill and died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The court agreed, but before he could be sent, he fell ill and died.

manualTranslations.zh: 子古辰襲。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Guchen succeeded him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Guchen succeeded him.

sourceRange.text: 弟崇，太武詔令襲桓王爵。崇性沉厚。初，衛王死後，道武欲敦宗親之義，詔引諸王子弟入宴。常山王素等三十餘人咸謂與衛王相坐，疑懼。皆出逃遁，將奔蠕蠕，唯崇獨至。道武見之，甚悅，厚加禮賜，遂寵敬之，素等於是亦安。久之，拜并州刺史，有政績。從征蠕蠕，別督諸軍出大澤，越涿耶山，威懾漠北。薨，諡曰景王。

context.beforeSource: 竊視其懷有刃，執而賜死。
context.afterSource: 子建襲，降爵為公，位鎮北將軍，懷荒鎮大將。

manualTranslations.zh: 弟崇，太武詔令襲桓王爵。
manualTranslations.literal: His younger brother Chong was ordered by Taiwu to inherit the title Prince Huan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His younger brother Chong was ordered by Taiwu to inherit the title Prince Huan.

manualTranslations.zh: 崇性沉厚。
manualTranslations.literal: Chong was grave and generous by nature.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chong was grave and generous by nature.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，衛王死後，道武欲敦宗親之義，詔引諸王子弟入宴。
manualTranslations.literal: At first, after the Prince of Wei died, Daowu wanted to strengthen the duty of kinship among the imperial relatives and issued an edict inviting the princes' sons and younger brothers to a banquet.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At first, after the Prince of Wei died, Daowu wanted to strengthen the duty of kinship among the imperial relatives and issued an edict inviting the princes' sons and younger brothers to a banquet.

manualTranslations.zh: 常山王素等三十餘人咸謂與衛王相坐，疑懼。
manualTranslations.literal: Prince Su of Changshan and more than thirty others all thought they would be implicated with the Prince of Wei and were afraid.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Prince Su of Changshan and more than thirty others all thought they would be implicated with the Prince of Wei and were afraid.

manualTranslations.zh: 皆出逃遁，將奔蠕蠕，唯崇獨至。
manualTranslations.literal: They all fled and were about to run to Rouran; only Chong came alone.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They all fled and were about to run to Rouran; only Chong came alone.

manualTranslations.zh: 道武見之，甚悅，厚加禮賜，遂寵敬之，素等於是亦安。
manualTranslations.literal: Daowu saw him and was greatly pleased, treating and rewarding him generously; he then favored and respected him, and Su and the others were also reassured.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Daowu saw him and was greatly pleased, treating and rewarding him generously; he then favored and respected him, and Su and the others were also reassured.

manualTranslations.zh: 久之，拜并州刺史，有政績。
manualTranslations.literal: After some time, Chong was appointed regional inspector of Bingzhou and had a record of good administration.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After some time, Chong was appointed regional inspector of Bingzhou and had a record of good administration.

manualTranslations.zh: 從征蠕蠕，別督諸軍出大澤，越涿耶山，威懾漠北。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed the campaign against Rouran, separately commanding the armies out through the Great Marsh and across Zhuoye Mountain, awing the lands north of the desert.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He followed the campaign against Rouran, separately commanding the armies out through the Great Marsh and across Zhuoye Mountain, awing the lands north of the desert.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨，諡曰景王。
manualTranslations.literal: He died and received the posthumous title Prince Jing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died and received the posthumous title Prince Jing.

sourceRange.text: 子嶷，字子仲。孝武初，授兗州刺史。于時城人王奉伯等相扇謀逆，棄城出走。懸門發，斷嶷要而出。詔齊州刺史尉景、本州刺史蔡俊各部在州士往討之。嶷返復任。封濮陽縣伯。孝靜時，轉尚書令，攝選部。嶷雖居重任，隨時而已。薨于瀛州刺史，贈司徒公，諡曰靖懿。

context.beforeSource: 德子悝，潁川太守，卒于光州刺史，諡曰恭。
context.afterSource: 悝弟暉，字景襲。

manualTranslations.zh: 子嶷，字子仲。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Yi was styled Zizhong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Yi was styled Zizhong.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝武初，授兗州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Xiaowu's reign, he was appointed regional inspector of Yanzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xiaowu's reign, he was appointed regional inspector of Yanzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 于時城人王奉伯等相扇謀逆，棄城出走。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time, townsmen Wang Fengbo and others incited one another to rebellion and abandoned the city to flee.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time, townsmen Wang Fengbo and others incited one another to rebellion and abandoned the city to flee.

manualTranslations.zh: 懸門發，斷嶷要而出。
manualTranslations.literal: The portcullis fell, cutting Yi at the waist as he escaped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The portcullis fell, cutting Yi at the waist as he escaped.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔齊州刺史尉景、本州刺史蔡俊各部在州士往討之。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict ordered Qi Province inspector Wei Jing and the local province inspector Cai Jun each to lead troops from their provinces to punish them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Qi Province inspector Wei Jing and the local province inspector Cai Jun each to lead troops from their provinces to punish them.

manualTranslations.zh: 嶷返復任。
manualTranslations.literal: Yi returned and resumed his post.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yi returned and resumed his post.

manualTranslations.zh: 封濮陽縣伯。
manualTranslations.literal: He was enfeoffed as Count of Puyang County.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was enfeoffed as Count of Puyang County.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝靜時，轉尚書令，攝選部。
manualTranslations.literal: In Xiaojing's time, he was transferred to Director of the Masters of Writing and oversaw the personnel-selection department.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Xiaojing's time, he was transferred to Director of the Masters of Writing and oversaw the personnel-selection department.

manualTranslations.zh: 嶷雖居重任，隨時而已。
manualTranslations.literal: Though Yi held an important office, he merely followed the times.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Though Yi held an important office, he merely followed the times.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨于瀛州刺史，贈司徒公，諡曰靖懿。
manualTranslations.literal: He died while serving as regional inspector of Yingzhou; he was posthumously granted the title Minister of Works and received the posthumous name Jingyi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died while serving as regional inspector of Yingzhou; he was posthumously granted the title Minister of Works and received the posthumous name Jingyi.

manualTranslations.zh: 子侖，太武時襲父爵，以功除統萬鎮將。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Lun inherited his father's title in Taiwu's time and, for merit, was appointed commander of Tongwan Garrison.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Lun inherited his father's title in Taiwu's time and, for merit, was appointed commander of Tongwan Garrison.

manualTranslations.zh: 後從永昌王仁南征，別出汝陰。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he followed Prince Ren of Yongchang on a southern campaign and separately advanced from Ruyin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he followed Prince Ren of Yongchang on a southern campaign and separately advanced from Ruyin.

manualTranslations.zh: 濟淮，宋將劉康祖屯于慰武亭以邀軍路，師人患之。
manualTranslations.literal: After crossing the Huai, the Song general Liu Kangzu garrisoned Weiwu Pavilion to block the army's route, and the troops were troubled by it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After crossing the Huai, the Song general Liu Kangzu garrisoned Weiwu Pavilion to block the army's route, and the troops were troubled by it.

manualTranslations.zh: 侖曰：「今大風既勁，若令推草車，方軌並進，乘風縱煙火，以精兵自後乘之，破之必矣。」
manualTranslations.literal: Lun said, "Now the great wind is already strong. If we have them push carts of grass forward wheel to wheel, release smoke and fire with the wind, and send elite troops to strike from behind, we will certainly break him."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lun said, "Now the great wind is already strong. If we have them push carts of grass forward wheel to wheel, release smoke and fire with the wind, and send elite troops to strike from behind, we will certainly break him."

manualTranslations.zh: 從之，斬康祖，傳首行宮。
manualTranslations.literal: They followed this plan, beheaded Kangzu, and sent his head to the traveling palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They followed this plan, beheaded Kangzu, and sent his head to the traveling palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 文成即位，除秦州刺史，進爵隴西公。
manualTranslations.literal: When Wencheng took the throne, Lun was appointed regional inspector of Qinzhou and advanced to Duke of Longxi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Wencheng took the throne, Lun was appointed regional inspector of Qinzhou and advanced to Duke of Longxi.

manualTranslations.zh: 卒，諡曰定公。
manualTranslations.literal: He died and received the posthumous title Duke Ding.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died and received the posthumous title Duke Ding.

manualTranslations.zh: 子琛襲爵。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Chen inherited the title.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Chen inherited the title.

sourceRange.text: 太武皇帝十一男：賀皇后生景穆帝；越椒房生晉王伏羅；舒椒房生東平王翰；弗椒房生臨淮王譚；伏椒房生廣陽王建；閭左昭儀生吳王餘；其小兒、貓兒、真、彪頭、龍頭並闕母氏，皆早薨，無傳。晉王伏羅，真君三年封，加車騎大將軍。後督高平、涼州諸軍討吐谷渾慕利延。軍至樂都，謂諸將曰：「若從正道，恐軍聲先振，必當遠遁。潛軍出其非意，此鄧艾禽蜀之計也。」諸將咸難之。伏羅曰：「夫將軍制勝，萬里擇利，專之可也。」遂間道行。至大母橋，慕利延眾驚，奔白蘭。慕利延兄子拾寅走河西，降其一萬餘落。八年，薨，無子，國除。東平王翰，真君三年封秦王，拜侍中、中軍大將軍，參典都曹事。忠貞雅正，百僚憚之。太傅高元以翰年少，作《諸侯箴》以遺之，翰覽之大悅。後鎮枹罕，羌戎敬服。改封東平王。太武崩，諸大臣等議欲立翰，而中常侍宗愛與翰不協，矯太后令立南安王餘，遂殺翰。子道符襲爵，拜長安鎮都大將。皇興元年，謀反，司馬段太陽斬之，傅首京師。臨淮王譚，真君三年封燕王，拜侍中，參都曹事。後改封臨淮王。薨，諡宣王。

context.beforeSource: 後事發，賜死，國除。
context.afterSource: 子提襲，為梁州刺史。
