manualTranslations.zh: 太武皇帝十一男：賀皇后生景穆帝；
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Taiwu had eleven sons: Empress He bore Emperor Jingmu;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Taiwu had eleven sons: Empress He bore Emperor Jingmu;

manualTranslations.zh: 越椒房生晉王伏羅；
manualTranslations.literal: Lady Yue bore Fuluo, Prince of Jin;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lady Yue bore Fuluo, Prince of Jin;

manualTranslations.zh: 舒椒房生東平王翰；
manualTranslations.literal: Lady Shu bore Han, Prince of Dongping;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lady Shu bore Han, Prince of Dongping;

manualTranslations.zh: 弗椒房生臨淮王譚；
manualTranslations.literal: Lady Fu bore Tan, Prince of Linhuai;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lady Fu bore Tan, Prince of Linhuai;

manualTranslations.zh: 伏椒房生廣陽王建；
manualTranslations.literal: Lady Fu bore Jian, Prince of Guangyang;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lady Fu bore Jian, Prince of Guangyang;

manualTranslations.zh: 閭左昭儀生吳王餘；
manualTranslations.literal: Lady Lu, Zhaoyi of the Left, bore Yu, Prince of Wu;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lady Lu, Zhaoyi of the Left, bore Yu, Prince of Wu;

manualTranslations.zh: 其小兒、貓兒、真、彪頭、龍頭並闕母氏，皆早薨，無傳。
manualTranslations.literal: As for Xiao'er, Mao'er, Zhen, Biaotou, and Longtou, their mothers are all unrecorded; they all died young and have no biographies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As for Xiao'er, Mao'er, Zhen, Biaotou, and Longtou, their mothers are all unrecorded; they all died young and have no biographies.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉王伏羅，真君三年封，加車騎大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Fuluo, Prince of Jin, was enfeoffed in the third year of Zhenjun and additionally made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fuluo, Prince of Jin, was enfeoffed in the third year of Zhenjun and additionally made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry.

manualTranslations.zh: 後督高平、涼州諸軍討吐谷渾慕利延。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he commanded the armies of Gaoping and Liangzhou to attack Tuyuhun Muliyan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he commanded the armies of Gaoping and Liangzhou to attack Tuyuhun Muliyan.

manualTranslations.zh: 軍至樂都，謂諸將曰：「若從正道，恐軍聲先振，必當遠遁。
manualTranslations.literal: When the army reached Ledu, he told the generals, "If we follow the main road, I fear news of the army will spread first and he will surely flee far away.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the army reached Ledu, he told the generals, "If we follow the main road, I fear news of the army will spread first and he will surely flee far away.

manualTranslations.zh: 潛軍出其非意，此鄧艾禽蜀之計也。」
manualTranslations.literal: To move the army in secret and emerge where he does not expect it is the strategy by which Deng Ai captured Shu."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: To move the army in secret and emerge where he does not expect it is the strategy by which Deng Ai captured Shu."

manualTranslations.zh: 諸將咸難之。
manualTranslations.literal: The generals all found this difficult.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The generals all found this difficult.

manualTranslations.zh: 伏羅曰：「夫將軍制勝，萬里擇利，專之可也。」
manualTranslations.literal: Fuluo said, "A general wins victory by choosing advantage over ten thousand li; he may decide such things on his own."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fuluo said, "A general wins victory by choosing advantage over ten thousand li; he may decide such things on his own."

manualTranslations.zh: 遂間道行。
manualTranslations.literal: He then went by a hidden route.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He then went by a hidden route.

manualTranslations.zh: 至大母橋，慕利延眾驚，奔白蘭。
manualTranslations.literal: When he reached Damu Bridge, Muliyan's forces were startled and fled to Bailan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he reached Damu Bridge, Muliyan's forces were startled and fled to Bailan.

manualTranslations.zh: 慕利延兄子拾寅走河西，降其一萬餘落。
manualTranslations.literal: Muliyan's elder brother's son Shiyin fled to Hexi, and more than ten thousand of his settlements surrendered.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Muliyan's elder brother's son Shiyin fled to Hexi, and more than ten thousand of his settlements surrendered.

manualTranslations.zh: 八年，薨，無子，國除。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth year, Fuluo died; he had no sons, and the fief was abolished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, Fuluo died; he had no sons, and the fief was abolished.

manualTranslations.zh: 東平王翰，真君三年封秦王，拜侍中、中軍大將軍，參典都曹事。
manualTranslations.literal: Han, Prince of Dongping, was enfeoffed as Prince of Qin in the third year of Zhenjun and appointed Palace Attendant and Grand General of the Central Army, participating in the administration of the metropolitan offices.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Han, Prince of Dongping, was enfeoffed as Prince of Qin in the third year of Zhenjun and appointed Palace Attendant and Grand General of the Central Army, participating in the administration of the metropolitan offices.

manualTranslations.zh: 忠貞雅正，百僚憚之。
manualTranslations.literal: He was loyal, steadfast, refined, and upright, and the officials all stood in awe of him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was loyal, steadfast, refined, and upright, and the officials all stood in awe of him.

manualTranslations.zh: 太傅高元以翰年少，作《諸侯箴》以遺之，翰覽之大悅。
manualTranslations.literal: Because Han was young, Grand Tutor Gao Yuan composed Admonitions for the Feudal Lords and presented it to him; when Han read it, he was greatly pleased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because Han was young, Grand Tutor Gao Yuan composed Admonitions for the Feudal Lords and presented it to him; when Han read it, he was greatly pleased.

manualTranslations.zh: 後鎮枹罕，羌戎敬服。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he garrisoned Fuhan, and the Qiang and Rong respected and submitted to him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he garrisoned Fuhan, and the Qiang and Rong respected and submitted to him.

manualTranslations.zh: 改封東平王。
manualTranslations.literal: His title was changed to Prince of Dongping.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His title was changed to Prince of Dongping.

manualTranslations.zh: 太武崩，諸大臣等議欲立翰，而中常侍宗愛與翰不協，矯太后令立南安王餘，遂殺翰。
manualTranslations.literal: When Taiwu died, the great ministers discussed installing Han, but the Palace Attendant Zong Ai was at odds with Han, falsely issued an order from the empress dowager to install Yu, Prince of Nan'an, and then killed Han.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Taiwu died, the great ministers discussed installing Han, but the Palace Attendant Zong Ai was at odds with Han, falsely issued an order from the empress dowager to install Yu, Prince of Nan'an, and then killed Han.

manualTranslations.zh: 子道符襲爵，拜長安鎮都大將。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Daofu inherited the title and was appointed chief commander of Chang'an Garrison.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Daofu inherited the title and was appointed chief commander of Chang'an Garrison.

manualTranslations.zh: 皇興元年，謀反，司馬段太陽斬之，傅首京師。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Huangxing, he plotted rebellion, and Marshal Duan Taiyang beheaded him and sent his head to the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Huangxing, he plotted rebellion, and Marshal Duan Taiyang beheaded him and sent his head to the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 臨淮王譚，真君三年封燕王，拜侍中，參都曹事。
manualTranslations.literal: Tan, Prince of Linhuai, was enfeoffed as Prince of Yan in the third year of Zhenjun, appointed Palace Attendant, and participated in the metropolitan offices.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tan, Prince of Linhuai, was enfeoffed as Prince of Yan in the third year of Zhenjun, appointed Palace Attendant, and participated in the metropolitan offices.

manualTranslations.zh: 後改封臨淮王。
manualTranslations.literal: Later his title was changed to Prince of Linhuai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later his title was changed to Prince of Linhuai.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨，諡宣王。
manualTranslations.literal: He died and received the posthumous title Prince Xuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died and received the posthumous title Prince Xuan.

sourceRange.text: 子湛，字士淵，少有風尚。孝莊初，襲封。孝靜初，累遷冀州刺史。所在聚斂，風政不立。入為侍中，後行司州牧。時齊神武作相，以湛頗有器望，啟超拜太尉公。薨，贈假黃鉞、大司馬、尚書令，諡曰文獻。初，湛名位漸重，留連聲色，始以婢紫光遺尚書郎中宋游道，後乃私耽，出為冀州，竊而攜去。遊道大致紛紜，乃雲紫光湛父所寵，湛母遺己。將致公文，久乃停息。論者兩非之。

context.beforeSource: 莊帝追復王爵，贈司徒公，諡曰忠武。
context.afterSource: 湛弟瑾，尚書祠部郎。
context.beforeLocal: 莊帝追復王爵，贈司徒公，諡曰忠武。
context.afterLocal: 湛弟瑾，尚書祠部郎。

manualTranslations.zh: 子湛，字士淵，少有風尚。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Zhan was styled Shiyuan and in youth had refined bearing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Zhan was styled Shiyuan and in youth had refined bearing.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝莊初，襲封。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Xiaozhuang's reign, he inherited the fief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xiaozhuang's reign, he inherited the fief.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝靜初，累遷冀州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Xiaojing's reign, he rose through successive posts to regional inspector of Jizhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xiaojing's reign, he rose through successive posts to regional inspector of Jizhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 所在聚斂，風政不立。
manualTranslations.literal: Wherever he served, he amassed exactions, and sound governance was not established.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wherever he served, he amassed exactions, and sound governance was not established.

manualTranslations.zh: 入為侍中，後行司州牧。
manualTranslations.literal: He entered court as Palace Attendant and later acted as governor of Sizhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He entered court as Palace Attendant and later acted as governor of Sizhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 時齊神武作相，以湛頗有器望，啟超拜太尉公。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time Shenwu of Qi was chief minister; because Zhan had considerable ability and reputation, he memorialized to have him extraordinarily appointed Grand Commandant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time Shenwu of Qi was chief minister; because Zhan had considerable ability and reputation, he memorialized to have him extraordinarily appointed Grand Commandant.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨，贈假黃鉞、大司馬、尚書令，諡曰文獻。
manualTranslations.literal: He died and was posthumously granted the acting yellow axe, Grand Marshal, and Director of the Masters of Writing, with the posthumous title Wenxian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously granted the acting yellow axe, Grand Marshal, and Director of the Masters of Writing, with the posthumous title Wenxian.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，湛名位漸重，留連聲色，始以婢紫光遺尚書郎中宋游道，後乃私耽，出為冀州，竊而攜去。
manualTranslations.literal: At first, as Zhan's reputation and rank gradually rose, he lingered over music and women; he first gave the maid Ziguang to Secretariat Gentleman Song Youdao, but later became privately infatuated with her and, when he went out to Jizhou, secretly took her along.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At first, as Zhan's reputation and rank gradually rose, he lingered over music and women; he first gave the maid Ziguang to Secretariat Gentleman Song Youdao, but later became privately infatuated with her and, when he went out to Jizhou, secretly took her along.

manualTranslations.zh: 遊道大致紛紜，乃雲紫光湛父所寵，湛母遺己。
manualTranslations.literal: Youdao caused a great uproar, saying that Ziguang had been favored by Zhan's father and that Zhan's mother had given her to him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Youdao caused a great uproar, saying that Ziguang had been favored by Zhan's father and that Zhan's mother had given her to him.

manualTranslations.zh: 將致公文，久乃停息。
manualTranslations.literal: The matter was about to produce formal documents, but after a long time it finally subsided.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The matter was about to produce formal documents, but after a long time it finally subsided.

manualTranslations.zh: 論者兩非之。
manualTranslations.literal: Commentators blamed both men.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Commentators blamed both men.

sourceRange.text: 景隆初封丹楊公，位廣州刺史，徙徐州，改封彭城王。丁父憂，襲封宋王，又為廣州刺史。卒。梁復以景仲為廣州刺史，封枝江縣公。侯景作亂，遣誘召之，許奉為主。景仲將應之，為西江督護陳霸先所攻，乃縊而死。

context.beforeSource: 子景隆、景仲。
context.afterSource: 河南王曜，天興六年封。
context.beforeLocal: 子景隆、景仲。
context.afterLocal: 河南王曜，天興六年封。

manualTranslations.zh: 景隆初封丹楊公，位廣州刺史，徙徐州，改封彭城王。
manualTranslations.literal: Jinglong was first enfeoffed as Duke of Danyang, served as regional inspector of Guangzhou, was transferred to Xuzhou, and had his title changed to Prince of Pengcheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jinglong was first enfeoffed as Duke of Danyang, served as regional inspector of Guangzhou, was transferred to Xuzhou, and had his title changed to Prince of Pengcheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁父憂，襲封宋王，又為廣州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: When he went into mourning for his father, he inherited the title Prince of Song and again became regional inspector of Guangzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he went into mourning for his father, he inherited the title Prince of Song and again became regional inspector of Guangzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 卒。
manualTranslations.literal: He died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died.

manualTranslations.zh: 梁復以景仲為廣州刺史，封枝江縣公。
manualTranslations.literal: Liang then made Jingzhong regional inspector of Guangzhou and enfeoffed him as Duke of Zhijiang County.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liang then made Jingzhong regional inspector of Guangzhou and enfeoffed him as Duke of Zhijiang County.

manualTranslations.zh: 侯景作亂，遣誘召之，許奉為主。
manualTranslations.literal: When Hou Jing rebelled, he sent to lure Jingzhong in and promised to serve him as ruler.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Hou Jing rebelled, he sent to lure Jingzhong in and promised to serve him as ruler.

manualTranslations.zh: 景仲將應之，為西江督護陳霸先所攻，乃縊而死。
manualTranslations.literal: Jingzhong was about to respond, but Chen Baxian, commander-protector of the West River, attacked him, and he hanged himself.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jingzhong was about to respond, but Chen Baxian, commander-protector of the West River, attacked him, and he hanged himself.

sourceRange.text: 廣陽王建，真君三年封楚王，後改封廣陽。薨，諡曰簡王。子石侯襲，薨，諡曰哀王。子遺興襲，薨，諡曰定王。無子。

context.beforeSource: 性疏佷，頗以基地驕物，時論鄙之。
context.afterSource: 石侯弟嘉，少沉敏，喜慍不形於色，兼有武略。
context.beforeLocal: 性疏佷，頗以基地驕物，時論鄙之。
context.afterLocal: 石侯弟嘉，少沉敏，喜慍不形於色，兼有武略。

manualTranslations.zh: 廣陽王建，真君三年封楚王，後改封廣陽。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian, Prince of Guangyang, was enfeoffed as Prince of Chu in the third year of Zhenjun; later his title was changed to Guangyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jian, Prince of Guangyang, was enfeoffed as Prince of Chu in the third year of Zhenjun; later his title was changed to Guangyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨，諡曰簡王。
manualTranslations.literal: He died and received the posthumous title Prince Jian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died and received the posthumous title Prince Jian.

manualTranslations.zh: 子石侯襲，薨，諡曰哀王。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Shihou inherited, died, and received the posthumous title Prince Ai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Shihou inherited, died, and received the posthumous title Prince Ai.

manualTranslations.zh: 子遺興襲，薨，諡曰定王。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Yixing inherited, died, and received the posthumous title Prince Ding.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Yixing inherited, died, and received the posthumous title Prince Ding.

manualTranslations.zh: 無子。
manualTranslations.literal: He had no sons.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He had no sons.

sourceRange.text: 嘉好飲酒，或沉醉，在宣武前言笑自得，無所顧忌。帝尊年老，常優容之。與彭城、北海、高陽諸王，每入宴集，極歡彌夜，數加賞賜。帝亦時幸其第。性好儀飾，車服鮮華。既居儀同，又任端首，出入容衛，道路榮之。後遷司空，轉司徒。嘉好立功名，有益公私，多所敷奏，帝雅委付之。愛敬人物，後來才俊未為時知者，侍坐之次，轉加談引，時人以此稱之。薨，遺命薄葬。宣武悼惜之，贈侍中、太保，諡曰懿烈。

context.beforeSource: 拜衛大將軍、尚書令，除儀同三司。
context.afterSource: 嘉后妃宜都王穆壽孫女，司空從妹也。
context.beforeLocal: 拜衛大將軍、尚書令，除儀同三司。
context.afterLocal: 嘉后妃宜都王穆壽孫女，司空從妹也。

manualTranslations.zh: 嘉好飲酒，或沉醉，在宣武前言笑自得，無所顧忌。
manualTranslations.literal: Jia loved drinking and was sometimes dead drunk; in Xuanwu's presence he talked and laughed freely, without any restraint.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jia loved drinking and was sometimes dead drunk; in Xuanwu's presence he talked and laughed freely, without any restraint.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝尊年老，常優容之。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor respected his age and always treated him indulgently.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor respected his age and always treated him indulgently.

manualTranslations.zh: 與彭城、北海、高陽諸王，每入宴集，極歡彌夜，數加賞賜。
manualTranslations.literal: Together with the princes of Pengcheng, Beihai, and Gaoyang, whenever he entered for banquets, they enjoyed themselves deep into the night, and rewards were repeatedly bestowed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Together with the princes of Pengcheng, Beihai, and Gaoyang, whenever he entered for banquets, they enjoyed themselves deep into the night, and rewards were repeatedly bestowed.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝亦時幸其第。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor also sometimes visited his residence.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor also sometimes visited his residence.

manualTranslations.zh: 性好儀飾，車服鮮華。
manualTranslations.literal: By nature Jia loved ceremonial adornment, and his carriages and robes were bright and splendid.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By nature Jia loved ceremonial adornment, and his carriages and robes were bright and splendid.

manualTranslations.zh: 既居儀同，又任端首，出入容衛，道路榮之。
manualTranslations.literal: Since he held Equal to the Three Excellencies rank and also served as chief minister, his attendants and guards were impressive when he came and went, and people along the road considered it an honor to see him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Since he held Equal to the Three Excellencies rank and also served as chief minister, his attendants and guards were impressive when he came and went, and people along the road considered it an honor to see him.

manualTranslations.zh: 後遷司空，轉司徒。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he was promoted to Minister of Works and transferred to Minister over the Masses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he was promoted to Minister of Works and transferred to Minister over the Masses.

manualTranslations.zh: 嘉好立功名，有益公私，多所敷奏，帝雅委付之。
manualTranslations.literal: Jia liked to establish merit and reputation; he made many proposals beneficial to public and private interests, and the emperor trusted and entrusted him greatly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jia liked to establish merit and reputation; he made many proposals beneficial to public and private interests, and the emperor trusted and entrusted him greatly.

manualTranslations.zh: 愛敬人物，後來才俊未為時知者，侍坐之次，轉加談引，時人以此稱之。
manualTranslations.literal: He loved and respected talented people; when later able men were not yet known in their time, he would draw them into conversation while they attended him, and people praised him for this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He loved and respected talented people; when later able men were not yet known in their time, he would draw them into conversation while they attended him, and people praised him for this.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨，遺命薄葬。
manualTranslations.literal: He died and left instructions for a simple burial.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died and left instructions for a simple burial.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣武悼惜之，贈侍中、太保，諡曰懿烈。
manualTranslations.literal: Xuanwu mourned and regretted him, posthumously granted him the offices of Palace Attendant and Grand Protector, and gave him the posthumous title Yilie.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xuanwu mourned and regretted him, posthumously granted him the offices of Palace Attendant and Grand Protector, and gave him the posthumous title Yilie.

sourceRange.text: 長子平原襲爵。忠果有智略。為齊州刺史，善於懷撫。孝文時，妖賊司馬小君自稱晉後，屯聚平陵，年號聖君。平原身自討擊，禽小君，送京師斬之。又有妖人劉舉，自稱天子，復討斬之。時歲頻不登，齊人饑饉，平原以私米三千餘斛為粥，以全人命。北州戍卒一千餘人，還者皆給路糧，百姓咸稱詠之。遷征南大將軍、開府、雍州刺史，鎮長安。薨，諡曰簡王。

context.beforeSource: 薨，諡曰成王。
context.afterSource: 長子和，字善意，襲爵。
context.beforeLocal: 薨，諡曰成王。
context.afterLocal: 長子和，字善意，襲爵。

manualTranslations.zh: 長子平原襲爵。
manualTranslations.literal: The eldest son, Pingyuan, inherited the title.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The eldest son, Pingyuan, inherited the title.

manualTranslations.zh: 忠果有智略。
manualTranslations.literal: He was loyal, resolute, and possessed strategy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was loyal, resolute, and possessed strategy.

manualTranslations.zh: 為齊州刺史，善於懷撫。
manualTranslations.literal: As regional inspector of Qizhou, he was good at winning people over and calming them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As regional inspector of Qizhou, he was good at winning people over and calming them.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝文時，妖賊司馬小君自稱晉後，屯聚平陵，年號聖君。
manualTranslations.literal: In Xiaowen's time, the rebel sorcerer Sima Xiaojun claimed to be a descendant of Jin, gathered followers at Pingling, and adopted the era name Shengjun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Xiaowen's time, the rebel sorcerer Sima Xiaojun claimed to be a descendant of Jin, gathered followers at Pingling, and adopted the era name Shengjun.

manualTranslations.zh: 平原身自討擊，禽小君，送京師斬之。
manualTranslations.literal: Pingyuan personally attacked him, captured Xiaojun, and sent him to the capital to be beheaded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Pingyuan personally attacked him, captured Xiaojun, and sent him to the capital to be beheaded.

manualTranslations.zh: 又有妖人劉舉，自稱天子，復討斬之。
manualTranslations.literal: There was also the sorcerer Liu Ju, who claimed to be Son of Heaven; Pingyuan again attacked and beheaded him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: There was also the sorcerer Liu Ju, who claimed to be Son of Heaven; Pingyuan again attacked and beheaded him.

manualTranslations.zh: 時歲頻不登，齊人饑饉，平原以私米三千餘斛為粥，以全人命。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time harvests repeatedly failed and the people of Qi were starving; Pingyuan used more than three thousand hu of his own grain to make porridge and save lives.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time harvests repeatedly failed and the people of Qi were starving; Pingyuan used more than three thousand hu of his own grain to make porridge and save lives.

manualTranslations.zh: 北州戍卒一千餘人，還者皆給路糧，百姓咸稱詠之。
manualTranslations.literal: For more than a thousand garrison soldiers returning from the northern provinces, he supplied travel grain to all of them, and the people all praised him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For more than a thousand garrison soldiers returning from the northern provinces, he supplied travel grain to all of them, and the people all praised him.

manualTranslations.zh: 遷征南大將軍、開府、雍州刺史，鎮長安。
manualTranslations.literal: He was promoted to Grand General Who Campaigns South, granted an office establishment, and made regional inspector of Yongzhou, guarding Chang'an.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Grand General Who Campaigns South, granted an office establishment, and made regional inspector of Yongzhou, guarding Chang'an.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨，諡曰簡王。
manualTranslations.literal: He died and received the posthumous title Prince Jian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died and received the posthumous title Prince Jian.

sourceRange.text: 永昌王健，泰常七年封。健姿貌魁壯，所在征戰，常有大功。才藝比陳留桓王而智略過之。從太武破赫連昌，遂西略至木根山。討和龍，健別攻拔建德。後平叛胡白龍餘黨於西海。太武襲蠕蠕，越涿邪山，詔健殿后。矢不虛發，所中皆應弦而斃，威震漠北。尋從平涼州，健功居多。又討破禿發保周，自殺，傳首京師。復降沮渠無諱。薨，諡曰莊王。子仁襲。仁亦驍勇有父風，太武奇之。後與濮陽王閭若文謀為不軌，發覺，賜死，國除。

context.beforeSource: 薨，諡曰簡王。
context.afterSource: 建甯王崇，泰常七年封。

manualTranslations.zh: 永昌王健，泰常七年封。
manualTranslations.literal: Prince Jian of Yongchang was enfeoffed in the seventh year of Taichang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Prince Jian of Yongchang was enfeoffed in the seventh year of Taichang.

manualTranslations.zh: 健姿貌魁壯，所在征戰，常有大功。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian was imposing in appearance; wherever he campaigned, he always had great achievements.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jian was imposing in appearance; wherever he campaigned, he always had great achievements.

manualTranslations.zh: 才藝比陳留桓王而智略過之。
manualTranslations.literal: His talents matched Prince Huan of Chenliu, while his wisdom and strategy surpassed him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His talents matched Prince Huan of Chenliu, while his wisdom and strategy surpassed him.

manualTranslations.zh: 從太武破赫連昌，遂西略至木根山。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed Taiwu in defeating Helian Chang and then campaigned west as far as Mugen Mountain.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He followed Taiwu in defeating Helian Chang and then campaigned west as far as Mugen Mountain.

manualTranslations.zh: 討和龍，健別攻拔建德。
manualTranslations.literal: When Helong was attacked, Jian separately assaulted and captured Jiande.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Helong was attacked, Jian separately assaulted and captured Jiande.

manualTranslations.zh: 後平叛胡白龍餘黨於西海。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he pacified the remaining followers of the rebel Hu Bailong at Xihai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he pacified the remaining followers of the rebel Hu Bailong at Xihai.

manualTranslations.zh: 太武襲蠕蠕，越涿邪山，詔健殿后。
manualTranslations.literal: When Taiwu raided Rouran and crossed Zhuoxie Mountain, he ordered Jian to guard the rear.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Taiwu raided Rouran and crossed Zhuoxie Mountain, he ordered Jian to guard the rear.

manualTranslations.zh: 矢不虛發，所中皆應弦而斃，威震漠北。
manualTranslations.literal: Not an arrow was loosed in vain; everything he hit fell at the twang of the bowstring, and his might shook the lands north of the desert.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Not an arrow was loosed in vain; everything he hit fell at the twang of the bowstring, and his might shook the lands north of the desert.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋從平涼州，健功居多。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he followed in pacifying Liangzhou, and Jian had the greatest share of the merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he followed in pacifying Liangzhou, and Jian had the greatest share of the merit.

manualTranslations.zh: 又討破禿發保周，自殺，傳首京師。
manualTranslations.literal: He also attacked and broke Tufa Baozhou; Baozhou killed himself, and his head was sent to the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also attacked and broke Tufa Baozhou; Baozhou killed himself, and his head was sent to the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 復降沮渠無諱。
manualTranslations.literal: He also forced Juqu Wuhui to surrender.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also forced Juqu Wuhui to surrender.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨，諡曰莊王。
manualTranslations.literal: He died and received the posthumous title Prince Zhuang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died and received the posthumous title Prince Zhuang.

manualTranslations.zh: 子仁襲。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Ren inherited.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Ren inherited.

manualTranslations.zh: 仁亦驍勇有父風，太武奇之。
manualTranslations.literal: Ren too was fierce and brave, with his father's manner, and Taiwu regarded him as extraordinary.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ren too was fierce and brave, with his father's manner, and Taiwu regarded him as extraordinary.

manualTranslations.zh: 後與濮陽王閭若文謀為不軌，發覺，賜死，國除。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he plotted rebellion with Prince Luruowen of Puyang; when it was discovered, he was ordered to die and the fief was abolished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he plotted rebellion with Prince Luruowen of Puyang; when it was discovered, he was ordered to die and the fief was abolished.

sourceRange.text: 孝文崩後，和罷沙門歸俗。棄其妻子，納一寡婦曹氏為妻。曹氏年長，大和十五歲，攜男女五人，隨鑒至曆城，幹亂政事。和與曹及五子七處受納，鑒皆順其意，言無不從。於是獄以賄成，取受狼籍，齊人苦之，鑒名大損。轉徐州刺史。屬徐、兗大水，人多饑餓，鑒表加賑恤，人賴以濟。先是，京兆王愉為徐州，王既年少，長史盧陽烏寬以馭下，郡縣多不奉法。鑒表梁郡太守程靈虯虐政殘人，盜寇並起。詔免靈虯，於是徐境肅然。薨，諡悼王。

context.beforeSource: 齊人愛詠，咸曰耳目更新。
context.afterSource: 和與鑒子伯崇競求承襲，詔聽和襲，位東郡太守。

manualTranslations.zh: 孝文崩後，和罷沙門歸俗。
manualTranslations.literal: After Xiaowen died, He left the Buddhist clergy and returned to lay life.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Xiaowen died, He left the Buddhist clergy and returned to lay life.

manualTranslations.zh: 棄其妻子，納一寡婦曹氏為妻。
manualTranslations.literal: He abandoned his wife and children and took a widow, Lady Cao, as his wife.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He abandoned his wife and children and took a widow, Lady Cao, as his wife.

manualTranslations.zh: 曹氏年長，大和十五歲，攜男女五人，隨鑒至曆城，幹亂政事。
manualTranslations.literal: Lady Cao was older than He by fifteen years; bringing five sons and daughters, she followed Jian to Licheng and interfered disruptively in government affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lady Cao was older than He by fifteen years; bringing five sons and daughters, she followed Jian to Licheng and interfered disruptively in government affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 和與曹及五子七處受納，鑒皆順其意，言無不從。
manualTranslations.literal: He, Cao, and the five children accepted gifts in seven different places; Jian indulged all their wishes and followed everything they said.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He, Cao, and the five children accepted gifts in seven different places; Jian indulged all their wishes and followed everything they said.

manualTranslations.zh: 於是獄以賄成，取受狼籍，齊人苦之，鑒名大損。
manualTranslations.literal: Thus lawsuits were decided by bribes, taking was rampant, the people of Qi suffered from it, and Jian's reputation was badly damaged.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thus lawsuits were decided by bribes, taking was rampant, the people of Qi suffered from it, and Jian's reputation was badly damaged.

manualTranslations.zh: 轉徐州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to regional inspector of Xuzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was transferred to regional inspector of Xuzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 屬徐、兗大水，人多饑餓，鑒表加賑恤，人賴以濟。
manualTranslations.literal: When Xuzhou and Yanzhou suffered great floods and many people were hungry, Jian memorialized requesting additional relief, and the people relied on it to survive.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Xuzhou and Yanzhou suffered great floods and many people were hungry, Jian memorialized requesting additional relief, and the people relied on it to survive.

manualTranslations.zh: 先是，京兆王愉為徐州，王既年少，長史盧陽烏寬以馭下，郡縣多不奉法。
manualTranslations.literal: Before this, when Prince Yu of Jingzhao governed Xuzhou, the prince was young, and his chief clerk Lu Yangwu was too lenient in managing subordinates, so the commanderies and counties often did not obey the law.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before this, when Prince Yu of Jingzhao governed Xuzhou, the prince was young, and his chief clerk Lu Yangwu was too lenient in managing subordinates, so the commanderies and counties often did not obey the law.

manualTranslations.zh: 鑒表梁郡太守程靈虯虐政殘人，盜寇並起。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian memorialized that Cheng Lingqiu, administrator of Liang Commandery, governed brutally and harmed the people, so bandits had risen everywhere.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jian memorialized that Cheng Lingqiu, administrator of Liang Commandery, governed brutally and harmed the people, so bandits had risen everywhere.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔免靈虯，於是徐境肅然。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict dismissed Lingqiu, and Xuzhou territory thereupon became orderly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict dismissed Lingqiu, and Xuzhou territory thereupon became orderly.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨，諡悼王。
manualTranslations.literal: He died and received the posthumous title Prince Dao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died and received the posthumous title Prince Dao.

sourceRange.text: 提子昌，字法顯。好文學。居父母喪，哀號孺慕，非感行人。宣武時，復封臨淮王，未拜而薨。贈齊州刺史，諡曰康王，追改封濟南王。

context.beforeSource: 宣武時，贈雍州刺史，諡曰「懿」。
context.afterSource: 子彧，字文若，紹封。
context.beforeLocal: 宣武時，贈雍州刺史，諡曰「懿」。
context.afterLocal: 子彧，字文若，紹封。

manualTranslations.zh: 提子昌，字法顯。
manualTranslations.literal: Ti's son Chang was styled Faxian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ti's son Chang was styled Faxian.

manualTranslations.zh: 好文學。
manualTranslations.literal: He loved literature and learning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He loved literature and learning.

manualTranslations.zh: 居父母喪，哀號孺慕，非感行人。
manualTranslations.literal: While mourning his parents, his wailing and childlike grief moved even passersby.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: While mourning his parents, his wailing and childlike grief moved even passersby.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣武時，復封臨淮王，未拜而薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In Xuanwu's time, he was again enfeoffed as Prince of Linhuai, but died before taking up the title.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Xuanwu's time, he was again enfeoffed as Prince of Linhuai, but died before taking up the title.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈齊州刺史，諡曰康王，追改封濟南王。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously made regional inspector of Qizhou, received the posthumous title Prince Kang, and was posthumously re-enfeoffed as Prince of Jinan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made regional inspector of Qizhou, received the posthumous title Prince Kang, and was posthumously re-enfeoffed as Prince of Jinan.

sourceRange.text: 樂安王范，泰常七年封。雅性沉厚。太武以長安形勝之地，乃拜范為衛大將軍、開府義同三司、長安鎮都大將。范謙恭惠下，推心撫納，百姓稱之。時秦土新離寇賊，流亡者相繼，請崇易簡之禮，帝納之。於是遂寬徭，與人休息。後劉潔之謀，范聞而不告。事發，因疾暴薨。長子良，太武未有子，嘗曰：「兄弟之子猶子。

localRange.text: 長子良，太武未有子，嘗曰：「兄弟之子猶子。

context.beforeSource: 無子，國除。
context.afterSource: 」親撫養之。
context.beforeLocal: 無子，國除。
context.afterLocal: 親撫養之。

manualTranslations.zh: 樂安王范，泰常七年封。
manualTranslations.literal: Prince Fan of Le'an was enfeoffed in the seventh year of Taichang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Prince Fan of Le'an was enfeoffed in the seventh year of Taichang.

manualTranslations.zh: 雅性沉厚。
manualTranslations.literal: By nature he was refined, grave, and generous.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By nature he was refined, grave, and generous.

manualTranslations.zh: 太武以長安形勝之地，乃拜范為衛大將軍、開府義同三司、長安鎮都大將。
manualTranslations.literal: Because Chang'an was a place of strategic strength, Taiwu appointed Fan General of the Guards, gave him an office establishment with rank Equal to the Three Excellencies, and made him chief commander of Chang'an Garrison.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because Chang'an was a place of strategic strength, Taiwu appointed Fan General of the Guards, gave him an office establishment with rank Equal to the Three Excellencies, and made him chief commander of Chang'an Garrison.

manualTranslations.zh: 范謙恭惠下，推心撫納，百姓稱之。
manualTranslations.literal: Fan was modest, respectful, and kind to those below him; he opened his heart in pacifying and receiving the people, and the people praised him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fan was modest, respectful, and kind to those below him; he opened his heart in pacifying and receiving the people, and the people praised him.

manualTranslations.zh: 時秦土新離寇賊，流亡者相繼，請崇易簡之禮，帝納之。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time the Qin region had recently suffered banditry and refugees came one after another; he requested that simple and easy rites be honored, and the emperor accepted this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time the Qin region had recently suffered banditry and refugees came one after another; he requested that simple and easy rites be honored, and the emperor accepted this.

manualTranslations.zh: 於是遂寬徭，與人休息。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon corvee was eased and the people were allowed to rest.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thereupon corvee was eased and the people were allowed to rest.

manualTranslations.zh: 後劉潔之謀，范聞而不告。
manualTranslations.literal: Later, Fan heard of Liu Jie's plot but did not report it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later, Fan heard of Liu Jie's plot but did not report it.

manualTranslations.zh: 事發，因疾暴薨。
manualTranslations.literal: When the affair was exposed, he suddenly died of illness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the affair was exposed, he suddenly died of illness.

sourceRange.text: 匡屢請更權衡不已，於是詔曰：「謹權審度，自昔令典，定章革曆，往代良規。匡宗室賢亮，留心既久，可令更集儒貴，以時驗決。必務權衡得衷，令寸籥不舛。」又詔曰：「故廣平殤王洛侯體自恭宗，茂年薨殞，國除祀廢，不祀忽諸。匡親同若子，私繼歲久，宜樹維城，永茲磐石，可特襲王爵，封東平郡王。」匡所制尺度訖，請集朝士議定是非，詔付門下、尚書、三府、九列議定以聞。太師、高陽王雍等議，以為「晉中書監荀勖所造之尺，與高祖所定，毫釐略同。侍中崔光得古象尺，于時亦准議令施用。仰惟孝文皇帝德邁前王，睿明下燭，不刊之式，事難變改。臣等參論，請停匡議，永遵先皇之制。」詔從之。

context.beforeSource: 違其糾惡之心，又慮匡辭解，欲獎安之，進號安南將軍，後加鎮東將軍。
context.afterSource: 匡每有奏請，尚書令、任城王澄時致執奪。

manualTranslations.zh: 匡屢請更權衡不已，於是詔曰：「謹權審度，自昔令典，定章革曆，往代良規。
manualTranslations.literal: Kuang repeatedly requested that weights and measures be revised, and would not stop. An edict therefore said: "Careful weights and exact measures have been statutory canons since antiquity; fixing standards and reforming calendars were fine regulations of past ages.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Kuang repeatedly requested that weights and measures be revised, and would not stop. An edict therefore said: "Careful weights and exact measures have been statutory canons since antiquity; fixing standards and reforming calendars were fine regulations of past ages.

manualTranslations.zh: 匡宗室賢亮，留心既久，可令更集儒貴，以時驗決。
manualTranslations.literal: Kuang is a worthy and discerning imperial kinsman and has long kept this matter in mind. He may again gather eminent Confucians and nobles, and test and decide the matter in due time.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Kuang is a worthy and discerning imperial kinsman and has long kept this matter in mind. He may again gather eminent Confucians and nobles, and test and decide the matter in due time.

manualTranslations.zh: 必務權衡得衷，令寸籥不舛。」
manualTranslations.literal: He must be certain that the weights and measures reach the proper mean, so that the inch and the pitch-pipe are not in error."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He must be certain that the weights and measures reach the proper mean, so that the inch and the pitch-pipe are not in error."

manualTranslations.zh: 又詔曰：「故廣平殤王洛侯體自恭宗，茂年薨殞，國除祀廢，不祀忽諸。
manualTranslations.literal: Another edict said: "The late Prince Shang of Guangping, Luohou, was born of Gongzong. He died in the bloom of youth, so his state was abolished and its sacrifices discontinued, leaving him suddenly without offerings.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Another edict said: "The late Prince Shang of Guangping, Luohou, was born of Gongzong. He died in the bloom of youth, so his state was abolished and its sacrifices discontinued, leaving him suddenly without offerings.

manualTranslations.zh: 匡親同若子，私繼歲久，宜樹維城，永茲磐石，可特襲王爵，封東平郡王。」
manualTranslations.literal: Kuang is kin to him as if he were a son, and has privately continued the line for many years. He should be established as a bulwark of the realm, an enduring rock; he may specially inherit the princely rank and be enfeoffed as Prince of Dongping."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Kuang is kin to him as if he were a son, and has privately continued the line for many years. He should be established as a bulwark of the realm, an enduring rock; he may specially inherit the princely rank and be enfeoffed as Prince of Dongping."

manualTranslations.zh: 匡所制尺度訖，請集朝士議定是非，詔付門下、尚書、三府、九列議定以聞。
manualTranslations.literal: When Kuang finished the scale he had devised, he requested that court officers be gathered to decide what was right and wrong. An edict referred the matter to the Palace Secretariat, the Masters of Writing, the Three Offices, and the Nine Ministers to deliberate and report.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Kuang finished the scale he had devised, he requested that court officers be gathered to decide what was right and wrong. An edict referred the matter to the Palace Secretariat, the Masters of Writing, the Three Offices, and the Nine Ministers to deliberate and report.

manualTranslations.zh: 太師、高陽王雍等議，以為「晉中書監荀勖所造之尺，與高祖所定，毫釐略同。
manualTranslations.literal: Grand Preceptor Yong, Prince of Gaoyang, and the others deliberated, saying: "The foot-rule made by Xun Xu, Director of the Palace Writers under Jin, is almost identical down to the smallest measure with the one fixed by Gaozu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Grand Preceptor Yong, Prince of Gaoyang, and the others deliberated, saying: "The foot-rule made by Xun Xu, Director of the Palace Writers under Jin, is almost identical down to the smallest measure with the one fixed by Gaozu.

manualTranslations.zh: 侍中崔光得古象尺，于時亦准議令施用。
manualTranslations.literal: Attendant-in-ordinary Cui Guang obtained an ancient ivory foot-rule, and at the time it too was used as the basis for deliberation and ordered into use.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Attendant-in-ordinary Cui Guang obtained an ancient ivory foot-rule, and at the time it too was used as the basis for deliberation and ordered into use.

manualTranslations.zh: 仰惟孝文皇帝德邁前王，睿明下燭，不刊之式，事難變改。
manualTranslations.literal: We reverently consider that Emperor Xiaowen's virtue surpassed former kings and that his wise clarity shone downward; his unalterable standard is difficult to change.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We reverently consider that Emperor Xiaowen's virtue surpassed former kings and that his wise clarity shone downward; his unalterable standard is difficult to change.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣等參論，請停匡議，永遵先皇之制。」
manualTranslations.literal: We your subjects have discussed it together, and request that Kuang's proposal be halted and that the late emperor's system be followed forever."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We your subjects have discussed it together, and request that Kuang's proposal be halted and that the late emperor's system be followed forever."

manualTranslations.zh: 詔從之。
manualTranslations.literal: The edict followed this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The edict followed this.

manualTranslations.literal: Mao's son Qi, styled Weiqing, inherited the title.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Mao's son Qi, styled Weiqing, inherited the title.

sourceRange.text: 子文都，性梗直，仕周為右侍上士。隋開皇初，授內史舍人。煬帝即位，累遷御史大夫，坐事免。未幾，授太府卿，甚有當時譽。大業十三年，帝幸江都宮，詔文都與段達、皇甫無逸、韋津等同為東都留守。帝崩，文都與達、津等共推越王侗為帝。侗署文都為內史令、開府儀同三司、光祿大夫、左驍衛大將軍、攝右翊衛將軍、魯國公。

context.beforeSource: 仕周為小塚宰、江陵總管。
context.afterSource: 既而宇文化及立秦王浩為帝，擁兵至彭城，所在響震。
context.beforeLocal: 仕周為小塚宰、江陵總管。
context.afterLocal: 既而宇文化及立秦王浩為帝，擁兵至彭城，所在響震。

manualTranslations.zh: 子文都，性梗直，仕周為右侍上士。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Wendu was upright and direct by nature. In service under Zhou, he became Right Attendant Senior Gentleman.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Wendu was upright and direct by nature. In service under Zhou, he became Right Attendant Senior Gentleman.

manualTranslations.zh: 隋開皇初，授內史舍人。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Sui's Kaihuang era, he was appointed Secretariat Drafter.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Sui's Kaihuang era, he was appointed Secretariat Drafter.

manualTranslations.zh: 煬帝即位，累遷御史大夫，坐事免。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Yang ascended the throne, he was repeatedly promoted to Censor-in-chief, but was dismissed for an offense.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yang ascended the throne, he was repeatedly promoted to Censor-in-chief, but was dismissed for an offense.

manualTranslations.zh: 未幾，授太府卿，甚有當時譽。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long he was appointed Minister of the Imperial Treasury, and he had a strong reputation at the time.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before long he was appointed Minister of the Imperial Treasury, and he had a strong reputation at the time.

manualTranslations.zh: 大業十三年，帝幸江都宮，詔文都與段達、皇甫無逸、韋津等同為東都留守。
manualTranslations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Daye, the emperor visited Jiangdu Palace. An edict made Wendu, together with Duan Da, Huangfu Wuyi, Wei Jin, and others, defenders-in-residence of the Eastern Capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Daye, the emperor visited Jiangdu Palace. An edict made Wendu, together with Duan Da, Huangfu Wuyi, Wei Jin, and others, defenders-in-residence of the Eastern Capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝崩，文都與達、津等共推越王侗為帝。
manualTranslations.literal: When the emperor died, Wendu, Da, Jin, and the others jointly put forward Tong, Prince of Yue, as emperor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the emperor died, Wendu, Da, Jin, and the others jointly put forward Tong, Prince of Yue, as emperor.

manualTranslations.zh: 侗署文都為內史令、開府儀同三司、光祿大夫、左驍衛大將軍、攝右翊衛將軍、魯國公。
manualTranslations.literal: Tong appointed Wendu Director of the Secretariat, Equal to the Three Excellencies with an Office Establishment, Grandee of Light, General-in-chief of the Left Valiant Guard, acting General of the Right Supporting Guard, and Duke of Lu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tong appointed Wendu Director of the Secretariat, Equal to the Three Excellencies with an Office Establishment, Grandee of Light, General-in-chief of the Left Valiant Guard, acting General of the Right Supporting Guard, and Duke of Lu.

context.afterSource: 袁椒房生陽平幽王新成；

sourceRange.text: 煬帝即位，拜齊郡太守。及遼東之役，郡官督事者前後相屬。有西曹掾當行，詐疾，褒杖之。掾大言曰：「我將詣行在所，欲有所告。」褒大怒，因杖百餘，數日死。坐免官，卒於家。

context.beforeSource: 」上歎異之，稱為長者。
context.afterSource: 樂良王萬壽，和平三年封，拜征東大將軍，鎮和龍。
context.beforeLocal: 上歎異之，稱為長者。
context.afterLocal: 樂良王萬壽，和平三年封，拜征東大將軍，鎮和龍。

manualTranslations.zh: 煬帝即位，拜齊郡太守。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Yang ascended the throne, Bao was appointed Administrator of Qi Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yang ascended the throne, Bao was appointed Administrator of Qi Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 及遼東之役，郡官督事者前後相屬。
manualTranslations.literal: During the Liaodong campaign, commandery officials assigned to supervise affairs arrived one after another.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Liaodong campaign, commandery officials assigned to supervise affairs arrived one after another.

manualTranslations.zh: 有西曹掾當行，詐疾，褒杖之。
manualTranslations.literal: A West Office clerk was due to go, but feigned illness, and Bao had him beaten with rods.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A West Office clerk was due to go, but feigned illness, and Bao had him beaten with rods.

manualTranslations.zh: 掾大言曰：「我將詣行在所，欲有所告。」
manualTranslations.literal: The clerk shouted: "I am going to the imperial encampment, and I have something to report."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The clerk shouted: "I am going to the imperial encampment, and I have something to report."

manualTranslations.zh: 褒大怒，因杖百餘，數日死。
manualTranslations.literal: Bao was furious and thereupon had him beaten more than a hundred strokes; after several days he died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Bao was furious and thereupon had him beaten more than a hundred strokes; after several days he died.

manualTranslations.zh: 坐免官，卒於家。
manualTranslations.literal: For this, Bao was dismissed from office and died at home.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For this, Bao was dismissed from office and died at home.

sourceRange.text: 京兆王子推，太安五年封，位侍中、征南大將軍、長安鎮大將。子推性沈雅，善於綏接，秦、雍之人服其威惠。入為中都大官，察獄有稱。獻文將禪位於子推，以大臣固諫，乃傳孝文。孝文即位，拜侍中、本將軍、開府儀同三司、青州刺史。未至，道薨。

context.beforeSource: 未幾，卒，子贇襲。
context.afterSource: 子太興襲，拜長安鎮大將。
context.beforeLocal: 未幾，卒，子贇襲。
context.afterLocal: 子太興襲，拜長安鎮大將。

manualTranslations.zh: 京兆王子推，太安五年封，位侍中、征南大將軍、長安鎮大將。
manualTranslations.literal: Zitui, Prince of Jingzhao, was enfeoffed in the fifth year of Taian and held posts as Attendant-in-ordinary, General-in-chief Who Campaigns South, and Garrison Commander of Changan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zitui, Prince of Jingzhao, was enfeoffed in the fifth year of Taian and held posts as Attendant-in-ordinary, General-in-chief Who Campaigns South, and Garrison Commander of Changan.

manualTranslations.zh: 子推性沈雅，善於綏接，秦、雍之人服其威惠。
manualTranslations.literal: Zitui was calm and refined by nature, and skilled at conciliating and receiving people. The people of Qin and Yong submitted to his authority and kindness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zitui was calm and refined by nature, and skilled at conciliating and receiving people. The people of Qin and Yong submitted to his authority and kindness.

manualTranslations.zh: 入為中都大官，察獄有稱。
manualTranslations.literal: He entered court as Chief Judicial Officer of the Capital, and was praised for his examination of legal cases.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He entered court as Chief Judicial Officer of the Capital, and was praised for his examination of legal cases.

manualTranslations.zh: 獻文將禪位於子推，以大臣固諫，乃傳孝文。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Xianwen was about to abdicate in favor of Zitui, but because the great ministers firmly remonstrated, he transmitted the throne to Emperor Xiaowen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Xianwen was about to abdicate in favor of Zitui, but because the great ministers firmly remonstrated, he transmitted the throne to Emperor Xiaowen.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝文即位，拜侍中、本將軍、開府儀同三司、青州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xiaowen ascended the throne, Zitui was appointed Attendant-in-ordinary, kept his generalship, was made Equal to the Three Excellencies with an Office Establishment, and was appointed governor of Qingzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowen ascended the throne, Zitui was appointed Attendant-in-ordinary, kept his generalship, was made Equal to the Three Excellencies with an Office Establishment, and was appointed governor of Qingzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 未至，道薨。
manualTranslations.literal: Before he arrived, he died on the road.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before he arrived, he died on the road.

sourceRange.text: 仲景弟暹，字叔照。孝莊初，除南兗州刺史。在州猛暴，多所殺害。元顥入洛，暹據州不屈。莊帝還宮，封汝陽王，累遷秦州刺史。先秦州城人屢為反覆，暹盡誅之，存者十一二。普泰元年，除涼州刺史，貪暴無極。欲規府人及商胡富人財物，詐一台符，誣諸豪等，雲欲加賞。一時屠戮，所有資財生口，悉沒自入。孝靜時，位侍中、錄尚書事。薨，贈太師、錄尚書。子沖襲。無子，國絕。

context.beforeSource: 仲景多內亂，後就州賜死。
context.afterSource: 太興弟遙，字太原，有器望。
context.beforeLocal: 仲景多內亂，後就州賜死。
context.afterLocal: 太興弟遙，字太原，有器望。

manualTranslations.zh: 仲景弟暹，字叔照。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhongjing's younger brother Xian was styled Shuzhao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhongjing's younger brother Xian was styled Shuzhao.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝莊初，除南兗州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Xiaozhuang's reign, he was appointed governor of Southern Yanzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Emperor Xiaozhuang's reign, he was appointed governor of Southern Yanzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 在州猛暴，多所殺害。
manualTranslations.literal: In the province he was violent and cruel, and killed many people.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the province he was violent and cruel, and killed many people.

manualTranslations.zh: 元顥入洛，暹據州不屈。
manualTranslations.literal: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, Xian held the province and refused to submit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, Xian held the province and refused to submit.

manualTranslations.zh: 莊帝還宮，封汝陽王，累遷秦州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: After Emperor Zhuang returned to the palace, Xian was enfeoffed as Prince of Ruyang and was repeatedly promoted to governor of Qinzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Emperor Zhuang returned to the palace, Xian was enfeoffed as Prince of Ruyang and was repeatedly promoted to governor of Qinzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 先秦州城人屢為反覆，暹盡誅之，存者十一二。
manualTranslations.literal: Earlier, the people of Qinzhou city had repeatedly rebelled and returned to allegiance; Xian executed them all, and only one or two in ten survived.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier, the people of Qinzhou city had repeatedly rebelled and returned to allegiance; Xian executed them all, and only one or two in ten survived.

manualTranslations.zh: 普泰元年，除涼州刺史，貪暴無極。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Putai, he was appointed governor of Liangzhou, where his greed and violence had no limit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Putai, he was appointed governor of Liangzhou, where his greed and violence had no limit.

manualTranslations.zh: 欲規府人及商胡富人財物，詐一台符，誣諸豪等，雲欲加賞。
manualTranslations.literal: Wanting to seize the property of wealthy people in the provincial seat and rich Hu merchants, he forged a document from the Imperial Secretariat and falsely accused the powerful families and others, saying that they were to be rewarded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wanting to seize the property of wealthy people in the provincial seat and rich Hu merchants, he forged a document from the Imperial Secretariat and falsely accused the powerful families and others, saying that they were to be rewarded.

manualTranslations.zh: 一時屠戮，所有資財生口，悉沒自入。
manualTranslations.literal: He slaughtered them all at once, and confiscated all their property, goods, and dependents for himself.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He slaughtered them all at once, and confiscated all their property, goods, and dependents for himself.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝靜時，位侍中、錄尚書事。
manualTranslations.literal: In Emperor Xiaojing's time, he held posts as Attendant-in-ordinary and Manager of the Affairs of the Masters of Writing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Emperor Xiaojing's time, he held posts as Attendant-in-ordinary and Manager of the Affairs of the Masters of Writing.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨，贈太師、錄尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: When he died, he was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and Manager of the Masters of Writing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he died, he was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and Manager of the Masters of Writing.

manualTranslations.zh: 子沖襲。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Chong inherited the title.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Chong inherited the title.

manualTranslations.zh: 無子，國絕。
manualTranslations.literal: Chong had no son, and the state was extinguished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chong had no son, and the state was extinguished.

sourceRange.text: 偃弟麗，字寶掌，位兼宗正卿、右衛將軍。遷光祿勳，宗正、右衛如故。時秦州屠各王法智推州主簿呂苟兒為主，號建明元年，置立百官，攻逼州郡。涇州人陳瞻亦聚眾自稱王，號聖明元年。以麗為使持節、都督，與楊椿討之。苟兒率眾十餘萬，屯孤山，別據諸險，圍逼州城。麗出擊，大破之，使進軍水洛。賊徒逆戰，麗夜擊走之。行秦州事李韶破苟兒於孤山，乘勝追掩，獲其父母妻子。諸城之圍，亦悉奔散。苟兒率其王公三十餘人詣麗請罪。麗因平賊之勢，枉掠良善七百餘人。宣武嘉其功，詔有司不聽追檢。

context.beforeSource: 莊帝初，為從兄暉業訴奪王爵。
context.afterSource: 拜雍州刺史，為政嚴酷，吏人患之。
context.beforeLocal: 莊帝初，為從兄暉業訴奪王爵。
context.afterLocal: 拜雍州刺史，為政嚴酷，吏人患之。

manualTranslations.zh: 偃弟麗，字寶掌，位兼宗正卿、右衛將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Yan's younger brother Li was styled Baozhang, and held concurrent posts as Grand Master of the Imperial Clan and General of the Right Guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yan's younger brother Li was styled Baozhang, and held concurrent posts as Grand Master of the Imperial Clan and General of the Right Guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 遷光祿勳，宗正、右衛如故。
manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to Minister of Light, while retaining Grand Master of the Imperial Clan and Right Guard as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Minister of Light, while retaining Grand Master of the Imperial Clan and Right Guard as before.

manualTranslations.zh: 時秦州屠各王法智推州主簿呂苟兒為主，號建明元年，置立百官，攻逼州郡。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time Wang Fazhi, a Tuge of Qinzhou, put forward the provincial registrar Lu Gou'er as leader, took the reign title first year of Jianming, established a full bureaucracy, and attacked and pressed the provinces and commanderies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time Wang Fazhi, a Tuge of Qinzhou, put forward the provincial registrar Lu Gou'er as leader, took the reign title first year of Jianming, established a full bureaucracy, and attacked and pressed the provinces and commanderies.

manualTranslations.zh: 涇州人陳瞻亦聚眾自稱王，號聖明元年。
manualTranslations.literal: Chen Zhan of Jingzhou also gathered followers, called himself king, and took the reign title first year of Shengming.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chen Zhan of Jingzhou also gathered followers, called himself king, and took the reign title first year of Shengming.

manualTranslations.zh: 以麗為使持節、都督，與楊椿討之。
manualTranslations.literal: Li was made Acting with the Staff of Authority and Area Commander, and with Yang Chun campaigned against them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Li was made Acting with the Staff of Authority and Area Commander, and with Yang Chun campaigned against them.

manualTranslations.zh: 苟兒率眾十餘萬，屯孤山，別據諸險，圍逼州城。
manualTranslations.literal: Gou'er led more than a hundred thousand followers, camped at Gushan, separately occupied the strategic passes, and besieged the provincial city.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gou'er led more than a hundred thousand followers, camped at Gushan, separately occupied the strategic passes, and besieged the provincial city.

manualTranslations.zh: 麗出擊，大破之，使進軍水洛。
manualTranslations.literal: Li sallied out and attacked, greatly defeating him, then ordered the army to advance to Shuiluo.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Li sallied out and attacked, greatly defeating him, then ordered the army to advance to Shuiluo.

manualTranslations.zh: 賊徒逆戰，麗夜擊走之。
manualTranslations.literal: The rebels met them in battle; Li attacked by night and drove them off.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The rebels met them in battle; Li attacked by night and drove them off.

manualTranslations.zh: 行秦州事李韶破苟兒於孤山，乘勝追掩，獲其父母妻子。
manualTranslations.literal: Li Shao, acting administrator of Qinzhou affairs, defeated Gou'er at Gushan, followed up the victory in pursuit, and captured his parents, wife, and children.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Li Shao, acting administrator of Qinzhou affairs, defeated Gou'er at Gushan, followed up the victory in pursuit, and captured his parents, wife, and children.

manualTranslations.zh: 諸城之圍，亦悉奔散。
manualTranslations.literal: The sieges of the various cities also all scattered in flight.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The sieges of the various cities also all scattered in flight.

manualTranslations.zh: 苟兒率其王公三十餘人詣麗請罪。
manualTranslations.literal: Gou'er led more than thirty of his kings and dukes to Li to confess their crimes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gou'er led more than thirty of his kings and dukes to Li to confess their crimes.

manualTranslations.zh: 麗因平賊之勢，枉掠良善七百餘人。
manualTranslations.literal: Li took advantage of having pacified the rebels to wrongfully seize more than seven hundred innocent people.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Li took advantage of having pacified the rebels to wrongfully seize more than seven hundred innocent people.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣武嘉其功，詔有司不聽追檢。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Xuanwu praised his achievement and ordered the responsible offices not to allow any later investigation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanwu praised his achievement and ordered the responsible offices not to allow any later investigation.

sourceRange.text: 子誕，字曇首。初，誕伯父郁以貪污賜死，爵除。詔以誕，偃正妃子，立為嫡孫，特聽紹封。累遷齊州刺史。在州貪暴，大為人患。牛馬騾驢，無不逼奪，家之奴隸，悉迫取良人為婦。有沙門為誕采藥，還見誕，問外消息，對曰：「唯聞王貪，願王早代。」誕曰：「齊州七萬家，吾至來，一家未得三十錢，何得言貪？」後為御史中尉元纂所糾，會赦免。薨，諡靜王。

context.beforeSource: 郁弟偃，位太中大夫。
context.afterSource: 子撫，字伯懿，襲。
context.beforeLocal: 郁弟偃，位太中大夫。
context.afterLocal: 子撫，字伯懿，襲。

manualTranslations.zh: 子誕，字曇首。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Dan was styled Tanshou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Dan was styled Tanshou.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，誕伯父郁以貪污賜死，爵除。
manualTranslations.literal: At first, Dan's uncle Yu had been ordered to die for corruption, and the title was abolished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At first, Dan's uncle Yu had been ordered to die for corruption, and the title was abolished.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔以誕，偃正妃子，立為嫡孫，特聽紹封。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict declared that because Dan was the son of Yan's principal consort, he should be established as the legitimate grandson and specially permitted to continue the fief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict declared that because Dan was the son of Yan's principal consort, he should be established as the legitimate grandson and specially permitted to continue the fief.

manualTranslations.zh: 累遷齊州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to governor of Qizhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to governor of Qizhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 在州貪暴，大為人患。
manualTranslations.literal: In the province he was greedy and violent, and became a great affliction to the people.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the province he was greedy and violent, and became a great affliction to the people.

manualTranslations.zh: 牛馬騾驢，無不逼奪，家之奴隸，悉迫取良人為婦。
manualTranslations.literal: There were no oxen, horses, mules, or donkeys that he did not forcibly seize; for the slaves of his household, he forced free women to become their wives.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: There were no oxen, horses, mules, or donkeys that he did not forcibly seize; for the slaves of his household, he forced free women to become their wives.

manualTranslations.zh: 有沙門為誕采藥，還見誕，問外消息，對曰：「唯聞王貪，願王早代。」
manualTranslations.literal: A sramana was gathering medicinal herbs for Dan. When he returned and saw Dan, Dan asked him for news from outside, and he replied: "I have only heard that Your Highness is greedy; I hope Your Highness is soon replaced."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A sramana was gathering medicinal herbs for Dan. When he returned and saw Dan, Dan asked him for news from outside, and he replied: "I have only heard that Your Highness is greedy; I hope Your Highness is soon replaced."

manualTranslations.zh: 誕曰：「齊州七萬家，吾至來，一家未得三十錢，何得言貪？」
manualTranslations.literal: Dan said: "Qizhou has seventy thousand households. Since I arrived, I have not yet gotten thirty cash from each household. How can you call me greedy?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Dan said: "Qizhou has seventy thousand households. Since I arrived, I have not yet gotten thirty cash from each household. How can you call me greedy?"

manualTranslations.zh: 後為御史中尉元纂所糾，會赦免。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he was impeached by Yuan Zuan, Inspector of the Masters of Writing, but happened to receive amnesty and was spared.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he was impeached by Yuan Zuan, Inspector of the Masters of Writing, but happened to receive amnesty and was spared.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨，諡靜王。
manualTranslations.literal: When he died, he was posthumously named Prince Jing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he died, he was posthumously named Prince Jing.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，薨，贈假黃鉞、使持節、都督中外諸軍事、太傅、領太尉公，加以殊禮，備九錫，依晉大司馬齊王攸故事，諡曰文宣王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year he died. He was posthumously granted Acting Yellow Axe, Acting with the Staff of Authority, Commander-in-chief of all military affairs within and without, Grand Tutor, and concurrently Grand Commandant. Special rites were added, he was furnished with the Nine Bestowments according to the precedent of You, Prince Qi and Grand Marshal of Jin, and he was posthumously named Prince Wenxuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year he died. He was posthumously granted Acting Yellow Axe, Acting with the Staff of Authority, Commander-in-chief of all military affairs within and without, Grand Tutor, and concurrently Grand Commandant. Special rites were added, he was furnished with the Nine Bestowments according to the precedent of You, Prince Qi and Grand Marshal of Jin, and he was posthumously named Prince Wenxuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 澄之葬也，凶飾甚盛。
manualTranslations.literal: At Cheng's burial, the funerary decorations were extremely lavish.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At Cheng's burial, the funerary decorations were extremely lavish.

manualTranslations.zh: 靈太后親送郊外，停輿悲哭，哀慟左右。
manualTranslations.literal: Empress Dowager Ling personally escorted him beyond the suburbs, stopped her carriage, and wept sorrowfully, grieving those around her.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Ling personally escorted him beyond the suburbs, stopped her carriage, and wept sorrowfully, grieving those around her.

manualTranslations.zh: 百官會赴千餘人，莫不欷歔，當時以為哀榮之極。
manualTranslations.literal: More than a thousand of the hundred officials attended the funeral, and none failed to sigh and sob. People at the time considered it the height of mournful honor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: More than a thousand of the hundred officials attended the funeral, and none failed to sigh and sob. People at the time considered it the height of mournful honor.

manualTranslations.zh: 第四子彝襲。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: His fourth son Yi inherited the title.

sourceRange.text: 宣武即位，拜吏部尚書，以前後軍功，進爵常山侯。尋詔英率眾南討，大破梁曹景宗軍。梁司州刺史蔡道恭憂死，三關戍棄城而走。初，孝文平漢陽，英有戰功，許復其封。及為陳顯達所敗，遂寢。是役也，宣武大悅，乃復之，改封中山王。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon an edict ordered Ying to lead forces south in attack, and he greatly defeated the army of Liang's Cao Jingzong.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liang's governor of Sizhou, Cai Daogong, died of anxiety, and the garrisons at the Three Passes abandoned their cities and fled.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Emperor Xiaowen pacified Hanyang, Ying had military merit and was promised restoration of his fief.

sourceRange.text: 神龜元年，詔加女侍中貂蟬，同外侍中之飾。澄上表諫曰：「高祖、世宗皆有女侍中官，未見綴金蟬於象珥，極鼲貂於鬢髮。江南偽晉穆何後有女尚書而加貂榼，此乃衰亂之世，妖妄之服。且婦人而服男子之服，至陰而陽，故自穆、哀以降，國統二絕。因是劉裕所以篡逆。禮容舉措，風化之本，請依常儀，追還前詔。」帝從之。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ritual appearance and deportment are the basis of moral transformation. I request that regular ceremony be followed and the previous edict rescinded."

manualTranslations.zh: 帝從之。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor followed this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor followed this.

sourceRange.text: 次子燮襲，拜太中大夫，除華州刺史。燮表曰：「謹惟州居李潤堡，雖是少梁舊地，晉芮錫壤，然胡夷內附，遂為戎落。竊以馮翊古城，實惟西籓奧府；面華、渭，包原澤；井淺地平，樵牧饒廣。采材華陰，陸運七十，伐木龍門，順流而下。陪削舊雉，功省力易。丁不十錢之費，人無八旬之勤。損輕益重，乞垂昭鑒。」遂詔曰：「一勞永逸，便可聽移。」薨於州，贈朔州刺史。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: By enlarging and trimming the old battlements, the work would be economical and the labor easy.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: This lessens what is slight and benefits what is important; I beg that clear judgment be extended to it."

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thereupon an edict said: "One labor will bring lasting ease; the move may be permitted."

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in the province and was posthumously granted governor of Shuozhou.

sourceRange.text: 澄弟嵩，字道岳，孝文時，位步兵校尉。大司馬、安定王休薨，未及卒哭，嵩便游田。帝聞而大怒，詔曰：「嵩，大司馬薨殂甫爾，便以鷹鷂自娛，有如父之痛，無猶子之情，捐心棄禮，何其太速！便可免官。」後兼武衛將軍。孝文南伐，齊將陳顯達率眾拒戰，嵩身備三仗，免胄直前，勇冠三軍。將士從之，顯達奔潰。帝大悅曰：「任城康王大有福德，文武頓出其門。」以功賜爵高平縣侯。初，孝文之發洛也，馮皇后以罪幽于宮內。既平顯達，回次谷唐原，帝疾甚，將賜後死，曰：「使人不易可得。」顧謂任城王澄曰：「任城必不負我，嵩亦當不負任城，可使嵩也。」於是引嵩入內，親詔遣之。宣武即位，為揚州刺史，威名大振。後並妻穆氏為蒼頭李太伯等所害。諡曰剛侯。第二子世俊，頗有幹用，而無行業。襲爵。孝莊時，遷吏部尚書。爾硃兆寇京師，詔世俊以本官為都督，守河橋。及兆至河，世俊初無拒守意，便隔岸遙拜。遂將船五艘迎兆軍，兆因得入。京都破殘，皆世俊之罪，時論疾之。尤為爾硃世隆所昵。孝武初，改封武陽縣子。世俊居選曹，不能厲心，多所受納，為中尉彈糾，坐免官。孝靜時，位尚書令。世俊輕薄，好去就。興和中，薨。贈太尉，諡曰躁戾。

manualTranslations.zh: 帝聞而大怒，詔曰：「嵩，大司馬薨殂甫爾，便以鷹鷂自娛，有如父之痛，無猶子之情，捐心棄禮，何其太速！
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor heard of this and was furious. His edict said: "Song, the Grand Marshal has only just died, yet you amuse yourself with hawks and sparrowhawks. One should feel pain as for a father, but you lack even the feeling of a nephew; you discard feeling and abandon ritual. How hasty this is!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor heard of this and was furious. His edict said: "Song, the Grand Marshal has only just died, yet you amuse yourself with hawks and sparrowhawks. One should feel pain as for a father, but you lack even the feeling of a nephew; you discard feeling and abandon ritual. How hasty this is!

manualTranslations.zh: 便可免官。」
manualTranslations.literal: He may be dismissed from office."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He may be dismissed from office."

manualTranslations.zh: 後兼武衛將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he concurrently served as General of the Martial Guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he concurrently served as General of the Martial Guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝文南伐，齊將陳顯達率眾拒戰，嵩身備三仗，免胄直前，勇冠三軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xiaowen campaigned south, the Qi general Chen Xianda led forces to resist. Song armed himself with three weapons, removed his helmet, and advanced straight forward, his courage topping the three armies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowen campaigned south, the Qi general Chen Xianda led forces to resist. Song armed himself with three weapons, removed his helmet, and advanced straight forward, his courage topping the three armies.

manualTranslations.zh: 將士從之，顯達奔潰。
manualTranslations.literal: The officers and soldiers followed him, and Xianda fled in collapse.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The officers and soldiers followed him, and Xianda fled in collapse.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝大悅曰：「任城康王大有福德，文武頓出其門。」
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor was delighted and said: "Prince Kang of Rencheng has great fortune and virtue; civil and military talent have suddenly emerged from his house."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor was delighted and said: "Prince Kang of Rencheng has great fortune and virtue; civil and military talent have suddenly emerged from his house."

manualTranslations.zh: 以功賜爵高平縣侯。
manualTranslations.literal: For his merit, Song was granted the title Marquis of Gaoping County.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For his merit, Song was granted the title Marquis of Gaoping County.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，孝文之發洛也，馮皇后以罪幽于宮內。
manualTranslations.literal: Earlier, when Emperor Xiaowen departed Luoyang, Empress Feng was confined inside the palace for an offense.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Emperor Xiaowen departed Luoyang, Empress Feng was confined inside the palace for an offense.

manualTranslations.zh: 既平顯達，回次谷唐原，帝疾甚，將賜後死，曰：「使人不易可得。」
manualTranslations.literal: After defeating Xianda, as he returned and stopped at Gutangyuan, the emperor became gravely ill and was about to order the empress to die. He said: "A suitable envoy is not easily found."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After defeating Xianda, as he returned and stopped at Gutangyuan, the emperor became gravely ill and was about to order the empress to die. He said: "A suitable envoy is not easily found."

manualTranslations.zh: 顧謂任城王澄曰：「任城必不負我，嵩亦當不負任城，可使嵩也。」
manualTranslations.literal: He turned and said to Cheng, Prince of Rencheng: "Rencheng will surely not fail me, and Song also will not fail Rencheng. Song may be sent."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He turned and said to Cheng, Prince of Rencheng: "Rencheng will surely not fail me, and Song also will not fail Rencheng. Song may be sent."

manualTranslations.zh: 於是引嵩入內，親詔遣之。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon he summoned Song inside and personally issued the edict dispatching him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thereupon he summoned Song inside and personally issued the edict dispatching him.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣武即位，為揚州刺史，威名大振。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xuanwu ascended the throne, Song became governor of Yangzhou, and his awe-inspiring reputation greatly flourished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuanwu ascended the throne, Song became governor of Yangzhou, and his awe-inspiring reputation greatly flourished.

manualTranslations.zh: 後並妻穆氏為蒼頭李太伯等所害。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he and his wife, Lady Mu, were both killed by his cangtou Li Taibo and others.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he and his wife, Lady Mu, were both killed by his cangtou Li Taibo and others.

manualTranslations.zh: 諡曰剛侯。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously named Marquis Gang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously named Marquis Gang.

manualTranslations.zh: 第二子世俊，頗有幹用，而無行業。
manualTranslations.literal: His second son Shijun had considerable practical ability, but lacked moral conduct.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His second son Shijun had considerable practical ability, but lacked moral conduct.

manualTranslations.zh: 襲爵。
manualTranslations.literal: He inherited the title.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He inherited the title.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝莊時，遷吏部尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: In Emperor Xiaozhuang's time, he was transferred to Minister of Personnel.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Emperor Xiaozhuang's time, he was transferred to Minister of Personnel.

manualTranslations.zh: 爾硃兆寇京師，詔世俊以本官為都督，守河橋。
manualTranslations.literal: When Erzhu Zhao raided the capital, an edict made Shijun, with his original office, Area Commander and ordered him to guard Heqiao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Zhao raided the capital, an edict made Shijun, with his original office, Area Commander and ordered him to guard Heqiao.

manualTranslations.zh: 及兆至河，世俊初無拒守意，便隔岸遙拜。
manualTranslations.literal: When Zhao reached the river, Shijun had no intention of resisting or defending, and at once bowed from across the bank.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhao reached the river, Shijun had no intention of resisting or defending, and at once bowed from across the bank.

manualTranslations.zh: 遂將船五艘迎兆軍，兆因得入。
manualTranslations.literal: He then led five boats to welcome Zhao's army, and Zhao was thereby able to enter.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He then led five boats to welcome Zhao's army, and Zhao was thereby able to enter.

manualTranslations.zh: 京都破殘，皆世俊之罪，時論疾之。
manualTranslations.literal: The capital was ruined; this was all Shijun's fault, and opinion at the time detested him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The capital was ruined; this was all Shijun's fault, and opinion at the time detested him.

manualTranslations.zh: 尤為爾硃世隆所昵。
manualTranslations.literal: He was especially intimate with Erzhu Shilong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was especially intimate with Erzhu Shilong.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝武初，改封武陽縣子。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Xiaowu's reign, his enfeoffment was changed to Viscount of Wuyang County.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Emperor Xiaowu's reign, his enfeoffment was changed to Viscount of Wuyang County.

manualTranslations.zh: 世俊居選曹，不能厲心，多所受納，為中尉彈糾，坐免官。
manualTranslations.literal: When Shijun held office in the selections bureau, he could not discipline himself and accepted many gifts. He was impeached by the Censor-in-chief and was dismissed from office for the offense.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Shijun held office in the selections bureau, he could not discipline himself and accepted many gifts. He was impeached by the Censor-in-chief and was dismissed from office for the offense.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝靜時，位尚書令。
manualTranslations.literal: In Emperor Xiaojing's time, he held the post of Director of the Masters of Writing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Emperor Xiaojing's time, he held the post of Director of the Masters of Writing.

manualTranslations.zh: 世俊輕薄，好去就。
manualTranslations.literal: Shijun was frivolous and liked to shift his allegiances.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shijun was frivolous and liked to shift his allegiances.

manualTranslations.zh: 興和中，薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the Xinghe era, he died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the Xinghe era, he died.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈太尉，諡曰躁戾。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously granted Grand Commandant and given the posthumous name Zaoli.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted Grand Commandant and given the posthumous name Zaoli.

localRange.text: 景穆十二王下任城王雲，和平五年封。

context.afterSource: 少聰慧，年五歲，景穆崩，號哭不絕聲。
context.afterLocal: 少聰慧，年五歲，景穆崩，號哭不絕聲。

manualTranslations.literal: Xi's younger brother Lue, styled Junxing, held the office of Gentleman Attendant of the Yellow Gate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xi's younger brother Lue, styled Junxing, held the office of Gentleman Attendant of the Yellow Gate.

context.afterSource: 景山字寶嶽，少有器局，幹略過人。

manualTranslations.literal: Chao's younger brother Yan was styled Fubao. In the Datong era, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Song'an.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chao's younger brother Yan was styled Fubao. In the Datong era, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Song'an.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨，諡曰懿。
manualTranslations.literal: When he died, he was posthumously named Yi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he died, he was posthumously named Yi.

manualTranslations.zh: 子景山。
manualTranslations.literal: His son was Jingshan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son was Jingshan.

manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Wencheng had seven sons: Empress Xiaoyuan bore Emperor Xianwen;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Wencheng had seven sons: Empress Xiaoyuan bore Emperor Xianwen;

manualTranslations.zh: 李夫人生安樂厲王長樂；
manualTranslations.literal: Lady Li bore Changle, Prince Li of Anle;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lady Li bore Changle, Prince Li of Anle;

manualTranslations.zh: 曹夫人生廣川莊王略；
manualTranslations.literal: Lady Cao bore Lue, Prince Zhuang of Guangchuan;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lady Cao bore Lue, Prince Zhuang of Guangchuan;

manualTranslations.zh: 沮渠夫人生齊郡順王簡；
manualTranslations.literal: Lady Juqu bore Jian, Prince Shun of Qi Commandery;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lady Juqu bore Jian, Prince Shun of Qi Commandery;

manualTranslations.zh: 乙夫人生河間孝王若；
manualTranslations.literal: Lady Yi bore Ruo, Prince Xiao of Hejian;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lady Yi bore Ruo, Prince Xiao of Hejian;

manualTranslations.zh: 悅夫人生安豐匡王猛；
manualTranslations.literal: Lady Yue bore Meng, Prince Kuang of Anfeng;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lady Yue bore Meng, Prince Kuang of Anfeng;

manualTranslations.zh: 玄夫人生韓哀王安平，早薨，無傳。
manualTranslations.literal: Lady Xuan bore Anping, Prince Ai of Han; he died young and has no biography.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lady Xuan bore Anping, Prince Ai of Han; he died young and has no biography.

sourceRange.text: 齊天保元年，降爵為縣公。韶性行溫裕，以高氏婿，頗膺時寵。能自謙退，臨人有惠政，好儒學；禮致才彥，愛林泉，修第宅華而不侈。文宣常剃韶鬢須，加以粉黛，衣婦人服以自隨。曰：「以彭城為嬪御。」譏元氏微弱，比之婦女。

manualTranslations.zh: 齊天保元年，降爵為縣公。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Tianbao under Qi, his title was reduced to county duke.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianbao under Qi, his title was reduced to county duke.

manualTranslations.zh: 韶性行溫裕，以高氏婿，頗膺時寵。
manualTranslations.literal: Shao was warm and generous in character and conduct; as a son-in-law of the Gao family, he enjoyed considerable favor at the time.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shao was warm and generous in character and conduct; as a son-in-law of the Gao family, he enjoyed considerable favor at the time.

manualTranslations.zh: 能自謙退，臨人有惠政，好儒學；
manualTranslations.literal: He was able to be humble and retiring; in governing people he had benevolent policies, and he loved Confucian learning;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was able to be humble and retiring; in governing people he had benevolent policies, and he loved Confucian learning;

manualTranslations.zh: 禮致才彥，愛林泉，修第宅華而不侈。
manualTranslations.literal: he invited talented worthies with proper rites, loved woods and springs, and built residences that were splendid but not extravagant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: he invited talented worthies with proper rites, loved woods and springs, and built residences that were splendid but not extravagant.

manualTranslations.zh: 文宣常剃韶鬢須，加以粉黛，衣婦人服以自隨。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Wenxuan often shaved Shao's sideburns and beard, applied powder and rouge to him, dressed him in women's clothing, and had him follow at his side.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Wenxuan often shaved Shao's sideburns and beard, applied powder and rouge to him, dressed him in women's clothing, and had him follow at his side.

manualTranslations.zh: 曰：「以彭城為嬪御。」
manualTranslations.literal: He said, "I make Pengcheng a concubine attendant."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He said, "I make Pengcheng a concubine attendant."

manualTranslations.zh: 譏元氏微弱，比之婦女。
manualTranslations.literal: This mocked the weakness of the Yuan clan by comparing them to women.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This mocked the weakness of the Yuan clan by comparing them to women.

sourceRange.text: 詳母高太妃頗助威虐，怨嚮嗷然。

localRange.text: 詳母高太妃頗助威虐，怨<鄉向>嗷然。

manualTranslations.zh: 詳母高太妃頗助威虐，怨嚮嗷然。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiang's mother, Grand Consort Gao, did much to aid his tyrannical cruelty, and resentment toward them rose in a clamor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiang's mother, Grand Consort Gao, did much to aid his tyrannical cruelty, and resentment toward them rose in a clamor.

sourceRange.text: 謐性暴虐，明帝初，台使元延到其州界，以驛邏無兵，攝帥檢核。隊主高保願列言：「所有之兵，王皆私役。」謐聞，大怒，鞭保願等五人各二百。數日間，謐召近州人夫，閉四門，內外嚴固，搜掩城人，楚掠備至。又無事而斬六人，合城兇懼。眾遂大呼，屯門。謐怖，登樓毀梯以自固。士人散走，城人分守四門。靈太后遣遊擊將軍王竫馳驛喻之。城人既見靖至，開門謝罪。乃罷謐州，除大司農卿。遷幽州刺史。謐妃胡氏，靈太后從女也。未發，坐毆其妃，免官。後除都官尚書。車駕出拜圓丘，謐與妃乘赤馬犯鹵簿，為御史所彈，靈太后特不問。薨，高陽王雍，幹之母弟，啟論謐，贈假侍中、司州牧，諡貞景。

context.beforeSource: 後為岐州刺史。
context.afterSource: 謐兄諶，字興伯，性平和，位都官尚書。
