manualTranslations.zh: 尉撥，代人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Wei Bo was a man of Dai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wei Bo was a man of Dai.

manualTranslations.zh: 父那，濮陽太守。
manualTranslations.literal: His father Na was Grand Administrator of Puyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His father Na was Grand Administrator of Puyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 撥為太學生，募從兗州刺史羅忸擊賊于陳、汝，有功，賜爵介休男。
manualTranslations.literal: Bo was a student at the Imperial Academy and enlisted under Luo Niu, Inspector of Yan Province, to attack rebels in Chen and Ru; he had merit and was granted the title Baron of Jiexiu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Bo was a student at the Imperial Academy and enlisted under Luo Niu, Inspector of Yan Province, to attack rebels in Chen and Ru; he had merit and was granted the title Baron of Jiexiu.

manualTranslations.zh: 討和龍，擊吐谷渾，皆有軍功，進爵為子。
manualTranslations.literal: In the campaigns against Helong and the Tuyuhun, he had military merit in both and was advanced to viscount.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the campaigns against Helong and the Tuyuhun, he had military merit in both and was advanced to viscount.

manualTranslations.zh: 累遷杏城鎮將，大得人和。
manualTranslations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted, becoming Garrison Commander of Xingcheng, and greatly won the people’s support.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted, becoming Garrison Commander of Xingcheng, and greatly won the people’s support.

manualTranslations.zh: 文成以撥清平有惠績，賜以衣服。
manualTranslations.literal: Because Bo was upright and had benevolent achievements, Wencheng bestowed clothing on him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because Bo was upright and had benevolent achievements, Wencheng bestowed clothing on him.

manualTranslations.zh: 獻文即位，為北征都將。
manualTranslations.literal: When Xianwen took the throne, Bo became Chief Commander of the Northern Campaign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Xianwen took the throne, Bo became Chief Commander of the Northern Campaign.

manualTranslations.zh: 南攻懸瓠。
manualTranslations.literal: He attacked Xuanhu in the south.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He attacked Xuanhu in the south.

manualTranslations.zh: 進爵安城侯，位北豫州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: He was advanced to Marquis of Ancheng and held the post of Inspector of Northern Yu Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was advanced to Marquis of Ancheng and held the post of Inspector of Northern Yu Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 卒，諡敬侯。
manualTranslations.literal: He died and received the posthumous title Marquis Jing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died and received the posthumous title Marquis Jing.

manualTranslations.zh: 陸真，代人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Lu Zhen was a man of Dai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lu Zhen was a man of Dai.

manualTranslations.zh: 父洛侯，秦州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: His father Luohou was Inspector of Qin Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His father Luohou was Inspector of Qin Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 真少善騎射。
manualTranslations.literal: In youth Zhen was skilled at mounted archery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In youth Zhen was skilled at mounted archery.

manualTranslations.zh: 太武以真膂力過人，拜內三郎。
manualTranslations.literal: Because Taiwu considered Zhen’s physical strength exceptional, he appointed him Inner Gentleman of the Third Rank.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because Taiwu considered Zhen’s physical strength exceptional, he appointed him Inner Gentleman of the Third Rank.

manualTranslations.zh: 真君中，從討蠕蠕，以功賜爵關內侯。
manualTranslations.literal: During the Zhenjun era, he followed the campaign against the Rouran and, for his merit, was granted the title Marquis Within the Passes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Zhenjun era, he followed the campaign against the Rouran and, for his merit, was granted the title Marquis Within the Passes.

manualTranslations.zh: 後攻懸瓠，登樓臨射城中，弦不虛發。
manualTranslations.literal: Later, when attacking Xuanhu, he climbed a tower and shot down into the city, and every arrow found its mark.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later, when attacking Xuanhu, he climbed a tower and shot down into the city, and every arrow found its mark.

manualTranslations.zh: 從太武至江，還攻盱眙，真功居多。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed Taiwu to the Yangtze and then returned to attack Xuyi; Zhen’s merit was the greatest.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He followed Taiwu to the Yangtze and then returned to attack Xuyi; Zhen’s merit was the greatest.

manualTranslations.zh: 文成即位，進爵都昌侯，位選部尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: When Wencheng took the throne, Zhen was advanced to Marquis of Duchang and held the post of Minister of the Selection Department.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Wencheng took the throne, Zhen was advanced to Marquis of Duchang and held the post of Minister of the Selection Department.

manualTranslations.zh: 後拜長安平鎮將。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he was appointed Garrison Commander of Chang’anping.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he was appointed Garrison Commander of Chang’anping.

manualTranslations.zh: 時初置長蛇鎮，真率眾築城未訖，而氐豪仇傉檀等反叛。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time, Changshe Garrison had just been established; Zhen led the people in building the city, but before it was finished, the Di chiefs Chou Noutan and others rebelled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time, Changshe Garrison had just been established; Zhen led the people in building the city, but before it was finished, the Di chiefs Chou Noutan and others rebelled.

manualTranslations.zh: 真擊平之，卒城長蛇而還。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhen attacked and pacified them, completed the city at Changshe, and returned.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhen attacked and pacified them, completed the city at Changshe, and returned.

manualTranslations.zh: 東平王道符反于長安，以真為長安鎮將，賜爵河南公。
manualTranslations.literal: When Prince Daofu of Dongping rebelled at Chang’an, Zhen was made Garrison Commander of Chang’an and granted the title Duke of Henan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Prince Daofu of Dongping rebelled at Chang’an, Zhen was made Garrison Commander of Chang’an and granted the title Duke of Henan.

manualTranslations.zh: 長安平兵人素伏其威信，及至，皆怗然安靜。
manualTranslations.literal: The soldiers and people of Chang’anping had long submitted to his authority and trustworthiness, and when he arrived they all settled peacefully.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The soldiers and people of Chang’anping had long submitted to his authority and trustworthiness, and when he arrived they all settled peacefully.

manualTranslations.zh: 在鎮數年，甚著威稱。
manualTranslations.literal: He remained at the garrison for several years, and his reputation for authority became very prominent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He remained at the garrison for several years, and his reputation for authority became very prominent.

manualTranslations.zh: 卒，諡曰烈。
manualTranslations.literal: He died and received the posthumous name Lie.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died and received the posthumous name Lie.

sourceRange.text: 太武時，瓌父匹知遣瓌入貢，帝留之。瓌善騎射，手格猛獸。

localRange.text: 太武時，瑰父匹知遣瑰入貢，帝留之。瑰善騎射，手格猛獸。

context.beforeSource: 其先世統部落。
context.afterSource: 尚太武女上谷公主，除駙馬都尉，賜爵西平公。
context.beforeLocal: 其先世統部落。
context.afterLocal: 尚太武女上谷公主，除駙馬都尉，賜爵西平公。

manualTranslations.zh: 太武時，瓌父匹知遣瓌入貢，帝留之。
manualTranslations.literal: In Taiwu's time, Gui's father Pizhi sent Gui to present tribute, and the emperor kept him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Taiwu's time, Gui's father Pizhi sent Gui to present tribute, and the emperor kept him.

manualTranslations.zh: 瓌善騎射，手格猛獸。
manualTranslations.literal: Gui was skilled at mounted archery and could grapple fierce beasts with his bare hands.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gui was skilled at mounted archery and could grapple fierce beasts with his bare hands.

sourceRange.text: 列傳第十三古弼張黎劉潔丘堆娥清伊珝乙瓌周幾豆代田車伊洛王洛兒車路頭盧魯元陳建來大干宿石萬安國周觀尉撥陸真呂洛拔薛彪子子琡尉元慕容白曜和其奴苟頹宇文福__TOC__古弼，代人也。少忠謹，善騎射。初為獵郎，門下奏事，以敏正稱。明元嘉其直而有用，賜名曰筆。後改名弼，言其有輔佐才也。令典西部，與劉潔等分綰機要，敷奏百揆。太武即位，以功拜立節將軍，賜爵靈壽侯。歷位侍中、吏部尚書，典南部奏事。後征馮弘。弘將奔高麗，高麗救軍至，弘乃隨之，令婦人被甲居中，其精卒及高麗陳兵於外。弼部將高苟子擊賊軍。弼酒醉，拔刀止之，故弘得東奔。太武大怒，黜為廣夏門卒。尋復為侍中，與尚書李順使涼州。賜爵建興公，鎮長安，甚有威名。及議征涼州，弼與順咸言涼州乏水草，不宜行，帝不從。既克姑臧，微嫌之，以其有將略，弗之責。

manualTranslations.zh: 古弼，代人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Gu Bi was a man of Dai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gu Bi was a man of Dai.

manualTranslations.zh: 少忠謹，善騎射。
manualTranslations.literal: In youth he was loyal and careful, and he was skilled at mounted archery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In youth he was loyal and careful, and he was skilled at mounted archery.

manualTranslations.zh: 初為獵郎，門下奏事，以敏正稱。
manualTranslations.literal: At first he served as a hunting gentleman; when reporting matters at the palace gate, he was praised for quickness and rectitude.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At first he served as a hunting gentleman; when reporting matters at the palace gate, he was praised for quickness and rectitude.

manualTranslations.zh: 明元嘉其直而有用，賜名曰筆。
manualTranslations.literal: Mingyuan admired his honesty and usefulness and gave him the name Bi, “Brush.”
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Mingyuan admired his honesty and usefulness and gave him the name Bi, “Brush.”

manualTranslations.zh: 後改名弼，言其有輔佐才也。
manualTranslations.literal: Later his name was changed to Bi, meaning that he had the talent to assist and support.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later his name was changed to Bi, meaning that he had the talent to assist and support.

manualTranslations.zh: 令典西部，與劉潔等分綰機要，敷奏百揆。
manualTranslations.literal: He was ordered to manage the western section and, with Liu Jie and the others, divided responsibility for confidential affairs and presented the business of the offices.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was ordered to manage the western section and, with Liu Jie and the others, divided responsibility for confidential affairs and presented the business of the offices.

manualTranslations.zh: 太武即位，以功拜立節將軍，賜爵靈壽侯。
manualTranslations.literal: When Taiwu took the throne, for his merit he was appointed General Establishing Integrity and granted the title Marquis of Lingshou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Taiwu took the throne, for his merit he was appointed General Establishing Integrity and granted the title Marquis of Lingshou.

manualTranslations.zh: 歷位侍中、吏部尚書，典南部奏事。
manualTranslations.literal: He successively held the posts of Palace Attendant and Minister of Personnel, and managed memorials from the southern section.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He successively held the posts of Palace Attendant and Minister of Personnel, and managed memorials from the southern section.

manualTranslations.zh: 後征馮弘。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he campaigned against Feng Hong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he campaigned against Feng Hong.

manualTranslations.zh: 弘將奔高麗，高麗救軍至，弘乃隨之，令婦人被甲居中，其精卒及高麗陳兵於外。
manualTranslations.literal: When Hong was about to flee to Goguryeo, a Goguryeo relief army arrived; Hong then followed them, ordering women to wear armor in the center while his elite troops and the Goguryeo forces arrayed outside.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Hong was about to flee to Goguryeo, a Goguryeo relief army arrived; Hong then followed them, ordering women to wear armor in the center while his elite troops and the Goguryeo forces arrayed outside.

manualTranslations.zh: 弼部將高苟子擊賊軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Bi’s subordinate commander Gao Gouzi attacked the enemy army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Bi’s subordinate commander Gao Gouzi attacked the enemy army.

manualTranslations.zh: 弼酒醉，拔刀止之，故弘得東奔。
manualTranslations.literal: Bi was drunk and drew his sword to stop him, so Hong was able to flee east.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Bi was drunk and drew his sword to stop him, so Hong was able to flee east.

manualTranslations.zh: 太武大怒，黜為廣夏門卒。
manualTranslations.literal: Taiwu was furious and demoted him to a gate soldier at Guangxia Gate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Taiwu was furious and demoted him to a gate soldier at Guangxia Gate.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋復為侍中，與尚書李順使涼州。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was restored as Palace Attendant and sent to Liang Province with Minister Li Shun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was restored as Palace Attendant and sent to Liang Province with Minister Li Shun.

manualTranslations.zh: 賜爵建興公，鎮長安，甚有威名。
manualTranslations.literal: He was granted the title Duke of Jianxing and stationed at Chang’an, where he had great authority and reputation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was granted the title Duke of Jianxing and stationed at Chang’an, where he had great authority and reputation.

manualTranslations.zh: 及議征涼州，弼與順咸言涼州乏水草，不宜行，帝不從。
manualTranslations.literal: When a campaign against Liang Province was discussed, Bi and Shun both said that Liang Province lacked water and pasture and should not be attacked, but the emperor did not follow them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When a campaign against Liang Province was discussed, Bi and Shun both said that Liang Province lacked water and pasture and should not be attacked, but the emperor did not follow them.

manualTranslations.zh: 既克姑臧，微嫌之，以其有將略，弗之責。
manualTranslations.literal: After Guzang was conquered, the emperor was somewhat displeased with him, but because he had military strategy, he did not reproach him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Guzang was conquered, the emperor was somewhat displeased with him, but because he had military strategy, he did not reproach him.

sourceRange.text: 乙瓌，代人也。

localRange.text: 乙瑰，代人也。

context.beforeSource: 贈雍州刺史。
context.afterSource: 其先世統部落。
context.beforeLocal: 贈雍州刺史。
context.afterLocal: 其先世統部落。

manualTranslations.zh: 乙瓌，代人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Yi Gui was a man of Dai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yi Gui came from Dai.

sourceRange.text: 陳建，代人也。以善騎射擢為三郎，遷下大夫、內行長。太武討山胡白龍，輕之，單將騎數十，每自登山。白龍伏壯士，出不意；帝墜馬，幾至不測。建以身捍賊，奮擊，殺數人，被十餘瘡。帝壯之，賜別戶二十。文成初，出為幽州刺史，假秦郡公。帝以建貪暴懦弱，遣使就州罰杖五十。孝文初，徵為尚書右僕射，加侍中，進爵趙郡公。建與晉陽侯元仙德、長樂王穆亮、平原王陸睿密表啟南伐，帝嘉之。遷司徒，進爵魏郡王。帝與文明太后頻幸建第，賜建妻宴于後庭。薨，子念生襲。有罪，爵除。來大干，代人也。

localRange.text: 陳建，代人也。以善騎射擢為三郎，遷下大夫、內行長。太武討山胡白龍，輕之，單將騎數十，每自登山。白龍伏壯士，出不意；帝墜馬，幾至不測。建以身捍賊，奮擊，殺數人，被十餘瘡。帝壯之，賜別戶二十。文成初，出為幽州刺史，假秦郡公。帝以建貪暴懦弱，遣使就州罰杖五十。孝文初，徵為尚書右僕射，加侍中，進爵趙郡公。建與晉陽侯元仙德、長樂王穆亮、平原王陸睿密表啟南伐，帝嘉之。遷司徒，進爵魏郡王。帝與文明太后頻幸建第，賜建妻宴于後庭。薨，子念生襲。有罪，爵除。

manualTranslations.zh: 陳建，代人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Chen Jian was a man of Dai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chen Jian was a man of Dai.

manualTranslations.zh: 以善騎射擢為三郎，遷下大夫、內行長。
manualTranslations.literal: Because he was skilled at mounted archery, he was promoted to Gentleman of the Third Rank, then transferred to Junior Grand Master and Chief of Inner Conduct.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because he was skilled at mounted archery, he was promoted to Gentleman of the Third Rank, then transferred to Junior Grand Master and Chief of Inner Conduct.

manualTranslations.zh: 太武討山胡白龍，輕之，單將騎數十，每自登山。
manualTranslations.literal: When Taiwu attacked the mountain Hu Bailong, he underestimated him and, leading only several dozen cavalry, often climbed the mountain himself.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Taiwu attacked the mountain Hu Bailong, he underestimated him and, leading only several dozen cavalry, often climbed the mountain himself.

manualTranslations.zh: 白龍伏壯士，出不意；帝墜馬，幾至不測。
manualTranslations.literal: Bailong had strong men lying in ambush who struck unexpectedly; the emperor fell from his horse and nearly met disaster.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Bailong had strong men lying in ambush who struck unexpectedly; the emperor fell from his horse and nearly met disaster.

manualTranslations.zh: 建以身捍賊，奮擊，殺數人，被十餘瘡。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian used his own body to block the enemy, fought fiercely, killed several men, and suffered more than ten wounds.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jian used his own body to block the enemy, fought fiercely, killed several men, and suffered more than ten wounds.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝壯之，賜別戶二十。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor admired his bravery and granted him twenty separate households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor admired his bravery and granted him twenty separate households.

manualTranslations.zh: 文成初，出為幽州刺史，假秦郡公。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Wencheng’s reign, he was sent out as Inspector of You Province and provisionally made Duke of Qin Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Wencheng’s reign, he was sent out as Inspector of You Province and provisionally made Duke of Qin Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝以建貪暴懦弱，遣使就州罰杖五十。
manualTranslations.literal: Because the emperor considered Jian greedy, violent, and cowardly, he sent an envoy to the province to punish him with fifty strokes of the cane.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because the emperor considered Jian greedy, violent, and cowardly, he sent an envoy to the province to punish him with fifty strokes of the cane.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝文初，徵為尚書右僕射，加侍中，進爵趙郡公。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Xiaowen’s reign, he was summoned as Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, additionally made Palace Attendant, and advanced to Duke of Zhao Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xiaowen’s reign, he was summoned as Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, additionally made Palace Attendant, and advanced to Duke of Zhao Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 建與晉陽侯元仙德、長樂王穆亮、平原王陸睿密表啟南伐，帝嘉之。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian, with Marquis Yuan Xiande of Jinyang, Prince Mu Liang of Changle, and Prince Lu Rui of Pingyuan, secretly submitted a memorial proposing a southern campaign, and the emperor praised it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jian, with Marquis Yuan Xiande of Jinyang, Prince Mu Liang of Changle, and Prince Lu Rui of Pingyuan, secretly submitted a memorial proposing a southern campaign, and the emperor praised it.

manualTranslations.zh: 遷司徒，進爵魏郡王。
manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to Minister over the Masses and advanced to Prince of Wei Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Minister over the Masses and advanced to Prince of Wei Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝與文明太后頻幸建第，賜建妻宴于後庭。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor and Empress Dowager Wenming often visited Jian’s residence, and the emperor granted Jian’s wife a banquet in the rear court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor and Empress Dowager Wenming often visited Jian’s residence, and the emperor granted Jian’s wife a banquet in the rear court.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨，子念生襲。
manualTranslations.literal: He died, and his son Niansheng inherited.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died, and his son Niansheng inherited.

manualTranslations.zh: 有罪，爵除。
manualTranslations.literal: Because he was guilty of a crime, the title was abolished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because he was guilty of a crime, the title was abolished.

sourceRange.text: 子統襲爵，以父任，侍東宮。太武以元舅陽平王杜超女南安長公主所生妻之。車駕親自臨送，太官設供具，賞賚千計。文成即位，典選部、主客二曹。卒，贈襄城王，諡曰景。無子。弟彌娥襲。卒，贈襄城王，諡曰恭。

localRange.text: 子統襲爵，以父任，侍東宮。太武以元舅陽平王杜超女南安長公主所生妻之。車駕親自臨送，太官設供具，賞賚千計。文成即位，典選部、主客二曹。卒，贈襄城王，諡曰景。無子。弟彌娥襲。卒，贈襄城王，諡曰恭。

manualTranslations.zh: 子統襲爵，以父任，侍東宮。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Tong inherited the title and, by virtue of his father’s office, attended upon the Eastern Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Tong inherited the title and, by virtue of his father’s office, attended upon the Eastern Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 太武以元舅陽平王杜超女南安長公主所生妻之。
manualTranslations.literal: Taiwu married him to the daughter born to Princess Royal Nan’an, daughter of the emperor’s maternal uncle Du Chao, Prince of Yangping.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Taiwu married him to the daughter born to Princess Royal Nan’an, daughter of the emperor’s maternal uncle Du Chao, Prince of Yangping.

manualTranslations.zh: 車駕親自臨送，太官設供具，賞賚千計。
manualTranslations.literal: The imperial carriage personally came to see her off; the Grand Provisioner arranged the offerings, and rewards and gifts were counted by the thousands.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The imperial carriage personally came to see her off; the Grand Provisioner arranged the offerings, and rewards and gifts were counted by the thousands.

manualTranslations.zh: 文成即位，典選部、主客二曹。
manualTranslations.literal: When Wencheng took the throne, Tong managed the Selection and Guests departments.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Wencheng took the throne, Tong managed the Selection and Guests departments.

manualTranslations.zh: 卒，贈襄城王，諡曰景。
manualTranslations.literal: He died and was posthumously granted the title Prince of Xiangcheng, with the posthumous name Jing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously granted the title Prince of Xiangcheng, with the posthumous name Jing.

manualTranslations.zh: 無子。
manualTranslations.literal: He had no sons.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He had no sons.

manualTranslations.zh: 弟彌娥襲。
manualTranslations.literal: His younger brother Mi’e inherited.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His younger brother Mi’e inherited.

manualTranslations.zh: 卒，贈襄城王，諡曰恭。
manualTranslations.literal: When he died, he was posthumously granted the title Prince of Xiangcheng, with the posthumous name Gong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he died, he was posthumously granted the title Prince of Xiangcheng, with the posthumous name Gong.

manualTranslations.zh: 正平元年，和詣闕。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Zhengping, He went to the imperial court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhengping, He went to the imperial court.

manualTranslations.zh: 太武優寵之，待以為上客。
manualTranslations.literal: Taiwu favored him generously and treated him as an honored guest.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Taiwu favored him generously and treated him as an honored guest.

manualTranslations.zh: 文成以和歸誠先朝，封酒泉公。
manualTranslations.literal: Because He had submitted sincerely to the previous court, Wencheng enfeoffed him as Duke of Jiuquan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because He had submitted sincerely to the previous court, Wencheng enfeoffed him as Duke of Jiuquan.

manualTranslations.zh: 太安中，為濟州刺史，甚有稱績。
manualTranslations.literal: During the Taian era, he became Inspector of Ji Province and had achievements that were much praised.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Taian era, he became Inspector of Ji Province and had achievements that were much praised.

manualTranslations.zh: 徵為內都大官。
manualTranslations.literal: He was summoned to serve as Grand Director of the Inner Court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was summoned to serve as Grand Director of the Inner Court.

manualTranslations.zh: 評決獄訟，不加捶楚，察疑獲實者甚多，世以是稱之。
manualTranslations.literal: In judging lawsuits, he did not apply flogging or caning; in examining doubtful cases he often obtained the truth, and the age praised him for this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In judging lawsuits, he did not apply flogging or caning; in examining doubtful cases he often obtained the truth, and the age praised him for this.

manualTranslations.zh: 卒，贈征西大將軍、太常卿、酒泉王，諡曰宣。
manualTranslations.literal: He died and was posthumously granted the titles General-in-Chief Who Conquers the West, Chamberlain for Ceremonials, and Prince of Jiuquan, with the posthumous name Xuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously granted the titles General-in-Chief Who Conquers the West, Chamberlain for Ceremonials, and Prince of Jiuquan, with the posthumous name Xuan.

sourceRange.text: 四年，遷江陵總管。陳遣其將章昭達圍江陵，衞王直聞有陳寇，遣大將軍趙訚、李遷哲等率歩騎赴之，並受騰節度。時遷哲等守外城，陳將程文季、雷道勤夜來掩襲，遷哲等驚亂，不能抗禦。騰夜遣開門奮撃，大破之。陳人奔潰，道勤中流矢而斃。陳人決龍川寧朔堤，引水灌江陵城。騰親率將士，戰於西堤，破之，陳人乃遁。加位柱國，進爵上庸郡公。建德二年，徴拜大司空，尋出爲涇州總管。宣政元年冬，薨於京師，贈太尉公，諡曰定。子玄嗣。玄字士鑒，入關時，年七歳。仕齊爲奉朝請、成平縣令。齊平，武帝見玄，特加勞勉，卽拜地官府都上士。大象末，爲隋文帝相府内兵參軍。玄弟融，字士傾，最知名，少暦顯職。

sourceRange.text: 時宋司州刺史常珍奇以懸瓠内附，新人猶懷去就。珝銜旨撫慰，諸有陷軍爲奴婢者，珝皆免之。百姓欣悅，人情乃定。車駕討蠕蠕，詔珝爲選部尚書，録留臺事。及獻文將禪位於京兆王子推，任城王雲、隴西王源賀並固諫。珝抗言曰：「皇太子聖德承基，四海瞻望，不可橫議，干國之紀。臣請刎頸殿庭，有死無貳。」久之，帝乃解。詔曰：「珝直臣也，其能保吾子乎？」遂以珝爲太保，與太尉源賀持節奉皇帝璽紱傳位於孝文。延興四年薨，贈以本官，諡曰貞王。珝有六子，琇、凱知名。

sourceRange.text: 煬帝卽位，拜大理少卿。帝在顯仁宮，敕宮外衞士，不得輒離所守。有一主帥，私令衞士出外，帝付大理。師據法奏徒。帝令斬之。師奏曰：「若陛下初便殺之，自可不關文墨。旣付有司，義歸恆典。脱宿衞近侍者更有此犯，將何以加之？」帝乃止。

sourceRange.text: 定國在繈抱，文成幸其第，詔養宮内。至於游止，常與獻文同處。年六歳，爲中庶子。及獻文踐祚，拜散騎常侍，賜封東郡王。定國以承父爵，辭，不許。又以父爵讓弟睿，乃聽之。俄遷侍中、儀曹尚書，轉殿中尚書。前後大駕征巡，擢爲行臺，録都曹事，超遷司空。定國恃恩，不循法度，延興五年，坐事免官爵爲兵。大和初，復除侍中、鎭南將軍、秦益二州刺史，復王爵。八年，薨於州。贈以本官，諡曰莊王。

sourceRange.text: 薛提，太原人，皇始中，補太學生，拜侍御史，累遷晉王丕衞兵將軍、冀州刺史，封太原公。有政績，徴拜侍中，攝都曹事。太武崩，秘不發喪，尚書左僕射蘭延、侍中和延等議。以皇孫幼沖，宜立長君，征秦王翰置之秘室。提曰：「皇孫有世嫡之重，人望所系，春秋雖少，令問聞於天下。廢所宜立而更別求，必有不可。」延等未決，中常侍宗愛知其謀，矯皇后令，征提等入，殺之。文成卽位，以提有謀立之誠，詔提弟浮子襲先爵太原公，有司奏降爲侯。

sourceRange.text: 劉昶，字休道，宋文帝子也。在宋封義陽王，位徐州刺史。及廢主子業立，疑昶有異志。昶和平六年，遂委母妻，攜妾吳氏，間行降魏。朝廷嘉重之，尚武邑公主，拜侍中、征南將軍、駙馬都尉，封丹楊王。歲餘，主薨，更尚建興長公主。皇興中，宋明帝使至，獻文詔昶與書，為兄弟式。宋明帝不答，責昶，以母為其國妾，宜如《春秋》荀鳷對楚稱外臣之禮。尋敕昶更為書。辭曰：「臣若改書，事為二敬，猶修往文，彼所不納。請停今答。」朝廷從之。拜外都坐大官。公主復薨，更尚平陽長公主。

sourceRange.text: 十九年，昶朝京師。孝文臨光極堂大選，曰：「國家昔在恆代，隨時制宜，非通世之長法。或言，唯能是寄，不必拘門。朕以為不然，何者？清濁同流，混齊一等，君子小人，名品無別，此殊為不可。我今八族以上，士人品第有九；九品之外，小人之官，復有七等。若苟有其人，可起家為三公。正恐賢才難得，不可止為一人，混我典制。故令班鏡九流，使千載之後，我得仿像唐、虞，卿等依希元、凱。」及論大將軍，帝曰：「劉昶即其人也。」後給班劍二十人。薨于彭城，孝文為之舉哀，給溫明秘器，贈假黃鉞、太傅，領揚州刺史。加以殊禮，備九錫，給前後部羽葆鼓吹，依晉琅邪王伷故事，諡曰明。

manualTranslations.literal: I think this is not so. Why?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I think this is not so. Why?

manualTranslations.zh: 清濁同流，混齊一等，君子小人，名品無別，此殊為不可。
manualTranslations.literal: If clear and muddy flow together, mixed equally as one, then gentlemen and petty men have no distinction of name and rank; this is especially unacceptable.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If clear and muddy flow together, mixed equally as one, then gentlemen and petty men have no distinction of name and rank; this is especially unacceptable.

manualTranslations.zh: 我今八族以上，士人品第有九；
manualTranslations.literal: Now, for the eight clans and above, gentlemen are ranked in nine grades;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now, for the eight clans and above, gentlemen are ranked in nine grades;

manualTranslations.zh: 九品之外，小人之官，復有七等。
manualTranslations.literal: outside the nine grades, the offices of lesser men again have seven classes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: outside the nine grades, the offices of lesser men again have seven classes.

manualTranslations.zh: 若苟有其人，可起家為三公。
manualTranslations.literal: If there truly is the right person, he may rise from his first appointment to become one of the Three Dukes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If there truly is the right person, he may rise from his first appointment to become one of the Three Dukes.

manualTranslations.zh: 正恐賢才難得，不可止為一人，混我典制。
manualTranslations.literal: I only fear that worthy talent is hard to obtain; one cannot, for the sake of a single person, confuse our institutions.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I only fear that worthy talent is hard to obtain; one cannot, for the sake of a single person, confuse our institutions.

manualTranslations.zh: 故令班鏡九流，使千載之後，我得仿像唐、虞，卿等依希元、凱。」
manualTranslations.literal: Therefore I have ordered the nine streams to be clearly set forth, so that after a thousand years I may emulate Tang and Yu, and you may faintly resemble Yuan and Kai."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Therefore I have ordered the nine streams to be clearly set forth, so that after a thousand years I may emulate Tang and Yu, and you may faintly resemble Yuan and Kai."

manualTranslations.zh: 及論大將軍，帝曰：「劉昶即其人也。」
manualTranslations.literal: When the discussion turned to Grand General, the emperor said, "Liu Chang is the man."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the discussion turned to Grand General, the emperor said, "Liu Chang is the man."

manualTranslations.zh: 後給班劍二十人。
manualTranslations.literal: Later Chang was given twenty bearers of ceremonial swords.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later Chang was given twenty bearers of ceremonial swords.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨于彭城，孝文為之舉哀，給溫明秘器，贈假黃鉞、太傅，領揚州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: He died at Pengcheng, and Xiaowen held mourning for him, granted him the Wenming burial coffer, and posthumously granted him Acting Yellow Axe, Grand Tutor, and concurrent Inspector of Yang Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died at Pengcheng, and Xiaowen held mourning for him, granted him the Wenming burial coffer, and posthumously granted him Acting Yellow Axe, Grand Tutor, and concurrent Inspector of Yang Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 加以殊禮，備九錫，給前後部羽葆鼓吹，依晉琅邪王伷故事，諡曰明。
manualTranslations.literal: He was given special rites, the full Nine Bestowments, and front and rear feathered-canopy bands, following the precedent of Prince Zhou of Langya in Jin; his posthumous name was Ming.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was given special rites, the full Nine Bestowments, and front and rear feathered-canopy bands, following the precedent of Prince Zhou of Langya in Jin; his posthumous name was Ming.

sourceRange.text: 蕭大圜，字仁顯，梁簡文帝第二十子也。幼而聰敏，年四歲，能誦《三都賦》及《孝經》、《論語》，七歲居母喪，便有成人性。梁大寶元年，封樂梁郡王，丹楊尹。屬侯景殺簡文，大圜潛遁獲免。景平，歸建業。時喪亂之後，無所依，乃寓居善覺佛寺。人有以告王僧辯，乃給船餼，得往江陵。梁元帝見之甚悅，賜以越衫胡帶，改封晉熙郡王，除琅邪、彭城二郡太守。

manualTranslations.zh: 蕭大圜，字仁顯，梁簡文帝第二十子也。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiao Dahuan, styled Renxian, was the twentieth son of Emperor Jianwen of Liang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiao Dahuan, styled Renxian, was the twentieth son of Emperor Jianwen of Liang.

manualTranslations.zh: 幼而聰敏，年四歲，能誦《三都賦》及《孝經》、《論語》，七歲居母喪，便有成人性。
manualTranslations.literal: He was intelligent and quick from childhood; at four he could recite the Rhapsody on the Three Capitals, the Classic of Filial Piety, and the Analects, and at seven, while mourning his mother, he already had an adult temperament.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was intelligent and quick from childhood; at four he could recite the Rhapsody on the Three Capitals, the Classic of Filial Piety, and the Analects, and at seven, while mourning his mother, he already had an adult temperament.

manualTranslations.zh: 梁大寶元年，封樂梁郡王，丹楊尹。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Liang’s Dabao era, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Leliang Commandery and made Intendant of Danyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Liang’s Dabao era, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Leliang Commandery and made Intendant of Danyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 屬侯景殺簡文，大圜潛遁獲免。
manualTranslations.literal: When Hou Jing killed Jianwen, Dahuan escaped secretly and was spared.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Hou Jing killed Jianwen, Dahuan escaped secretly and was spared.

manualTranslations.zh: 景平，歸建業。
manualTranslations.literal: After Jing was pacified, he returned to Jiankang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Jing was pacified, he returned to Jiankang.

manualTranslations.zh: 時喪亂之後，無所依，乃寓居善覺佛寺。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time, after bereavement and disorder, he had no one to rely on and lodged at Shanjue Buddhist Monastery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time, after bereavement and disorder, he had no one to rely on and lodged at Shanjue Buddhist Monastery.

manualTranslations.zh: 人有以告王僧辯，乃給船餼，得往江陵。
manualTranslations.literal: Someone reported this to Wang Sengbian, who then provided boats and provisions, enabling him to go to Jiangling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Someone reported this to Wang Sengbian, who then provided boats and provisions, enabling him to go to Jiangling.

manualTranslations.zh: 梁元帝見之甚悅，賜以越衫胡帶，改封晉熙郡王，除琅邪、彭城二郡太守。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Yuan of Liang was very pleased when he saw him, gave him a Yue robe and Hu belt, changed his title to Prince of Jinxi Commandery, and appointed him Grand Administrator of Langya and Pengcheng commanderies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Yuan of Liang was very pleased when he saw him, gave him a Yue robe and Hu belt, changed his title to Prince of Jinxi Commandery, and appointed him Grand Administrator of Langya and Pengcheng commanderies.

sourceRange.text: 叔彪少機悟，豪率輕俠，好奇策，慕諸葛亮之爲人。爲賀拔勝荊州開府長史。勝不用其計，棄城奔梁。叔彪歸本縣，築室臨陂，優遊自適。齊文襄降辟書，辭疾不到。天保初，復征。不得已，布裙露車至鄴。楊愔往候之，以爲司徒諮議，辭疾不受。孝昭即位，召爲中庶子，問以世事。叔彪勸討關西，畫地陳兵勢，請立重鎮於平陽，與彼蒲州相對，深溝高壘，運糧實之。帝深納之。又願自居平陽，成此謀略。帝命元文遙與叔虎參謀，撰《平西策》一卷。未幾，帝崩，事寢。武成即位，拜儀同三司，判都官尚書，出爲金州刺史，遷太子詹事。叔彪在鄕時，有粟千石，毎至春夏，鄕人無食者，令自載取。

manualTranslations.zh: 叔彪少機悟，豪率輕俠，好奇策，慕諸葛亮之爲人。
manualTranslations.literal: Shubiao was perceptive from youth, bold, forthright, and lightly chivalrous; he liked unusual strategies and admired Zhuge Liang as a man.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shubiao was perceptive from youth, bold, forthright, and lightly chivalrous; he liked unusual strategies and admired Zhuge Liang as a man.

manualTranslations.zh: 爲賀拔勝荊州開府長史。
manualTranslations.literal: He served as Chief Secretary in Heba Sheng's opened office in Jing Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He served as Chief Secretary in Heba Sheng's opened office in Jing Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 勝不用其計，棄城奔梁。
manualTranslations.literal: Sheng did not use his plans, abandoned the city, and fled to Liang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sheng did not use his plans, abandoned the city, and fled to Liang.

manualTranslations.zh: 叔彪歸本縣，築室臨陂，優遊自適。
manualTranslations.literal: Shubiao returned to his home county, built a house overlooking a pond, and lived at ease as he pleased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shubiao returned to his home county, built a house overlooking a pond, and lived at ease as he pleased.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊文襄降辟書，辭疾不到。
manualTranslations.literal: Qi Wenxiang sent down a summons, but he declined on grounds of illness and did not come.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Qi Wenxiang sent down a summons, but he declined on grounds of illness and did not come.

manualTranslations.zh: 天保初，復征。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao, he was summoned again.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianbao, he was summoned again.

manualTranslations.zh: 不得已，布裙露車至鄴。
manualTranslations.literal: With no choice, he came to Ye in plain cloth and an uncovered carriage.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: With no choice, he came to Ye in plain cloth and an uncovered carriage.

manualTranslations.zh: 楊愔往候之，以爲司徒諮議，辭疾不受。
manualTranslations.literal: Yang Yin went to visit him and made him Adviser to the Minister over the Masses, but he declined on grounds of illness and did not accept.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yang Yin went to visit him and made him Adviser to the Minister over the Masses, but he declined on grounds of illness and did not accept.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝昭即位，召爲中庶子，問以世事。
manualTranslations.literal: When Xiaozhao took the throne, he summoned him as Junior Palace Attendant and questioned him about affairs of the age.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Xiaozhao took the throne, he summoned him as Junior Palace Attendant and questioned him about affairs of the age.

manualTranslations.zh: 叔彪勸討關西，畫地陳兵勢，請立重鎮於平陽，與彼蒲州相對，深溝高壘，運糧實之。
manualTranslations.literal: Shubiao urged a campaign against Guanxi, drew troop dispositions on the ground, and requested that a major garrison be established at Pingyang opposite their Pu Province, with deep ditches, high ramparts, and grain transported to fill it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shubiao urged a campaign against Guanxi, drew troop dispositions on the ground, and requested that a major garrison be established at Pingyang opposite their Pu Province, with deep ditches, high ramparts, and grain transported to fill it.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝深納之。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor deeply accepted this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor deeply accepted this.

manualTranslations.zh: 又願自居平陽，成此謀略。
manualTranslations.literal: He also wished to station himself at Pingyang and complete this strategy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also wished to station himself at Pingyang and complete this strategy.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝命元文遙與叔虎參謀，撰《平西策》一卷。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor ordered Yuan Wenyao and Shuhu to consult on the strategy and compose one scroll, Strategy for Pacifying the West.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Yuan Wenyao and Shuhu to consult on the strategy and compose one scroll, Strategy for Pacifying the West.

manualTranslations.zh: 未幾，帝崩，事寢。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long, the emperor died, and the matter was dropped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before long, the emperor died, and the matter was dropped.

manualTranslations.zh: 武成即位，拜儀同三司，判都官尚書，出爲金州刺史，遷太子詹事。

sourceRange.text: 道裕弟道虔，字慶祖。粗閑經史，兼通算術。尚孝文女濟南長公主，拜駙馬都尉。公主驕淫，聲穢遐邇，無疾暴薨，時雲道虔所害。宣武秘其事，不苦窮之。後靈太后追主薨事，黜道虔，令終身不仕。道虔外生李彧，尚莊帝姊豐亭公主，因相藉托。永安中，除輔國將軍、通直常侍。以議曆勳，賜爵臨淄伯。天平中，曆都官尚書、本州大中正，幽州刺史，加衛大將軍。卒官，贈尚書右僕射、司空公、瀛州刺史，諡曰文恭。

manualTranslations.zh: 祐以郡國雖有太學，縣黨宜有黌序，乃縣立講學，黨立教學，村立小學。
manualTranslations.literal: You held that although commanderies and principalities had the Imperial Academy, counties and districts should also have schools, so he established lecture schools in the counties, teaching schools in the districts, and elementary schools in the villages.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: You held that although commanderies and principalities had the Imperial Academy, counties and districts should also have schools, so he established lecture schools in the counties, teaching schools in the districts, and elementary schools in the villages.

manualTranslations.zh: 又令一家之中，自立一碓；
manualTranslations.literal: He also ordered each household to set up its own mortar;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also ordered each household to set up its own mortar;

manualTranslations.zh: 五家之外，共造一井，以給行客，不聽婦人寄舂取水。
manualTranslations.literal: and for every group of five households or more, they were to dig one well together to supply travelers, while women were not allowed to go elsewhere to have grain pounded or draw water.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: and for every group of five households or more, they were to dig one well together to supply travelers, while women were not allowed to go elsewhere to have grain pounded or draw water.

manualTranslations.zh: 又設禁賊之方，令五五相保，若盜發，則連其坐。
manualTranslations.literal: He also established a method for suppressing theft, ordering groups of five households to guarantee one another; if a theft broke out, they were jointly liable.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also established a method for suppressing theft, ordering groups of five households to guarantee one another; if a theft broke out, they were jointly liable.

manualTranslations.zh: 初似煩碎，後風化大行，寇盜止息。
manualTranslations.literal: At first this seemed troublesome and petty, but afterward instruction and transformation spread widely, and bandits and thieves ceased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At first this seemed troublesome and petty, but afterward instruction and transformation spread widely, and bandits and thieves ceased.

manualTranslations.zh: 轉宋王劉昶傅，以參定律令，賜帛粟馬等。
manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to be Tutor to Liu Chang, Prince of Song, and for participating in settling statutes and ordinances, he was granted silk, grain, horses, and other items.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was transferred to be Tutor to Liu Chang, Prince of Song, and for participating in settling statutes and ordinances, he was granted silk, grain, horses, and other items.

manualTranslations.zh: 昶以其舊官年耆，雅相祗重。
manualTranslations.literal: Chang treated him with refined reverence and respect because You was an old official and advanced in years.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chang treated him with refined reverence and respect because You was an old official and advanced in years.

manualTranslations.zh: 拜光祿大夫，傅如故。
manualTranslations.literal: You was appointed Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, remaining Tutor as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: You was appointed Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, remaining Tutor as before.

manualTranslations.zh: 昶薨，徵為宗正卿，而祐留連彭城，久不赴。
manualTranslations.literal: When Chang died, You was summoned as Director of the Imperial Clan, but he lingered in Pengcheng and for a long time did not go.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Chang died, You was summoned as Director of the Imperial Clan, but he lingered in Pengcheng and for a long time did not go.

manualTranslations.zh: 僕射李沖奏祐無事稽命，處刑三歲，以贖論，免卿任。
manualTranslations.literal: Vice Director Li Chong memorialized that You had delayed an order without cause; he was sentenced to three years of punishment, allowed to redeem it by payment, and removed from his directorship.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Vice Director Li Chong memorialized that You had delayed an order without cause; he was sentenced to three years of punishment, allowed to redeem it by payment, and removed from his directorship.

manualTranslations.zh: 復為光祿，卒。
manualTranslations.literal: He was again made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was again made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and died.

manualTranslations.zh: 太常諡曰煬侯。
manualTranslations.literal: The Chamberlain for Ceremonials gave him the posthumous name Marquis Yang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Chamberlain for Ceremonials gave him the posthumous name Marquis Yang.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔曰：「不遵上命曰靈，可諡為靈。」
manualTranslations.literal: The edict said: "Failing to obey commands from above is called Ling; he may receive the posthumous name Ling."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The edict said: "Failing to obey commands from above is called Ling; he may receive the posthumous name Ling."

sourceRange.text: 合弟秉，少有志氣，陽平王順之為定州，秉為衛軍府錄事，帶毋極令。時甄琛為長史，曾因公事，言競之間，以拳擊琛墜床。琛以本縣長，笑而不論。其豪率若此。彭城王勰行壽春，秉從行，招致壯俠，以為部下。勰目之，謂左右曰：「吾當寄膽氣於此人。」累遷廣平內史，大納財貨，為清論所鄙。後為燕州刺史，為杜洛周攻圍，堅守歷年。朝廷遣都督元譚赴救，譚敗，秉奔定州，坐免官。太昌中，除驃騎大將軍、儀同三司。頻以老病求解，永熙三年，去職。薨，贈尚書令、司徒公，諡曰靖穆。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xie watched him and said to those around him: “I should entrust courage and spirit to this man.”

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later, as Inspector of Yan Province, he was attacked and besieged by Du Luozhou and held firm for years.

manualTranslations.zh: 朝廷遣都督元譚赴救，譚敗，秉奔定州，坐免官。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: The court sent Commander Yuan Tan to hurry to his rescue; when Tan was defeated, Bing fled to Ding Province and was dismissed from office for the offense.

manualTranslations.zh: 太昌中，除驃騎大將軍、儀同三司。
manualTranslations.literal: During Taichang, he was appointed General of Agile Cavalry and Equal in Honor to the Three Excellencies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Taichang, he was appointed General of Agile Cavalry and Equal in Honor to the Three Excellencies.

manualTranslations.zh: 頻以老病求解，永熙三年，去職。
manualTranslations.literal: He repeatedly requested release on grounds of age and illness, and in the third year of Yongxi he left office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He repeatedly requested release on grounds of age and illness, and in the third year of Yongxi he left office.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨，贈尚書令、司徒公，諡曰靖穆。
manualTranslations.literal: When he died, he was posthumously granted Director of the Masters of Writing and Minister over the Masses, with the posthumous name Jingmu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he died, he was posthumously granted Director of the Masters of Writing and Minister over the Masses, with the posthumous name Jingmu.

sourceRange.text: 祖遭，字景遇，位鉅鹿令。

localRange.text: 祖遭，字景遇，位钜鹿令。

context.afterSource: 父綽，少孤，學行修明，有名於世。

manualTranslations.literal: His grandfather Zao, styled Jingyu, served as Magistrate of Julu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His grandfather Zao, styled Jingyu, served as Magistrate of Julu.

sourceRange.text: 恭帝元年，周文欲開梁、漢舊路，乃命猷督儀同劉道通等五人開通車路，鑿山堙谷五百餘里，至於梁州。即以猷為都督、梁州刺史。及周文崩，始、利、沙、興等諸州阻兵為逆，信、合、開、楚四州亦叛，唯梁州境內，人無二心。利州刺史崔士謙請援，猷遣兵六千赴之。信州糧盡，猷為送米四千斛。於是二鎮獲全。猷第二女，帝養為己女，封富平公主。周明帝即位，徵拜禦正中大夫。時依《周禮》稱天王，又不建年號。猷以為世有澆淳，故帝王因以沿革。今天子稱王，不足以威天下。請遵秦漢，稱皇帝，建年號。朝議從之。除司會中大夫，禦正如故。明帝崩，遺詔立武帝。晉公護謂猷曰：「今奉遵遺旨。君以為何如？」對曰：「殷道尊尊，周道親親，今朝廷既遵《周禮》，無容輙違此義。」雖不行，時稱其守正。

context.beforeSource: 十七年，進侍中、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、本州大中正，賜姓宇文氏。
context.afterSource: 及陳將蔡皎來附，晉公護議欲南伐，公卿莫敢言。

manualTranslations.zh: 恭帝元年，周文欲開梁、漢舊路，乃命猷督儀同劉道通等五人開通車路，鑿山堙谷五百餘里，至於梁州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Emperor Gong, Zhou Wen wanted to open the old Liang-Han route, so he ordered You to supervise Equal-in-Honor Liu Daotong and five others in opening a cart road, cutting through mountains and filling valleys for more than five hundred li until they reached Liang Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Emperor Gong, Zhou Wen wanted to open the old Liang-Han route, so he ordered You to supervise Equal-in-Honor Liu Daotong and five others in opening a cart road, cutting through mountains and filling valleys for more than five hundred li until they reached Liang Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 即以猷為都督、梁州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: He then made You Commander-in-Chief and Inspector of Liang Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He then made You Commander-in-Chief and Inspector of Liang Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 及周文崩，始、利、沙、興等諸州阻兵為逆，信、合、開、楚四州亦叛，唯梁州境內，人無二心。
manualTranslations.literal: When Zhou Wen died, Shi, Li, Sha, Xing, and other provinces raised troops in rebellion, and Xin, He, Kai, and Chu also rebelled; only within Liang Province did the people have no divided heart.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhou Wen died, Shi, Li, Sha, Xing, and other provinces raised troops in rebellion, and Xin, He, Kai, and Chu also rebelled; only within Liang Province did the people have no divided heart.

manualTranslations.zh: 利州刺史崔士謙請援，猷遣兵六千赴之。
manualTranslations.literal: Cui Shiqian, Inspector of Li Province, requested aid, and You sent six thousand troops to him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cui Shiqian, Inspector of Li Province, requested aid, and You sent six thousand troops to him.

manualTranslations.zh: 信州糧盡，猷為送米四千斛。
manualTranslations.literal: When Xin Province's grain was exhausted, You sent it four thousand hu of rice.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Xin Province's grain was exhausted, You sent it four thousand hu of rice.

manualTranslations.zh: 於是二鎮獲全。
manualTranslations.literal: As a result, the two garrisons were preserved.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As a result, the two garrisons were preserved.

manualTranslations.zh: 猷第二女，帝養為己女，封富平公主。
manualTranslations.literal: Cui You's second daughter was raised by the emperor as his own daughter and enfeoffed as Princess Fuping.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cui You's second daughter was raised by the emperor as his own daughter and enfeoffed as Princess Fuping.

manualTranslations.zh: 周明帝即位，徵拜禦正中大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Ming of Zhou took the throne, You was summoned and appointed Middle Grand Master of Imperial Rectification.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming of Zhou took the throne, You was summoned and appointed Middle Grand Master of Imperial Rectification.

manualTranslations.zh: 時依《周禮》稱天王，又不建年號。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time, following the Rites of Zhou, the ruler was styled Heavenly King and no reign title was established.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time, following the Rites of Zhou, the ruler was styled Heavenly King and no reign title was established.

manualTranslations.zh: 猷以為世有澆淳，故帝王因以沿革。
manualTranslations.literal: You believed that ages differ in coarseness and purity, and therefore emperors and kings make continuities and changes accordingly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: You believed that ages differ in coarseness and purity, and therefore emperors and kings make continuities and changes accordingly.

manualTranslations.zh: 今天子稱王，不足以威天下。
manualTranslations.literal: For the present Son of Heaven to be called king was not enough to awe the realm.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For the present Son of Heaven to be called king was not enough to awe the realm.

manualTranslations.zh: 請遵秦漢，稱皇帝，建年號。
manualTranslations.literal: He requested that they follow Qin and Han, use the title emperor, and establish a reign title.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He requested that they follow Qin and Han, use the title emperor, and establish a reign title.

manualTranslations.zh: 朝議從之。
manualTranslations.literal: The court deliberations followed this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The court deliberations followed this.

manualTranslations.zh: 除司會中大夫，禦正如故。
manualTranslations.literal: He was appointed Middle Grand Master of Accounts, while remaining Imperial Rectifier as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was appointed Middle Grand Master of Accounts, while remaining Imperial Rectifier as before.

manualTranslations.zh: 明帝崩，遺詔立武帝。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Ming died, his posthumous edict established Emperor Wu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming died, his posthumous edict established Emperor Wu.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉公護謂猷曰：「今奉遵遺旨。
manualTranslations.literal: Duke Hu of Jin said to You: “We now respectfully follow the late command.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Duke Hu of Jin said to You: “We now respectfully follow the late command.

manualTranslations.zh: 君以為何如？」
manualTranslations.literal: What do you think?”
manualTranslations.idiomatic: What do you think?”

manualTranslations.zh: 對曰：「殷道尊尊，周道親親，今朝廷既遵《周禮》，無容輙違此義。」
manualTranslations.literal: You replied: “The way of Yin honored the honored; the way of Zhou treated kin as kin. Since the court now follows the Rites of Zhou, there is no room to lightly violate this principle.”
manualTranslations.idiomatic: You replied: “The way of Yin honored the honored; the way of Zhou treated kin as kin. Since the court now follows the Rites of Zhou, there is no room to lightly violate this principle.”

manualTranslations.zh: 雖不行，時稱其守正。
manualTranslations.literal: Although it was not carried out, people at the time praised him for holding to what was right.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Although it was not carried out, people at the time praised him for holding to what was right.

sourceRange.text: 弘升字上客，在周為右侍上士。從平尉遲迥，以功拜上儀同。尋加上開府，封黃台縣侯。隋文受禪，進爵為公，授驃騎將軍。曆慈鄭二州刺史、襄州總管。以戚屬故，待遇隆重。及河南王妃罪廢，弘升亦免官。煬帝即位，曆冀州刺史、信都太守，位金紫光祿大夫，轉涿郡太守。遼東之役，檢校左武衛大將軍事，指平壤。與宇文述等同敗，奔還，發病卒。

manualTranslations.zh: 弘升字上客，在周為右侍上士。
manualTranslations.literal: Hongsheng was styled Shangke. Under Zhou he served as Right Attending Senior Serviceman.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hongsheng was styled Shangke. Under Zhou he served as Right Attending Senior Serviceman.

manualTranslations.zh: 從平尉遲迥，以功拜上儀同。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed in pacifying Yuchi Jiong and for his merit was appointed Upper Equal in Honor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He followed in pacifying Yuchi Jiong and for his merit was appointed Upper Equal in Honor.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋加上開府，封黃台縣侯。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was additionally made Upper Opening Office and enfeoffed as Marquis of Huangtai County.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was additionally made Upper Opening Office and enfeoffed as Marquis of Huangtai County.

manualTranslations.zh: 隋文受禪，進爵為公，授驃騎將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Wen of Sui accepted the abdication, Hongsheng's title was advanced to duke and he was appointed General of Agile Cavalry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen of Sui accepted the abdication, Hongsheng's title was advanced to duke and he was appointed General of Agile Cavalry.

manualTranslations.zh: 曆慈鄭二州刺史、襄州總管。
manualTranslations.literal: He successively served as Inspector of Ci and Zheng Provinces and Area Commander of Xiang Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He successively served as Inspector of Ci and Zheng Provinces and Area Commander of Xiang Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 以戚屬故，待遇隆重。
manualTranslations.literal: Because he was an imperial relative, he was treated with great favor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because he was an imperial relative, he was treated with great favor.

manualTranslations.zh: 及河南王妃罪廢，弘升亦免官。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Princess Consort of the Prince of Henan was deposed for an offense, Hongsheng was also removed from office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Princess Consort of the Prince of Henan was deposed for an offense, Hongsheng was also removed from office.

manualTranslations.zh: 煬帝即位，曆冀州刺史、信都太守，位金紫光祿大夫，轉涿郡太守。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Yang took the throne, Hongsheng successively served as Inspector of Ji Province and Administrator of Xindu, held the rank Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon, and was transferred to Administrator of Zhuo Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yang took the throne, Hongsheng successively served as Inspector of Ji Province and Administrator of Xindu, held the rank Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon, and was transferred to Administrator of Zhuo Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 遼東之役，檢校左武衛大將軍事，指平壤。
manualTranslations.literal: During the Liaodong campaign, he provisionally oversaw the affairs of Grand General of the Left Martial Guard and headed toward Pyongyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Liaodong campaign, he provisionally oversaw the affairs of Grand General of the Left Martial Guard and headed toward Pyongyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 與宇文述等同敗，奔還，發病卒。
manualTranslations.literal: He was defeated together with Yuwen Shu and the others, fled back, fell ill, and died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was defeated together with Yuwen Shu and the others, fled back, fell ill, and died.

localRange.text: 求之古義，竊為當矣。

sourceRange.text: 子雄少慷慨有大志，陝州破，因隨周軍入長安。家世並以學業自通，子雄獨習騎射。其兄子旦讓之曰：「棄文尚武，非士大夫素業。」子雄曰：「自古誠臣貴仕，文武不備而能濟功業者鮮矣。既文且武，兄何病焉。」子旦無以應。仕周，累遷小賓部。後從達奚武與齊人戰於芒山，諸軍大破，子雄所領獨全。累遷涼州總管長史。從滕王逌破吐谷渾于青海，以功加上儀同。宣帝即位，行軍總管韋孝寬略定淮南，拜亳州刺史。隋文帝總百揆，徵爲司會中大夫，以淮南功，加位上開府。及受禪，拜鴻臚卿，進爵高都郡公。及晉王廣出鎮并州，以子雄爲河北行台兵部尚書。

manualTranslations.zh: 子雄少慷慨有大志，陝州破，因隨周軍入長安。
manualTranslations.literal: In youth Zixiong was generous-spirited and had great ambitions. When Shan Province fell, he followed the Zhou army into Chang'an.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In youth Zixiong was generous-spirited and had great ambitions. When Shan Province fell, he followed the Zhou army into Chang'an.

manualTranslations.zh: 家世並以學業自通，子雄獨習騎射。
manualTranslations.literal: His family had all made their way through learning, but Zixiong alone practiced riding and archery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His family had all made their way through learning, but Zixiong alone practiced riding and archery.

manualTranslations.zh: 其兄子旦讓之曰：「棄文尚武，非士大夫素業。」
manualTranslations.literal: His elder brother Zidan reproved him, saying: "To abandon letters and esteem arms is not the customary calling of a gentleman."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His elder brother Zidan reproved him, saying: "To abandon letters and esteem arms is not the customary calling of a gentleman."

manualTranslations.zh: 子雄曰：「自古誠臣貴仕，文武不備而能濟功業者鮮矣。
manualTranslations.literal: Zixiong said: "Since antiquity, among sincere ministers and honored officials, few have completed achievements without being prepared in both civil and martial arts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zixiong said: "Since antiquity, among sincere ministers and honored officials, few have completed achievements without being prepared in both civil and martial arts.

manualTranslations.zh: 既文且武，兄何病焉。」
manualTranslations.literal: If one is both civil and martial, what fault does elder brother find in it?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If one is both civil and martial, what fault does elder brother find in it?"

manualTranslations.zh: 子旦無以應。
manualTranslations.literal: Zidan had no reply.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zidan had no reply.

manualTranslations.zh: 仕周，累遷小賓部。
manualTranslations.literal: He served Zhou and was promoted repeatedly to the Minor Ministry of Guests.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He served Zhou and was promoted repeatedly to the Minor Ministry of Guests.

manualTranslations.zh: 後從達奚武與齊人戰於芒山，諸軍大破，子雄所領獨全。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he followed Daxi Wu in battle against Qi forces at Mangshan; the armies were badly defeated, but the troops Zixiong commanded alone remained intact.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he followed Daxi Wu in battle against Qi forces at Mangshan; the armies were badly defeated, but the troops Zixiong commanded alone remained intact.

manualTranslations.zh: 累遷涼州總管長史。
manualTranslations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to Chief Clerk of the Liang Province Area Command.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was promoted repeatedly to Chief Clerk of the Liang Province Area Command.

manualTranslations.zh: 從滕王逌破吐谷渾于青海，以功加上儀同。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed Prince You of Teng in defeating Tuyuhun at Qinghai and for his merit was additionally made Upper Equal in Honor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He followed Prince You of Teng in defeating Tuyuhun at Qinghai and for his merit was additionally made Upper Equal in Honor.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣帝即位，行軍總管韋孝寬略定淮南，拜亳州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xuan took the throne, Campaign Commander Wei Xiaokuan campaigned through and pacified Huainan, and Zixiong was appointed Inspector of Bo Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuan took the throne, Campaign Commander Wei Xiaokuan campaigned through and pacified Huainan, and Zixiong was appointed Inspector of Bo Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 隋文帝總百揆，徵爲司會中大夫，以淮南功，加位上開府。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Wen of Sui took charge of the hundred offices, Zixiong was summoned as Middle Grand Master of Accounts and, for his merit in Huainan, was additionally ranked Upper Opening Office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen of Sui took charge of the hundred offices, Zixiong was summoned as Middle Grand Master of Accounts and, for his merit in Huainan, was additionally ranked Upper Opening Office.

manualTranslations.zh: 及受禪，拜鴻臚卿，進爵高都郡公。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Wen accepted the abdication, Zixiong was appointed Chamberlain for Dependencies, and his title was advanced to Duke of Gaodu Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen accepted the abdication, Zixiong was appointed Chamberlain for Dependencies, and his title was advanced to Duke of Gaodu Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 及晉王廣出鎮并州，以子雄爲河北行台兵部尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: When Prince Guang of Jin went out to garrison Bing Province, Zixiong was made Minister of War in the Hebei Branch Secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Prince Guang of Jin went out to garrison Bing Province, Zixiong was made Minister of War in the Hebei Branch Secretariat.

sourceRange.text: 祖升弟祖勳，位給事黃門侍郎。齊文宣以其女爲濟南王妃。除侍中，封丹楊郡王，尋改封公。濟南即位，除趙州刺史。濟南廢，還除金紫光祿大夫。大寧中，昭信後有寵于武成，除齊州刺史。贓賄狼籍，坐免官。復起爲光州刺史。祖勳性貪慢，兼其妻崔氏驕豪干政，時論鄙之。女侍中陸媼母元氏，即祖勳妻姨，爲此附會，又除西兗州刺史、殿中尚書。祖勳無才幹，自少及長，居官無可稱述。卒，贈尚書右僕射。武平中，將封後兄君璧等爲王，還復祖勳王爵。其弟祖欽封竟陵王，位光祿卿。祖勳第三弟祖納，兄弟中最有識尚，以經史被知，卒于散騎常侍。

sourceRange.text: 盧昶之在朐山也，肇諫曰：「朐山蕞爾，僻在海濱，於我非急，於賊爲利。如聞賊將屢以宿豫求易朐山，持此無用之地，復彼舊有之疆，兵役時解，其利爲大。」帝將從之，尋而昶敗。遷侍中。梁軍主徐玄明斬其青、冀二州刺史張稷首，以鬱州內附。朝議遣兵赴援，肇表以爲不宜勞師爭海島之地，帝不納。及大將軍高肇伐蜀，肇又陳願俟後圖，又不納。明帝即位，遷中書令、相州刺史，有惠政。再遷尚書右僕射。肇於吏事斷決不速，主者諮呈反覆，至於再三，必窮其理，然後下筆。雖寵勢幹請，終無回撓，方正之操，時人服之。及元叉廢靈太后，將害太傅、清河王懌，乃集公卿會議其事。于時，君官莫不失色順旨，肇獨抗言，以爲不可，終不下署。卒，諡文貞公。

context.afterSource: 肇外寬柔，內剛直，耽好經傳，手不釋書。

sourceRange.text: 道衡不樂王府，用漢王諒之计，遂出江陵道而去。尋詔徵還，直内史省。晉王由是銜之。然愛其才，猶頗見禮。後數歲，授内史侍郎，加上仪同三司。道衡每构文，必隐坐空斋，蹋壁而卧，闻户外有人便怒，其沈思如此。帝每曰："道衡作文书称我意。"然诫之以迂诞。后帝谓杨素、牛弘曰：道衡老矣，驱使勤劳，宜使朱门陈戟。"于是进上开府，赐物百段。道衡辞以无功。帝曰："尔久劳阶陛，国家大事，皆尔宣行，岂非尔功也？

sourceRange.text: 太和元年，宋葭蘆戍主楊文度遣弟鼠據仇池，詔懷喜討鼠。鼠棄城南走。進次濁水，遂軍於覆津。文度將強大黑固守津道，懷喜部分將士，擊大黑走之。追奔，攻拔葭蘆城，斬文度，傳首京師。詔慰勉之。又詔于駱穀築城，懷喜表求待來年築城。詔責之曰：「若不時築，築而不成，成而不固，以軍法繩之。」南天水人柳旃據險不順，懷喜討滅之。後為豫州刺史，詔讓其在州寬怠，以飲酒廢事，威不禁下，遣使就州，決以杖罰。卒，諡曰恭公。子承宗襲。

manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Taihe, Yang Wendu, the Song garrison commander at Jialu, sent his younger brother Shu to occupy Qiuchi, and an edict ordered Huaixi to campaign against Shu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taihe, Yang Wendu, the Song commander at the Jialu garrison, sent his younger brother Shu to occupy Qiuchi; Huaixi was ordered to attack him.

manualTranslations.literal: Shu abandoned the city and fled south.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shu abandoned the city and fled south.

manualTranslations.literal: Advancing, Huaixi halted at Zhuoshui and then encamped at Fujin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Huaixi advanced to Zhuoshui and made camp at Fujin.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wendu’s general Qiang Dahei held the ford road, but Huaixi deployed his men, attacked him, and drove him off.

manualTranslations.zh: 追奔，攻拔葭蘆城，斬文度，傳首京師。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He pursued the rout, captured Jialu, beheaded Wendu, and sent the head to the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔慰勉之。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chiwen and Mo Zhen, Duke of Linhuai, attacked and defeated them.

manualTranslations.zh: 天安元年卒，長子萬護讓爵于弟翰。
manualTranslations.literal: He died in the first year of Tian’an; his eldest son Wanhu yielded the title to his younger brother Han.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in the first year of Tian’an. His eldest son Wanhu yielded the title to his younger brother Han.

manualTranslations.zh: 于時讓者唯萬護及元氏侯趙辟惡子元伯讓其弟次興，朝廷義而許之。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time the only men who yielded were Wanhu and Yuanbo, son of Zhao Bi’e, Marquis of Yuanshi, who yielded to his younger brother Cixing; the court deemed this righteous and permitted it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time, the only such acts of yielding were Wanhu’s and that of Yuanbo, son of Zhao Bi’e, Marquis of Yuanshi, who yielded to his younger brother Cixing; the court considered both righteous and allowed them.

localRange.text: 韓茂皮豹子封敕文呂羅漢孔伯恭田益宗孟表奚康生楊大眼崔延伯李叔仁韓茂皮豹子封敕文呂羅漢孔伯恭田益宗孟表奚康生楊大眼崔延伯李叔仁韓茂，字元興，安定安武人也。

context.afterSource: 父耆字黃耇，永興中，自赫連屈丐來降，位常山太守，假安武侯，仍居常山之九門。

sourceRange.text: 子澤，頗有文學。齊孝昭初，為齋帥，奏舍人。孝昭崩，魏收議為恭烈皇帝，澤正色抗論曰：「魏收死後，亦不肯為恭烈之諡，何容以擬大行。且比皇太后不豫，先帝飧寢失常，聖躬貶損，今者易名，必須加孝。」遂改為孝昭。因此忤旨，出為廣州司馬。尋歷位中書侍郎，兼給事黃門侍郎，以漏泄免。後為散騎侍郎，尋為誹毀大臣趙彥深等，兼詠石榴詩，微以托意，有人以奏武成，武成決杖六十，髡頭除名。後主即位，為清河郡守。與祖珽有舊，珽奏除尚書左丞，又引為兼黃門。執政疾其祖珽之党，與崔季舒等同見誅。

context.beforeSource: 贈東雍州刺史。
context.afterSource: 澤本勁直，無所回避，及被出追還，折節和光。

manualTranslations.zh: 子澤，頗有文學。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Ze had considerable literary learning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Ze had considerable literary learning.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊孝昭初，為齋帥，奏舍人。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Xiaozhao of Qi, he served as a zhaishuai and was recommended as a palace attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in Emperor Xiaozhao of Qi's reign, he served as a palace guard officer and was recommended as a palace attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝昭崩，魏收議為恭烈皇帝，澤正色抗論曰：「魏收死後，亦不肯為恭烈之諡，何容以擬大行。
manualTranslations.literal: When Xiaozhao died, Wei Shou proposed making him Emperor Gonglie; Ze, with stern expression, argued against it, saying: "After Wei Shou dies, even he would not be willing to have Gonglie as a posthumous title, so how could it be proposed for the deceased emperor?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Xiaozhao died, Wei Shou proposed the posthumous title Emperor Gonglie. Ze sternly objected: "After Wei Shou dies, even he would not accept Gonglie as his own posthumous title; how can it be proposed for the departed emperor?

manualTranslations.zh: 且比皇太后不豫，先帝飧寢失常，聖躬貶損，今者易名，必須加孝。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, recently when the empress dowager was unwell, the late emperor ate and slept irregularly and reduced his sacred person; now, in changing his name, xiao must be added."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Moreover, when the empress dowager was recently unwell, the late emperor neglected food and sleep and wore himself down. Now, in assigning his posthumous name, xiao must be included."

manualTranslations.zh: 」遂改為孝昭。
manualTranslations.literal: It was therefore changed to Xiaozhao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The title was therefore changed to Xiaozhao.

manualTranslations.zh: 因此忤旨，出為廣州司馬。
manualTranslations.literal: Because of this he offended imperial wishes and was sent out as Sima of Guangzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For this he offended the emperor and was sent out as Sima of Guangzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋歷位中書侍郎，兼給事黃門侍郎，以漏泄免。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he served successively as Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrently Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate, but was dismissed for leaking secrets.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He later served as Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrently Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate, but was dismissed for leaking confidential matters.

manualTranslations.zh: 後為散騎侍郎，尋為誹毀大臣趙彥深等，兼詠石榴詩，微以托意，有人以奏武成，武成決杖六十，髡頭除名。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he became Cavalier Attendant; soon, because he slandered great ministers such as Zhao Yanshen and also composed a poem on the pomegranate, subtly lodging his meaning in it, someone reported this to Wucheng, and Wucheng sentenced him to sixty strokes of the rod, shaved his head, and removed his name.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later, as Cavalier Attendant, he was accused of slandering Zhao Yanshen and other senior ministers, and of hinting at his views in a poem on pomegranates. Someone reported it to Emperor Wucheng, who sentenced him to sixty strokes, had his head shaved, and removed him from office.

manualTranslations.zh: 後主即位，為清河郡守。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Later Lord ascended the throne, he became Governor of Qinghe Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the Later Lord came to the throne, Ze became governor of Qinghe Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 與祖珽有舊，珽奏除尚書左丞，又引為兼黃門。
manualTranslations.literal: Because he had old ties with Zu Ting, Ting memorialized to appoint him Left Assistant of the Department of State Affairs and again drew him in as acting Yellow Gate attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because of his old connection with Zu Ting, Zu Ting memorialized to have him appointed Left Assistant in the Department of State Affairs and then brought him in as acting Yellow Gate attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 執政疾其祖珽之党，與崔季舒等同見誅。
manualTranslations.literal: Those in power hated him as one of Zu Ting's faction, and he was executed together with Cui Jishu and the others.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The men in power hated him as part of Zu Ting's faction, and he was executed together with Cui Jishu and the others.

sourceRange.text: 十六年，遷河南郡守，仍鎮孔城。廢帝元年，進使持節、車騎大將軍、儀同三司、散騎常侍。周孝閔帝踐阼，進爵為子。寬在孔城十三年，與齊洛州刺史獨孤永業相對。永業有計謀，多譎詐。或聲言春發，秋乃出兵；或掩蔽消息，倏忽而至。寬每揣知其情，出兵邀擊，無不克之。天和三年，除溫州刺史。初，陳氏與周通和，每修聘好。自華皎附後，乃圖寇掠。沔州既接敵境，於是以寬為沔州刺史。陳將程靈洗攻之，力屈城陷。陳人乃執寬至揚州，尋被送嶺外，經數載，復還建鄴，遂卒于江左。子義宣後從禦正杜果使于陳，始得將寬柩還。隋開皇元年，文帝詔贈襄、郢二州刺史。義宣，位司金二命士、合江令。

context.beforeSource: 」乃手書署寬名下，授持節、帥都督，封夏陽縣男，即除孔城城主。
context.afterSource: 寬弟漢，字仲霄。

manualTranslations.zh: 十六年，遷河南郡守，仍鎮孔城。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixteenth year, he was transferred to be Governor of Henan Commandery and continued to garrison Kongcheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, he became governor of Henan Commandery while continuing to garrison Kongcheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 廢帝元年，進使持節、車騎大將軍、儀同三司、散騎常侍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of the Deposed Emperor, he was advanced to Commissioner with the Staff, General of Chariots and Cavalry, Equal to the Three Offices, and Cavalier Attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Deposed Emperor, he was promoted to Commissioner with the Staff, General of Chariots and Cavalry, Equal to the Three Offices, and Cavalier Attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 周孝閔帝踐阼，進爵為子。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xiaomin of Zhou ascended the throne, his title was advanced to viscount.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaomin of Zhou ascended the throne, his noble rank was advanced to viscount.

manualTranslations.zh: 寬在孔城十三年，與齊洛州刺史獨孤永業相對。
manualTranslations.literal: Kuan was at Kongcheng for thirteen years, facing Dugu Yongye, Inspector of Qi's Luozhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Kuan held Kongcheng for thirteen years opposite Dugu Yongye, the Qi inspector of Luozhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 永業有計謀，多譎詐。
manualTranslations.literal: Yongye had schemes and plans and was much given to deception.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yongye was strategic and highly deceptive.

manualTranslations.zh: 或聲言春發，秋乃出兵；
manualTranslations.literal: Sometimes he announced that he would set out in spring, but only sent troops in autumn;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sometimes he announced a spring campaign but sent troops only in autumn;

manualTranslations.zh: 或掩蔽消息，倏忽而至。
manualTranslations.literal: sometimes he concealed all news and arrived suddenly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: at other times he concealed all word of his movements and arrived without warning.

manualTranslations.zh: 寬每揣知其情，出兵邀擊，無不克之。
manualTranslations.literal: Kuan always gauged and knew his intent, sent troops to intercept him, and defeated him every time.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Kuan always read his intentions, sent troops to intercept him, and defeated every attempt.

manualTranslations.zh: 天和三年，除溫州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Tianhe, he was appointed Inspector of Wenzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tianhe, he was appointed inspector of Wenzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，陳氏與周通和，每修聘好。
manualTranslations.literal: At first, the Chen house was in peaceful relations with Zhou and regularly maintained friendly embassies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At first Chen and Zhou were at peace and regularly exchanged friendly embassies.

manualTranslations.zh: 自華皎附後，乃圖寇掠。
manualTranslations.literal: After Hua Jiao came over, they then planned raids and plunder.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Hua Jiao defected, Chen began planning raids.

manualTranslations.zh: 沔州既接敵境，於是以寬為沔州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: Since Mianzhou bordered enemy territory, Kuan was therefore made Inspector of Mianzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because Mianzhou bordered enemy territory, Kuan was made its inspector.

manualTranslations.zh: 陳將程靈洗攻之，力屈城陷。
manualTranslations.literal: The Chen general Cheng Lingxi attacked it; their strength gave out and the city fell.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Chen general Cheng Lingxi attacked; Kuan's forces were exhausted, and the city fell.

manualTranslations.zh: 陳人乃執寬至揚州，尋被送嶺外，經數載，復還建鄴，遂卒于江左。
manualTranslations.literal: The Chen people then seized Kuan and took him to Yangzhou; soon he was sent beyond the passes, and after several years returned to Jianye, where he died east of the Yangzi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Chen seized Kuan and took him to Yangzhou. He was soon sent beyond the southern ranges; after several years he returned to Jianye and died in the south.

manualTranslations.zh: 子義宣後從禦正杜果使于陳，始得將寬柩還。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Yixuan later accompanied Yuzheng Du Guo on an embassy to Chen, and only then was able to bring Kuan's coffin back.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Yixuan later accompanied Yuzheng Du Guo on an embassy to Chen, and only then was able to bring Kuan's coffin home.

manualTranslations.zh: 隋開皇元年，文帝詔贈襄、郢二州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Sui's Kaihuang era, Emperor Wen issued an edict posthumously appointing him Inspector of Xiang and Ying provinces.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kaihuang under Sui, Emperor Wen posthumously appointed him inspector of Xiang and Ying provinces.

manualTranslations.zh: 義宣，位司金二命士、合江令。
manualTranslations.literal: Yixuan held office as Sijin Erming Shi and magistrate of Hejiang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yixuan held office as Sijin Erming Shi and magistrate of Hejiang.

localRange.text: 裴駿裴延雋裴佗裴果裴寬裴俠裴文舉裴仁基裴駿從孫敬憲莊伯從弟安祖裴延俊裴佗子讓之孫矩皇甫和裴果裴寬裴俠子祥肅裴文舉裴仁基裴駿，字神駒，小名皮，河東聞喜人也。

context.afterSource: 父雙碩，位恆農太守、安邑子，贈東雍州刺史、聞喜侯。

sourceRange.text: 文舉少喪父，其兄又在山東，唯與弟璣幼相訓養，友愛甚篤。璣又早亡，文舉撫視遺孤，逾于己子，時人以此稱之。初，文舉叔父季和為曲沃令，終於聞喜川；而叔母韋氏卒于正平縣，屬東西分隔，韋氏墳隴，遂在齊境。及文舉在本州，每加賞募。齊人感其孝義，潛相要結，以韋柩西歸，竟得合葬。六年，除南青州刺史。宣政元年，卒於位。子胄嗣，位至大都督。子神，安邑通守。有子知禮。

context.beforeSource: 六年，入為司憲中大夫，進爵為伯，轉軍司馬。
context.afterSource: 裴仁基，字德本，河東人也。

manualTranslations.zh: 文舉少喪父，其兄又在山東，唯與弟璣幼相訓養，友愛甚篤。
manualTranslations.literal: Wenju lost his father when young, and his elder brother was also in Shandong; only he and his younger brother Ji instructed and raised each other from childhood, and their fraternal affection was very deep.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wenju lost his father young, and his elder brother was in Shandong, so he and his younger brother Ji grew up instructing and caring for one another with deep affection.

manualTranslations.zh: 璣又早亡，文舉撫視遺孤，逾于己子，時人以此稱之。
manualTranslations.literal: Ji also died early; Wenju cared for his orphaned children more than his own sons, and people of the time praised him for this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ji too died young, and Wenju cared for Ji's orphans even more than for his own sons; people of the time praised him for it.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，文舉叔父季和為曲沃令，終於聞喜川；
manualTranslations.literal: Earlier, Wenju's uncle Jihe was magistrate of Quwo and died at Wenxi River;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier, Wenju's uncle Jihe had served as magistrate of Quwo and died at Wenxi River;

manualTranslations.zh: 而叔母韋氏卒于正平縣，屬東西分隔，韋氏墳隴，遂在齊境。
manualTranslations.literal: his aunt Lady Wei died in Zhengping County, and because east and west were divided, Lady Wei's grave mound lay in Qi territory.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: his aunt, Lady Wei, died in Zhengping County, and because east and west were divided, her grave lay inside Qi territory.

manualTranslations.zh: 及文舉在本州，每加賞募。
manualTranslations.literal: When Wenju served in his home province, he repeatedly offered rewards to recruit help.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Wenju later served in his home province, he repeatedly offered rewards for help.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊人感其孝義，潛相要結，以韋柩西歸，竟得合葬。
manualTranslations.literal: People of Qi were moved by his filial righteousness and secretly made arrangements with one another, so that Lady Wei's coffin returned west and at last she could be buried together with her husband.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: People in Qi were moved by his filial devotion and quietly arranged for Lady Wei's coffin to be returned west, so she was finally buried together with her husband.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，除南青州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year, he was appointed Inspector of Southern Qingzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, he was appointed inspector of Southern Qingzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣政元年，卒於位。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Xuanzheng, he died in office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuanzheng, he died in office.

manualTranslations.zh: 子胄嗣，位至大都督。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Zhou inherited and reached the office of Grand Commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Zhou inherited and rose to Grand Commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 子神，安邑通守。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Shen was Tongshou of Anyi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Shen served as tongshou of Anyi.

manualTranslations.zh: 有子知禮。
manualTranslations.literal: He had a son, Zhili.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He had a son, Zhili.

sourceRange.text: 時突厥強盛，都藍可汗妻大義公主即宇文氏女，由是數為邊患。後因公主與從胡私通，長孫晟先發其事，矩請出使說都藍，顯戳宇文。上從之，竟如其言。公主見殺後，都藍與突利可汗構難，屢犯亭鄣。詔太平公史萬歲為行軍總管，出定襄道，以矩為行軍長史，破達頭可汗于塞外。萬歲被誅，功竟不錄。上以啟人可汗初附，令矩撫慰之。還，為尚書左丞。其年，文獻皇后崩，太常舊無儀注，矩與牛弘、李百藥等據齊禮參定。轉吏部侍郎，名為稱職。煬帝即位，營建東都，矩職修府省，九旬功就。

context.beforeSource: 除戶部侍郎，遷內吏侍郎。
context.afterSource: 時西域諸蕃多至張掖與中國交市，帝令矩掌其事。

manualTranslations.zh: 時突厥強盛，都藍可汗妻大義公主即宇文氏女，由是數為邊患。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time the Turks were strong and flourishing; Dulan Qaghan's wife, Princess Dayi, was a daughter of the Yuwen clan, and because of this they repeatedly caused trouble on the frontier.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time the Turks were powerful. Dulan Qaghan's wife, Princess Dayi, was a daughter of the Yuwen clan, and they repeatedly troubled the frontier.

manualTranslations.zh: 後因公主與從胡私通，長孫晟先發其事，矩請出使說都藍，顯戳宇文。
manualTranslations.literal: Later, because the princess had illicit relations with a subordinate Hu, Changsun Sheng first exposed the matter; Ju requested to go as envoy to persuade Dulan and publicly execute the Yuwen woman.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later, after the princess had an illicit affair with a subordinate Hu, Changsun Sheng exposed the matter. Ju requested permission to go as envoy, persuade Dulan, and publicly execute the Yuwen woman.

manualTranslations.zh: 上從之，竟如其言。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor followed this, and in the end it was as he had said.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed, and events unfolded as Ju had predicted.

manualTranslations.zh: 公主見殺後，都藍與突利可汗構難，屢犯亭鄣。
manualTranslations.literal: After the princess was killed, Dulan and Tuli Qaghan formed a conflict and repeatedly violated the frontier posts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the princess was killed, Dulan and Tuli Qaghan fell into conflict and repeatedly raided the frontier posts.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔太平公史萬歲為行軍總管，出定襄道，以矩為行軍長史，破達頭可汗于塞外。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict made Shi Wansui, Duke of Taiping, campaign commander to go out by the Dingxiang route, with Ju as campaign chief clerk; they defeated Datou Qaghan beyond the frontier.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Shi Wansui, Duke of Taiping, as campaign commander on the Dingxiang route, with Ju as his chief clerk; they defeated Datou Qaghan beyond the frontier.

manualTranslations.zh: 萬歲被誅，功竟不錄。
manualTranslations.literal: When Wansui was executed, the merit was ultimately not recorded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Wansui was executed, the achievement was never recorded.

manualTranslations.zh: 上以啟人可汗初附，令矩撫慰之。
manualTranslations.literal: Because Qimin Qaghan had newly submitted, the emperor ordered Ju to soothe and comfort him.

sourceRange.text: 尚書左丞司馬子瑞奏彈義雲，稱：「天保元年四月，竇氏皇姨祖載日，內外百官赴第吊省；義雲唯遣御史投名，身遂不赴。又義雲啟云：'喪婦孤貧。後娶李世安女為妻。世安身雖父服未終，其女為祖已就平吉，特乞暗迎，不敢備禮。'及義雲成婚之夕，眾禮備設，克日拜閣；鳴騶清路，盛列羽儀；兼差台吏二十人，責其鮮服，侍從車後。直是苟求成婚，誣罔幹上。義雲資產宅宇，足稱豪室，忽通孤貧，亦為矯詐。又駕幸晉陽，都坐判：'拜起居表，四品以下五品以上，令預前一日赴南都署表；三品以上，臨日署訖。'義雲乃乖例，署表之日，索表就家先署，臨日遂稱私忌不來。」於是詔付廷尉科罪。尋敕免推。子瑞又奏彈義雲事十餘條，多煩碎，罪止罰金，不至除免。
